rules.effect: On a bonus action, you can make an additional melee attack if your hit point total is less than half of its maximum. This attack uses your highest ability modifier.
rules.drawback: You must use your bonus action for this attack and it cannot be used with other features that grant extra attacks.

abilities.warioNote: Need more damage? This one's for you! Just remember, you can't use it all day long!

abilities.name: Double Tap
abilities.description: Fire two additional rounds from a firearm as a bonus action.
abilities.apReason: This ability grants a reliable combat edge at level 1, costing only one Ability Point.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocks early to leverage the Gunslinger's primary weapon proficiency at level 1.

rules.effect: When you make a ranged attack with a firearm, you can fire two additional rounds as a bonus action. You must have ammunition for each round fired.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you are incapacitated or restrained.

abilities.warioNote: It's just two extra shots, what could go wrong? Right?

abilities.name: Commanding Gaze
abilities.description: You command allies within sight, granting them advantage on attack rolls and saving throws for the next minute.
abilities.apReason: A level 1 ability that offers immediate tactical advantage at no cost.
abilities.levelReason: A level 1 Leader is starting to find their voice in combat.

rules.effect: All allies within range gain advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of your next turn. The effect ends early if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: You must use a bonus action each round to maintain this effect.

abilities.warioNote: It’s like giving your friends superpowers, but you have to keep waving your hand!

abilities.name: Cheap Brew
abilities.description: Craft a simple potion that heals 1d4+Charisma modifier hit points.
abilities.apReason: Crafting a potion is useful but limited to basic remedies, costing one AP.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners can start crafting basic remedies with limited resources.

rules.effect: DC 8 + proficiency + Charisma modifier save for half effect; ends on a successful save.
rules.drawback: Cannot create potions of higher tier than this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Cheap Brew? Why not just buy a potion from me for only 1 AP? Save your gold!

abilities.name: Reload Swiftly
abilities.description: Quickly reload a simple weapon, gaining an additional shot before your next action.
abilities.apReason: Provides a combat edge, unlocking at the start of training.
abilities.levelReason: A basic militia can perform quick reloads as part of their training.

rules.effect: You gain an additional attack with a simple weapon before your next action. You must have at least one hand free to reload.
rules.drawback: You cannot reload or attack again until after your next action.

abilities.warioNote: These toads might be slow, but they can still pack a punch quick as a wink!

abilities.name: Divine Shield Wall
abilities.description: Create a wall of holy energy that grants you and an ally within 5 feet a +2 bonus to AC until the end of your next turn.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities should cost 1 AP, and this provides a significant defensive boost.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins can create protective effects early in their career.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You and an ally within 5 feet gain a +2 bonus to AC until the end of your next turn. This ends if you move more than 10 feet away from the target ally.
rules.drawback: The wall can only protect one target at a time.

abilities.warioNote: For just a buck? You get to turn yourself into a shield! Who needs armor anyway?

abilities.name: Rampage Charge
abilities.description: On your bonus action, charge into combat and deal an extra 1d6 damage with your next melee attack.
abilities.apReason: Rampage Charge provides a significant combat advantage for a single action point, making it cost-effective at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 1 allows for early engagement in combat.

rules.effect: On the next melee attack, deal an extra 1d6 damage. Ends when you make another melee attack or disengage.
rules.drawback: Cannot be activated if you are already charging.

abilities.warioNote: For just one AP, you get to charge into battle like a rampaging beast! What more could you ask?

abilities.name: Arcane Veil
abilities.description: Create a shimmering mist that grants temporary cover and conceals your movements.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 ability that provides a temporary area effect at will with a drawback.
abilities.levelReason: Wizards at level 1 begin to experiment with basic illusions.

rules.effect: You create a shimmering veil that provides you and willing creatures within 5 feet of you total cover. The effect ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: While under the effect, you have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and saving throws.

abilities.warioNote: $1 AP? It's like having an invisible friend to hide you from danger!

abilities.name: Sharpshooter's Edge
abilities.description: Gain advantage on attack rolls with ranged weapons for 1 minute.
abilities.apReason: A bonus action that provides a significant combat advantage at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: Fights need to be able to improve their attacks early in the game.

rules.effect: Gain advantage on attack rolls with ranged weapons. Ends when you make an attack roll without advantage or if your concentration is broken.
rules.drawback: You cannot gain the benefit of Sharpshooter's Edge for 1 hour after taking damage.

abilities.warioNote: It's like aiming with both eyes wide open, but only once you’ve been hit today!

abilities.name: Divine Vigilance
abilities.description: Gain advantage on saving throws and attack rolls while within 30 feet of an ally.
abilities.apReason: Gives consistent support to an ally without requiring concentration or other resources.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins start combat with a reliable edge for their allies.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You and an ally within 30 feet gain advantage on saving throws and attack rolls. This ends when you move more than 30 feet away from the ally.
rules.drawback: Only one ally can benefit at a time.

abilities.warioNote: It’s like having a little guardian angel watching over your friend!

abilities.name: Shadowstep Sneak
abilities.description: You can move up to your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
abilities.apReason: Provides a significant advantage for movement and stealth at level one, justifying the cost of 1 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Rogues need basic movement advantages at level one.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and do not provoke opportunity attacks until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You must make a concentration check (DC 10 + proficiency + Dexterity modifier) to maintain this effect.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! For only 1 AP, you can slip away like you're invisible. But don't get cocky—concentration slips are a pain!

abilities.name: Furious Roar
abilities.description: Roar at enemies, forcing them to make a saving throw or be knocked prone.
abilities.apReason: A level 1 ability that provides a combat advantage with a moderate drawback.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians gain the ability to inspire fear early in their training.

rules.effect: DC 8 + Strength modifier (save DC) - On a failed save, targets are knocked prone and must make another saving throw at the start of their turn or remain prone.
rules.drawback: Cannot target the same creature more than once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Forces 'em to the ground! Can't say no to that!

abilities.name: Arcane Tempest
abilities.description: Call forth a swirling storm of arcane energy to disrupt enemies within range.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities provide a reliable edge in combat for new spellcasters.
abilities.levelReason: Beginning spellcasters can focus their will into a minor tactical disruption.

rules.effect: Creatures within the area must make a DC 8 + Intelligence modifier + proficiency save or be disoriented until the end of their next turn. On a save success, they are unaffected.
rules.drawback: You cannot use Arcane Tempest again until after completing a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, sure! Watch your wallet fly away with this little gust of power!

abilities.name: Swift Blade
abilities.description: On your bonus action, you can make an additional attack with a weapon you are proficient in.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities provide a small reliable edge at low levels.
abilities.levelReason: At level 1, fighters start to learn how to quickly follow up their initial attacks.

rules.effect: You gain an additional attack with a weapon you are proficient in. This attack uses your proficiency bonus and your Strength modifier.
rules.drawback: If the extra attack hits, it deals non-lethal damage.

abilities.warioNote: For just a buck? You get to hit twice! What a steal!

abilities.name: Rapid Sight
abilities.description: On your turn, you gain advantage on your first attack roll against a target within your line of sight.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities provide small reliable edges, and this one enhances the first attack roll in combat.
abilities.levelReason: Enhances combat effectiveness by providing an early advantage.

rules.range: line of sight to the target
rules.effect: You gain advantage on your first attack roll against a creature within your line of sight. This effect ends when you make that attack.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if you are blinded or have disadvantage on perception checks.

abilities.warioNote: It's like getting a second look at your target before you shoot. What could be better?

abilities.name: Inspire Charge
abilities.description: On your charge, an ally within 5 feet can make a bonus attack.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge for a level 1 ability, enhancing combat during an early charge.
abilities.levelReason: A Leader's first ability to enhance combat effectiveness during their initial forays into battle.

rules.effect: An ally touches you during your charge to gain advantage on one attack roll this turn. Ends when the ally makes their attack.
rules.drawback: You cannot use Inspire Charge more than once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: It's just a little zap of motivation—how hard can it be? *sneer*

abilities.name: Quick Brew
abilities.description: Create a simple potion at will, providing a minor benefit or healing.
abilities.apReason: Level 1-4 abilities provide reliable small edges at low cost.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners often need to quickly remedy small injuries or emergencies.

rules.effect: Create a potion that heals 1d4+Con modifier hit points. The effect ends when consumed.
rules.drawback: The potion is of poor quality, and consuming it has a -2 penalty to any ability check or saving throw made within the next hour.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it’s quick, but is it worth risking your next few rolls? You get what you pay for with this one!

abilities.name: Sentinel Shield
abilities.description: Increase your shield's AC by 2 until the start of your next turn.
abilities.apReason: Boosting AC on a reaction is a valuable defensive option for a level 1 character.
abilities.levelReason: Basic training in defensive techniques allows you to boost your shield's effectiveness temporarily.

rules.duration: until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: Increase your AC by 2 until your next turn. Ends if you take damage before then.
rules.drawback: You can only use Sentinel Shield once per round.

abilities.warioNote: Guardian Stance? Hardly! Sentinel Shield's the real deal, toad!

abilities.name: Tool Shield
abilities.description: While holding an artisan tool, gain a +1 bonus to AC as long as you use it for defense.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge that enhances utility at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans often rely on tools for both offense and defense.

rules.duration: until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: You gain a +1 bonus to AC as long as you are holding an artisan tool for defense.
rules.drawback: You cannot wield any weapon while using this feature.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it's just a little shield made of tools, but it'll definitely make you feel like a true artisan!

abilities.name: Sacred Barrier
abilities.description: Create a shimmering shield of holy light that absorbs one attack or deals radiant damage to an attacker.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities provide a reliable edge, and this divine ability offers protection against attacks.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins can protect themselves from the first threats at level 1.

rules.duration: until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: When an attacker hits you with a melee attack, you can activate this to absorb the attack and instead take 1d8 radiant damage. DC 8 + Proficiency + Wisdom modifier as saving throw.
rules.drawback: You cannot use Sacred Barrier again until after completing a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: It's just a little shield... but it packs one heck of a punch!

abilities.name: Shade Strike
abilities.description: Emerge from shadows to deliver a precise, nonlethal strike.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 ability providing combat utility at no cost.
abilities.levelReason: Rogues gain the ability to perform quick, silent attacks at level 1.

rules.effect: You make a melee attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage and is blinded until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: The target can make a Wisdom saving throw to end this effect on itself.

abilities.warioNote: For just one AP, you get to be sneaky and strike twice! What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Mirage Veil
abilities.description: Create a shifting mirage to confuse foes, reducing their attack rolls by 2 until they succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw.
abilities.apReason: A combat-focused ability that provides a reliable edge at level 1 without overpowered effects.
abilities.levelReason: A basic ability for beginners to start confusing enemies early in the game.

rules.duration: Up to 1 minute or until you use this feature again
rules.effect: Enemies within range have their attack rolls reduced by 2. Ends when they succeed on a DC 10 Wis saving throw.
rules.drawback: You must be seen for the mirage to work; otherwise, it fails.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, Mirage Veil! It's like looking through a funhouse mirror... but with real consequences!

abilities.name: Reckless Strike
abilities.description: Gain +1d6 damage on your next attack, but you must attack the closest target.
abilities.apReason: A reliable combat ability that gives fighters a small edge at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocks at level 1 to give new fighters a reliable edge in combat.

rules.effect: On your next melee attack, you deal an additional 1d6 damage. You must target the closest enemy to yourself.
rules.drawback: You cannot choose a specific target for this attack.

abilities.warioNote: For just a single Ability Point, you get to hit harder... but only the closest thing in front of you! What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Quickfire Volley
abilities.description: Fire three rounds in quick succession, dealing extra damage on a critical hit.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge at low levels that allows quick follow-up shots in combat.
abilities.levelReason: The Gunslinger gains the precision and speed to unleash rapid fire shots early in their training.

rules.effect: On a successful hit, deal an additional 1d6 damage. The bonus action cannot be used if the Gunslinger is incapacitated.
rules.drawback: Cannot use while reloading or if out of ammunition.

abilities.warioNote: For a few coins, you get to unload three rounds faster than your buddy. What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Nightshade Cloak
abilities.description: You become nearly invisible for a moment, granting advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge for level 1 that offers a significant benefit to the Spy's role.
abilities.levelReason: Spies often need to move unseen during their missions.

rules.duration: 1 minute, or until you take a major action
rules.effect: You gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Ends if you attack.
rules.drawback: You must remain still while using this ability.

abilities.warioNote: For all the sneaking you do, it’s only worth one AP? You’re lucky I’m selling this at all!

abilities.name: Charge Boost
abilities.description: Grant an ally within 10 feet a +2 bonus to their speed on their next turn.
abilities.apReason: Provides an immediate combat advantage at low cost.
abilities.levelReason: New leaders benefit from enhancing their allies early in combat.

rules.duration: Until the end of the next turn for an ally
rules.effect: Choose one willing ally within range. That target gains a +2 bonus to their speed on its next turn.
rules.drawback: You must be able to see and reach the chosen ally.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it’s just a little boost... but now they’ll be running around like maniacs!

abilities.name: Brew Tonic
abilities.description: Concoct a restorative potion to heal yourself or an ally for 1d4+2 hit points.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities should be small reliable edges that cost little AP to use frequently.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners can start experimenting with simple remedies early on.

rules.effect: DC 8 + proficiency + Wisdom modifier; on a success, the target regains 1d4+2 hit points.
rules.drawback: The potion is weak and only restores a small amount of hit points.

abilities.warioNote: Tonic ain't magic, it's just... water with a splash of something. But hey, it works!

abilities.name: War Cry
abilities.description: Shout your defiance, forcing nearby foes to save or flinch from your ferocious roar.
abilities.apReason: A reliable combat maneuver that aids in short-term engagements without overpowered effects.
abilities.levelReason: Basic training allows militia to bolster their courage and that of allies.

rules.effect: Each creature within 30 feet must make a DC 8 + Proficiency + Con modifier Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the start of your next turn. Effect ends on a successful save.
rules.drawback: You and allies within range take disadvantage on attack rolls while this is active.

abilities.warioNote: War Cry? Sure, it's loud... but it's gotta be heard to be feared!

abilities.name: Toolcraft Focus
abilities.description: Temporarily enhance your tools, granting a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls for one turn.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge for a level 1 ability, enhancing immediate combat effectiveness.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans begin their training with basic tool proficiency.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with tools. This ends when you stop using tools in combat.
rules.drawback: You must use at least one tool as an action each round until Toolcraft Focus ends.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Need that extra push to land that critical hit? Just $500 in AP! What could be better?

abilities.name: Shroudstep
abilities.description: Blends into shadows, granting advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge for stealth that unlocks at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: Rogues start by blending with their environment for subtle advantages.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until the rogue moves more than 30 feet
rules.effect: The rogue has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Ends when the duration expires or the rogue moves more than 30 feet.
rules.drawback: While active, the rogue must remain in shadowy conditions.

abilities.warioNote: It's like a cloak of invisibility... but only if you're already sneaky. Worth every AP!

abilities.name: Raging Charge
abilities.description: On a successful melee attack, gain advantage on your next attack roll.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities provide a small reliable edge in combat encounters, making Raging Charge cost 1 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians benefit from this ability early to enhance their combat prowess.

rules.duration: until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: After making a successful melee attack, you gain advantage on one attack roll before your next turn ends.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability more than once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Pfft! This one’s cheap as dirt. Watch your back after that first charge!

abilities.name: Raging Overload
abilities.description: Gain +2d10 temporary hit points until you take damage or are knocked prone.
abilities.apReason: Leverages a low-level Fighter's burst combat ability while fitting their role and hit die.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters start combat encounters with a burst of raw power.

rules.duration: until you take damage or are knocked prone
rules.effect: You gain +2d10 temporary hit points. This effect ends when you take damage or are knocked prone.
rules.drawback: +1 exhaustion level at the start of your next short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Rushing into battle? Now you can, with this little pill! Watch as you pack on extra durability. But don't overdo it; you’ll be running on fumes faster than you can say 'overload'.

abilities.name: Rapid Twitch
abilities.description: On your bonus action, reload one firearm as a free attack.
abilities.apReason: It provides a combat utility at low cost, allowing for quick engagement in melee after reloading.
abilities.levelReason: Gunslingers often need to reload quickly in combat.

rules.effect: Reload one firearm as a free attack. The firearm must be out of ammunition, and you make an attack roll with the firearm.
rules.drawback: You can only use this ability once per turn.

abilities.warioNote: Oh, you think that reload trick is fast? Try doing it while dodging bullets yourself!

abilities.name: Shadowslip Step
abilities.description: Merge with shadows to move unseen, ending when struck or an area changes.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge that allows for quick and silent movement.
abilities.levelReason: Spies must navigate and observe without being detected.

rules.duration: until struck, environment changes, or a short rest
rules.effect: You become invisible until you are hit or the area's light level changes. A successful DC 8 Dexterity saving throw ends this effect early.
rules.drawback: While unseen, you have disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

abilities.warioNote: See how much easier it is to sell secrets when no one can see you sneaking around!

abilities.name: Inspiring Shout
abilities.description: Shout to bolster allies within earshot, granting them temporary hit points.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities provide a reliable edge that costs one AP, making this a solid choice for new Leaders.
abilities.levelReason: Leaders start by inspiring their allies with a simple shout.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you use this feature again
rules.effect: Allies within 30 feet gain 2d8 temporary hit points. Save DC 8 + your Charisma modifier.
rules.drawback: You must be able to speak and hear clearly.

abilities.warioNote: It's just a shout, but it packs quite the punch! Only wish it came with a free soda.

abilities.name: Feral Leap
abilities.description: Leap into battle, dealing damage to all enemies within reach.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 ability that provides immediate combat advantage at a reasonable cost.
abilities.levelReason: Unlockable at level 1 for immediate combat utility.

rules.effect: When you take the Dash action on your turn, you and all creatures within 5 feet of you can make a melee attack as a bonus action. This effect ends when you miss with an attack made during this reaction.
rules.drawback: You must have disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn.

abilities.warioNote: Leap into battle, deal some damage—what more could you ask for? *cough* $30 *cough*

abilities.name: Divine Aura
abilities.description: You radiate a holy light that grants temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1) to allies within 10 feet.
abilities.apReason: Provides significant healing and support at level 1, costing minimal Ability Points.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins can provide immediate healing and support at level 1.

rules.effect: All allies within range gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier (min 1). Ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: You must complete a short rest before using this ability again.

abilities.warioNote: Alright, okay... it's not a shield, but it’s still pretty cool. You get to heal your friends! Just don’t use it too much or you’ll run out of juice.

abilities.name: Shadowslice
abilities.description: Disappear into shadowy mist, then reappear behind an enemy to deal bonus damage.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge for a level 1 Rogue to exploit stealth more effectively.
abilities.levelReason: Allows Rogues to exploit shadows for tactical advantage early in their career.

rules.duration: until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: You become invisible until your next turn. When you attack an enemy, it has disadvantage on its next saving throw or ability check. This effect ends if you leave your shadowy form.
rules.drawback: While in shadowy form, you have disadvantage on all attacks and ability checks.

abilities.warioNote: So ya wanna be sneaky? Well, this’ll make yer stealth game ten times better—for just one AP! What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Feral Snarl
abilities.description: Unleash a primal scream that intimidates enemies within 30 feet, forcing them to make a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 round.
abilities.apReason: Feral Snarl provides an immediate combat advantage at level 1, justifying a cost of 1 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians can unleash their rage early in the fight with this simple but effective ability.

rules.effect: DC 8 + proficiency + Wisdom modifier; on a failed save, target is frightened until the start of its next turn or until it takes damage.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if already frightened.

abilities.warioNote: For 1 AP? You get to scare your enemies half to death! What more could you ask for?

abilities.name: Arcane Snare
abilities.description: Cast an invisible, sticky web to entangle creatures in your way.
abilities.apReason: A basic utility spell that requires minimal effort for its level.
abilities.levelReason: Unleashes basic defensive capabilities early on.

rules.effect: DC 10 + Intelligence modifier (Dexterity saving throw); targets slowed until freed by a creature or with an action.
rules.drawback: The web is visible to creatures with blindsight.

abilities.warioNote: It's like catching flies, but for adventurers—so much fun!

abilities.name: Steel Dash
abilities.description: Dash up to your speed +5 feet, gaining advantage on attacks until you move less than half your speed.
abilities.apReason: A minor tactical edge that scales with level and character movement ability.
abilities.levelReason: A level 1 Fighter can use their movement for a tactical edge without sacrificing attack rolls.

rules.duration: until you move less than half your speed or until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: You gain advantage on melee attack rolls. This ends when you move less than half your speed.
rules.drawback: While gaining advantage, you can only move up to half your speed.

abilities.warioNote: For just a few coins, turn your clumsy dashes into deadly strikes!

abilities.name: Divine Mark
abilities.description: Targeted a foe with a holy mark, forcing it to make a saving throw or become frightened until the end of its turn.
abilities.apReason: A reliable combat maneuver that provides a short-term battlefield advantage at level 4.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins can reliably target foes and apply pressure at this level.

rules.duration: Until the end of the marked creature's turn
rules.uses: Once per short or long rest
rules.effect: The target must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is frightened until the end of its next turn.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used on creatures immune to fear.

abilities.warioNote: Why pay more? This mark is as sharp as my shoelaces!

abilities.name: Shade Slide
abilities.description: You can slip through shadows, using them to move silently and avoid detection.
abilities.apReason: At level 4, this provides a reliable edge that helps Rogues remain undetected and mobile in stealthy situations, costing only one AP.
abilities.levelReason: At level 4, Rogues have the mobility and stealth necessary for this ability to be effective in combat.

rules.effect: You gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Until the start of your next turn, you can move through non-magical darkness and difficult terrain as if it were normal terrain. This effect ends when you attack or cast a spell.
rules.drawback: While using this ability, you have disadvantage on Strength (Athletics) checks.

abilities.warioNote: Need to stay quiet? This'll help you slip past those pesky guards without making a sound! But don't overdo it—too much movement will make your presence known!

abilities.name: Berserker Slam
abilities.description: Deal an extra 1d6 bludgeoning damage on your first attack of the turn.
abilities.apReason: Level 4 abilities provide a small reliable edge, and this is a combat-focused boost that increases damage output on the first hit of the turn.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians can reliably land a powerful opening strike by level 4.

rules.effect: When you make an attack with a melee weapon as part of the Attack action, add 1d6 bludgeoning damage to the attack roll. This effect ends if you miss the target or do not deal any damage.
rules.drawback: You can only use this ability once per turn.

abilities.warioNote: For just one AP, you get to go boom! First swing's the count!

abilities.name: Spellweave Shield
abilities.description: Summon a shimmering barrier that grants temporary hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier when you cast a spell.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge, providing defensive capabilities at the cost of one AP, which fits the low-tier level 3 ability.
abilities.levelReason: Wizards gain access to more complex spells at level 3, making this shield both defensive and synergistic with their core abilities.

rules.effect: You gain temporary hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier. This effect ends if you lose consciousness or if you use another spell.
rules.drawback: The barrier is weak against magical attacks; it offers no resistance to spells.

abilities.warioNote: It's just a shield, but it costs extra! Learn to budget those APs wisely!

abilities.name: Brawling Boost
abilities.description: Gain a +1 bonus to all unarmed strike damage rolls.
abilities.apReason: Provides a reliable edge in close combat at this level.
abilities.levelReason: Unarmed strikes are often used by fighters, even at this early level.

rules.effect: When making an unarmed strike, add +1 to the damage roll. Ends when you make a melee weapon attack.
rules.drawback: Cannot use Brawling Boost while wearing armor that restricts movement.

abilities.warioNote: It's like getting an extra punch in your glove—just don't go too hard on the padding!

abilities.name: Sniper's Peek
abilities.description: Gain advantage on one ranged attack roll per short rest, but your next movement action this turn is Halved.
abilities.apReason: A low-tier combat ability that grants a reliable edge with a small cost.
abilities.levelReason: Allows the Gunslinger to take a reliable edge at a key moment in combat.

rules.effect: You gain advantage on one ranged attack roll. On your next movement action this turn, you are Halved in speed.
rules.drawback: Your subsequent movement is significantly slower, leaving you vulnerable to attacks of opportunity.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Want the shot of the century? You’ll be walking like an old man after. But it’s worth it, right?

abilities.name: Resolve Boost
abilities.description: Grant a temporary boost to a comrade's resolve, granting advantage on one saving throw.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge that provides significant support at low cost.
abilities.levelReason: Leader abilities become more impactful as they gain experience and command presence.

rules.duration: 1 round per point of temporary hit points granted
rules.effect: Target gains advantage on one saving throw. Ends when the target no longer has temporary hit points.
rules.drawback: You must use your action to focus and reinforce the boost.

abilities.warioNote: For just a buck, you get a buck's worth of resolve! Can't beat that kind of value!

abilities.name: Tonic Throw
abilities.description: Shake an improvised potion and throw it, granting a temporary boost to your next attack roll.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge in combat for level 4, granting advantage on an attack roll.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners unlock reliable combat abilities later in training.

rules.duration: until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: You gain advantage on your next attack roll. The effect ends if you take damage before attacking.
rules.drawback: The potion is a one-time use and may have unintended effects, like causing minor intoxication.

abilities.warioNote: It's just a shake and a throw! What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Mighty Charge
abilities.description: On your move, you can charge into battle, giving you advantage on your first attack roll.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge for combat support at this level.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 4 allows for reliable bonus action attacks to support the team.

rules.effect: On your move, you can use this ability. When you do so, you gain advantage on the first attack roll made during that move.
rules.drawback: You must make a melee attack with a simple weapon as part of the bonus action.

abilities.warioNote: Oh, mighty indeed! For just one AP, you can turn your charge into a critical hit!

abilities.name: Tool Finesse
abilities.description: Increase your tool proficiency check by 2d6.
abilities.apReason: Provides a small reliable edge in tool-based tasks at level 4.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans need a reliable edge in tool-based tasks early on.

rules.effect: When you make an ability check using a tool, add 2d6 to the roll. This effect ends when you finish a short rest.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if you are incapacitated.

abilities.warioNote: Who needs a toolbox? Just a little finesse and these AP go straight to your pocket!

abilities.name: Heavenly Shield
abilities.description: Gain a +1 bonus to AC and deal an additional 1d6 radiant damage on melee attacks.
abilities.apReason: Changes one encounter beat and provides significant combat benefit at level 7, costing two Ability Points.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins gain the ability to enhance their defenses and attacks with divine power at this level.

rules.effect: Gain a +1 bonus to AC and deal an additional 1d6 radiant damage on melee attacks. Ends when you are no longer within 30 feet of a lawful creature.
rules.drawback: You must be within 30 feet of a lawful creature to maintain the effect.

abilities.warioNote: Watch those chaotic bastards squirm! You’ll be radiating so much power they won’t know what hit them!

abilities.name: Raging Blitz
abilities.description: In one turn, you unleash a frenzied flurry of attacks dealing extra damage to your target.
abilities.apReason: Level 6 abilities typically cost 2 AP for moderate combat changes and this ability boosts damage output significantly in one round.
abilities.levelReason: At level 6, Barbarians can sustain more powerful combat maneuvers that change an encounter beat.

rules.effect: You make two additional melee attacks as a bonus action. If you hit, the target takes an extra 2d6 damage.
rules.drawback: On your next turn after using Raging Blitz, you move at half speed.

abilities.warioNote: It's like buying a ticket to chaos! Watch your step, or you might trip over the extra attacks!

abilities.name: Rallying Strike
abilities.description: Make a powerful attack that inspires allies within reach, forcing enemies to focus on you.
abilities.apReason: Provides a significant combat boost with a moderate cost, fitting its mid-tier level and role support.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters at level 6 are ready for more dynamic combat roles that include support and short-term battlefield control.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you attack again
rules.effect: You make a melee weapon attack against an enemy within reach. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 damage and is incapacitated until the start of your next turn (DC 13 Constitution saving throw ends this effect). Allies within close range gain advantage on their attacks until the end of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you are incapacitated.

abilities.warioNote: It's like buying a house pet that turns into a guard dog... for a minute!

abilities.name: Rapid Fire
abilities.description: Deal an additional bullet as a bonus action with a firearm, but reduce its accuracy.
abilities.apReason: Provides moderate combat utility at a reasonable cost for mid-tier play.
abilities.levelReason: Allows the Gunslinger to maintain high attack frequency without overloading on actions.

rules.effect: You make an additional attack with a firearm as a bonus action. The attack has disadvantage due to increased risk of misfire.
rules.drawback: The additional bullet reduces the accuracy of your firearm attacks.

abilities.warioNote: It's like getting that extra shot in, but with less precision. Perfect for those close encounters!

abilities.name: Stealth Brew
abilities.description: Concoct a potion that grants you advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks for 1 hour.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a reliable edge at low levels but has a cost that keeps it balanced.
abilities.levelReason: Spies require reliable tools to gain information, and this potion provides an edge in stealth.

rules.uses: at will (must spend a short rest before using again)
rules.effect: You gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks until the start of your next turn after drinking this potion. This effect ends if you take any action other than movement.
rules.drawback: The potion is temporary and requires a short rest to use again, limiting its effectiveness in prolonged engagements.

abilities.warioNote: It's just a little potion, but it sure makes you invisible for an hour! What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Commanding Rally
abilities.description: Inspire allies within 30 feet with a commanding call, granting them advantage on attack rolls for the next minute.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a party-wide buff, making it impactful at level 9 and costing 3 AP for its power.
abilities.levelReason: Leadership abilities become more potent as they unlock, providing game-changing support at this level.

rules.effect: All allies within range gain advantage on attack rolls. Ends if the Leader is incapacitated or falls unconscious.
rules.drawback: The Leader must use an action to dismiss this effect early.

abilities.warioNote: It’s like buying a whole army with just one coin! But that coin sure feels heavy.

abilities.name: Poison Brew
abilities.description: Create a vial of poison that deals 1d6 poison damage on contact.
abilities.apReason: Creating an effective poison is useful but requires precision and skill, thus costing two AP.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners can afford to learn how to create basic poisons at this level.

rules.effect: When used, you create a vial of poison that deals 1d6 poison damage to the target. The effect ends when the vial is used.
rules.drawback: If you fail a DC 10 Medicine check, the poison is ineffective.

abilities.warioNote: Poison brew? Sure, for a price. You get what you pay for... or don't.

abilities.name: Rallying Salute
abilities.description: Blast a morale-boosting signal, forcing nearby allies to fight harder and gain temporary hit points.
abilities.apReason: Moderate leadership boost at an appropriate cost for a mid-tier ability.
abilities.levelReason: Militia can now inspire their comrades with a commanding call.

rules.effect: Each ally within 30 feet must make a DC 8 + proficiency + Charisma modifier Wisdom saving throw. On a success, they gain 2d6 temporary hit points and become charmed by you until the end of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you are incapacitated or have used it within the last round.

abilities.warioNote: It's just a little trumpet, but trust me, it can turn the tide of battle!

abilities.name: Forge Shield
abilities.description: Create a temporary shield of malleable metal to block an attack.
abilities.apReason: Level 5 with moderate defensive benefits and limited uses per rest justifies a cost of 2 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans can now defend against attacks with their crafting skills.

rules.effect: You create a shield made of malleable metal. This provides a +2 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn; you must make an Intelligence saving throw with a DC equal to 8 + proficiency modifier + Intelligence modifier. On a failed save, the shield crumbles and offers no benefit.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again until after a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: For less than the price of lunch, get a shield that’s stronger than most! But don’t abuse it; you’ll need to wait for your next break!

abilities.name: Radiant Guard
abilities.description: Create a shimmering barrier of holy light that absorbs one attack each turn.
abilities.apReason: Creating a defensive barrier that absorbs attacks is a moderate defensive maneuver requiring two AP points.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins unlock significant defensive abilities at level 8, enhancing their ability to absorb damage.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: When a creature attacks you, it must make a DC 12 + CHA modifier saving throw. On a failure, the attack deals no damage and you take half as much from any other source.
rules.drawback: You can only activate this ability once per turn.

abilities.warioNote: It’s like having a little shield fairy on your shoulder, but you have to pay for the magic!

abilities.name: Spellbook Boost
abilities.description: Increase the effectiveness of your next spell by adding your Intelligence modifier to its damage.
abilities.apReason: A bonus action with an immediate effect and at-will use justify a cost of one Ability Point.
abilities.levelReason: This ability enhances a critical moment in combat, unlocking at mid-level for impactful use.

rules.effect: When you cast a spell on your next turn after activating this ability, add your Intelligence modifier to the spell’s damage roll.
rules.drawback: You must prepare for the increased risk of overloading your spellcasting focus.

abilities.warioNote: It's like giving your spells a little power-up before they go into battle!

abilities.name: Rampage Slash
abilities.description: Unleash a flurry of strikes that bypass armor, dealing extra damage to armored foes.
abilities.apReason: The ability provides significant combat benefit, making it fair for two AP at mid-tier level.
abilities.levelReason: Rampage Slash provides a significant combat advantage suitable for mid-tier encounters.

rules.effect: You gain +2 to attack rolls and deal an additional 3d6 damage against armored targets. The effect ends if you miss or use a bonus action for another purpose.
rules.drawback: The bonus action used for Rampage Slash cannot be used for other abilities within the same round.

abilities.warioNote: Rampage Slash? Why pay extra when you can just buy a shield! But hey, it's got that 'extra' damage.

abilities.name: Slick Draw
abilities.description: Drawing your firearm with such speed it's almost invisible, allowing you to fire on reaction.
abilities.apReason: Provides a combat benefit at will with no cost, making it moderately powerful for an 8th-level ability.
abilities.levelReason: Gains the ability to draw and shoot firearms at an unprecedented rate.

rules.effect: When you are hit by a melee attack, as a reaction you can make a ranged weapon attack against the attacker. You have advantage on this attack if they are within 5 feet of you.
rules.drawback: You cannot use Slick Draw again until after completing a short or long rest.

abilities.warioNote: Saw that coming? With this trick, you can turn any fight around faster than they can say 'reload'!

abilities.name: Shade Sneak
abilities.description: You slip into a shadowy form, gaining advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks for one minute.
abilities.apReason: Provides a significant tactical advantage with a moderate drawback at this level.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, you gain the ability to manipulate shadows for tactical advantages in combat and infiltration.

rules.effect: You gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks until the start of your next turn after ending this effect. The effect ends if you are hit by an attack.
rules.drawback: While in shadowy form, you have disadvantage on attack rolls and cannot use any action that requires vision.

abilities.warioNote: This one’s worth every AP. Sneak past the guards like it's nobody's business!

abilities.name: Roaring Rally
abilities.description: Inspire allies within 30 feet, granting them advantage on saving throws until the end of your next turn.
abilities.apReason: This is a strong per-rest play that provides significant support, justifying the high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Leadership abilities at this level offer strong per-rest plays that bolster the party's resilience.

rules.duration: Until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: All allies within range gain advantage on saving throws. Ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: You must be conscious to activate this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Alright, here's some training that might actually save your party! Or at least give them a fighting chance. Pricey, but worth it!

abilities.name: Toad's Guile
abilities.description: Deceive foes and escape danger with the cunning of a toad, adding your Charisma modifier to Dexterity saving throws.
abilities.apReason: Requires strategic timing and adds significant value, fitting the mid-tier level.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners gain more nuanced skills as they grow in experience.

rules.effect: You can use your reaction to add half your Charisma modifier (rounded down) to any Dexterity saving throw you make. This effect ends when you take a long rest.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you are incapacitated or restrained.

abilities.warioNote: Selling toad's guile? Who needs a toad when I’ve got this!

abilities.name: Shoulder Slam
abilities.description: Shove an opponent back with a powerful shoulder charge, knocking them prone.
abilities.apReason: Requires a bonus action for situational combat utility, making it moderately valuable at level 6.
abilities.levelReason: Militia's mid-tier combat ability to alter the battlefield dynamically.

rules.effect: Make a Strength (Athletics) check against the target's AC. On success, knock the target prone. The effect ends when you miss or are hit.
rules.drawback: You must be in melee with the target and can only use this ability once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, you want to knock them down? For just two AP? Like that's hard!

abilities.name: Toolguardian
abilities.description: Activate your tools to form a temporary shield, deflecting up to two weapon attacks.
abilities.apReason: Moderate defensive boost with a cost that reflects its utility and limited uses per short rest.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans gain the ability to bolster their defenses with their tools at this level.

rules.effect: When you activate Toolguardian, choose up to two weapon attacks targeting you. You gain a +2 bonus to your AC against those attacks until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you are not holding any tools.

abilities.warioNote: These tools don’t just build stuff, they can save your life too! Priceless!

abilities.name: Holy Vow
abilities.description: By uttering a solemn vow, you grant allies within 30 feet advantage on saving throws until they succeed.
abilities.apReason: A powerful per-rest play ability that provides significant support to the party, justifying its high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins use this high-tier ability to bolster their allies in critical moments of combat.

rules.duration: until an ally succeeds on a saving throw
rules.effect: Allies within range gain advantage on saving throws. Effect ends when they succeed.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again until you finish a short or long rest.

abilities.warioNote: Watch your wallet! This one's a doozy, but it'll keep your allies safe in the heat of battle!

abilities.name: Shadowstep Dive
abilities.description: Leap into a shadowy dive, landing behind enemies for a guaranteed critical strike.
abilities.apReason: Requires precision and timing, making it a moderate tactical decision for mid-tier play.
abilities.levelReason: Rogues gain the ability to exploit shadows for deadly precision at this level.

rules.effect: When you take this action as a reaction, make a melee attack against an enemy within reach. If the attack hits, it is a critical hit.
rules.drawback: You must be unseen by the target to use this ability.

abilities.warioNote: It's like getting a free critical hit... as long as you’re not seen. What’s the point?

abilities.name: Feral Howl
abilities.description: Roar to terrify enemies within a 30-foot cone, forcing them to make Wisdom saves or be frightened.
abilities.apReason: Feral Howl provides moderate crowd control and encounter-changing potential for level 8 Barbarians, justifying its cost.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians gain the ability to unleash powerful attacks that can change an encounter beat mid-level.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you use another bonus action for this effect
rules.effect: All enemies within range must make a DC (8 + Proficiency + Wisdom modifier) Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, they are frightened until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again until you finish a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: This one’s a hoot! With Feral Howl, you can make your foes tremble in fear. Just don’t expect to use it twice quick!

abilities.name: Arcane Shadowstep
abilities.description: Teleport a short distance to evade an attack or slip through tight spaces.
abilities.apReason: Changes one encounter beat and requires careful timing, making it mid-tier for level 5.
abilities.levelReason: This mid-tier ability allows wizards to change the battlefield, shifting for evasion or positioning.

rules.effect: You teleport up to 20 feet away from a creature that has made an attack roll against you. The creature must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the start of its next turn.
rules.drawback: The spell leaves behind a faint shadow, giving nearby creatures advantage on Perception checks to locate your position.

abilities.warioNote: For those times when you can't afford a miss—pricey, but worth the risk!

abilities.name: Breach Strike
abilities.description: Unleash a devastating strike that bypasses one layer of armor or shield.
abilities.apReason: Requires significant precision and effort to bypass armor or shield.
abilities.levelReason: Requires the Fighter's expertise in martial strikes to land this powerful blow.

rules.effect: Make a melee attack against an enemy. If successful, you may bypass one layer of the target's armor or shield. Save DC = 8 + proficiency + Strength modifier.
rules.drawback: You must make a Strength saving throw (DC 10) at the start of your next turn; on failure, you are fatigued until you complete a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, now you can punch through someone’s defense. Just don't expect it every day!

abilities.name: Bullet Barrage
abilities.description: Fire a flurry of bullets, stunning nearby enemies and allies within your reach.
abilities.apReason: Strong burst combat ability requiring a significant resource for high-impact effects.
abilities.levelReason: Requires precise control and firepower mastery unlocked at high tiers.

rules.effect: You fire a barrage of bullets, forcing all creatures within 5 feet to make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or be stunned until the start of your next turn. You also gain advantage on attack rolls against stunned targets.
rules.drawback: The gun's overheating reduces your next action to reloading it.

abilities.warioNote: For those with the golden touch, this one's a real goldmine of firepower!

abilities.name: Ethereal Shadowstep
abilities.description: 在不触发任何感知或察觉检查的情况下，您可以在短距离内进行一次无声音步移。
abilities.apReason: 这是一个中期（5-8级）的能力，能够显著改变一次战斗的节奏，因此花费2个AP。
abilities.levelReason: 从潜行和信息收集的角度来看，到了8级，间谍可以更有效地利用他们的能力来避开敌人的视线。

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you move out of the area
rules.effect: You become invisible and silent for a short distance. You can use your movement to cross any terrain without triggering opportunity attacks, but you must end this effect if you attack or cast a spell.
rules.drawback: While using Ethereal Shadowstep, you are vulnerable to being targeted by divination spells.

abilities.warioNote: 嘿！你以为我只会卖那些普通的潜行技巧？看看这个，让你在战场上无声无息！

abilities.name: Commanding Resolve
abilities.description: Instill unwavering determination in allies, granting them advantage on saving throws against fear effects.
abilities.apReason: This high-tier leadership ability provides party-wide buffs with limited use per rest, justifying its cost.
abilities.levelReason: Leaders at this level can provide party-wide buffs that significantly alter encounters.

rules.duration: 1 minute per level of the Leader
rules.effect: All allies within 30 feet gain advantage on saving throws against being frightened. Ends when you use this ability again.
rules.drawback: You must make a Wisdom saving throw at DC 15 + your Charisma modifier; failure means the ability does not function.

abilities.warioNote: You think it’s just a little command? No, this is where you turn the tide of battle!

abilities.name: Stink Cloud
abilities.description: Release a noxious cloud that blinds enemies and leaves them reeling.
abilities.apReason: Provides moderate control and damage, changing one encounter beat at level 7.
abilities.levelReason: Changes one encounter beat by providing significant control and damage.

rules.effect: Enemies within a 10-foot radius must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or become blinded until the start of their next turn. The cloud dissipates after 1 minute.
rules.drawback: You must be proficient with improvised weapons to use this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Eww! Stink Cloud? You really want to buy that? It's like paying for a trash can!

abilities.name: Spearpoint Charge
abilities.description: On a successful attack, you push your foe back 10 feet. They must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw or fall prone.
abilities.apReason: Requires precision and timing, making it more impactful than a basic combat move at level 7.
abilities.levelReason: Militia gain the precision to drive foes back and create space in combat at this level.

rules.effect: On a hit, target is pushed 10 feet and must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw or fall prone. Effect ends if the target moves.
rules.drawback: You can only use this ability after taking damage in the same round.

abilities.warioNote: Spearpoint Charge? More like 'Spinepoint Slide' if you ask me. But hey, it's free!

abilities.name: Forge Ward
abilities.description: Create a shield of molten metal around yourself, granting temporary hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier x4.
abilities.apReason: Creating a shield of molten metal is a moderate defensive action that requires careful control and focus.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans can now bolster their defense in combat situations requiring immediate protection.

rules.effect: You gain temporary hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier x4. These disappear at the start of your next turn unless you make a DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Intelligence modifier Constitution saving throw.
rules.drawback: If your temporary hit points are reduced to 0, the effect ends immediately.

abilities.warioNote: You think you can just forge a shield with your wits? It’s not as easy as it looks!

abilities.name: Judgment Shield
abilities.description: Grant a divine shield to allies within 30 feet, absorbing damage equal to your Paladin level + Cha modifier before being reduced by half.
abilities.apReason: This is a strong per-rest play, providing significant party-wide buffs.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, Paladins seek powerful party-wide buffs for decisive moments.

rules.duration: Until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: All allies within range gain a bonus to AC equal to your Paladin level + Charisma modifier. This ends if you lose concentration (as if broken by an attack).
rules.drawback: You must finish a short or long rest before using this ability again.

abilities.warioNote: It’s like buying an army of shields—just one at a time!

abilities.name: Shadow Slide
abilities.description: On a successful Stealth check, you can slip through shadows to reposition yourself with advantage.
abilities.apReason: Provides a significant tactical advantage at mid-tier level, justifying a moderate AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Allows for significant battlefield positioning at an elite Rogue level.

rules.effect: You can use your reaction to move up to half your speed if you have advantage on the next Stealth check made immediately after.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used in direct sunlight or areas without shadows.

abilities.warioNote: Watch your step, Rogues! This one’s a slippery deal!

abilities.name: Feral Wrath
abilities.description: Roar to inspire allies within 30 feet, granting them advantage on attack rolls until they strike.
abilities.apReason: This leadership ability provides a strong per-rest play, making it level 10 and costing 3 AP.
abilities.levelReason: At level 10, the Barbarian seeks a powerful leadership ability that can turn the tide of battle.

rules.duration: until you or an ally strikes
rules.effect: All allies within range gain advantage on attack rolls until they make a melee attack. Ends when an ally attacks.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you are incapacitated.

abilities.warioNote: For just 3 AP, you get your friends fighting like they're untouchable! What could possibly go wrong?

abilities.name: Arcane Quill
abilities.description: Write a spell on a scroll that temporarily doubles its duration when cast.
abilities.apReason: Enhancing the effect of a spell with a bonus action for moderate utility.
abilities.levelReason: Mastery of quick and potent spells allows wizards to enhance their scrolls' effects.

rules.duration: instantaneous, effect lasts until the next long rest
rules.effect: Choose one spell from an expended spell slot that you have prepared. Until your next long rest, that spell's duration is doubled.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability on a cantrip.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it’s just a quill, but now your scrolls are twice as powerful! Or at least last twice as long... for a little extra.

abilities.name: Fury of Steel
abilities.description: Gain temporary hit points and a shield bonus to AC equal to your proficiency bonus for the duration.
abilities.apReason: Level 10 high-tier ability providing significant party-wide buffs and survivability, costing 3 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 10 provides a strong per-rest play that enhances survivability and offensive capabilities.

rules.duration: Until end of next long rest
rules.effect: Gain (Proficiency Bonus + 5) temporary hit points and a shield bonus to AC equal to your proficiency bonus.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if you have any class feature that grants similar benefits.

abilities.warioNote: It's like getting a shiny new shield AND a boost to your health—just don't go overboard or you'll need another nap!

abilities.name: Bullet Storm
abilities.description: Fire a volley of bullets that deals 2d6 fire damage to all creatures within 15 feet, forcing them to make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.
abilities.apReason: This powerful burst attack requires high-level play and resources to be effective, justifying a 3 AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Provides a strong burst attack suitable for a Gunslinger's high-damage build at this tier.

rules.effect: All creatures within 15 feet must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they are knocked prone and take 2d6 fire damage.
rules.drawback: You must reload your firearm for each use of this ability.

abilities.warioNote: I'd charge you extra for the reloading service, ya know!

abilities.name: Shadow Cloak
abilities.description: Instantly merge with shadows, granting +2 to Stealth checks for 1 minute.
abilities.apReason: Level 9 abilities provide strong per-rest buffs, making Shadow Cloak fit the high-tier balance expectations.
abilities.levelReason: At level 9, Spies can afford a strong per-rest buff that enhances their stealth capabilities.

rules.effect: Until the end of the duration, you gain +2 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This effect ends if your concentration is broken.
rules.drawback: If detected by a creature with darkvision or truesight while using this ability, it ends immediately.

abilities.warioNote: This one’s like a sneaky hug from the shadows! But watch out—once they catch your eye, you’re done for!

abilities.name: Streetwise Heist
abilities.description: Spot and disarm traps with uncanny accuracy, bypassing them instantly.
abilities.apReason: Requires a significant leap in stealthy acumen and an immediate use of a bonus action for such a risky maneuver.
abilities.levelReason: Requires a significant leap in stealthy acumen to pull off complex heists.

rules.effect: You bypass all traps and locks within reach on a successful Dexterity (Stealth) check, DC 15 + proficiency. The effect ends if you fail to maintain Stealth.
rules.drawback: If caught using this ability, you are considerednoticed by all present creatures.

abilities.warioNote: You think I'd sell you this? It's the kinda skill only Wario himself could pull off!

abilities.name: Tactical Shield
abilities.description: Gain a +1 bonus to AC and advantage on saving throws against fear and charm effects.
abilities.apReason: Moderate defensive boost with a limited use per long rest.
abilities.levelReason: Mid-tier combat utility for defensive encounters with magical threats.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You gain a +1 bonus to AC and advantage on saving throws against fear and charm effects. This ends when you take damage.
rules.drawback: If you are incapacitated, this ability is lost.

abilities.warioNote: You think that shield's gonna save you from my cheap shots? Try buying some armor instead!

abilities.name: Forge Bond
abilities.description: Create a temporary steel shield from your tools, granting you advantage on saving throws against being knocked prone.
abilities.apReason: Provides a moderate defensive boost that changes the encounter beat by granting advantage on prone saves.
abilities.levelReason: Allows the Artisan to protect themselves in combat by leveraging their tool proficiency.

rules.effect: You gain a +2 bonus to AC against being knocked prone until the start of your next turn. Ends if you lose access to tools or are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: The temporary shield can only be used once per short rest, and it requires your concentration.

abilities.warioNote: It's like wearing your toolbox as armor! Bet you didn't expect THAT!

abilities.name: Divine Retribution
abilities.description: Call down divine retribution upon a foe, dealing massive holy damage and blinding them.
abilities.apReason: This is an epic-level ability that requires careful planning and reserves its dramatic impact for one critical moment per session.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, Paladins can unleash powerful, epic moments that turn the tide of battle.

rules.effect: You target one creature within range. It must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded until the start of your next turn and take 5d12 radiant damage. The effect ends if you move more than 30 feet away from it.
rules.drawback: You must finish a short rest before using this ability again.

abilities.warioNote: Oh, you want to sell this? For 4 AP? You’re a fool if you think it’s worth anything less! It’s like getting hit by a bus... but with holy power!

abilities.name: Shadow Conjuration
abilities.description: Summons a spectral companion to fight at your side, granting temporary hit points equal to half your level.
abilities.apReason: Mid-tier combat utility that provides a moderate boost in HP and tactical flexibility at level 7.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, wizards can reliably summon an effective combatant to bolster their party.

rules.effect: You conjure a spectral familiar that grants you temporary hit points equal to half your level (rounded down). The familiar disappears at the end of its turn.
rules.drawback: The familiar cannot attack, but it can use its spectral form to evade attacks and is immune to non-magical damage.

abilities.warioNote: For the price of two AP, you get a little helper who can soak some hits! It's like having an extra arm... or a ghostly one.

abilities.name: Crimson Surge
abilities.description: Deal an extra 2d6 slashing damage on your first attack of the turn.
abilities.apReason: Crimson Surge provides significant combat prowess at level 12, justifying the cost of 3 AP.
abilities.levelReason: At level 12, fighters can unleash powerful per-rest plays that reshape encounters.

rules.effect: On your first attack of the turn, deal an extra 2d6 slashing damage to a target. This effect ends when you miss with this attack.
rules.drawback: You can only use this ability once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: For just a few gold, you get to hit harder! What's not to love?

abilities.name: Ethereal Escape
abilities.description: Teleport yourself to an unoccupied space within 30 feet, leaving a traceless shadow in your place.
abilities.apReason: A strong per-rest play ability at level 11 justifies a 3 AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Provides significant burst mobility for a spy at this level.

rules.effect: You teleport to an unoccupied space within 30 feet, leaving behind an invisible duplicate that lasts until the start of your next turn. The duplicate can be seen by creatures with blindsense.
rules.drawback: The shadow consumes your movement and cannot attack or interact with objects.

abilities.warioNote: Who needs a key when you can just slip through shadows!

abilities.name: Commanding Triumph
abilities.description: Lead your allies to victory with a roar that instills strength and resilience, granting temporary hit points.
abilities.apReason: This powerful leadership ability is costly and impactful, fitting for its placement at level 13.
abilities.levelReason: Epic leadership abilities grant one dramatic moment per session, making this unlock at level 13 appropriate.

rules.duration: Until the end of your next turn
rules.uses: Once per short or long rest
rules.effect: You gain 4d8 temporary hit points. If you are reduced to 0 hit points, this effect ends and you instead take 2d8 damage.
rules.drawback: If you fail a saving throw against an effect that would reduce your hit points to 0 or less, the temporary hit points gained from this ability are halved.

abilities.warioNote: It's like getting a second chance to win! But remember, Wario, you can only use it once before needing a long rest. So make it count!

abilities.name: Market Manipulation
abilities.description: Negotiate advantageous deals, boosting profits by +2d6 gold per day.
abilities.apReason: A strong one-time play that justifies the cost at level 9, providing meaningful burst.
abilities.levelReason: Provides a strong one-time social boost at the key level for party-wide benefits.

rules.duration: until end of next long rest
rules.effect: You gain advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks and can increase your daily profit by +2d6 gold. This ends when you complete a long rest.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used in combat or during dangerous negotiations.

abilities.warioNote: Don't waste this on useless battles! Use it to buy that extra potion!

abilities.name: Mass Shield Bash
abilities.description: Shout and bash, granting temporary hit points to allies within reach.
abilities.apReason: Mass effect with a strong support role, unlocking at high-tier level 9.
abilities.levelReason: Militia can now meaningfully support their team with a strong per-rest play.

rules.effect: All allies within 10 feet gain 3d6 temporary hit points. Ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: Reduces your own defenses by half for the duration.

abilities.warioNote: Yeah right... like I’m gonna let you have THIS power for just 3 AP! You gotta earn it!

abilities.name: Toolstorm
abilities.description: Summon a flurry of tools that deal 1d6 bludgeoning damage to all creatures within 5 feet and impose disadvantage on their next attack.
abilities.apReason: Toolstorm is a strong per-rest play ability that provides burst damage and debuffing potential, justifying the 3 AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Toolstorm provides a strong per-rest play, offering burst damage and debuffing potential at the expense of action economy.

rules.effect: Creatures in a 5-foot radius take 1d6 bludgeoning damage and have disadvantage on their next attack roll. Ends when the Toolstorm ends or if no creatures are within range.
rules.drawback: Requires using a bonus action, limiting its use in combat.

abilities.warioNote: Ah yes, Toolstorm! It's like raining tools on your enemies' heads. Priceless!

abilities.name: Divine Radiance
abilities.description: Deal radiant damage to all creatures within a 10-foot radius, forcing them to make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded until the start of your next turn.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic ability requires significant recovery and impact.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking epic moments for divine warriors.

rules.duration: Instantaneous, ends at the start of your next turn if a creature fails its save
rules.effect: You deal 8d6 radiant damage to all creatures in range. A creature must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw; on a failed save, it is blinded until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: After using this ability, you are exhausted until after you finish a long rest.

abilities.warioNote: For those moments when you need to dazzle 'em and amaze 'em! Pricey, but worth it for that one big scene!

abilities.name: Shadowstep Sabotage
abilities.description: Swap your next attack for a stealthy sabotage, damaging the target and denying it movement until the end of its turn.
abilities.apReason: A high-tier ability that offers both combat utility and a meaningful party-wide buff.
abilities.levelReason: Requires high precision and control typical of a well-rested rogue.

rules.effect: You make an attack against a creature you can reach. On a hit, it must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained until the end of its next turn and take 1d6 force damage.
rules.drawback: The target gains advantage on its movement-related checks for one minute.

abilities.warioNote: It’s like selling you the best stealthy sabotage... for just three Ability Points!

abilities.name: Feral Charge
abilities.description: On your movement, you can charge as a bonus action, gaining advantage on melee attacks until the start of your next turn.
abilities.apReason: This high-tier ability provides significant combat advantage and control, justifying the cost.
abilities.levelReason: Unleashing this power requires mastering the peak of berserker fury and stamina.

rules.duration: Until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: You gain advantage on melee attack rolls until the start of your next turn. Save DC 15 + Proficiency + Strength modifier.
rules.drawback: If you miss with a melee attack while under this effect, you must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or become Exhausted.

abilities.warioNote: For only 3 AP, it's like charging into battle with a tank! Or at least feeling like one.

abilities.name: Shroud of Misdirection
abilities.description: Create a deceptive illusion to mislead creatures within 30 feet, forcing them to make a saving throw or be confused for 1 round.
abilities.apReason: Requires precise timing and control to set up effectively, hence the mid-tier cost.
abilities.levelReason: Provides significant battlefield control suitable for mid-tier wizards.

rules.effect: DC 8 + Intelligence modifier. Creatures within range must make a save or become confused, disoriented for 1 round on a failed save.
rules.drawback: Cannot target creatures that have advantage on saving throws.

abilities.warioNote: This one’s tricky, but trust me: it’s worth every AP!

abilities.name: Rampage Finisher
abilities.description: Unleash a devastating strike against a single foe, dealing extra damage and leaving them stunned.
abilities.apReason: This epic-level ability requires a significant action and risk, offering a dramatic, one-time finisher for the encounter.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, fighters seek to deliver one definitive blow that can turn the tide of battle.

rules.effect: On a successful hit against an enemy, deal an extra 2d8 + Strength modifier damage and the target is stunned until their next turn.
rules.drawback: Failing to strike with this ability during your reaction means you lose your opportunity to react that round.

abilities.warioNote: For just four AP, it's like buying all the excitement of a boss fight... in a single card!

abilities.name: Silent Strike
abilities.description: On a successful sneak attack, your target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be rendered immobile for 1 round.
abilities.apReason: A high-tier ability providing burst, party-wide control - justifies 3 AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: High-tier ability providing strong control and burst damage at the Spy's peak skill.

rules.effect: Target must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or become immobilized for 1 round. Ends on a successful save.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if the target is aware of your presence.

abilities.warioNote: For those who think they're sneaky... try being a ghost!

abilities.name: Commanding Epic Roar
abilities.description: Erupt with a roar that terrifies foes and compels allies to greater heights, dealing damage and boosting nearby allies.
abilities.apReason: This epic-level leadership ability requires a significant cost to reflect its dramatic effect and limited use per day.
abilities.levelReason: At epic levels, leaders can command the battlefield in truly dramatic ways.

rules.effect: All allies within range gain advantage on attack rolls and saving throws. Enemies in the area take 4d8 psychic damage and are frightened (save DC 20 + Cha modifier) until end of their next turn.
rules.drawback: The user cannot move more than 10 feet or act for 1 round after using this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Alright, you got the best command in the shop! Just remember, only one time per day. You don't want to waste it on just anyone!

abilities.name: Toadstool Tonic
abilities.description: Consume a toadstool to gain temporary hit points equal to your level + Constitution modifier until you finish a short rest.
abilities.apReason: At level 10, this provides significant health restoration with a drawback that balances its power.
abilities.levelReason: At this tier, it provides meaningful burst health and is a strong per-rest play for the Commoner class.

rules.duration: until you finish a short rest
rules.effect: You gain temporary hit points equal to your level + your Constitution modifier.
rules.drawback: The toadstool is poisonous, and you must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15 + proficiency + Wisdom modifier) or suffer disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the effect ends.

abilities.warioNote: Toadstool Tonic? Sure! But it might just make you feel like a toad yourself!

abilities.name: Shield Wall Formation
abilities.description: Create a defensive barrier of shields, granting temporary hit points to nearby allies.
abilities.apReason: Level 10 ability providing a strong party-wide buff, justifying a higher AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Requires the strategic coordination typical for experienced militia members.

rules.range: Touch (up to three willing allies within 5 feet)
rules.effect: Each ally within the area gains 2d8 temporary hit points. Ends if you lose concentration or an ally moves more than 5 feet from the formation.
rules.drawback: You must be able to see all targets and they must be willing.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, now you can turn your friends into human shields! Just don't let them get too close to the frontlines.

abilities.name: Steel Tempest
abilities.description: Create a spinning whirlwind of sharp metal shards that damages enemies within its radius.
abilities.apReason: A high-tier ability with a strong, party-wide combat effect justifies a 3 AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans need a high-tier ability to provide strong party-wide damage in key moments.

rules.duration: Instantaneous, ends on your next turn if you move out of the area
rules.effect: You create a whirlwind of metal debris in a 15-foot radius around yourself. Each creature within it must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 4d6 slashing damage and be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You are vulnerable to the elemental damage type until the start of your next turn.

abilities.warioNote: For only 3 AP, you get to turn yourself into a living tornado! What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Judgment Bolt
abilities.description: Deal a searing bolt of divine energy, forcing the target to make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded until your next turn.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic, single-use ability demands significant resources to execute such a powerful divine judgment.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, Paladins can execute definitive judgments that reshape battles.

rules.duration: until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: A bolt of radiant energy strikes a creature within range. It must make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw, or be blinded until your next turn.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you are not proficient in martial weapons.

abilities.warioNote: For Wario, it's like buying the biggest, most dazzling fireworks—only these can blind your enemies! Priceless!

abilities.name: Shadowweave
abilities.description: Instantly cloak yourself and one ally in shadow, granting both complete stealth for a round.
abilities.apReason: A strong per-rest play ability that provides significant stealth benefits at level 10, requiring a notable investment in skill and focus.
abilities.levelReason: Requires significant skill to execute such a complex stealth maneuver effectively.
