rules.effect: Both targets gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and are considered invisible until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if either target is within 5 feet of a source of bright light.

abilities.warioNote: You think I'd sell you something this shadowy for just three AP? Betrayal!

abilities.name: Feral Overpower
abilities.description: Bellow a primal scream to shatter defenses, forcing enemies within reach to make a saving throw or be stunned.
abilities.apReason: Requires a significant sacrifice to unleash an impactful, once-per-session combat maneuver that can change an encounter beat.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 13 allows for a dramatic moment per session where the Barbarian can deliver a crushing blow against their foes.

rules.effect: Each creature within close range must make a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be stunned until the end of their next turn.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again for 24 hours after using it.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it's powerful... but did you check the price? You could’ve bought two other abilities for that!

abilities.name: Arcane Barrage
abilities.description: Fire three bolts of arcane energy, dealing force damage to all enemies within a 15-foot line.
abilities.apReason: Level 9 ability providing a strong per-rest play, requiring focus and resources.
abilities.levelReason: Exploits the wizard's high spellcasting proficiency for a powerful burst attack.

rules.effect: 3d8 + Intelligence modifier force damage. Save DC 14 + Proficiency + Intelligence modifier.
rules.drawback: Reduces your Spellcasting ability by 2 until the end of your next short rest.

abilities.warioNote: These bolts pack a wallop! Perfect for when you need to clear out a horde!

abilities.name: Rampage Smash
abilities.description: Deal massive damage and reduce attackers' AC by 2 until the end of your next turn.
abilities.apReason: Requires a significant Action Point for such a dramatic finisher at epic levels.
abilities.levelReason: Only usable in epic encounters, providing a dramatic finishing move.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You make one melee attack against an enemy within reach. On a hit, you deal an extra 2d6 damage and reduce its armor class by 2 until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You must spend an Action Point to use this ability.

abilities.warioNote: For those moments when you need to end it... with rampaging force!

abilities.name: Shrapnel Burst
abilities.description: Deal area damage to enemies within a burst, dealing piercing damage and pushing them back.
abilities.apReason: Shrapnel Burst provides strong area control, making it a key combat tool at level 12 that requires significant resource management.
abilities.levelReason: Gunslingers master their firearms enough at this level to unleash devastating area attacks with precise control.

rules.effect: You create a burst of shrapnel within range. Each creature in the burst must make a DC 14 DEX saving throw, taking 8d6 piercing damage on a failed save and being pushed back 10 feet on a successful one.
rules.drawback: You must reload all your firearms after using this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Hey! Want to push back the bad guys AND deal damage? This one’s got you covered... for a few bullets!

abilities.name: Shadowscape
abilities.description: Transform into a living shadow, blending seamlessly with darkness for 1 minute.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a dramatic and limited transformation, offering significant tactical advantages at the cost of situational immobility.
abilities.levelReason: Master spies command shadows to enhance their tactical maneuvers.

rules.effect: You assume the form of a shadow, gaining +2 to Dexterity and advantage on Stealth checks. You can move through any object or creature you can see without provoking opportunity attacks. This effect ends if you leave an area of dim light.
rules.drawback: While in Shadowscape, you cannot be targeted by spells or effects that rely on sight.

abilities.warioNote: It's like being invisible... but still in your own clothes. What’s not to love?

abilities.name: Heroic Rally
abilities.description: Inspire your allies, granting them advantage on one ability check or attack roll until the end of your next turn.
abilities.apReason: This is a dramatic, once-per-session ability that dramatically affects combat and requires careful use.
abilities.levelReason: A leader's influence at its peak—inspiring their allies in a dramatic moment.

rules.duration: Until the end of your next turn
rules.uses: Once per short or long rest
rules.effect: All creature within 5 feet of you gain advantage on one ability check or attack roll. Ends if the target uses a bonus action.
rules.drawback: You must be able to see all targets for the effect to function.

abilities.warioNote: It's like giving your friends superpowers... temporarily. But it costs you big!

abilities.name: Crowd Control
abilities.description: Temporarily incapacitate a hostile creature, buying your party precious time to regroup.
abilities.apReason: Level 11 abilities provide strong party-wide buffs or control. This ability offers hard control, fitting its high tier.
abilities.levelReason: At level 11, Commoners have the resources and experience needed for powerful control effects.

rules.duration: until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: You touch an enemy. They must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be incapacitated until your next turn. On a successful save, they are only stunned for 1 round.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you have any allies within 5 feet of the target.

abilities.warioNote: Need a quick way to clear out that pesky foe? Look no further! For just 3 AP, you can turn the tide of battle!

abilities.name: Shieldsmith's Command
abilities.description: Command nearby allies in light armor to bolster their shields, increasing defense for all within reach.
abilities.apReason: This high-tier support ability provides a strong per-rest play benefit at level 11, justifying its 3 AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: At level 11, Militias can offer a significant party-wide buff with this command ability.

rules.effect: All allies within 30 feet of the Militia gain +2 to AC until the start of their next turn. Ends if the Militia moves more than 5 feet away.
rules.drawback: The Militia cannot take reactions for 1 minute after using this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Get your friends to shield up with this one - worth every AP!

abilities.name: Hammerfall Stomp
abilities.description: Deal area damage to foes within an explosion, stunning them on a failed save.
abilities.apReason: This strong combat utility requires three AP to reflect its burst damage potential and control effect.
abilities.levelReason: Crafters need a strong burst ability at this level to help their party in tough encounters.

rules.duration: Instantaneous, until all targets save or are no longer stunned
rules.effect: Targets within 10 feet must make a DC (8 + Proficiency + Strength) Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they are knocked prone and stunned for 1 minute.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again until after completing a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Stomp on 'em good! It's like a mini-earthquake under their feet!

abilities.name: Judgment Smite
abilities.description: Deal radiant damage to one creature of your choice within range, ending their concentration if they have any.
abilities.apReason: Requires a significant risk to concentration and limited daily usage at this high level.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins gain the power to deliver a final judgment at this epic tier.

rules.effect: You deal 8d6 radiant damage to one creature of your choice within range. The target must make a DC (15 + your Charisma modifier) Wisdom saving throw, or lose all spell slots of 3rd level and lower.
rules.drawback: If successful on the save, you cannot use Judgment Smite again for 24 hours.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, try to smite with divine wrath! It’s not like you can use it more than once a day...

abilities.name: Fury Shout
abilities.description: Shake your surroundings, dealing thunder damage to all enemies within reach and forcing them to make a saving throw or be knocked prone.
abilities.apReason: Requires a significant moment in play, providing a strong effect that is hard-limited to one use per session.
abilities.levelReason: Unleashes a dramatic moment in the epic tier, providing a significant battlefield impact.

rules.effect: Each enemy within 10 feet must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and take 5d6 thunder damage.
rules.drawback: You are vulnerable to all magical effects for the next minute.

abilities.warioNote: For a few coins more, you could get a normal roar! But this? This is showmanship.

abilities.name: Arcane Cataclysm
abilities.description: Summon a wave of arcane energy that deals 2d8 + Intelligence modifier force damage to all creatures within 10 feet.
abilities.apReason: A strong per-rest play ability, this spell provides a burst of damage and control.
abilities.levelReason: Employs high-level spellcasting and area effect for significant combat impact.

rules.effect: All creatures within 10 feet must make a DC (8 + Proficiency + Intelligence modifier) Constitution saving throw or take 2d8 force damage. The effect ends if the caster moves more than 5 feet away.
rules.drawback: Cannot be cast in enclosed spaces to avoid friendly fire.

abilities.warioNote: For the price of three AP, you get a spell that can clear out a room! Who needs a team when you’ve got this?

abilities.name: Raging Shield
abilities.description: Unleash a powerful shield bash, dealing force damage to all creatures within reach.
abilities.apReason: This epic-tier ability requires a dramatic cost to match its powerful effect.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, fighters can command the battlefield with devastating effect.

rules.effect: You deal force damage equal to your Strength modifier + proficiency bonus + half your level. Creatures within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: If you fail the reaction save, you cannot use this ability for 1 minute.

abilities.warioNote: Ringing in your ears? That's the sound of your opponents hitting the ground... hard!

abilities.name: Explosive Salvo
abilities.description: Deal massive damage to a target with a barrage of explosive bullets, leaving behind a dangerous residue.
abilities.apReason: Explosive Salvo requires precise timing and a significant risk, making it a dramatic but limited ability.
abilities.levelReason: At level 13, the Gunslinger can deliver a devastating single attack that reshapes battles.

rules.effect: Make a ranged weapon attack against a target within range. On a hit, the target takes 4d10 + DEX modifier fire damage and is knocked prone. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute.
rules.drawback: The area around the target is drenched in volatile chemicals that last for an hour. Any creature entering this area takes 2d4 fire damage at the start of their turn.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, you want to blow things up? Can’t blame ya. But be careful, this one’s gonna leave a mess!

abilities.name: Ethereal Shadow
abilities.description: Summon an ethereal doppelgänger to scout ahead, reporting back on enemies within 30 feet.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a significant tactical advantage, making it a dramatic but hard-limited resource.
abilities.levelReason: At this epic tier, spies execute their most daring and impactful missions.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You summon an ethereal doppelgänger to scout ahead. It reports back on enemies within 30 feet with a successful Intelligence (Insight) check against DC 15. The shadow vanishes if it takes any damage or if you use your action on the same turn.
rules.drawback: The doppelgänger can only report visual information and cannot engage in combat.

abilities.warioNote: Alright, alright! This one’s a real showstopper. Watch your wallet fly right out the window!

abilities.name: Commanding Convergence
abilities.description: Unite allies into a cohesive force, granting each an additional attack and +1 to AC for one round.
abilities.apReason: Dramatic leadership ability that requires a significant cost for such a powerful effect.
abilities.levelReason: Requires the depth of experience and command necessary to inspire such dramatic unity in battle.

rules.duration: Until the end of the next long rest
rules.effect: All allies within 30 feet gain +1 to AC and an additional attack. Ends if any ally takes damage.
rules.drawback: You must lead from the front, exposing yourself to at least one attack.

abilities.warioNote: This command is so powerful, even I'd be scared to buy it! Just sayin'.

abilities.name: Mega Brew
abilities.description: Create a potent potion that heals all allies within range for half their max hit points.
abilities.apReason: A high-tier ability that provides significant healing utility for the party at will, justifying a higher AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: A strong per-rest play for the Commoner, healing party-wide.

rules.effect: Each ally within range heals for 1d8 + Constitution modifier hit points. No save required. Ends when used.
rules.drawback: The Commoner must possess an alchemy kit and have consumed all ingredients.

abilities.warioNote: Sell this training? Oh sure! You’ll be the healer of your group in no time!

abilities.name: Mighty Rally
abilities.description: Cry a battle cry that grants nearby allies advantage on attack rolls until their next action.
abilities.apReason: A high-tier ability that provides significant buffs, justifying its cost.
abilities.levelReason: Enables high-impact party-wide buffs at crucial moments of combat.

rules.duration: Until the start of each ally's next action
rules.effect: All allies within range can roll advantage on attack rolls. Ends when a target takes damage.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used again until after a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Need your toads to fight like heroes? This one's for ya—just remember, no second chances!

abilities.name: Crafted Shield
abilities.description: Forge a temporary shield made of your tools, granting you advantage on saving throws until it breaks.
abilities.apReason: Crafted Shield provides a strong, per-rest play mechanic with a significant drawback to balance its power level.
abilities.levelReason: Harnesses the peak skill and resourcefulness of an Artisan to create powerful but ephemeral defenses.

rules.duration: until you take damage or cast another spell with this feature
rules.effect: You conjure a shield made of your tools. It provides a +2 bonus to AC against all attacks until it breaks, requiring an Intelligence saving throw (DC 14) to maintain. Breaking the shield reduces your speed by 5 feet.
rules.drawback: The shield is made from your tools and can be broken by any attack that deals damage.

abilities.warioNote: Need some extra protection? For just four AP, you can turn your tools into a makeshift shield that'll have the whole party asking for one too!

abilities.name: Divine Annihilation
abilities.description: Channel divine power to obliterate a single creature, dealing massive radiant damage.
abilities.apReason: This is an epic-tier ability that can turn the tide of battle with one devastating strike, costing heavily in resources.
abilities.levelReason: Only a paladin of great renown can harness this final, dramatic ability.

rules.effect: You deal 8d12 + Cha modifier radiant damage to one creature. The target must make a DC 18 + Cha modifier + Proficiency saving throw or be reduced to 0 hit points.
rules.drawback: This ability consumes your divine health for the day, requiring a full night's rest to recover.

abilities.warioNote: For those rare moments when you need to make a statement. Priceless!

abilities.name: Shadowstep Saboteur
abilities.description: As an action, you can trip a creature within reach without using your movement.
abilities.apReason: Strong per-rest play at level 12 justifies 3 AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Provides strong control and party-wide benefit at this level.

rules.effect: Trip the target; DC 14 + DEX modifier. On a success, you can choose to have the creature fall prone.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if your speed is less than 20 feet.

abilities.warioNote: Watch out, it's a trip wire! But you get the last laugh as they fall flat!

abilities.name: Rampage of Ruin
abilities.description: In a berserk frenzy, you unleash a wave of primal energy that devastates enemies within reach.
abilities.apReason: This ability is a defining moment that reshapes combat dynamics for the entire encounter at an epic level.
abilities.levelReason: Only at this level can the Barbarian fully harness epic rage to obliterate foes.

rules.activation: Reaction when hit by an attack or reduced to half HP
rules.duration: Instantaneous; ends on your next turn if not otherwise ended
rules.effect: All creatures within 10 feet of you must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or take 4d6 necrotic damage. On a successful save, they take half as much damage.
rules.drawback: You cannot take other actions this turn and are exhausted until your next short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Only the most desperate situations warrant selling this training... or do they?

abilities.name: Storm Whirlwind
abilities.description: Summon a vortex of wind that deals lightning damage to enemies within its radius, stunning them on save failure.
abilities.apReason: Level 11 and a strong per-rest play ability requiring significant resources.
abilities.levelReason: At level 11, wizards have the spellcasting proficiency and power to unleash powerful area-of-effect attacks.

rules.effect: Creatures within a 15-foot radius must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and stunned for 1 round.
rules.drawback: The vortex drains spell slots: it consumes one 3rd-level slot when cast, two 2nd-level slots if cast using 2nd level spells.

abilities.warioNote: Don't ask me why, but this one sells like hotcakes. Storm Whirlwind? Priceless!

abilities.name: Rampart Shield
abilities.description: Forge a barrier of steel around yourself, reducing damage by half for one minute.
abilities.apReason: The ability provides an epic one-time defensive boost with significant cost.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, the fighter can command a dramatic shift in battle dynamics with an epic ability.

rules.effect: You gain resistance to all damage. Ends when you take damage or if you attack someone other than a hostile creature.
rules.drawback: While in effect, you cannot use any weapon attacks.

abilities.warioNote: For those times when you need to make a wall out of your shield... for $20!

abilities.name: Gunstorm
abilities.description: Erupt a volley of gunfire that deals 1d6+DEX modifier fire damage to all enemies within 30 feet.
abilities.apReason: This ability is a dramatic, one-time-per-session finisher that demands significant resources for its power.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, the Gunslinger can execute a devastating finale with one powerful move.

rules.uses: Once per short or long rest
rules.effect: All enemies within 30 feet take 1d6+DEX modifier fire damage. Saving throw DC 14 + proficiency + DEX modifier.
rules.drawback: Targets may make a saving throw to halve the damage.

abilities.warioNote: Alright, you think you can handle this? One wrong move and it's raining fire!

abilities.name: Silent Shadows
abilities.description: Summon a cloud of shadows to obscure your movement, granting you advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic ability requires a significant investment of AP due to its epic-level utility and lasting effect.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, the spy can manipulate shadows for grand effect in critical situations.

rules.duration: Until you move more than 30 feet or end your turn in sunlight
rules.effect: You create a cloud of shadows that obscures your movements. Until the cloud dissipates, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. The cloud disperses if you move more than 30 feet or end your turn in sunlight.
rules.drawback: While under the effect, you cannot be seen by creatures with Darkvision.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! For just four AP, you get to turn the tables on your enemies. How's that for a deal?

abilities.name: Triumphant Command
abilities.description: Roar and command allies to surge forward, dealing damage to enemies within reach.
abilities.apReason: This ability requires a significant investment of resources, providing a dramatic and impactful effect.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking this ability grants a Leader the power to dramatically turn the tide of battle at their peak.

rules.effect: All allies within range gain +2 to attacks and damage until the end of their next turn. Saves vs. DC 19 (CHA + proficiency) are required to remain unaffected for 1 round after failing.
rules.drawback: The Leader must use their action to issue this command.

abilities.warioNote: For the price of 4 AP? You get to make your friends stronger and your enemies weaker. What's not to like?

abilities.name: Toad's Leap
abilities.description: Leap over enemies to land behind them, granting you advantage on your next attack.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic and impactful ability requires a significant resource due to its limited use and the risk involved in a reaction.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, the Commoner gains the capability for a dramatic and impactful moment in combat.

rules.effect: When you activate this ability, make a DC 15 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. On a success, you leap over the nearest enemy and land behind it. You have advantage on your next melee attack against that target. The effect ends if you move more than 20 feet away from the target.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability to leap over an enemy larger than you.

abilities.warioNote: Jumping over enemies is easy when you're as nimble as a toad! Just don't land on anything too big or you might get squashed!

abilities.name: Mass Shield Wall
abilities.description: Create a wall of shields that grants temporary hit points to allies within reach.
abilities.apReason: Massively impactful support at a high level, requiring significant resources.
abilities.levelReason: At epic tier, the militia can bolster their entire team with protective strength.

rules.duration: Until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: Each target gains 2d8 temporary hit points. Ends if you use another action on them.
rules.drawback: You must be within 30 feet of all targets.

abilities.warioNote: And who's gonna pay for THAT shield wall? It ain't cheap!

abilities.name: Forge Titan
abilities.description: Temporarily increase your strength and hit points, becoming a titan of iron and flame.
abilities.apReason: This is a dramatic, one-shot ability that reshapes the battlefield at a crucial moment.
abilities.levelReason: Epic abilities allow for dramatic moments that change the tide of battle.

rules.effect: You gain +4 to Strength and Charisma, and your hit points increase by 2d6. These effects last until the end of your next short or long rest. This ability ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: Using Forge Titan exhausts you for 1 hour after its duration ends.

abilities.warioNote: These training sessions are tough! But once you're a titan, no foe will stand against you!

abilities.name: Judgment Shout
abilities.description: Shout a challenge that draws all enemies within sight to you, granting them temporary hit points equal to your Paladin level.
abilities.apReason: This ability is a defining moment in combat that can turn the tide of an epic battle.
abilities.levelReason: At this epic tier, the Paladin can command the battlefield with a single, dramatic shout.

rules.effect: All enemies within 60 feet must make a DC 25 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they are charmed and drawn towards you for the duration, gaining temporary hit points equal to your Paladin level.
rules.drawback: You become the target of any attacks from these enemies.

abilities.warioNote: Buy one, and you’ll wish you had more. This shout can bring the fight to you!

abilities.name: Ethereal Strike
abilities.description: Teleport to an enemy within sight, attack them on your turn, and return immediately.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic, one-time-per-session combat maneuver costs four Ability Points to reflect its significant impact and limited usage at the epic tier level.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, Rogues can exploit the battlefield with a move that dramatically changes the fight.

rules.effect: Make an attack roll against an enemy within range. On a hit, you deal 2d8 + DEX modifier damage. The target must succeed on a DC (DEX + proficiency) saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You can use this ability only once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Eh, it’s like teleporting for a free hit. What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Fury of Fragmentation
abilities.description: You shatter your surroundings, dealing damage to enemies within an area and leaving behind fragments that continue to deal damage over time.
abilities.apReason: This ability requires a dramatic and costly display of power, fitting for an epic-tier Barbarian.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, the Barbarian can unleash a devastating attack that not only strikes foes but leaves lingering effects on the battlefield.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you move more than 30 feet from the center of the area
rules.effect: You deal 4d6 + Strength modifier slashing damage to all creatures within a 15-foot radius centered on you. On a hit, they must succeed on a DC (8 + Proficiency + Strength) Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of their next turn. Unsuccessful saves are reduced by one success level, but cannot be less than 1.
rules.drawback: You take 2d6 damage from the fragments yourself after your action.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, why not? It's just a little self-harm to go with the massive damage. What could possibly go wrong?

abilities.name: Arcane Quake
abilities.description: Shake the ground with a powerful arcane pulse, knocking enemies prone within range.
abilities.apReason: High tier abilities require significant points to reflect their power and utility at this level.
abilities.levelReason: High-level wizards can command devastating bursts of power to reshape combat.

rules.effect: Each creature within range must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone. The effect ends if the wizard moves more than 5 feet away from any target.
rules.drawback: The wizard risks destabilizing the area, causing minor tremors that reduce their movement speed by 1 until the end of their next turn.

abilities.warioNote: Feel the earth tremble under your feet! For just three AP, you can make anyone wish they were anywhere else!

abilities.name: Overwhelming Momentum
abilities.description: Gain a +2 bonus to Strength-based attacks and saves until you miss or take damage.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a significant combat edge at level 17, making it a dramatic but limited effect.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, the Fighter can channel years of combat experience into an overwhelming surge of momentum.

rules.duration: until you miss an attack or take damage
rules.effect: You gain a +2 bonus to Strength-based attacks and saving throws. This ends when you miss an attack roll or take any damage.
rules.drawback: If you miss an attack, you must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of your next turn.

abilities.warioNote: For just four AP? You get to feel unstoppable! Or at least until you fumble or take a hit.

abilities.name: Rebel Salvo
abilities.description: Unleash a devastating volley of gunfire, dealing significant damage to enemies within an area.
abilities.apReason: This powerful combat maneuver requires significant preparation and leaves the Gunslinger vulnerable during the reloading phase.
abilities.levelReason: At this epic tier, the Gunslinger can pull off a defining, dramatic moment with a single, powerful attack.

rules.uses: Once per short or long rest
rules.effect: You fire a barrage of bullets within a 15-foot radius centered on a point you choose. All creatures in the area must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they take 4d8 piercing damage. On a successful save, they take half as much damage.
rules.drawback: You must reload your firearm for an additional action after using this ability.

abilities.warioNote: You think one shot is impressive? Try dodging this! But you’ll have to reload, so be careful!

abilities.name: Dark Mirage
abilities.description: Emerge from shadows as a perfect copy of an enemy, confusing them long enough to escape or strike.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic and hard-limited ability offers one defining moment per session at level 17, making it a strategic asset.
abilities.levelReason: Master spies can manipulate reality itself for a defining moment.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You become an exact duplicate of a hostile creature within reach, swapping places with it. The target must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be disoriented until the start of its next turn. You can't attack with this ability.
rules.drawback: On a failed save, you are exposed to any attacks made against the enemy, but they also target you.

abilities.warioNote: Watch your step, partner! This Dark Mirage is a sneaky little guy that’ll make you wish you didn’t mess with the big leagues!

abilities.name: Crown Command
abilities.description: Command allies with a single word, granting them advantage on their next attack roll or saving throw.
abilities.apReason: Requires significant leadership and vocal prowess, making it an epic-level ability.
abilities.levelReason: Epic leaders command the battlefield with a mere whisper.

rules.effect: Choose one ally within range. That ally gains advantage on their next attack roll or saving throw before the end of its next turn.
rules.drawback: You must be able to speak and take a bonus action.

abilities.warioNote: For those who think words alone can't move the mountain... or at least get your allies to fight harder!

abilities.name: Toad Tyrant
abilities.description: Transform into a towering toad beast, dealing massive damage and forcing enemies back.
abilities.apReason: A dramatic, one-time transformation with a clear cost and limitation.
abilities.levelReason: Epic transformations for epic moments, granting the commoner dominion over foes.

rules.duration: Until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You transform into a towering toad beast. You gain a +4 bonus to Strength, and can make a melee weapon attack that deals 2d6+4 damage (10 on a hit). After attacking, all enemies within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: While in this form, you are unable to speak and revert back at the end of your next turn.

abilities.warioNote: For when you need to make a statement—literally!

abilities.name: Breach Rampage
abilities.description: Shatter defenses with a fearsome charge, dealing massive damage and forcing creatures to make saving throws.
abilities.apReason: This move is a dramatic, limited-use ability that reshapes combat in one big moment.
abilities.levelReason: At level 14, Militias can command the battlefield with decisive force.

rules.effect: Target one creature within reach. You make a melee weapon attack against it. On a hit, the target must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from you and restrained until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you are restrained.

abilities.warioNote: For just four APs? You get to say 'Bye-bye' to the bad guys... for now!

abilities.name: Masterpiece Creation
abilities.description: Craft an artifact that grants a one-time advantage or creates a permanent effect.
abilities.apReason: Crafting an artifact that can have lasting effects is a monumental task, worth four Ability Points.
abilities.levelReason: Requires mastery of materials and techniques to create something truly legendary.

rules.effect: Craft an item that provides a +2 bonus on one ability check or saving throw for the duration of the encounter. The item created can also provide a permanent benefit, such as a +1 to Charisma if crafted as a charm.
rules.drawback: The creation process takes 8 hours and requires expensive materials costing up to 500 gp.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, make something legendary? That’ll cost ya! You think I’m just gonna hand over a +2 bonus for free?

abilities.name: Divine Conduit
abilities.description: Channel divine power to grant allies a burst of strength and resilience.
abilities.apReason: This ability offers a dramatic one-time power spike, worthy of its high-level unlocking.
abilities.levelReason: At level 20, the paladin wields immense divine power for one dramatic moment.

rules.effect: Select up to three allies within 30 feet. Each target gains +2 to AC and damage rolls until the end of their next turn. A saving throw DC 18 (Wisdom) ends this effect early.
rules.drawback: You must concentrate, which can be difficult in a chaotic battle.

abilities.warioNote: Watch your wallet! This is a powerhouse that can turn the tide of even the most dire battles.

abilities.name: Shadowsilk Glide
abilities.description: Leap between shadows, teleporting up to 30 feet with perfect silence.
abilities.apReason: The dramatic and limited-duration nature justifies its high AP cost at level 16.
abilities.levelReason: Masterful agility and control over shadow allow for a dramatic leap.

rules.effect: You teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, ending your turn there. You take a –5 penalty on attack rolls and ability checks made before this movement.
rules.drawback: After using Shadowsilk Glide, you are fatigued until the end of your next long rest.

abilities.warioNote: It's like teleporting, but with shadows. What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Fury of the Wild
abilities.description: Transform into a raging beast, granting you +4 to STR and CON for 1 minute.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a significant boost to combat prowess at an epic level, making it costly but necessary for dramatic encounters.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, the Barbarian can command epic fury in their form.

rules.effect: You gain a +4 bonus to STR and CON until the end of your next long rest. This effect ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: While in this form, you can neither speak nor take verbal actions.

abilities.warioNote: For the price of 4 AP, you get to be a beast! What could go wrong? *cough*

abilities.name: Arcane Convergence
abilities.description: Merge your knowledge with nature to conjure a burst of elemental power.
abilities.apReason: This is an epic-level spell that provides a dramatic, limited-use power.
abilities.levelReason: Harnesses the deep magic knowledge acquired over many years.

rules.effect: You touch a creature. It must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence saving throw or take 2d6 force damage and be charmed by you for 1 minute. The effect ends if the target takes any nonmagical damage.
rules.drawback: The spell consumes one of your prepared spells.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it’s powerful, but you’ll be using up one of your best spells. Think about it!

abilities.name: Epic Smash
abilities.description: Smash through up to three enemies with a single, devastating strike.
abilities.apReason: The dramatic impact at level 18 justifies this costly ability point.
abilities.levelReason: At level 18, the fighter can deliver an impact that redefines combat encounters.

rules.effect: You make a melee attack against up to three creatures in range. On a hit, the target takes 8d10 bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone.
rules.drawback: If you miss any of your targets, the entire ability fails.

abilities.warioNote: This one’s a doozy! Smash them all down for four AP? You bet it is!

abilities.name: Bullet Tempest
abilities.description: Unleash a devastating volley of bullets that deal massive damage to all enemies within range.
abilities.apReason: A devastating one-time event that reshapes an encounter entirely, requiring significant resource management.
abilities.levelReason: Only a Gunslinger at epic tier can control such a volatile tempest of lead.

rules.effect: All creatures within 15 feet take 4d8 + DEX modifier piercing damage. DC 17 + proficiency + DEX modifier for saving throw; on failure, they are also knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You must reload your firearm after using this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! These Bullet Tempests are a real money-maker. Only the elite can afford such explosive firepower!

abilities.name: Shadowcrawl
abilities.description: Transform into a shadowy serpent, blending with darkness and striking unseen.
abilities.apReason: This epic-level ability offers significant tactical flexibility and risk at a high cost.
abilities.levelReason: Master spies can manipulate the shadows for ultimate tactical advantage.

rules.duration: Until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You assume the form of a serpent, gaining +2 to Dexterity and invisibility. You can move up to 30 feet through difficult terrain as if it were difficult only. A creature that starts its turn in your space must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained until the end of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You leave behind a trail of shadowy residue, revealing your location to creatures within 30 feet.

abilities.warioNote: It's like getting swallowed by the darkness... and then spitting back out with a tail!

abilities.name: Cry of Unity
abilities.description: Inspire allies within 30 feet to gain advantage on attack rolls for 1 round.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge for all allies, unlocking at this level.
abilities.levelReason: Leaders inspire their allies at this level, giving them a reliable edge in combat.

rules.effect: All allies within range gain advantage on attack rolls. The effect ends if you are incapacitated or die.
rules.drawback: You must be able to speak and see the targets.

abilities.warioNote: It’s just a little cry... but it packs quite a punch!

abilities.name: Toadstool Toss
abilities.description: Summons a cluster of explosive toadstools that deal 1d8 force damage on all enemies in an area.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic, one-shot combat ability requires significant resource investment at this level.
abilities.levelReason: Toads reach their peak defensive and offensive potential at this level, making them formidable foes or allies.

rules.effect: Each creature in a 10-foot radius must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 force damage. The effect ends if the area is cleaned of enemies.
rules.drawback: The toad risks becoming overwhelmed and unable to cast this ability again until after a long rest.

abilities.warioNote: For just four AP? You get a mushroom field explosion! But be careful, too many toads in the mix and you’ll be out of action!

abilities.name: Titan's Might
abilities.description: Gain a +4 bonus to all STR-based attacks and checks until you take damage in the next combat round.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic ability provides a massive edge for critical combat moments but requires careful timing.
abilities.levelReason: Only available at epic tier, providing a dramatic boost for critical moments.

rules.duration: Until you take damage in the next combat round
rules.effect: Gain +4 to STR-based attacks and checks. Ends when you take damage in a subsequent combat round.
rules.drawback: Only lasts until you take damage, requiring you to strike quickly or risk losing its benefit.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Want to feel like a real tank? It’s tough, but the results are worth it!

abilities.name: Divine Intervention
abilities.description: Call down divine favor, granting temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier when you critically hit.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge, providing healing on critical hits which is valuable at level 2.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins start combat effectively and this ability enhances their critical hits early in the game.

rules.effect: When you critically hit, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1). This effect ends when you take damage.
rules.drawback: You can only use this ability once per short or long rest after a critical hit.

abilities.warioNote: You think you need this? Holy shield already does that! But hey, it’s free and can’t be resisted!

abilities.name: Shadowstep Demolition
abilities.description: Leap through shadows to decimate a single target with precision strikes.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic maneuver requires intense concentration and risk, costing four AP for one decisive moment per session.
abilities.levelReason: Only the most experienced Rogues can master this dramatic leap and destructive strike.

rules.effect: Make a single attack roll against a target within range. On a hit, the target takes an additional 4d6 force damage and is knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You must spend 2 AP to activate this ability.

abilities.warioNote: It's like buying an entire arsenal... just for that one perfect shot!

abilities.name: Fury of the Storm
abilities.description: Call forth a storm of primal fury, dealing massive damage to enemies within reach and leaving them reeling.
abilities.apReason: This epic-level ability demands significant resource management, providing a dramatic but limited option for the final push of an encounter.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians command the raw power of nature at their peak, unleashing it in one devastating moment.

rules.effect: Target all creatures within 10 feet. Each creature takes 8d6 damage on a failed DC 24 Strength saving throw, or half as much on a success. The effect ends when the barbarian drops to 0 hit points.
rules.drawback: The storm drains the user's fury; it can only be used once per fight.

abilities.warioNote: It's like buying a storm in a bottle... or at least the most expensive one you’ll find here.

abilities.name: Arcane Eruption
abilities.description: Unleash a devastating burst of arcane energy, dealing 8d6 force damage to all creatures in an area.
abilities.apReason: Requires significant preparation and concentration, making it a dramatic moment per session.
abilities.levelReason: Harnesses the wizard's mastery over elemental forces for an epic display of power.

rules.effect: Each creature in a 15-foot radius must make a DC (8 + Proficiency + Intelligence) Dexterity saving throw or take 8d6 force damage. The effect ends when the last creature escapes the area.
rules.drawback: The wizard must concentrate for 1 minute after using this ability, during which they are vulnerable to all attacks.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Think you can handle the force? This one's a real doozy!

abilities.name: Titanic Strike
abilities.description: Deal massive damage and knock back enemies within a ten-foot radius.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic, one-use-per-session ability demands a significant cost to match its impact.
abilities.levelReason: Epic battles demand epic tactics; this ability delivers on that promise.

rules.effect: You deal 4d10 + Strength modifier damage to one creature within reach. All other creatures in a ten-foot radius must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You must take the Attack action on your turn, and this ability consumes all of your Strength points.

abilities.warioNote: For those moments when you need to break the world... for just a few AP!

abilities.name: Barrage Eclipse
abilities.description: Eclipse your foes with a barrage of firearms, blinding them temporarily.
abilities.apReason: This ability is epic in scale and effect, requiring significant AP for its dramatic impact.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, the Gunslinger can deliver a truly epic and game-changing moment.

rules.effect: You fire your firearms in an arc, blinding targets within 30 feet. They must succeed on a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: Blind allies within range are also affected.

abilities.warioNote: Alright, alright! This one's a bit of a gamble. You might just blind your friends too!

abilities.name: Shadowstep Cloak
abilities.description: Become invisible and silent for a round, allowing you to move through difficult terrain as if it were flat.
abilities.apReason: This ability allows for one dramatic moment per session where the spy can achieve total tactical advantage in stealth and movement.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, spies can achieve the ultimate moment of tactical brilliance by becoming undetectable.

rules.duration: Until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: You gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and become invisible and silent until your next turn begins. You can move through difficult terrain as if it were flat. This effect ends if you attack or cast a spell.
rules.drawback: If you are incapacitated, the effect immediately ends.

abilities.warioNote: It's like... a cloak of invisibility. But for you, not your mom.

abilities.name: Unity Shout
abilities.description: Boost allies' attack rolls within 30 feet by 1d6, but lose one ally's action.
abilities.apReason: Provides a moderate boost to combat effectiveness for one minute, at the cost of a crucial ally action.
abilities.levelReason: Leadership abilities become more impactful as the party grows stronger.

rules.effect: All allies within range gain a +1d6 bonus to attack rolls until the end of their next turn. The leader must use an ally's action.
rules.drawback: The leader cannot take any actions during this time.

abilities.warioNote: Sell it! For just two AP, you get to make your friends stronger... until they have nothing left!

abilities.name: Toad's Resilience
abilities.description: Gain temporary hit points equal to your level + Charisma modifier when you fall.
abilities.apReason: This is a dramatic moment, fitting for the epic tier, with a clear cost in terms of limited use per rest period.
abilities.levelReason: At this epic tier, the commoner gains resilience against falls.

rules.duration: Until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: You gain (level + CHA modifier) temporary hit points when you fall from a height. This effect ends if you take any damage.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used more than once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: You fall? Well, this'll catch you! But only once per short break... gotta watch those pennies!

abilities.name: Siegebreaker
abilities.description: Smash through heavy armor and shields, dealing massive damage to a single foe.
abilities.apReason: A dramatic, one-time ability that demands significant effort and resources to unlock at epic levels.
abilities.levelReason: Only the most seasoned Militia can unlock this devastating strike at epic levels.

rules.effect: Make a melee weapon attack against an enemy. On hit, deal double damage and ignore all cover and disadvantage from any shield or armor. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You can only use Siegebreaker once per day.

abilities.warioNote: This training’s no joke! You’ll need every AP you got for this doozy!

abilities.name: Divine Steed
abilities.description: Summons a steed to aide you in combat, granting an ally mount while you command.
abilities.apReason: Summoning divine aid requires a small investment of Ability Points, given its utility in combat and leadership.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins gain the ability to summon divine assistance as their power grows.

rules.effect: You and an ally of your choice gain the benefits of a mount. The steed provides assistance as if you had a warhorse, but it is not subject to exhaustion. This effect ends early if either you or your ally are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: The steed cannot be commanded by anyone other than you.

abilities.warioNote: You think it’s just a horse? No, it’s a Divine Steed! And it costs only one AP. What a deal!

abilities.name: Shadowstep Eclipsed
abilities.description: Summons a shadowy duplicate to attack for you, then merges into the dark after the fight.
abilities.apReason: Requires a dramatic, once-per-session moment where the Rogue's stealth and combat prowess are on full display.
abilities.levelReason: For epic Rogues, merging with darkness is more than just an evasion technique—it's a dramatic transformation.

rules.effect: You and your shadowy duplicate each make one attack against the target. On a hit, you have advantage on all Dexterity (Stealth) checks until the start of your next turn. The duplicate merges into darkness after 1 minute or when it takes any damage.
rules.drawback: The duplicate is only as strong as your proficiency with finesse weapons.

abilities.warioNote: It's like having a second you fight for you! Or maybe just a really dark shadow. Either way, it costs more than a meal at Luigi’s!

abilities.name: Feral Sprint
abilities.description: Gain a bonus to movement speed until you take damage.
abilities.apReason: Feral Sprint provides a significant combat advantage for a low AP cost, fitting its level tier as a reliable edge in encounters.
abilities.levelReason: Raging up close is key, and Feral Sprint gives you that edge in the first moments of battle.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you take damage
rules.effect: You gain +10 feet to your walking speed until you take damage. This effect ends.
rules.drawback: This ability cannot be used if you are already at full speed.

abilities.warioNote: What? Sell this? You want to sprint and not even pay extra? That’s just silly!

abilities.name: Arcane Annihilation
abilities.description: Summon a devastating wave of arcane energy that deals massive force damage to all creatures within an area.
abilities.apReason: A dramatic and impactful ability that requires significant resource management, fitting its epic tier placement.
abilities.levelReason: Harnesses the wizard's mastery over arcane forces for a climactic finish in epic encounters.

rules.duration: Instantaneous, until all targets are reduced to 0 hit points or leave area
rules.effect: Each creature in a 15-foot radius must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they take 7d6 force damage and are knocked prone. The effect ends when all creatures within the area are reduced to 0 hit points or leave the area.
rules.drawback: The wizard must concentrate for the duration of the spell, disallowing any other actions.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, this one's a real doozy! But hey, you only get it once per rest. You're welcome!

abilities.name: Bash Breaker
abilities.description: Deal an extra 1d6 bludgeoning damage to a single target with your weapon.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge at level 2, providing combat advantage for one additional action.
abilities.levelReason: Provides reliable combat advantage at level 2.

rules.effect: When you successfully hit a target with your weapon attack, the target takes an additional 1d6 bludgeoning damage. This effect ends when you miss on a reaction.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability more than once every 3 rounds.

abilities.warioNote: Bash Breaker? Oh sure, because nothing says 'reliable' like a broken shield!

abilities.name: Bullet Tsunami
abilities.description: Unleash a torrent of bullets that erupt from your gun, knocking back all enemies within range.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic move requires four Ability Points to reflect its epic power and impact.
abilities.levelReason: Only at epic levels can the Gunslinger unleash such a devastating display of firepower.

rules.effect: All creatures within 10 feet must make a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked back 10 feet and take 3d6 force damage. On a successful save, they take half as much damage.
rules.drawback: You must reload your firearm for 1 minute after using this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Oh, you want to sell Bullet Tsunami? Sure, why not. For 4 APs, sure thing! But let's be real, reloading for a minute ain't no joke.

abilities.name: Eclipse Strike
abilities.description: In a moment of shadowed elegance, you strike with such precision that your enemy is left in darkness.
abilities.apReason: A dramatic epic-level move with significant risk and impact, requiring all four Ability Points to master.
abilities.levelReason: Unleashing at epic levels when shadows and strikes converge into one devastating technique.

rules.effect: You make a melee weapon attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the end of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You must have advantage on your attack roll.

abilities.warioNote: These training points? They disappear as soon as you use 'em. But oh boy, it's worth it for that one perfect strike.

abilities.name: Unit Boost
abilities.description: Lead an ally within 30 feet on your turn to gain +1d6 attack damage and advantage on the next roll.
abilities.apReason: Provides a strong temporary boost to an ally, making it mid-tier for level 6
abilities.levelReason: Leadership abilities typically become impactful at mid-tier levels, providing a reliable boost for key moments in combat.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: Choose an ally within range. That ally deals +1d6 damage on its next attack roll and gains advantage on that roll.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again until after a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Boost 'em up! $1.50 more for the next one...

abilities.name: Epic Scribe
abilities.description: Summarize the battlefield, aiding allies and revealing hidden traps.
abilities.apReason: This is a dramatic moment-per-session ability that requires careful planning and resources to be used effectively.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 17 allows for a dramatic impact on the epic tier encounter.

rules.effect: You gain advantage on saving throws against effects that would reduce hit points. As a bonus action, you can also reveal hidden traps within 30 feet.
rules.drawback: You must rest for at least 8 hours before using this ability again.

abilities.warioNote: Eh, it’s not like you can scribble your way out of everything... but it's sure handy when you need it!

abilities.name: Siege Smash
abilities.description: Smash through fortified defenses, dealing massive damage to a target and breaking its morale.
abilities.apReason: Dramatic and impactful, yet with a significant drawback to keep it balanced at level 17.
abilities.levelReason: Epic challenges demand epic solutions; Siege Smash dismantles formidable fortifications with brutal force.

rules.effect: You make a melee weapon attack against the target. On a hit, you deal 1d8 + Strength modifier damage and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Con saving throw or be stunned until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: After using Siege Smash, you are disarmed for 1 minute.

abilities.warioNote: For the price of 4 APs, you get to wreck stuff! But watch out—afterwards, you’ll be unarmed for a while. Tasty!

abilities.name: Masterwork Finish
abilities.description: Create an instant masterpiece, enhancing your improvised weapon to deal double damage for the next minute.
abilities.apReason: This is a powerful one-time effect, requiring significant resources and time to maintain.
abilities.levelReason: At epic levels, artisans refine their craft into legendary creations.

rules.uses: Once per short or long rest
rules.effect: For the duration, your improvised weapon deals an additional +2 damage. Save DC is 15 + Proficiency + Intelligence modifier.
rules.drawback: You must spend 4 hours crafting a new masterpiece after using this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Spend a few hours away from the action? You got it—this way your weapon will shine like gold!

abilities.name: Radiant Smite
abilities.description: Deal radiant damage to a creature you can see within 5 feet, equal to your level + Cha modifier.
abilities.apReason: This mid-tier combat ability provides reliable damage and an area control effect, costing two AP as a moderate resource investment.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins unlock strong combat abilities around this tier for sustained damage output.

rules.effect: You deal 2d8 radiant damage to one creature you can see within range. The target must make a DC 8 + Cha modifier + level saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you are not proficient in martial weapons.

abilities.warioNote: Need some extra bite to your attacks? This one's got the radiant power to back it up! Just make sure you've got something sharp in hand.

abilities.name: Shadowstep Annihilation
abilities.description: You vanish into shadows, then strike with a devastating critical hit.
abilities.apReason: This ultimate combat ability requires a significant cost given its dramatic impact and limited use.
abilities.levelReason: Only the most elite Rogues can harness this ultimate combat ability.

rules.effect: You gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and deal an additional 5d6 damage with your next attack this turn. The effect ends if you move more than 30 feet.
rules.drawback: If the target of your attack has resistance to slashing damage, you must succeed on a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw or gain disadvantage on all attacks until the end of your next turn.

abilities.warioNote: Man, this one’s a real money-maker. Shadowstep Annihilation? Priceless! Don’t miss out!

abilities.name: Raging Slash
abilities.description: Deal an extra 1d6 damage on your next melee attack after raging.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable combat edge at level 4 just before the character gains access to more powerful abilities.
abilities.levelReason: Enhances combat prowess in the heat of battle.

rules.effect: On your next melee attack after raging, deal an extra 1d6 damage. Ends when you stop raging.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if not in a rage.

abilities.warioNote: Don't think you need this? Until you miss, then it's too late!

abilities.name: Arcane Revelation
abilities.description: Unlock a hidden truth, revealing an enemy's weakness within your Arcana check.
abilities.apReason: A moment-defining revelation is both rare and costly to achieve.
abilities.levelReason: Epic revelations demand epic power.

rules.effect: You make an Arcana check against the target's Wisdom saving throw. On a success, you reveal one of their weaknesses (e.g., a vulnerability to fire damage). The effect ends if the creature makes a successful save.
rules.drawback: The use drains your arcane reservoir, reducing your next Arcana check by 1d6.

abilities.warioNote: Ah, the truth hurts... but it sure sells those potions!

abilities.name: Destructive Smash
abilities.description: Deal an extra 1d6 damage on a melee hit, doubling the damage against creatures with fewer hit points than you.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge at level 3 that provides consistent combat utility.
abilities.levelReason: Fights often require reliable bonuses to hit and deal more damage as they progress.

rules.effect: When you score a hit with a melee weapon, add 1d6 extra damage. Against creatures with fewer hit points than your current hit points, the damage doubles.
rules.drawback: Requires a successful attack to trigger.

abilities.warioNote: It's like smashing something so hard it breaks apart! But only if you hit first, of course!

abilities.name: Crossfire Dive
abilities.description: The Gunslinger rolls under their Dexterity saving throw to dodge incoming attacks, dealing an extra 1d6 fire damage in the process.
abilities.apReason: At level 2, this ability provides a reliable edge in combat, making it cost exactly 1 AP as a small but impactful bonus.
abilities.levelReason: Gaining proficiency and a reliable edge in combat at level 2 allows for more dynamic maneuvers like Crossfire Dive.

rules.effect: On a successful Dexterity saving throw, the Gunslinger reduces all incoming damage by 1d6 and deals an additional 1d6 fire damage to one attacker.
rules.drawback: The reaction can only be used once per round.

abilities.warioNote: Dodge like a pro! Watch those bullets fly past you and send one attacker to the floor!

abilities.name: Evasive Shroud
abilities.description: You become momentarily invisible, granting you advantage on Dexterity saving throws.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge; advantage on Dexterity saving throws is valuable for Spies to avoid harm and stay undetected.
abilities.levelReason: Spies often need to avoid detection and stay unnoticed in combat.

rules.effect: You gain advantage on Dexterity saving throws until the start of your next turn. This ability ends if you take a voluntary action.
rules.drawback: Once used, it can't be used again until after you finish a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it’s just a little shroud of invisibility. You’ll wish you had this one more time!

abilities.name: Unity Call
abilities.description: Shout to allies within 30 feet, granting them advantage on the next attack roll.
abilities.apReason: Requires coordination and focus, making it a mid-tier leadership ability that changes the encounter beat.
abilities.levelReason: Leadership abilities become more impactful as encounters progress, and this ability boosts team effectiveness.

rules.duration: Until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: All allies within range gain advantage on their next attack roll. This effect ends when you make an attack.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if there are no allies within 30 feet.

abilities.warioNote: Buy one, feel the camaraderie—temporarily, for only 2 AP!

abilities.name: Toad's Grand Leap
abilities.description: Leap over obstacles and enemies, landing behind them for a surprise attack.
abilities.apReason: Requires dramatic coordination and strength, one big moment per session.
abilities.levelReason: Requires the coordination and strength only an epic Commoner can muster.

rules.effect: Make a Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. On success, you leap up to your movement speed in feet and land behind the nearest target within reach. The target must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You are disoriented for 1 round after using this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Watch out! This toad can leap over you like it’s nothing!

abilities.name: Fortress Shield
abilities.description: Erect an impenetrable barrier around yourself, granting immunity to damage for one minute.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides one of the most dramatic defensive options in the game, justifying its high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Only a true leader can command such a monumental defensive stance in their final form.

rules.effect: You gain immunity to all damage. This effect ends if you take any damage or if your concentration is broken (as if concentrating on a spell).
rules.drawback: While under its effects, you cannot move more than 5 feet per turn and are incapacitated.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, now you think you can take on an entire army? Fortress Shield's more like 'Fortress Slow-Motion'!

abilities.name: Masterful Creation
abilities.description: Craft an object of extraordinary quality and utility, granting a +2 bonus to all checks related to your chosen artisan skill.
abilities.apReason: Crafting a masterful creation is a dramatic moment, requiring significant time and resources.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, artisans can create masterpieces that significantly impact their faction's operations.

rules.uses: Once per short or long rest
rules.effect: Craft an object, granting +2 to all checks related to your chosen artisan skill. The DC for any save required is 18 (8 + proficiency + Wisdom modifier). This effect ends when the object is no longer in use.
rules.drawback: You must spend 4 hours and gather materials worth at least 50 gp.

abilities.warioNote: For just 4 AP, get a +2 bonus on your next big project—worth every penny!

abilities.name: Radiant Vigor
abilities.description: Gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier when you are reduced to 0 hit points.
abilities.apReason: Provides a significant boost in survivability, justifying the mid-tier cost.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins unlock strong, healing abilities mid-tier.

rules.effect: Gain (CHA modifier) temporary hit points when reduced to 0 HP.
rules.drawback: Cannot use if you have any negative conditions.

abilities.warioNote: Hey pal! This one’s a lifesaver—literally! Watch your HP spike like a sunbeam!

abilities.name: Shadowstep Dodge
abilities.description: On your turn, you can shift up to your speed and gain advantage on Dexterity saving throws until the start of your next turn.
abilities.apReason: Provides a reliable edge for early level play, enhancing survivability and mobility.
abilities.levelReason: Enhances mobility and situational awareness early in play.

rules.duration: until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: Gain advantage on Dexterity saving throws. This ends when you make a Dexterity saving throw.
rules.drawback: You must move at least 5 feet during this activation.

abilities.warioNote: For just a penny more, you could be dodging arrows like it's nothing!

abilities.name: Rageborne Slam
abilities.description: Smash an opponent with a berserk fury, dealing an extra 2d6 damage and knocking them prone.
abilities.apReason: Activating with a bonus action and providing significant combat benefit at mid-tier justify the cost of 2 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians unlock this powerful combat ability mid-tier to change one encounter beat.

rules.effect: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, it must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. You take an additional 2d6 damage from the attack.
rules.drawback: You can only use this ability once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Feel the fury! One use per short rest? Pfft, still worth every AP!

abilities.name: Catastrophic Conjuration
abilities.description: Summon a devastating spellstorm, dealing massive damage to all enemies within range.
abilities.apReason: This ability requires a significant amount of power, unlocking only at epic levels where it can be transformative.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, wizards can harness the power of multiple epic spells for one dramatic effect.

rules.effect: You conjure a storm that deals 8d12 force damage to all creatures within range. A successful DC 24 Dexterity saving throw halves the damage. This effect ends when no enemies remain.
rules.drawback: The spell consumes your next two short rests for recovery.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, why not. For 4 AP and your next two rest days? You’re welcome!

abilities.name: Steady Blade
abilities.description: Gain advantage on attack rolls with a weapon you are proficient with for the next minute.
abilities.apReason: Provides a short-term combat edge without overbalancing the ability.
abilities.levelReason: At level 4, fighters can reliably bolster their combat prowess with steady hands and blade precision.

rules.effect: Gain advantage on attack rolls with a weapon you are proficient in until the start of your next turn after expending this ability. Ends if you make an unarmed strike or use a spell.
rules.drawback: You must spend one hand free to activate, and only one weapon can benefit from this at a time.

abilities.warioNote: Steady Blade? Don't mess with me! It's like having your best friend hold steady while you stab things!

abilities.name: Ink Mirage
abilities.description: Create a mirage of ink that distracts nearby creatures, forcing them to make a saving throw or be temporarily blinded.
abilities.apReason: Provides a minor but useful tactical advantage at level 4, with a limited number of uses.
abilities.levelReason: Spies often need unexpected distractions early in their infiltration attempts.

rules.duration: Up to 1 minute per short rest
rules.effect: DC 8 + Proficiency + Charisma modifier. On a failed save, creatures within 30 feet are blinded until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You must have line of sight to the target and can only use this ability once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Watch out! This Ink Mirage might just blind your enemies... for a little while!

abilities.name: Unity Strike
abilities.description: Deal an additional 1d8+CHA modifier damage to you and adjacent allies as a bonus action.
abilities.apReason: Provides a moderate boost to combat effectiveness at the cost of two AP, making it a reliable team play ability for mid-level leaders.
abilities.levelReason: Enhances the effectiveness of group combat by providing immediate, substantial damage support.

rules.effect: You and each adjacent creature within 5 feet deal an additional 1d8+CHA modifier damage.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if you are incapacitated or restrained.

abilities.warioNote: Sell this training? Why would I do that? It's like giving your friends superpowers in battle!

abilities.name: Toad's Cataclysm
abilities.description: Call upon the earth to swallow foes within a 15-foot radius, dealing 2d8 bludgeoning damage and forcing them to make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be buried.
abilities.apReason: This epic ability requires significant power, affecting a large area and dealing substantial damage with a dramatic consequence.
abilities.levelReason: The epic power of the commoner finally reveals itself in a dramatic, world-altering ability.

rules.effect: All creatures within range must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be buried, taking 2d8 bludgeoning damage and becoming restrained until the effect ends.
rules.drawback: The area is prone to sinkholes for 1 hour after use.

abilities.warioNote: And it's like... BAM! You're selling a tiny toad that can swallow whole armies. Who wouldn't buy?

abilities.name: Titan's Stamp
abilities.description: Mobilize your allies with a fearsome war cry, granting temporary hit points to those within earshot.
abilities.apReason: This ability represents a pivotal moment in battle, affecting multiple allies and requiring careful timing.
abilities.levelReason: Only the most seasoned militia can command the battlefield like this.

rules.duration: Until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You and all allies within range gain 1d8 + Con modifier temporary hit points. A successful DC 16 Wisdom saving throw ends this effect early.
rules.drawback: You must be able to see at least one ally within the range.

abilities.warioNote: And for 4 AP? It’s like giving the whole squad a morale boost! What a deal!

abilities.name: Divine Silence
abilities.description: Command silence from all within your presence, granting temporary blindness to enemies.
abilities.apReason: Requires precision and control, effectively altering combat dynamics for a minute at a moderate cost.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins gain the ability to command divine interventions that affect combat dynamics at this level.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until a creature moves out of the area
rules.effect: All creatures within the area must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded until the end of their next turn.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you are surprised.

abilities.warioNote: Who needs fancy spells when you can just shut 'em down with silence? Pricey, but worth it!

abilities.name: Shadowstep Swipe
abilities.description: Gain advantage on your next attack roll after moving at least 10 feet in a straight line.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge like gaining advantage on an attack roll is priced appropriately for level 3.
abilities.levelReason: Rogues gain reliable combat bonuses around level 3 to improve their hit chances.

rules.effect: Gain advantage on one melee attack roll before your next action. Ends if you take damage or move more than 5 feet.
rules.drawback: You must move at least 10 feet in a straight line after using this ability.

abilities.warioNote: It's just one sneak step, but it'll make your attacks land with a thud!

abilities.name: Fury Shield
abilities.description: Raise a protective barrier to negate one damaging effect per turn, but reduce your movement speed by half.
abilities.apReason: Moderate combat utility at mid-tier level provides a reliable defensive option.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians unlock this ability mid-tier to manage incoming damage more effectively.

rules.effect: DC 8 + proficiency + Strength modifier saving throw; on failure, the shield reduces all incoming damage by half until your next turn. Effect ends if you take no damage before then.
rules.drawback: Movement speed is reduced by half while active.

abilities.warioNote: Need some extra protection? This shield’s got your back... and you’ll move like a tortoise!

abilities.name: Eternal Arcane
abilities.description: Recast any spent spell of 1st level or higher, instantly restoring its energy.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic, once-per-day ability reshapes the game at its highest tier, requiring a significant cost.
abilities.levelReason: At this epic tier, wizards can manipulate the very fabric of their knowledge to reshape reality.

rules.effect: You may spend a spell slot to cast any previously spent spell. The spell is cast at its original level and retains all its original properties.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability for the next 24 hours after casting a spell.

abilities.warioNote: Hey! You think you can just redo your spells? It's gonna cost ya, buddy!

abilities.name: Shattering Slice
abilities.description: Deal an additional 1d6 damage on a critical hit with any melee weapon.
abilities.apReason: This mid-tier combat ability provides a notable boost to critical hit damage, justifying its cost of 2 AP.
abilities.levelReason: This ability enhances critical hit damage at the mid-tier level, providing a significant combat edge.

rules.effect: If you score a critical hit with a melee weapon, deal an additional 1d6 damage. This effect ends if the target is no longer incapacitated.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if your Strength modifier is less than +2.

abilities.warioNote: Feel the power surge through your blade! Shattering Slice makes critical hits even more devastating!

abilities.name: Bullet Glide
abilities.description: Elevate your shots, gaining +1d6 damage on ranged weapon attacks.
abilities.apReason: Provides a small reliable edge with a minor drawback that keeps the ability balanced.
abilities.levelReason: Gains a reliable combat edge at level 3 for Gunslingers.

rules.effect: When you make a ranged weapon attack, roll an additional d6 and add it to the damage.
rules.drawback: Requires precise aiming, reducing accuracy by 1 on all ranged attacks until the start of your next turn.

abilities.warioNote: Bullet Glide? Oh sure, and next you’ll be asking me for a deal on 'Bullet Ballet' too. It’s all in the wrist, kid!

abilities.name: Evasion Dive
abilities.description: The spy darts behind an opponent, gaining advantage on their next attack roll.
abilities.apReason: Provides significant tactical flexibility and advantage at mid-tier, costing two AP for moderate encounter impact.
abilities.levelReason: Spies need a reliable mid-tier ability to escape or reposition during combat.

rules.effect: The spy can use this ability once per turn when they move at least 10 feet to avoid an attack. On their next turn, they gain advantage on their first attack roll.
rules.drawback: If the spy does not make a successful attack after gaining advantage, they must immediately disengage from combat.

abilities.warioNote: It's like teleporting behind your foe... but with a little sweat!

abilities.name: Commanding Vigor
abilities.description: Grant allies temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier + your level, lasting until they take damage.
abilities.apReason: A high-tier ability that provides strong support for the party, justifying a 3 AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Enables strong rest-based support that scales with the leader's level and Wisdom.

rules.uses: Once per short or long rest
rules.effect: All allies within 30 feet gain temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier + your level. Ends when an ally takes damage.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if you are incapacitated.

abilities.warioNote: Need some extra juice to keep your crew standing? This one’ll do the trick! Just don’t expect it when you’re out cold.

abilities.name: Epic Gamble
abilities.description: Roll a twenty-sided die. On a natural 20, gain +10 temporary hit points and an extra action this turn.
abilities.apReason: One big moment per session with a clear cost—this is a defining play call for a character's career.
abilities.levelReason: Unleashes at the apex of a player's career for that one defining moment.

rules.effect: Roll a d20. On a natural 20, gain +10 temporary hit points and an additional action this turn.
rules.drawback: If you roll anything below a 5, you must declare your next move to the DM before continuing.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, why not. Risk everything and hope for the best! What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Mighty Shield Wall
abilities.description: At your command, a wall of militia shields rises to block all incoming attacks.
abilities.apReason: This epic-level ability requires immense focus and energy to command such a large-scale defensive formation.
abilities.levelReason: Only epic defenders can command such a dramatic and powerful display.

rules.effect: All allies within 5 feet gain a +4 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn. Ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: You must make a DC 20 Con saving throw, or be stunned for 1 round.

abilities.warioNote: Well, it's not every day you get to sell training that can summon a shield wall! Priceless!

abilities.name: Masterful Fabrication
abilities.description: Craft a masterwork tool or weapon that grants +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls for the rest of the day.
abilities.apReason: Crafting a masterwork item is a dramatic and costly endeavor, requiring extensive resources and time.
abilities.levelReason: Requires deep mastery over tools, unlocking at epic level.

rules.duration: Until end of next short or long rest
rules.effect: Craft a masterwork tool or weapon; target gains +2 to attack and damage rolls with it until end of next short or long rest. Saves against effects that would change the object's form negate.
rules.drawback: The object must be crafted from available materials; no magic items can be created.

abilities.warioNote: Sell this training? You're daft! Crafting somethin' truly special takes more than just money!

abilities.name: Radiant Aegis
abilities.description: Create a shimmering barrier that reflects damage back at attackers, dealing radiant damage to them.
abilities.apReason: This mid-tier ability provides significant defensive value with a cost that reflects its strong impact on encounters.
