abilities.levelReason: Paladins gain the ability to protect their allies with divine power as they grow stronger in faith and combat.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until the effect ends
rules.effect: When an attacker hits you, it instead deals radiant damage equal to your Paladin level + your Wisdom modifier. You can end this effect as a bonus action.
rules.drawback: You must be proficient in shields and have a shield equipped for this ability.

abilities.warioNote: For just two AP, you get to make those attackers feel the burn of your divine wrath! What could be better?

abilities.name: Shadowslip Dodge
abilities.description: On a successful Dexterity saving throw, you become invisible until your next action.
abilities.apReason: Level 4 ability providing a reliable edge with at will use.
abilities.levelReason: Rogues gain the ability to use their Dexterity for more than just attacks by level 4.

rules.effect: You make a Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, you become invisible until your next action. This effect ends if you take damage or are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: Requires a successful Dexterity saving throw.

abilities.warioNote: This one's a slippery escape, but make sure your reflexes are sharp!

abilities.name: Berserker Rampage
abilities.description: In a wild fury, the barbarian deals an extra 1d6 damage on melee attacks.
abilities.apReason: Requires moderate focus and discipline to maintain the enraged state longer.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocks when the barbarian's rage becomes more devastating at level 8.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you take damage
rules.effect: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, add 1d6 extra damage. Ends when you are incapacitated or take damage.
rules.drawback: You risk losing your rage if you use this ability too often.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it's a rush, but watch out—too much of a good thing can backfire!

abilities.name: Arcane Juggle
abilities.description: Juggle three fireballs, dodging attacks by throwing them to nearby targets.
abilities.apReason: This ability offers a small but useful edge in handling multiple threats without costing more than a reliable bonus action.
abilities.levelReason: Wizards gain more control over their spells as they advance; this lets them manage multiple threats at once.

rules.effect: Throw three fireballs, which can each be redirected to a different target within range. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 fire damage; on a miss, you take 2d6 fire damage.
rules.drawback: You must maintain concentration for the duration of the ability or it ends early.

abilities.warioNote: Watch out, you might juggle yourself into a fireball!

abilities.name: Shatter Shield
abilities.description: Deal extra damage to shields by breaking through their defenses.
abilities.apReason: Requires precision and timing, making it impactful at mid-tier abilities.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters gain the ability to break through enemy defenses at this level.

rules.effect: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, it must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or take an additional 2d6 damage. The effect ends when the target no longer has a shield.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if your own shield is damaged.

abilities.warioNote: Alright, you want to break their guard? This’ll do the trick! Just don’t forget your own shield!

abilities.name: Shade Sprint
abilities.description: Disguise yourself as a shadow to move silently past enemies, ignoring opportunity attacks.
abilities.apReason: Changes one encounter beat by allowing the Spy to escape or move silently past enemies at a moderate cost.
abilities.levelReason: Spies need reliable methods of escape and silent movement.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you move less than 30 feet
rules.effect: You gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Until the end of your next turn, you ignore opportunity attacks for movement.
rules.drawback: While in this form, your speed is halved.

abilities.warioNote: It's like being a ghost... for a little while. What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Brew Potion
abilities.description: Quickly brew a potion using common ingredients, granting a one-time use of your next spell.
abilities.apReason: The ability provides a useful utility that allows a Commoner to quickly create potions, offering a small reliable edge at level 2.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners can quickly gather resources and create simple potions at level 2.

rules.effect: As a bonus action, you may prepare a potion of your choice. The potion is consumed when used but does not require an action to activate.
rules.drawback: You can only use this ability once per day.

abilities.warioNote: Selling the secret to potion brewing? You can’t get much cheaper than this, but you better have the right ingredients!

abilities.name: Mighty Shield Slam
abilities.description: Slam your shield into enemies, dealing bludgeoning damage and knocking them prone.
abilities.apReason: Provides a small reliable edge in combat, allowing for an additional move action with a cost.
abilities.levelReason: The militia benefits from a reliable combat move early in their career.

rules.effect: You slam your shield into an enemy within reach, dealing 1d8 + Strength modifier bludgeoning damage and knocking it prone. The effect ends if you move more than 5 feet away.
rules.drawback: After using this ability, you must make a DC 8 Constitution saving throw or be fatigued until your next short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Fatigue? Fatigue? What's that? Just another day at the militia, Wario!

abilities.name: Finish Mastery
abilities.description: Complete a masterpiece in one swift motion, dealing 2d8 + Intelligence modifier force damage to an enemy.
abilities.apReason: This epic-level ability requires a significant investment of time and resources, justifying its high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Mastery of craft and combat allows the Artisan to execute a perfect finish at their peak level.

rules.effect: You make a melee touch attack against one creature. On hit, it takes 2d8 + Intelligence modifier force damage and is knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You must spend 10 minutes crafting an item before you can use this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Want to finish that project right? It's like... 10 minutes of hard work. But the results are worth it!

abilities.name: Blinding Light
abilities.description: Paladin unleashes a burst of light, blinding nearby enemies for one round.
abilities.apReason: Provides a strong combat maneuver that can control multiple enemies, justifying its cost at this level tier.
abilities.levelReason: Requires high-tier offensive and control abilities to be meaningful at this level.

rules.effect: Each creature within 10 feet of the Paladin must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded until the start of its next turn. The effect ends if the creature moves more than 5 feet.
rules.drawback: Requires concentration and leaves the Paladin vulnerable to attacks for one round.

abilities.warioNote: For those who think a little blinding light is no big deal. Hahaha, you should try dodging THAT!

abilities.name: Furycleave
abilities.description: Deal massive damage to all enemies within a burst, ending their rage.
abilities.apReason: Furycleave is a high-tier combat ability that provides party-wide damage and debuff, justifying its cost.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians need high-tier abilities that offer party-wide buffs and hard control.

rules.effect: You deal 3d8 + Strength modifier damage to all creatures within a 10-foot radius. They must make a DC (8 + Proficiency + Constitution) Constitution saving throw or become exhausted until the end of their next turn.
rules.drawback: This ability costs 3 AP and requires you to be raging.

abilities.warioNote: For those who think they’re tough... until this comes crashing down!

abilities.name: Arcane Doodle
abilities.description: Quickly sketch a spell sigil that grants a minor benefit or provides insight.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge for a minor action cost at level 3.
abilities.levelReason: Wizards need quick solutions for tricky situations, even at level 3.

rules.effect: You sketch a sigil that provides insight into one ability check or spellcasting roll you make within the next hour. You gain advantage on this check or roll.
rules.drawback: The sigil fades after use, and cannot be reused.

abilities.warioNote: It's just a doodle, but it'll give ya that extra edge in a pinch!

abilities.name: Shatterpoint Slash
abilities.description: Deal piercing damage with each successful melee attack, doubling your weapon's critical hit range.
abilities.apReason: Provides a moderate damage boost and control effect through doubling critical hit range at mid-level play.
abilities.levelReason: Provides a significant combat edge for fighters specializing in martial weapons at mid-level play.

rules.duration: until end of your next turn
rules.effect: On a hit, you deal an additional 2d6 piercing damage and double the weapon's critical hit range for this attack.
rules.drawback: If you miss with the initial attack, you cannot use Shatterpoint Slash on that turn.

abilities.warioNote: For just two AP? You get extra damage and better crits! What could be fairer?

abilities.name: Shady Maneuver
abilities.description: Swap places with a creature within 30 feet, disorienting them for their next action.
abilities.apReason: Requires strategic positioning and changes one encounter beat, making it mid-tier for level 7.
abilities.levelReason: Allows the Spy to disrupt combat flow at mid-tier levels.

rules.duration: until end of next target's turn
rules.effect: You and one willing creature within range exchange positions. The target must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or become disoriented until the start of their next turn.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again until after completing a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: It's shady! But it works. Watch the disorientation hit!

abilities.name: Festive Feast
abilities.description: Share a hearty meal with allies, granting each one temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier until they finish eating.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a strong support effect for the party and requires preparation, justifying the higher AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Leadership abilities at level 10 should have strong party-wide effects that can turn the tide of an encounter.

rules.effect: Each touched ally regains temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier (4 + Wis modifier). Ends when the ally finishes eating.
rules.drawback: You must prepare a meal that can be shared, costing 10 gp.

abilities.warioNote: Hey! It's not every day you get to sell training that lets you feed your friends! But hey, it’s free health points—what could be better?

abilities.name: Toad's Trick
abilities.description: Transform into a toad and gain +2 AC and the ability to leap up to 10 feet.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge that offers both defensive and movement benefits at a low cost.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners can perform small reliable edges as they grow more confident with their abilities.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until a short rest
rules.effect: You gain +2 AC and can leap up to 10 feet as a bonus action. Ends when you take damage.
rules.drawback: While in this form, you cannot use your hands for anything other than moving.

abilities.warioNote: For just one AP? You get to be a toad! What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Wall Smash
abilities.description: Smash through obstacles to clear a path for your allies or create cover.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge that enhances combat utility at level 3.
abilities.levelReason: Militia can now effectively clear obstacles at this level.

rules.effect: You gain a +2 bonus to Strength (Athletics) checks for the next minute. If you fail an Athletics check, you can make one additional attempt.
rules.drawback: After using this ability, you are disoriented and cannot take reactions until your next short rest.

abilities.warioNote: For just a single AP? You get to bash through walls like they're made of paper! What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Masterpiece Tool
abilities.description: Create a tool-made weapon that deals 2d8 damage and grants +1 bonus to attack rolls for the next hour.
abilities.apReason: Level 19 is epic tier; this ability provides a significant combat boost with a clear cost.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 19 allows for a dramatic, once-per-session boost in combat prowess using familiar tools.

rules.duration: Until the start of your next turn after an hour passes
rules.effect: Create a weapon made from common materials (e.g., a hammer or a pair of pliers) that deals 2d8 slashing damage. You gain +1 to attack rolls with this weapon until the end of your next turn after an hour passes.
rules.drawback: The created tool must be discarded at the start of your next turn, and you cannot use it again for 24 hours.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! This Masterpiece Tool might just save your life in that big boss fight, but remember, you can only use it once every day. And after an hour of fighting, you'll be left with nothing but memories... and maybe some minor injuries!

abilities.name: Hammerfall Aegis
abilities.description: Deal holy damage to a foe while granting temporary hit points to allies within reach.
abilities.apReason: This high-tier ability provides a meaningful burst and party-wide buff, justifying its cost in Ability Points.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, Paladins can execute powerful divine techniques that have lasting effects on the battlefield.

rules.effect: Deal 6d8 holy damage to a creature within reach and grant each ally within 5 feet 2d4 temporary hit points. Ends when the target drops to 0 hit points.
rules.drawback: You must be within 30 feet of at least one ally for this ability to function.

abilities.warioNote: For those who think they're too good for the basics, but still want that extra edge. Priceless!

abilities.name: Fury Cleave
abilities.description: Deal massive damage to all creatures within a 10-foot radius. You must move at least 5 feet after activation.
abilities.apReason: A powerful burst combat ability that requires a significant movement cost.
abilities.levelReason: Unleashes a powerful burst attack for a Barbarian's final form.

rules.effect: Each creature in the area takes 8d6 slashing damage (DC 17 Consave halves). If they fail, you gain advantage on your next attack this turn.
rules.drawback: You must move at least 5 feet after using Fury Cleave.

abilities.warioNote: Watch your step, mister! One good shake and you'll be running like the wind!

abilities.name: Arcane Gesture
abilities.description: Quickly scribe a spell in midair, causing an illusory duplicate to distract foes.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge, giving the wizard an instant spell duplicate for strategic use.
abilities.levelReason: Wizard's higher Intelligence allows for quick and effective spell-casting gestures.

rules.duration: 1 round per level of the copied spell
rules.effect: Create an illusory duplicate that duplicates a 2nd-level or lower spell you know, with a save DC of 8 + your Intelligence modifier. The illusion ends if it is hit by an attack.
rules.drawback: The gesture consumes your bonus action and cannot be used again until after a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: It's like drawing magic in the air—what could go wrong?

abilities.name: Steady Shield
abilities.description: Gain +1 bonus to AC as long as you are holding a shield.
abilities.apReason: Provides moderate defensive benefit at a reasonable cost for mid-tier fighters.
abilities.levelReason: Enhances combat effectiveness by providing additional defense for mid-tier fighters.

rules.effect: You gain +1 to AC as long as you are holding a shield. This effect ends if you drop your shield or use it in an attack.
rules.drawback: If you drop the shield, you lose this bonus and provoke opportunity attacks until you hold one again.

abilities.warioNote: It's just a shield! What’s not to like? Except when it falls off...

abilities.name: Unite the Band
abilities.description: Shout a rallying cry that grants allies temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier x3 until they enter combat.
abilities.apReason: This is a strong per-rest play, party-wide buff that justifies a high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Leadership abilities become powerful party-wide buffs at this level, providing sustainable support for the team.

rules.duration: Until you or an ally enters combat
rules.effect: All allies within range gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier x3.
rules.drawback: You must be at least 20 feet away from any enemy when using this ability.

abilities.warioNote: For the price of four bananas, unite your team in a burst of morale! What could possibly go wrong?

abilities.name: Swift Potion
abilities.description: Create a minor healing potion as a bonus action, providing +1d4+Charisma modifier temporary hit points.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge at level 4, providing utility when healing is needed.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners need to unlock reliable utility at this level.

rules.effect: DC 8 + proficiency + Charisma modifier saving throw (harder to imbue); ends on a failed save; grants +1d4+Charisma modifier temporary hit points.
rules.drawback: Reduces your speed by 10 feet until the next short or long rest.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Need a quick fix? This potion ain't cheap... but it’ll save ya in a pinch!

abilities.name: Perfect Finishing Touch
abilities.description: On your turn, you may apply a flawless final touch to an ongoing artisan project, instantly completing it.
abilities.apReason: This is a dramatic, one-time-per-session ability that can drastically alter an encounter or quest.
abilities.levelReason: Only Artisans at the peak of their craft can masterfully finish projects in one decisive move.

rules.effect: You complete a project that has been worked on for at least an hour, providing a +2 bonus to the next Craft check related to it. The project must be within 5 feet and have made progress.
rules.drawback: The project must be in your current line of sight and you must have spent at least one short rest working on it.

abilities.warioNote: For Wario, this would be like finishing your entire meal in one bite—too good to be true!

abilities.name: Radiant Beacon
abilities.description: You emit a radiant light that grants temporary hit points to allies within 30 feet, boosting their resolve.
abilities.apReason: At level 11, this ability is a strong per-rest play that offers significant support to the party for 2 AP.
abilities.levelReason: At level 11, Paladins can offer significant support to the party with this powerful per-rest play ability.

rules.duration: Concentration up to 1 hour or until you lose hit points
rules.effect: All allies within range gain 2d8 temporary hit points. Ends if you fall unconscious.
rules.drawback: You must concentrate and can't regain hit points while doing so.

abilities.warioNote: Need a little light in your day? This one’s bright and powerful! Only costs 3 AP though—what could go wrong?

abilities.name: Shadowslice Glide
abilities.description: Teleport behind an enemy to strike with a rapier, ending in cover.
abilities.apReason: Requires mobility and precision, offering a moderate combat advantage at level 5.
abilities.levelReason: Rogues gain the precision and mobility needed for this combat maneuver at level 5.

rules.effect: You teleport behind an enemy within 30 feet, dealing 1d6 + DEX modifier piercing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 12 DEX save or be knocked prone. You end the effect in cover.
rules.drawback: Can only be used after seeing your target for at least one round.

abilities.warioNote: It's not every day you can stab someone in the back without them knowing it! Pricey, but worth it!

abilities.name: Rampage of the Beast
abilities.description: For one turn, you transform into a raging beast, doubling your strength and dealing extra damage to enemies within reach.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a dramatic one-turn advantage at the highest level tier with significant drawbacks to balance its power.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians gain unparalleled power at this level for their final epic moments of battle.

rules.effect: You gain +2 to STR and deal an extra 3d6 damage on melee attacks. Ends if you are knocked unconscious.
rules.drawback: While in this form, you cannot use any other action or reaction.

abilities.warioNote: Folks, it's like getting devoured by a bear... and then becoming one. Priceless!

abilities.name: Phantom Step
abilities.description: Teleport a short distance to escape an opponent or reach cover, reappearing immediately.
abilities.apReason: Requires precise timing and strategic positioning, making it moderately powerful for mid-level play.
abilities.levelReason: Allows for quick escapes and strategic positioning in combat.

rules.effect: You teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. A successful DC 12 Dexterity saving throw ends the effect early.
rules.drawback: Teleporting requires concentration, and failure on a save teleports you back to your previous location.

abilities.warioNote: Phantom Step? It's like disappearing act, but only for a second. Better watch where you're going!

abilities.name: Rampage Strike
abilities.description: Deal massive damage to a single foe, but you must engage every round until the effect ends.
abilities.apReason: Requires significant burst damage and continuous engagement for its effect, making it a strong but costly ability.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 9 provides a strong per-rest play for fighters seeking burst damage.

rules.duration: until the end of your next short rest
rules.effect: You make one melee attack against a creature within reach. On a hit, it takes 3d10 + Strength modifier slashing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You must continue to engage with the same enemy every round during combat until you take no actions in a turn.

abilities.warioNote: It's like taking on the whole gym — one workout at a time!

abilities.name: Flash Reload
abilities.description: Swap two firearm magazines with perfect aim, granting +1d6 damage to your next shot.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge, providing a quick tactical advantage at minimal cost.
abilities.levelReason: Requires nimble fingers and calm under pressure for a smooth reload.

rules.effect: You swap two firearm magazines, dealing an additional +1d6 damage to your next attack roll. This effect ends if you miss with the weapon or when you make another weapon attack.
rules.drawback: May only be used once per round.

abilities.warioNote: It's like a second chance! Reload faster than your competition!

abilities.name: Shadow Slip
abilities.description: Disappear into shadows for a round, moving through difficult terrain as if it weren't there.
abilities.apReason: Requires precise timing and a bonus action, offering significant tactical advantage at this level.
abilities.levelReason: Allows the Spy to gain an advantage in combat by temporarily becoming elusive.

rules.effect: You become invisible and can move through difficult terrain as if it were normal terrain. End when you attack or take damage.
rules.drawback: You leave a faint shadow trail that can be used to track your movement.

abilities.warioNote: Don't think it's easy! You gotta time it just right... or you'll leave a big ol' shadow on the battlefield!

abilities.name: Unity Roar
abilities.description: A powerful rallying cry that grants allies advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until their next action.
abilities.apReason: A strong per-rest play that offers significant buffs to party performance, justifying the high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Allows leaders to significantly boost allied performance in critical moments, just before a major encounter.

rules.duration: Until the start of each ally's next action
rules.uses: Once per short or long rest
rules.effect: All allies within range gain advantage on attack rolls and saving throws. Ends if an ally moves more than 10 feet away.
rules.drawback: Requires a leader to speak clearly, which can be difficult in noisy combat.

abilities.warioNote: For those who think they're too cool for a little team boost? Pricey but effective!

abilities.name: Mudslide Smash
abilities.description: Smash the ground with a powerful toad kick, sending mud and debris at enemies within reach.
abilities.apReason: Requires a bonus action but provides reliable combat support at an intermediate level.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners gain this ability when they can contribute more reliably in combat.

rules.effect: You make a melee attack against all creatures within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone.
rules.drawback: After using this ability, your next movement action incurs disadvantage.

abilities.warioNote: It's like kicking up a storm... for just 2 AP!

abilities.name: Wall Slam
abilities.description: Smash into a foe with your shield, pushing them back and knocking them prone.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge that requires no resources to use but has a cost in terms of weapon utility.
abilities.levelReason: Militia can reliably execute this tactic after several training sessions.

rules.effect: Make a strength check against an enemy's AC. On a success, the target is pushed back 5 feet and knocked prone; on failure, it moves back 10 feet.
rules.drawback: You are disarmed for your next action.

abilities.warioNote: It's like selling you a shield and telling you it can double as a battering ram—except it actually works!

abilities.name: Tool Toss
abilities.description: Throw your tools with deadly precision, dealing 1d6 + Intelligence modifier slashing damage on a hit.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge that enhances combat flexibility at level 2.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans at level 2 can refine their throws to be more than just improvised weapons.

rules.effect: Make a ranged weapon attack against a creature within range. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 + Intelligence modifier slashing damage.
rules.drawback: You must use an item from your Tools inventory to perform this action.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there, wanna learn how to make a quick getaway? You can’t run if you’re on the ground, and this’ll leave 'em flat!

abilities.name: Divine Shieldwall
abilities.description: Paladins can create a shimmering barrier that blocks the next attack against them, but it only protects one ally within reach.
abilities.apReason: At level 14, this ability offers a dramatic and limited shield that can change one encounter beat while requiring significant sacrifice from the Paladin.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 14 allows Paladins to provide an epic shield for their allies in the most critical moments of battle.

rules.effect: The Paladin creates a barrier that negates the damage of the next attack against them, but it transfers to one ally within 5 feet. The ally must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take half as much damage.
rules.drawback: After using Divine Shieldwall, the Paladin is vulnerable for the rest of their turn.

abilities.warioNote: Alright, you want to protect your buds? Sure! But don't think I’m just handing out free shields here.

abilities.name: Evasive Slide
abilities.description: As a bonus action, you can slide through tight spaces or between enemies, ending up at least 5 feet away.
abilities.apReason: Provides a versatile and strategic advantage that changes one encounter beat.
abilities.levelReason: Allows the rogue to exploit tight spaces for quick escapes and repositioning.

rules.effect: You can move up to your speed as a bonus action. You must end the movement at least 5 feet away from where you started.
rules.drawback: If you are hit by an attack while using this ability, you take double damage.

abilities.warioNote: It’s like being a wily fox—slipping through the cracks!

abilities.name: Stormborn Roar
abilities.description: Roar like a tempest, forcing enemies to reevaluate your strength with a blinding light and deafening sound.
abilities.apReason: This is an epic-tier ability that provides dramatic impact with a clear cost.
abilities.levelReason: Harnesses the power of the wild at its peak, only possible in the epic stages of mastery.

rules.effect: All creatures within range must make a DC 24 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded and deafened for the duration. Ends on a turn if you take any damage.
rules.drawback: You can only use this ability once per day, limiting its impact.

abilities.warioNote: Pricey, but who needs to see or hear you coming? It's all about the show!

abilities.name: Eternity's Veil
abilities.description: Summon an impenetrable arcane barrier that lasts until dispelled or a creature passes through it.
abilities.apReason: This ability unlocks dramatic moments per session, offering a significant strategic advantage at level 18, justifying its high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: At level 18, wizards have mastered the art of manipulating time and space with their spells.

rules.duration: Until dispelled or a creature passes through it
rules.effect: Create an impenetrable barrier with a 20-foot radius. Creatures must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be pushed back to their origin point if they attempt to enter.
rules.drawback: The spell drains the caster's life force, reducing their hit points by half for 24 hours.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, it’s just like buying a castle with this one. Watch your wallet!

abilities.name: Shatter Strike
abilities.description: Deal massive damage to a single foe, breaking their defenses and stunning them.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a meaningful combat burst at level 11, justifying its high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Requires significant strength and combat expertise to unleash such destructive power.

rules.effect: You make a melee attack against one creature within range. On a hit, you deal an additional 2d10 damage and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be stunned until the end of your next turn.
rules.drawback: After using Shatter Strike, you cannot use it again for 1 minute.

abilities.warioNote: For those with the heart of an emperor... or at least a tyrant. Watch your step!

abilities.name: Reload Dance
abilities.description: Quickly reload firearms while dealing an additional point of damage on your next attack.
abilities.apReason: Provides a moderate combat boost and recharges per short rest, fitting for mid-tier level 5.
abilities.levelReason: Gunslingers need reliable methods to maintain their weapon flow in combat.

rules.effect: When you make an attack with a firearm, add 1d6 to the damage. This effect ends on your next short rest.
rules.drawback: You must reload any used firearms at the end of this ability's duration.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Reload Dance? Sounds like a fun little dance. But let me remind you—those firearms still need reloading after the show!

abilities.name: Epic Rally
abilities.description: A single, forceful command grants all allies within 30 feet advantage on attack rolls until the end of their next turn.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a significant tactical boost for the entire party, making it epic in scope and impact.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, leaders can dramatically shift the tide of battle with a single, defining moment.

rules.duration: until the end of their next turn for each ally
rules.effect: All allies within range gain advantage on attack rolls. This effect ends when they make an attack roll.
rules.drawback: The leader cannot use this ability again until after a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: And here I was thinking you'd want to save that one for your biggest boss fight! Priceless!

abilities.name: Toad's Tactician
abilities.description: Temporarily improve your and nearby allies' rolls by suggesting clever tactics.
abilities.apReason: Improves tactical coordination, useful for mid-tier engagements.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners start to understand how to coordinate efforts in battle.

rules.effect: When you use this ability, all allies within your range can reroll one attack roll or saving throw before the outcome is determined. You must have at least one ally in the area.
rules.drawback: You and your allies gain no benefit if there are no enemies within 60 feet.

abilities.warioNote: Sell this training? Are you crazy? It’s like having a built-in battle strategist!

abilities.name: Defensive Stance
abilities.description: Gain +1 to AC as a bonus action, but suffer disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws until your next short or long rest.
abilities.apReason: Provides a strong defensive boost with a moderate cost that fits the mid-tier level and ability point system.
abilities.levelReason: Provides strong temporary defense, changing one encounter beat with its moderate cost and duration.

rules.duration: 1 minute (ends when you finish a short or long rest)
rules.uses: once per short or long rest
rules.effect: Gain +1 to AC. You have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws until your next short or long rest.
rules.drawback: Suffers disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws while active.

abilities.warioNote: You think this is cheap? It's like getting extra shields without the extra weight!

abilities.name: Tool Defense
abilities.description: Temporarily bolster your armor with an artisan's tools, granting a +1 bonus to AC for 1 round.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge, providing a temporary bonus to AC as a bonus action.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans gain the ability to enhance their defenses in combat at this level.

rules.effect: You gain a +1 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn. This effect ends if you drop or abandon your tools.
rules.drawback: Your tools become too unstable for further use until after your next short rest.

abilities.warioNote: It's just tools... but who needs armor when you've got precision?

abilities.name: Sanctified Strike
abilities.description: Deal radiant damage and grant temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier.
abilities.apReason: Provides both immediate combat support and healing at level 3, offering a reliable edge in low-level encounters.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins gain the ability to channel divine energy at a higher level, providing immediate combat support.

rules.effect: Deal 1d8 radiant damage and grant temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier (max. hits: 2). Ends when you take damage.
rules.drawback: You must concentrate on this ability for the duration, and it can only be used after a long rest.

abilities.warioNote: Watch your wallet! This little strike packs quite the punch for just one AP!

abilities.name: Shady Escape
abilities.description: On a successful Dexterity (Stealth) check, you can immediately teleport to an unoccupied square within 30 feet.
abilities.apReason: Requires a bonus action and offers moderate control/escape benefits at level 7.
abilities.levelReason: Mid-tier Rogue abilities offer moderate control and escape options.

rules.effect: You teleport to an unoccupied square within 30 feet. You must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + Dexterity modifier). On failure, you land in the nearest occupied space.
rules.drawback: If your target is within range, they can use their reaction to attempt to hit you with an attack.

abilities.warioNote: Watch your step, Rogues! This one’s a slippery escape, but it costs ya two AP!

abilities.name: Feral Stance
abilities.description: Gain advantage on Strength checks and saving throws until you take damage.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge that grants a significant combat advantage at level 2.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians gain more control over their primal fury starting at level 2.

rules.effect: You gain advantage on Strength checks and saving throws. This ends when you take any damage.
rules.drawback: While in Feral Stance, you are more susceptible to being knocked prone.

abilities.warioNote: This stance is like giving your Strength checks a buddy! But be careful—it might just make you fall flat on your face!

abilities.name: Infinity Scroll
abilities.description: Create an endless supply of one spell, but it must be memorized anew each dawn.
abilities.apReason: Unlocking an infinite supply of spells, even at high level, is a significant advantage, thus costing 4 AP.
abilities.levelReason: The Infinity Scroll allows wizards to cast an infinite number of spells per day, unlocking at the highest level tier.

rules.duration: Until dawn on the next calendar day
rules.effect: You create a scroll that allows you to cast one spell of your choice, but it counts as memorized and is consumed. You must prepare this spell anew at the start of each new day.
rules.drawback: The scroll consumes one spell slot per use and requires you to re-memorize the spell daily.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it's like having a bottomless pit of magic! Just remember to go to bed early!

abilities.name: Epic Shield Slam
abilities.description: Smash through enemies with a thunderous charge, stunning foes within reach.
abilities.apReason: This is a dramatic, once-per-session ability that requires significant resource management at the highest level of play.
abilities.levelReason: Only at level 20 can the fighter unleash this devastating close combat technique.

rules.effect: Make a melee attack against one creature within reach. On hit, it is stunned until the end of your next turn (DC 25 Con save). The effect ends if you move more than 10 feet away from it.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability on creatures immune to being stunned.

abilities.warioNote: Wow, you want THIS? Well, it's not cheap... But then again, nothing worth having ever was!

abilities.name: Shadowmeld Dive
abilities.description: Instantly vanish into shadows, granting yourself and a companion total concealment for one round.
abilities.apReason: Requires precise timing and execution, making it a strong burst play that impacts multiple targets.
abilities.levelReason: At level 10, Spies have the combat experience to execute this high-risk, high-reward stealth maneuver effectively.

rules.range: self and one ally within 30 feet
rules.effect: Both you and your target gain total cover from the DM's choice of a shadowy area; ends on initiative turn.
rules.drawback: You must be in dim light or darkness to use this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Need to disappear into the night? This one’s got you covered... for just three APs!

abilities.name: Unity's Vow
abilities.description: Call upon allies within 30 feet for an epic rally, granting them +2 to AC and damage until the end of your next turn.
abilities.apReason: Requires a dramatic and impactful moment; thus, it costs 4 AP as per the epic tier.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 18 provides a dramatic moment that can turn the tide of battle.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: All allies within range gain +2 to AC and melee damage until the end of your next turn. Save DC 18 (Wisdom saving throw). Ends if an ally takes any damage.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used more than once per day, requiring a significant emotional or mental investment.

abilities.warioNote: This Unity's Vow is no cheap shot! It’s an all-or-nothing call that leaves you drained but empowers your team like never before!

abilities.name: Toad Toss
abilities.description: Leap into the air and deliver an improvised weapon with brutal force.
abilities.apReason: Provides a powerful combat option at mid-tier, requiring careful use of AP.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocks as Commoners gain mid-tier combat capabilities.

rules.effect: Make a melee weapon attack. On hit, deal an additional 2d6 damage and knock the target prone.
rules.drawback: Cannot use this ability if unarmed or without a suitable improvised weapon.

abilities.warioNote: Selling you this training? Sure, but don't expect to win every fight with just that!

abilities.name: Barrage Boost
abilities.description: Increase your allies' attack rolls by 2d6 until the end of your next turn.
abilities.apReason: A moderate damage boost requiring a short rest for recovery justifies the 2 AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Militia gain a moderate damage boost to aid their team in combat encounters.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: Each ally within 5 feet of you that attacks before their next turn gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls. Ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again until after completing a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: It's a cheap shot, but hey, it packs quite a punch! Watch your wallet!

abilities.name: Toolful Shield
abilities.description: Create a shield of malleable metal to block a single attack or spell.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge, allowing Artisans to block attacks at will without costing multiple actions.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans can reliably craft shields that provide immediate protection in combat.

rules.effect: DC 10 + proficiency + Intelligence modifier. On a successful save, you create a shield of metal to block the next attack or spell directed at you, reducing damage by 5 (or blocking it entirely if the attacker chooses). The shield lasts until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: Creating the shield exhausts your tools for the next short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! For just one AP, you get to turn your tools into a shield. What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Divine Conviction
abilities.description: Gain +2 to all saving throws until you fail one; your next successful attack deals an extra 1d6 holy damage.
abilities.apReason: This is a high-tier ability that provides significant buffs and debuffs, making it impactful per rest.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins gain potent divine abilities that can shift the tide of battle at this level.

rules.duration: Until you fail a saving throw or make an attack
rules.effect: You gain +2 to all saving throws until you fail one; your next successful melee hit deals an extra 1d6 holy damage. The effect ends when you fail a saving throw.
rules.drawback: After using this ability, you are vulnerable for the remainder of the encounter.

abilities.warioNote: Hey pal! Spendin' three AP on this? Ya sure ya want to feel holy AND extra vulnerable?

abilities.name: Silent Blade
abilities.description: You can move through enemy cover without provoking opportunity attacks.
abilities.apReason: This high-tier ability provides a strong burst of combat utility by allowing movement through enemy cover, which is crucial for positioning and escaping.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, rogues gain the ability to strike with deadly precision while bypassing obstacles.

rules.duration: until end of your next turn
rules.effect: You can move through any non-magical object that is Large or smaller without triggering opportunity attacks. This ends when you take damage.
rules.drawback: While using this ability, you cannot attack with precision until the end of your next turn.

abilities.warioNote: For just 3 AP? You can slip right past those pesky guards! But don't expect to land a hit in the next round.

abilities.name: Fury Sprint
abilities.description: On your move, you can sprint up to double your speed for 1 round.
abilities.apReason: Provides moderate combat advantage at mid-tier levels but comes with a stealth penalty.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians gain the ability to channel raw fury into enhanced combat prowess at mid-tier levels.

rules.effect: You gain double your speed until the start of your next turn. This effect ends if you are incapacitated or take a running or swimming action.
rules.drawback: While under this effect, you have disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and Wisdom (Perception) checks.

abilities.warioNote: Sure it's quick, but can't hide when you're sprinting!

abilities.name: Echo Spell
abilities.description: Recast a recent spell from memory without expending spell slots.
abilities.apReason: Allows for a powerful spell re-cast without expending resources at this level.
abilities.levelReason: Wizards gain the ability to recall past spells at this level.

rules.effect: Recast a previously cast spell. The DC for saving throws or the target of the spell is reduced by 2.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used on spells with material components, and it does not restore expended spell slots.

abilities.warioNote: Pay extra for the convenience! It's like having your cake AND eating it too!

abilities.name: Shattering Swing
abilities.description: Deal an extra d10 damage on a critical hit with any weapon.
abilities.apReason: High-tier ability requiring significant impact and resource management at level 10.
abilities.levelReason: Allows for significant burst damage output at level 10.

rules.effect: On a critical hit, deal an additional d10 damage. This effect ends when the Fighter makes another weapon attack.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if the Fighter has not yet made a weapon attack this turn.

abilities.warioNote: For those who swing hard, it swings even harder... for an extra $4.99!

abilities.name: Eclipse Shadow
abilities.description: During a full shadow, you can manipulate the darkness to teleport up to 30 feet once per encounter.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a significant tactical advantage at a high level, requiring strategic use and costing a substantial number of Ability Points.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, spies can exploit the cover of night for dramatic and decisive movement.

rules.effect: You teleport up to 30 feet as a bonus action. You must be within your movement range and have cover or concealment. The effect ends if you move more than 10 feet after the teleport.
rules.drawback: If you are seen during the shadow, you incur disadvantage on all hiding checks until the start of your next turn.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, why not? Shadow travel? For that price you could just buy a map!

abilities.name: Inspiring Gesture
abilities.description: Increase a nearby ally's attack roll by 2 until their next action.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge that supports allies, fitting the low-tier level 2 AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Support abilities often provide small but reliable bonuses to allies, making them valuable early in the game.

rules.duration: until the start of the target's next action
rules.effect: When you use this ability, choose an ally within range. Until the start of their next action, the ally’s attack rolls are advantage.
rules.drawback: You cannot inspire more than one ally at a time.

abilities.warioNote: It's just a little wave of confidence—what could go wrong?

abilities.name: Toad's Trap
abilities.description: Place a sticky trap that, when triggered, slows enemies for one turn.
abilities.apReason: Sets traps that provide short-term combat advantage, making it mid-tier at level 8.
abilities.levelReason: Requires the precision and situational awareness of an experienced commoner to set traps effectively.

rules.effect: Place a sticky trap. When triggered by an enemy, it imposes the restrained condition for one turn (DC 12 Dexterity save to end).
rules.drawback: Traps can be destroyed and have a limited range.

abilities.warioNote: These toads know how to make a mess too! For just two APs, you get to slow down your foes. Who knew commoners were so tricky?

abilities.name: Quick Craft
abilities.description: Craft an improvised weapon or tool as a bonus action, dealing damage equal to 1d6 + Intelligence modifier.
abilities.apReason: Crafting an item as a bonus action with moderate utility justifies a mid-tier AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans need quick improvisation at mid-level encounters.

rules.effect: Create an improvised weapon or tool, dealing 1d6 + Intelligence modifier damage. Ends when the item is discarded.
rules.drawback: Cannot create items if hands are occupied.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Got a quick fix for you: turn your handy dandy into a weapon in the blink of an eye!

abilities.name: Divine Vengeance
abilities.description: Call down a divine storm that deals radiant damage to enemies within an area, ending when the last foe is destroyed.
abilities.apReason: Dramatic effect at a high level, requiring careful timing.
abilities.levelReason: Only unlocked at Epic level for maximum dramatic effect.

rules.duration: Until the last enemy is destroyed or ends its turn
rules.effect: Each creature in a 15-foot radius deals an additional 4d8 radiant damage on hit. Ends when all enemies are dead.
rules.drawback: You must be within 30 feet of the target and use your reaction to activate.

abilities.warioNote: It's like raining on your enemies' parade... for you! But Wario says it costs too much AP!

abilities.name: Shadowstep Shadow
abilities.description: Disappear into the shadows for a moment, becoming invisible and gaining advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a dramatic one-time use effect that reshapes combat, justifying its high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: At level 14, Rogues can execute a dramatic, one-time use ability that reshapes combat entirely.

rules.duration: Until the end of your next turn
rules.uses: Once per short or long rest
rules.effect: You become invisible until the start of your next turn. You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made before you become visible.
rules.drawback: You cannot attack, cast a spell, or interact with objects while invisible.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it’s temporary, but imagine the look on your enemies' faces when you vanish into nothingness! Priceless!

abilities.name: Furyhowl
abilities.description: Roar to terrify enemies, granting allies advantage on saving throws until the end of their next turn.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a strong, per-rest play mechanic that enhances party-wide defenses against fear and psychic damage.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians at this level can handle more complex and impactful combat maneuvers.

rules.duration: until the start of your next turn for each ally within 30 feet
rules.effect: Each ally within 30 feet gains advantage on saving throws against fear and psychic damage until the start of their next turn. Ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: You must make a DC 15 Constitution save at the start of your turn or become frightened for 1 round.

abilities.warioNote: It's like selling you an ice cream cone... but it might make your friends braver... or maybe more scared. Your choice!

abilities.name: Mirage Shield
abilities.description: Create a mirage of yourself to confuse attackers, granting temporary cover.
abilities.apReason: Creating a battlefield advantage with a mirage requires coordination and precision, making it mid-tier in difficulty.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, the wizard gains more control over battlefield positioning and deception.

rules.duration: until end of next turn or attacked
rules.effect: You create a mirage that provides half cover for yourself and creatures you designate within the radius. The mirage lasts until the start of your next turn or if you are attacked.
rules.drawback: The mirage is only effective once per encounter.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Mirage Shield? Sure, why not? It’s just a little trick of light, right? Oh wait, you get confused by your own shadow. Priceless!

abilities.name: Rampage Drive
abilities.description: Engage in a berserk frenzy, increasing damage and movement speed but suffering disadvantage on saves.
abilities.apReason: A high-tier ability that offers a powerful burst effect at the cost of vulnerability and limited duration.
abilities.levelReason: A Fighter's powerful per-rest play to burst through enemies with overwhelming force.

rules.effect: Increase melee attack and movement speed by 2. Gain advantage on melee attacks but suffer disadvantage on saving throws until the end of your next long rest.
rules.drawback: While in Rampage Drive, you are vulnerable to critical hits.

abilities.warioNote: It's like asking for trouble... but it sure feels good while you're doing it!

abilities.name: Bullet Dive
abilities.description: Leap into a crowd of enemies, dealing damage to all within reach.
abilities.apReason: Provides moderate combat advantage with area-of-effect damage and a drawback that keeps it balanced for mid-tier abilities.
abilities.levelReason: Mid-tier combat ability that changes an encounter beat by introducing area-of-effect damage and movement.

rules.effect: You leap through a crowd of enemies, dealing 2d6 fire damage to all creatures in a 5-foot radius centered on you. The effect ends when the move is complete.
rules.drawback: On your turn after this ability, you have disadvantage on your next attack roll.

abilities.warioNote: It's like diving into a swarm of bees... but with bullets. Fun, right?

abilities.name: Evasion Glide
abilities.description: Gain advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks to avoid attacks.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge, granting a significant boost in stealthy situations at level 3.
abilities.levelReason: Spies benefit greatly from evading danger and gaining advantages in stealthy situations.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You gain advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks to avoid being hit by an attack.
rules.drawback: You must be surprised or caught flat-footed for this ability to activate.

abilities.warioNote: For just one AP? You get to dodge like a pro! What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Unity Nudge
abilities.description: Quickly bolster a fallen ally with an encouraging word, halving their fall damage on their next turn.
abilities.apReason: Provides a significant support benefit at a low cost, fitting for level 3.
abilities.levelReason: Leadership skills are honed early to assist allies in tough times.

rules.duration: until the start of the next turn for the target ally
rules.effect: The target takes no fall damage on their next turn. Save DC: 8 + proficiency + Charisma modifier.
rules.drawback: You must be able to see and reach the fallen ally.

abilities.warioNote: It's just a little nudge... but it can save your buddy from a bad fall!

abilities.name: Mass Charm
abilities.description: Charms up to three allies, granting advantage on their next saving throw against fear effects.
abilities.apReason: Mass Charm provides a strong party-wide buff, justifying 3 AP cost at level 9.
abilities.levelReason: At level 9, a Commoner can command the crowd with charisma and charm.

rules.duration: Until end of next short rest for each target
rules.effect: Each charmed ally gains advantage on their next saving throw against fear effects. Ends when the effect ends.
rules.drawback: The Commoner must be within 30 feet of all targets and can only use this ability once per long rest.

abilities.warioNote: For 3 AP? You get to charm up to three friends! What a deal!

abilities.name: Rebound Strike
abilities.description: After blocking a melee attack, redirect half the attacker's damage to them.
abilities.apReason: Provides a strong defensive play at mid-tier but requires immediate follow-up to stay effective.
abilities.levelReason: Provides reliable defensive edge after taking an attack.

rules.effect: When you block a melee attack, redirect half the damage to the attacker. The effect ends if you take more than half your hit points in damage.
rules.drawback: You must use an action on your next turn or lose this ability for 1 minute.

abilities.warioNote: It's like getting paid to be hit! Or at least you know it’s coming back!

abilities.name: Tool Slam
abilities.description: Smash your tool into a foe, dealing damage equal to your Artisan level + Intelligence modifier.
abilities.apReason: Requires precise timing and a rare moment of vulnerability from the foe.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans can now leverage their tools in combat effectively at this level.

rules.effect: You make a melee touch attack. On a hit, you deal 6d6 bludgeoning damage.
rules.drawback: Your tool must be held in your hand and is destroyed on failure.

abilities.warioNote: You can't beat me at weapon sales... unless you want to play with broken tools!

abilities.name: Shadowscape Dive
abilities.description: Teleport behind enemy lines, teleporting instantly into combat with advantage on your first attack.
abilities.apReason: Requires a dramatic and costly moment at epic tier; teleportation is inherently expensive in terms of AP.
abilities.levelReason: At epic tier, Rogues can execute high-risk maneuvers that drastically alter the battlefield.

rules.effect: You teleport behind enemy lines and gain advantage on your next attack roll against a creature you can see. This effect ends if you move more than 5 feet from the teleported location.
rules.drawback: You must be in shadowy conditions to use this ability, reducing its effectiveness in bright or well-lit areas.

abilities.warioNote: Watch out! This one's risky! Stepping into battle unseen? Priceless... but it'll empty your wallet!

abilities.name: Raging Storm
abilities.description: Unleash a primal storm that deals thunder damage to enemies within a burst, stunning those who fail their save.
abilities.apReason: A strong per-rest play that offers both damage and control, making it a critical ability at level 12.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians channel immense power at high levels for devastating effects on the battlefield.

rules.uses: Once per short or long rest
rules.effect: Each creature in a 20-foot radius sphere takes 8d6 thunder damage. Those failing a DC 17 Constitution save are also stunned until the end of their next turn.
rules.drawback: You must spend 4 hours meditating to recover use after casting.

abilities.warioNote: For only 3 AP, this training lets you unleash the fury of nature! Just don't expect to meditate in comfort.

abilities.name: Titanic Smash
abilities.description: Smash through enemy defenses, dealing massive damage to a single target.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic ability requires significant resources to use once per session.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, the fighter can unleash devastating power in one dramatic moment.

rules.effect: Make a melee attack against a single target. On hit, deal 2d10 + Strength modifier damage and knock the target prone.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used in areas of severe terrain.

abilities.warioNote: For those who think they’re already tough, this is the ultimate test of strength!

abilities.name: Bullet Tornado
abilities.description: Summons a spinning storm of bullets, dealing damage in a wide area.
abilities.apReason: A moderate combat ability that requires careful aim; unlocking at level 7.
abilities.levelReason: At level 7, the Gunslinger has refined their aim to unleash devastating firepower.

rules.effect: You create a spinning tornado of bullets, dealing 2d8 piercing damage to all creatures in the 30-foot line. DC 14 + Dex modifier + proficiency bonus = save DC; if you succeed on the save, you are immune to this ability for 1 minute.
rules.drawback: You must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and take half damage.

abilities.warioNote: These bullets are a bit pricey, but the look on your opponents' faces is worth it!

abilities.name: Commanding Legend
abilities.description: Harness the power of legendary heroes, temporarily boosting allies' stats by one die type for an hour.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a dramatic but limited buff to allies, making it a hard-limited effect at level 13.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 13 allows leaders to invoke a momentous event that can turn the tide in a dramatic encounter.

rules.duration: Until the end of the next long rest
rules.uses: At will with a short rest
rules.effect: Choose up to three allies within 30 feet. Each gains advantage on saving throws and a +1 bonus to attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws for one hour. Ends if you use this ability again.
rules.drawback: You must perform a heroic deed in combat that is narratively significant.

abilities.warioNote: For an extra four AP, make your friends feel like legends for an hour. Who needs a long rest when you can be the star of the show?

abilities.name: Shield of Dust
abilities.description: Summons a cloud of dust that grants temporary hit points to you and allies within reach, obscuring vision.
abilities.apReason: High-tier support ability requiring three AP for its significant restful benefit and duration
abilities.levelReason: High-tier support ability for restful burst healing and battlefield control.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you move more than 30 feet away from an ally within reach
rules.effect: You and all allies within reach gain temporary hit points equal to 4 + your Constitution modifier. This effect ends if you take a damage-dealing action.
rules.drawback: The area of effect is visible, potentially revealing your position.

abilities.warioNote: Why pay so much for a dusty old shield? You coulda just bought some better armor!

abilities.name: Mass Shield Slam
abilities.description: Smash all nearby enemies with a coordinated shield bash, stunning one target.
abilities.apReason: The ability provides a moderate combat advantage and control at an encounter-changing level, requiring coordination that costs two AP.
abilities.levelReason: Militia can now coordinate their efforts to overwhelm foes effectively at this level.

rules.duration: one target stunned until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: Each enemy within 5 feet must make a DC 12 Con saving throw or be knocked prone. One creature of your choice in range is also stunned until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You must wear heavy armor to use this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Now you can bash 'em all! Just don't forget your heavy armor!

abilities.name: Toolchain Toss
abilities.description: Fling your tools like makeshift weapons, dealing 1d6 bludgeoning damage and knocking targets prone.
abilities.apReason: Requires precision and a bonus action for situational combat utility.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans gain the precision to wield tools as lethal weapons by level 7.

rules.effect: You make a ranged weapon attack with an improvised tool. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone.
rules.drawback: If you miss, you drop any tools in your hand until your next action.

abilities.warioNote: These tools are sharp... but not THAT sharp. Still, it’s fun to watch them fly!

abilities.name: Judgmental Strike
abilities.description: Unleash a divine strike that deals radiant damage to an enemy, halving their AC for one round.
abilities.apReason: This ability grants a significant combat advantage with a high AP cost to reflect its power.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins' ability to deliver decisive blows becomes truly epic at this level.

rules.duration: until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: You deal an additional 2d8 radiant damage and halve the target's AC until the start of your next turn. Saving throw DC is 15 + your Charisma modifier.
rules.drawback: You must make a Wisdom saving throw against a DC of 15; on a failed save, you cannot use this ability for 24 hours.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it's flashy, but did you know it could leave you wide open if you fail that save? Pricey, but worth the risk!

abilities.name: Mirror Shield
abilities.description: Create a shimmering shield of light that blocks one attack at your initiative count.
abilities.apReason: Provides moderate defensive capabilities at mid-tier, making it a key resource in encounters.
abilities.levelReason: Creates a defensive mechanism to block attacks, useful in mid-tier encounters.

rules.effect: DC 14 + Intelligence modifier. On an attack roll against you, you can use your reaction to create a shimmering shield that blocks the damage. The effect ends if you take any other action on your turn.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability more than once per short or long rest.

abilities.warioNote: It's like having a shield that only works when you really need it—perfect for those last-second saves!

abilities.name: Rampage Shout
abilities.description: Shout a fearsome cry that sends nearby enemies into disarray, granting you and your allies advantage on attack rolls against them.
abilities.apReason: A dramatic moment that changes one encounter beat per session, justifying a high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Mastering battlefield tactics at this level allows for such dramatic declarations.

rules.duration: Until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: All creatures within 10 feet of you and yourself have advantage on attack rolls against all enemies until the end of your next turn. Ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: You must be able to speak normally to activate this ability.

abilities.warioNote: For those moments when you need to make the battlefield shake and tremble!

abilities.name: Reload Dive
abilities.description: Drop to one knee, reload your firearm, then leap up with a precise shot.
abilities.apReason: Reload Dive provides a significant combat advantage by allowing the Gunslinger to reload and attack in one action, making it a moderate investment for mid-tier play.
abilities.levelReason: Reload Dive is a mid-tier combat ability that allows the Gunslinger to quickly reload and shoot in succession, changing an encounter beat by providing strong damage output at the cost of mobility.

rules.effect: As a bonus action, you drop to one knee and reload your firearm. On your next turn, make a ranged weapon attack at a -2 penalty. If the attack hits, it deals an additional 1d6 damage.
rules.drawback: You cannot use Reload Dive if you are currently reloading or have just used it on your last turn.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Reload Dive? Sure, why not? It's like saying ‘reload’ and then ‘shoot’ — all in one swift motion. But you only get one chance per fight, so don't waste it!

abilities.name: Shroud of Deception
abilities.description: Disguise yourself as another creature, granting temporary advantage on Charisma checks until you are injured.
abilities.apReason: Requires significant preparation and concentration to maintain a convincing disguise.
abilities.levelReason: Allows spies to drastically alter their appearance for critical social and combat advantages.

rules.duration: Until you are hit in combat
rules.effect: You gain advantage on all Charisma checks until a creature successfully hits you in combat. This effect ends if you take damage.
rules.drawback: If observed closely, the disguise can be easily penetrated by trained observers.

abilities.warioNote: Need some tricks up your sleeve? This one’s a real stinker! You better hope no one’s looking!

abilities.name: Mass Resolve
abilities.description: Bolster allies with unshakable determination, granting temporary hit points equal to half your Leader level (rounded down) as long as you are within 30 feet.
abilities.apReason: Mass Resolve is a dramatic, one-time-per-session ability that dramatically boosts the resilience of allies, fitting its epic tier.
abilities.levelReason: Only at epic tier can a leader command such an overwhelming boost of resolve for allies.

rules.duration: Until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: All allies within range gain temporary hit points equal to half your Leader level (rounded down). This effect ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: You must be a leader and have at least 20 hit points to activate this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Need some extra oomph for your squad? This'll give 'em the will to keep fightin' — just don't get hurt yourself!

abilities.name: Group Fortify
abilities.description: You shout a rallying cry, granting temporary hit points to all allies within earshot.
abilities.apReason: A high-tier ability that provides a significant party-wide buff for one long rest use.
abilities.levelReason: A powerful per-rest play, providing sustained party-wide buffs.

rules.effect: All allies within range gain 1d8 temporary hit points. The effect ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: You must be able to speak and see the targets.

abilities.warioNote: This trick might not work on Wario's minions, but it’s a goldmine at the right moment!

abilities.name: Fortified Stand
abilities.description: You and your allies within 10 feet gain temporary hit points equal to twice your level + Con modifier until the start of your next turn.
abilities.apReason: High tier support with a strong party-wide buff justifies the cost of 3 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Provides a strong per-rest buff for the party, enhancing survivability.

rules.effect: All allies within range gain 4d8 temporary hit points. Ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability for 1 minute after using it.

abilities.warioNote: Sell you some more training, why don't ya? Fortify your friends! For real money!

abilities.name: Toolmaster's Gambit
abilities.description: Create an improvised trap or weapon from common materials, dealing 1d6+INT modifier bludgeoning damage on a successful attack.
abilities.apReason: Creates an effective combat tool at mid-tier, requiring a bonus action and limited uses per rest.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans can now create effective combat tools that rival their foes' weapons.

rules.effect: Make a melee weapon attack. On hit, deal 1d6+INT modifier bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC (8 + proficiency + INT) Dexterity saving throw or be restrained until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You can use this ability only once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: These tools are cheap... but you better have your tools ready!

abilities.name: Radiant Decree
abilities.description: Unleash a blinding light that forces enemies to make a saving throw or be blinded until their next turn.
abilities.apReason: This ability is dramatic and game-changing for a single encounter, requiring significant expenditure of resources.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, Paladins can command the divine might to overwhelm foes with a single, powerful display of light.

rules.duration: Until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: Each creature within range must make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded until their next turn. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you are blinded or in darkness.

abilities.warioNote: For those moments when you need to light up the battlefield and make everyone else’s day... or night.

abilities.name: Fury Tornado
abilities.description: In a whirlwind of fury, you unleash a spinning vortex that damages enemies within its path.
abilities.apReason: Requires a dramatic one-shot effect that can significantly alter combat dynamics at level 13.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 13 allows for a dramatic, one-shot ability that can turn the tide of battle.

rules.effect: Create a 20-foot line of swirling wind. All creatures in the path take 8d6 slashing damage and must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You are also exposed to the wind, taking half the damage dealt by the tornado.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, now you can turn the battlefield into a hurricane! Just remember, you'll get drenched too!

abilities.name: Arcane Dynamo
abilities.description: Conjure a burst of magical energy, stunning enemies and boosting allies within range.
abilities.apReason: This high-tier combat ability provides a burst of damage and control, making it powerful but costly.
abilities.levelReason: A powerful burst ability that can turn the tide in an encounter.

rules.range: 15 feet (all creatures within 10 feet of you)
rules.duration: Until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: Each creature in range must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of your next turn. Creatures that succeed are knocked prone. You and your allies within 5 feet gain temporary hit points equal to twice your spellcasting ability modifier (Intelligence).
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you have already been stunned since your last short rest.

abilities.warioNote: For all the shiny lights and loud noises, it’s still pretty expensive... Worth every AP though!

abilities.name: Titan's Wrath
abilities.description: Deal massive damage and gain temporary hit points equal to your Fighter level + Con modifier.
abilities.apReason: A dramatic single-use ability that can turn the tide of battle.
abilities.levelReason: Unleashes a devastating attack, suitable for epic confrontations.

rules.effect: Deal 2d10 + Strength modifier damage. Target must succeed on a DC (8 + Proficiency + Constitution modifier) Con save or be knocked prone. On a failed save, you gain 5 temporary hit points per Fighter level.
rules.drawback: Cannot target creatures with immunity to being knocked prone.

abilities.warioNote: Feel the wrath, but watch your wallet! This one's a beast!

abilities.name: Bullet Symphony
abilities.description: Fire a volley of bullets that deals 2d8 damage to all enemies within 30 feet, stunning them on a failed Dexterity saving throw (DC 14).
abilities.apReason: High-level effect that provides significant combat support and control for the party.
abilities.levelReason: High-tier ability providing party-wide control and significant damage.

rules.duration: Instantaneous, stunned until the start of their next turn if they fail the save.
rules.effect: Each enemy within range takes 2d8 piercing damage. On a failed Dexterity saving throw (DC 14), they are also stunned until the start of their next turn.
rules.drawback: The gunslinger must reload after using this ability, costing an action.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, you want to drop a little 'bullet symphony'? That'll be 4 AP, mister! But hey, it's worth it if you like stunnin' your enemies!

abilities.name: Unity Pact
abilities.description: Unite allies with a binding promise, granting temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier + level.
abilities.apReason: Forging an epic bond that lasts for hours is a dramatic moment worth four Ability Points.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, leaders can forge lasting bonds that bolster their allies in epic encounters.

rules.effect: All touched allies gain temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier + your Charisma modifier. Ends when the pact is broken.
rules.drawback: The pact requires a shared promise, which must be spoken aloud and cannot be retracted.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it’s a big commitment. But think of the loyalty you’ll earn! Priceless!

abilities.name: Toad's Roar
abilities.description: Shout to rally allies within earshot, giving them advantage on their next attack roll.
abilities.apReason: The ability provides a strong per-rest party-wide buff, making it a high-tier play.
abilities.levelReason: A high-tier ability that provides a strong per-rest party-wide buff.

rules.effect: Each ally within 60 feet who hears the roar has advantage on their next attack roll. This effect ends when they make an attack.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if you are incapacitated or restrained.

abilities.warioNote: Sell this training? Of course! It's like giving your friends a second chance to hit that big boss!

abilities.name: Mass Shield
abilities.description: Gain a +1 bonus to AC for every ally within 30 feet, up to three allies.
abilities.apReason: Provides a strong per-rest play benefit with coordination cost.
abilities.levelReason: Provides significant party-wide buffs at the cost of requiring coordination and resources.

rules.duration: Concentration up to 1 minute or until you lose your concentration (as a bonus action)
rules.effect: Each ally within range has their AC increased by +1 for each ally within the area, up to three. Ends when concentration is lost.
rules.drawback: Requires concentration and cannot be cast in combat unless you are adjacent to an ally.

abilities.warioNote: Who needs a shield when you've got all your friends covered?

abilities.name: Forgestorm
abilities.description: Temporarily enhance your tools, doubling their damage for one turn.
abilities.apReason: Forgestorm is a strong burst combat ability, matching the high tier of level 9.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans unlock this powerful burst ability to maximize tool damage for a single combat encounter.

rules.effect: Until the start of your next turn, all improvised weapons and tools you wield deal double damage on hits. Ends if you drop or discard any weapon or tool.
rules.drawback: You can only use Forgestorm once per long rest.

abilities.warioNote: Forget the hammer, buy the storm! Double your damage in one round!

abilities.name: Divine Thunder
abilities.description: Summons a bolt of holy lightning that strikes all enemies within a 30-foot radius, dealing radiant damage and stunning those who fail the DC 17 Dexterity saving throw.
abilities.apReason: This epic-level ability requires significant focus and leaves the Paladin vulnerable during its usage, justifying a high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: At epic levels, Paladins can unleash devastating attacks that affect large areas.

rules.effect: Each creature in a 15-foot radius centered on the Paladin must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be stunned for 1 minute. The damage is 6d8 radiant damage.
rules.drawback: The Paladin cannot use this ability if they are within 30 feet of an ally.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, you want to level up like that? You’ll need some serious coin for this one, pal. It’s a thunderous investment!

abilities.name: Feral Transformation
abilities.description: Transform into a raging beast for a turn, gaining massive strength and ferocity in combat.
abilities.apReason: Requires a dramatic moment per session—this is the ultimate combat boost for an Epic Barbarian.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocks at Epic Tier to grant the Barbarian an ultimate transformation.

rules.duration: 1 minute per level, ends early on damage taken or Voluntarily
rules.effect: You gain +4 to STR and CON, advantage on Strength checks and saving throws, and can make one extra attack with your main hand. Save DC 18 + proficiency + Wisdom modifier.
rules.drawback: While in transformation, you are vulnerable to Charmed status.

abilities.warioNote: For those who think they've seen it all... this one's a beast!

abilities.name: Stormbound Spell
abilities.description: You harness a tempest of arcane energy to strike foes within 30 feet, dealing 1d8 lightning damage per wizard level.
abilities.apReason: A high-tier burst combat ability with a significant drawback that keeps it balanced at level 10.
abilities.levelReason: Harnesses the power of storm magic for a strong burst attack at this tier.

rules.effect: You create a tempest, dealing 1d8 lightning damage to each creature within the area. DC 15 + Intelligence modifier for saving throw. On a save success, it is immune to your next Stormbound Spell.
rules.drawback: After using this ability, you must spend 1 hour in calm weather to regain spellcasting focus.
