abilities.warioNote: It's like raining on your parade... but only if you hit them first!

abilities.name: Fatal Strike
abilities.description: Deal an overwhelming final blow, dealing double damage on a critical hit.
abilities.apReason: Requires a dramatic moment in combat at Epic level with a clear cost and limitation.
abilities.levelReason: Only available at level 16 to deliver the coup de grâce in epic encounters.

rules.effect: On a critical hit, deal double damage. The effect ends if you miss or the target is no longer a creature.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used against creatures immune to critical hits.

abilities.warioNote: You think you can survive THAT? Priceless!

abilities.name: Ink Camouflage
abilities.description: Erase your trail by blending into the shadows, leaving a misdirection for enemies to follow.
abilities.apReason: This high-tier ability provides significant stealth benefits while having a meaningful drawback, justifying the 3 AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, spies can afford to have an ability that provides significant stealth and misdirection benefits.

rules.duration: Until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You become invisible until your next action. On a failed Dexterity saving throw, enemies are drawn to you and must make an Intelligence check (DC 13) or follow you instead.
rules.drawback: Enemies that successfully track you gain advantage on their next attack roll against you.

abilities.warioNote: For those who think shadows are just dark corners... this one’s got depth!

abilities.name: Unity Command
abilities.description: As you issue your final rallying cry, all allies within earshot gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier + Wisdom modifier until the end of their next turn.
abilities.apReason: Requires a dramatic moment, one big impact per session, and is a high-level ability that changes an encounter beat.
abilities.levelReason: Only a true leader can command with such authority at this level of power and drama.

rules.duration: Until the end of their next turn for each ally within range
rules.effect: All allies within 30 feet gain (CHA modifier + WIS modifier) temporary hit points. Saving Throw DC = 15 + CHA modifier + proficiency bonus.
rules.drawback: The effect can only be used once per long rest and requires the leader to expend a significant amount of energy.

abilities.warioNote: Unity Command? Yeah... it's like telling everyone 'come get some' but with actual hit points. And only once a day.

abilities.name: Epic Whirlwind
abilities.description: Create a devastating whirlwind that sweeps enemies within an area, dealing 2d6 + Strength modifier bludgeoning damage and knocking them prone.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides one dramatic moment per session, making it epic-tier appropriate and worth 4 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Epic abilities provide one dramatic moment per session, perfect for this level.

rules.effect: Each creature in a 15-foot radius must make a DC (8 + Strength modifier) Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 + Strength modifier bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The effect ends when the area is no longer within line of sight.
rules.drawback: Requires a successful DC 15 Constitution save to avoid exhaustion for 1 hour.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Get ready for a whirlwind of destruction... for only 4 AP!

abilities.name: Shieldsmith's Shield
abilities.description: Create a temporary barrier of shields that absorbs damage for yourself or an ally.
abilities.apReason: This is a strong per-rest play ability that provides significant temporary defense at a high level.
abilities.levelReason: Militia can now provide critical defense and support, making this ability impactful at level 11.

rules.effect: Create an additional +2 to AC for the target, ends when you take a turn in combat.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you are wearing heavy armor.

abilities.warioNote: Ya gotta pay extra for this shield, it’s not cheap but it’ll keep ya safe!

abilities.name: Forge Surge
abilities.description: Gain advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until you take a short or long rest.
abilities.apReason: A strong per-rest play that provides significant combat utility at level 10.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans' mastery of tools grants them the power to surge beyond normal limits in combat.

rules.duration: until you take a short or long rest
rules.effect: You gain advantage on attack rolls and saving throws. This effect ends when you complete a short or long rest.
rules.drawback: While under the effect of Forge Surge, your tool proficiency bonus is halved.

abilities.warioNote: These tools are so powerful, they might just rust right through my pockets!

abilities.name: Judgment Cascade
abilities.description: Call down a cascade of holy energy that deals radiant damage to all enemies within an area, ending when they fall or leave.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic, one-time-per-session ability requires a significant investment of Ability Points to match its epic tier power.
abilities.levelReason: At level 18, the Paladin wields immense divine power capable of altering the battlefield.

rules.duration: Until all targets fall or leave the area
rules.effect: All creatures within a 20-foot radius take 10d8 radiant damage. Save DC 18 + Wis modifier + proficiency bonus. On a successful save, they are immune to this effect for 24 hours.
rules.drawback: The Paladin must concentrate while the ability is active and can only cast it once per long rest.

abilities.warioNote: Talk about your overpowered! This one's a doozy. Better have that long rest ready!

abilities.name: Shadowstep Carnage
abilities.description: Disappear into the shadows and emerge behind enemies to deliver a devastating strike.
abilities.apReason: This ability represents a dramatic and costly moment, fitting for an epic level skill.
abilities.levelReason: Only at epic levels can rogues command such dramatic moments with a single, decisive move.

rules.effect: Make a melee attack against a target within 5 feet. The attack deals an extra 4d6 damage on a hit. If the target is surprised, it must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be stunned until the end of your next turn.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if you are seen by any creature.

abilities.warioNote: For the price of four AP? You get to turn invisible and kill someone. What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Storm Conjuration
abilities.description: Summons a swirling storm of lightning that deals thunder damage to all enemies within 10 feet.
abilities.apReason: Level 11 ability with strong party-wide control and burst magic, costing 3 AP as expected.
abilities.levelReason: Allows for powerful burst magic at the key level when wizards can really shine.

rules.effect: Each enemy in the area takes 4d6 thunder damage. Saving throw DC 15 + Intelligence modifier; on a success, half damage.
rules.drawback: You must concentrate for this spell and can only cast it once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: You think that storm is bad? Try facing the Wario Blizzards!

abilities.name: Epic Shield Bash
abilities.description: Smash through enemies with a fearsome charge, dealing massive damage and leaving foes reeling.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic ability requires a significant cooldown to maintain balance at epic tier.
abilities.levelReason: At epic tier, fighters seek grandiose final blows to conclude encounters.

rules.effect: Make a melee weapon attack against an enemy within reach. On a hit, deal double damage and push the target 10 feet if it fails a DC 24 Strength saving throw.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again until you finish a short or long rest.

abilities.warioNote: For those times when you need to make one last, memorable stand. Priceless!

abilities.name: Pistol Volley
abilities.description: Fire three pistols in rapid succession, stunning enemies within a 10-foot radius for one round.
abilities.apReason: This is a powerful per-rest play combat ability that justifies its cost at level 10.
abilities.levelReason: Provides a strong burst combat ability at level 10.

rules.duration: One round, ends when the target is no longer stunned
rules.effect: Targeted enemies within a 10-foot radius must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be stunned until the end of their next turn. The effect ends if the target takes any damage.
rules.drawback: The user risks overheating and losing accuracy after using this ability, requiring a short rest to recover.

abilities.warioNote: Pfft... Pistol Volley? More like 'pistol whiplash'! Feel the burn, but hey, it's worth it!

abilities.name: Crowning Glory
abilities.description: Command your allies into a final, overwhelming surge of strength and coordination.
abilities.apReason: One big moment per session—dramatic but hard-limited
abilities.levelReason: Leadership's dramatic climax at the pinnacle of their power.

rules.effect: All allies within 10 feet gain +2 to attack and damage rolls until the start of your next turn. They must make a DC 24 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of their next turn.
rules.drawback: After using this ability, you cannot use it again for 24 hours.

abilities.warioNote: Watch your wallet! This one's a goldmine, but only once in a blue moon!

abilities.name: Toad's Gambit
abilities.description: Leap into the fray, disrupting foes with a flurry of improvised attacks.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic one-time effect demands a significant cost, fitting for an epic moment.
abilities.levelReason: At epic levels, commoners can exploit their surroundings for devastating effects.

rules.effect: You gain advantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn. On a hit, an enemy within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you are wearing armor.

abilities.warioNote: Sell this training? Why buy when I can make your toad leap into the fray like a champ!

abilities.name: Shield Phalanx
abilities.description: All allies within 10 feet gain +2 AC as long as you are not incapacitated.
abilities.apReason: Provides significant party-wide buffs at high levels, making it a strong per-rest play.
abilities.levelReason: Requires a strong per-rest play to bolster the party in critical situations.

rules.effect: All allies within range gain a +2 bonus to AC until the end of your next turn. This ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: You must maintain concentration or lose this ability.

abilities.warioNote: It's just one AP, but the wall of shields packs quite a punch! No wonder they call you the backbone of defense.

abilities.name: Hammerfall Strike
abilities.description: Deal massive damage to a single target and stun them for one round.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a strong per-rest play, justifying the 3 AP cost at level 11.
abilities.levelReason: For an Artisan to deliver a devastating blow at this level, the ability must provide a strong per-rest play.

rules.effect: Make a melee attack against one target within range. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 + Intelligence modifier + level damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn.
rules.drawback: The Artisan must expend 3 AP to use this ability.

abilities.warioNote: You think you're tough? Try getting hit with my Hammerfall Strike!

abilities.name: Divine Shroud
abilities.description: Paladins cloak themselves in a radiant barrier that reflects attacks, stunning attackers on a failed save.
abilities.apReason: Level 19 epic abilities provide one big moment per session, making Divine Shroud's dramatic conclusion justifiable for 4 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 19 allows for a dramatic conclusion to encounters.

rules.effect: DC 16 + Cha modifier; creature that attacks the paladin must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.
rules.drawback: The paladin can only activate this ability once per encounter.

abilities.warioNote: For those moments where you really need to show off your divine might...priceless!

abilities.name: Shroud Escape
abilities.description: On a successful Dexterity (Stealth) check, you become invisible for 1 round.
abilities.apReason: Changes one encounter beat by allowing a quick escape with stealth.
abilities.levelReason: Allows Rogues to escape from combat without drawing attention or triggering attacks of opportunity.

rules.effect: You become invisible until the start of your next turn. A successful DC 13 Perception check can notice your location.
rules.drawback: On a failed Dexterity (Stealth) check, you are disoriented and have disadvantage on all attacks and ability checks until the end of your next turn.

abilities.warioNote: Don't get caught trying to sneak away! It's cheaper than you think!

abilities.name: Fury of Titans
abilities.description: Channel primal power to unleash a devastating strike that deals extra damage and knocks foes back.
abilities.apReason: Requires a dramatic moment and significant risk, fitting for the epic tier of a level 16 Barbarian.
abilities.levelReason: Unleashes the ultimate fury at the peak of one's prowess, reserved for epic confrontations.

rules.effect: When you hit with a melee weapon attack using Strength, deal an additional 4d6 + Strength modifier damage and knock all targets back 10 feet. Saves DC 18 + Proficiency + Strength Modifier.
rules.drawback: Focusing this power drains you; you must finish your next short rest before using it again.

abilities.warioNote: This one’s a doozy! You better be ready for the big fight or you’ll be knocked out faster than you can say ‘Fury’!

abilities.name: Stormbound
abilities.description: Summons a tempest of arcane bolts that deals lightning damage to all enemies within an area.
abilities.apReason: A high-tier combat ability that requires a significant cost.
abilities.levelReason: High-level wizards need a burst combat ability.

rules.effect: You create an area of stormy winds that deals 4d8+INT modifier lightning damage to all enemies in the area. Save DC is 15 + Intelligence modifier. Ends when the spell ends or if you use your action to discontinue it.
rules.drawback: Exposes you and allies within range to the same damage.

abilities.warioNote: This one’s a storm of bolts, makes the battlefield rain fire! Just don’t forget your umbrella!

abilities.name: Titan's Roar
abilities.description: Roar to inspire allies within earshot, granting them advantage on attack rolls until their next action.
abilities.apReason: A dramatic, once-per-session ability that changes an encounter beat at level 18.
abilities.levelReason: At epic tier, a fighter can command the battlefield with a single powerful roar.

rules.effect: Allies within range gain advantage on attack rolls. Ends when they take their next action.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if the fighter is incapacitated.

abilities.warioNote: Buy one, lose your voice! But your allies will roar louder!

abilities.name: Reload Rush
abilities.description: Swap two bullets mid-shot for a guaranteed headshot.
abilities.apReason: This is a dramatic ability that can turn the tide of battle at level 14, requiring significant risk and resource.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, the gunslinger can pull off the impossible shot needed to survive epic encounters.

rules.effect: When you take damage on your turn and make a ranged weapon attack, you can use this ability as a reaction. You must spend one bullet from your pistol. On a hit against a target within 30 feet, the target takes an additional 2d6 force damage.
rules.drawback: You must drop to 0 hit points or be reduced to negative hit points before using Reload Rush.

abilities.warioNote: Reload? Sure! Just make sure you have extra bullets in stock!

abilities.name: Ultimate Rally
abilities.description: All allies within 30 feet gain advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the end of your next turn.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic, once-per-session ability provides a significant boost to your allies but comes with the cost of being limited to one use per session.
abilities.levelReason: Only the greatest leaders can inspire their troops in this decisive moment.

rules.duration: Until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: All allies within range gain advantage on attack rolls and saving throws. Ends if you are incapacitated or die.
rules.drawback: You must have at least one ally within 30 feet to activate this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Alright, it’s just one use per session. But look at that price tag! You better have some serious followers ready for this!

abilities.name: Toad's Triumph
abilities.description: Summons a wave of toads to overwhelm foes, dealing damage and forcing them to make saving throws.
abilities.apReason: This ability is a dramatic, once-per-session effect that can shift an encounter significantly.
abilities.levelReason: At epic levels, the commoner can command formidable allies in dramatic moments.

rules.effect: You summon a wave of toads. Creatures within 30 feet must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 6d6 bludgeoning damage and be restrained until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: The summoned toads can only act on your turn, and they cannot attack more than one foe.

abilities.warioNote: For 20 AP, you get an army of toads? What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Wall of Blades
abilities.description: Create a wall of spinning blades that deals radiant damage to enemies within its radius.
abilities.apReason: Requires dramatic timing and a powerful visual effect worthy of the epic tier.
abilities.levelReason: Requires epic combat prowess and timing for such a dramatic effect.

rules.duration: Until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: Creatures within the wall's radius take 4d6 radiant damage. Save DC 18. Ends if you move more than 10 feet away.
rules.drawback: You must remain stationary for its duration to maintain it.

abilities.warioNote: Need to keep your feet still? Priceless! Watch your wallet!

abilities.name: Toolmaster's Might
abilities.description: As a bonus action, you enhance your improvised weapon with tools. Attack rolls made with it are +2d6 until the end of your next turn.
abilities.apReason: This is a high-tier, party-wide buff that provides significant combat impact and balance at level 12.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, Artisans need a burst ability to significantly impact combat encounters.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: Attack rolls with improvised weapons made with tools are +2d6 until the end of your next turn. Ends when you stop using it as an improvised weapon.
rules.drawback: You can only activate this ability once per short or long rest.

abilities.warioNote: These tools are no toy! For an AP, you get to turn your everyday gizmo into a weapon of mass destruction!

abilities.name: Divine Coup
abilities.description: Deal massive holy damage to a single foe, turning their fate into a moment of divine retribution.
abilities.apReason: This is a one-time, dramatic moment per session that demands significant effort and resources to achieve.
abilities.levelReason: Only at level 20 can the Paladin unleash this final, dramatic strike.

rules.effect: You deal 4d10 + Cha modifier + Proficiency damage to one creature. The target must succeed on a DC 25 Wis saving throw or be incapacitated until the end of its next turn.
rules.drawback: Using this ability exhausts your concentration, and you cannot use it again until after completing a long rest.

abilities.warioNote: It's like hitting them so hard they need a week off for recovery... Pricey, but you get that grand final blow.

abilities.name: Shadow Blade
abilities.description: Deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage on a critical hit against blinded or obscured targets.
abilities.apReason: Provides significant damage output and a strong burst effect suitable for level 9 rogues.
abilities.levelReason: Exploits the rogue's expertise in stealth and precision for a strong per-rest play.

rules.effect: Deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage on a critical hit against blinded or obscured targets. Ends when the target is no longer blinded or obscured.
rules.drawback: Requires the rogue to be within reach of the target and can only apply once per target per combat.

abilities.warioNote: For those nights when you wish your blade could speak louder in the dark!

abilities.name: Wild Rampage
abilities.description: In a berserk frenzy, you unleash an unrelenting wave of damage against all enemies within reach.
abilities.apReason: This ability offers one dramatic moment per session with clear limitations and costs.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, the barbarian can command the fury of nature in one dramatic moment per session.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you take damage
rules.effect: All creatures within the area must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are restrained and take 4d6 + STR modifier force damage each round this effect lasts; on a success, they are immune to your Wild Rampage for 24 hours.
rules.drawback: You cannot use any actions or reactions until the effect ends.

abilities.warioNote: Man, you better save up those coins for this one! It's a real powerhouse, but it’ll leave you wide open until it’s over.

abilities.name: Epic Arcane Burst
abilities.description: Summon a burst of raw arcane power, dealing 2d8 force damage to all creatures in an area.
abilities.apReason: This ability is a dramatic moment per session that can change the tide of battle.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, wizards can unleash devastating spells that reshape the battlefield.

rules.effect: Each creature in a 10-foot radius must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 2d8 force damage. On a save, they take half as much damage.
rules.drawback: The caster must concentrate for the duration of their next turn.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, this one’s a real money maker. Watch your step, though—those who fail to save might end up in pieces!

abilities.name: Mountain Rampage
abilities.description: Shake the ground with a berserk charge, dealing damage to enemies within reach and leaving them prone.
abilities.apReason: This ability is a dramatic moment that can change an epic battle, justifying its high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Only epic-tier fighters have the power to command nature itself in their final form.

rules.effect: You charge at an enemy, moving up to your speed and making a melee weapon attack against it. On a hit, you deal 2d8 + Strength modifier damage. If successful, each creature within 5 feet of the target must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You are vulnerable to opportunity attacks during your charge.

abilities.warioNote: I hope you brought sturdy shoes for this one, buddy! Mountain Rampage is no joke!

abilities.name: Epic Resonance
abilities.description: Once per day, you can touch an ally and grant them a burst of strength for one turn.
abilities.apReason: This powerful one-time effect requires significant effort, fitting its epic tier.
abilities.levelReason: Epic abilities are reserved for moments that define a session.

rules.effect: The touched ally gains +4 to Strength checks and saving throws. Ends on their next turn.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again until you finish a long rest.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, Epic Resonance. It's like giving your buddy a giant boost for the finale of the show! But only once per day... what else do you expect from a toad?

abilities.name: Legion Strike
abilities.description: Leverage the strength of many to cleave through foes in a single devastating strike.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic ability requires significant resource management given its powerful effect and one-use per session.
abilities.levelReason: Militia's epic abilities allow them to deliver a climactic attack.

rules.effect: Make two melee weapon attacks against one target. On a hit, deal an extra 1d8 + Strength modifier damage and the target is knocked prone if it fails a DC 16 Strength saving throw.
rules.drawback: After using Legion Strike, you cannot attack with weapons for the next short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Oh boy, feel that raw power! One hit and they're down. Just don't do it too often or you'll be out of the fight for a while.

abilities.name: Toolmaster's Triumph
abilities.description: As a bonus action, you may transform any improvised weapon into a masterwork tool for the duration of one short rest.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a significant, yet temporary, upgrade that impacts multiple aspects of gameplay, making it worth 4 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking an epic level ability that offers a dramatic and limited-time upgrade to tools and improvisations.

rules.duration: until end of next short rest
rules.effect: You gain the ability to transform an improvised weapon into a masterwork tool for the duration. This effect ends when you take another short rest.
rules.drawback: The item reverts to its original state at the start of your next long rest.

abilities.warioNote: These tools are so good, they might just steal your lunch money!

abilities.name: Radiant Steed
abilities.description: Summons a steed made of light for combat support, granting it your Charisma modifier in AC.
abilities.apReason: A reliable combat support ability that unlocks early for Paladins, granting them an immediate boost.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins gain the ability to summon divine assistance at level 2.

rules.effect: You summon a steed made of light that fights by your side. It has AC equal to 10 + your Charisma modifier and can attack with a bite dealing 1d8 radiant damage.
rules.drawback: The steed is not trainable, and you cannot communicate directly with it.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! You think your horse can't help in a fight? Well, this steed's got radiant power and a heart of light! Only costs one AP - what could go wrong?

abilities.name: Shadowslice Dive
abilities.description: Deal a flurry of precise strikes as you dive past enemies, dealing damage equal to your Rogue level + Dexterity modifier.
abilities.apReason: This high-tier combat ability requires significant resource allocation for its burst damage potential and limited usage.
abilities.levelReason: At this tier, a strong per-rest play that offers burst combat effectiveness.

rules.effect: You make three melee attacks against a single target within reach. Each attack deals 1d6 + Dexterity modifier damage.
rules.drawback: You must spend 5 feet of movement to initiate this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Watch your step, Rogues! This dive cuts deep but leaves you wide open for a moment. Worth every AP!

abilities.name: Raging Tempest
abilities.description: Call upon the fury of a tempest, dealing massive damage to foes within a burst.
abilities.apReason: Level 18 abilities are dramatic but have hard limits, making this powerful burst combat move worth four AP.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 18 allows for a climactic finisher befitting an epic warrior.

rules.uses: At will, but only when bloodied
rules.effect: You unleash a tempest of primal energy in a 20-foot radius burst. Each creature in the area takes 8d12 slashing damage and must make a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. This ability ends when you take a short rest.
rules.drawback: Using this ability while not bloodied has no effect.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Need to end a boss fight with style? This one's for you. Just don't do it too often!

abilities.name: Cosmic Convergence
abilities.description: Summons a burst of astral energy, dealing radiant damage to enemies within a 15-foot radius.
abilities.apReason: Requires a dramatic and powerful moment fitting for epic level play, thus costing 4 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Unleashes a dramatic and powerful spell at epic levels.

rules.effect: Each creature within range must make a DC 16 + Intelligence modifier + proficiency bonus saving throw or take 4d8 radiant damage. The effect ends if the spellcaster moves more than 30 feet away.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used within 10 feet of an ally without risking collateral damage.

abilities.warioNote: Oh ho! This one’s a doozy, but it’ll cost ya! Watch those pips on your AP meter!

abilities.name: Shieldsmash
abilities.description: Smash an opponent's shield, dealing weapon damage plus your Strength modifier.
abilities.apReason: Provides a situational combat advantage at level 2, justifying 1 AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters can now exploit the strength and reach of their shields in combat.

rules.effect: You gain a bonus action to make a melee weapon attack against an enemy's shield. On a hit, you deal 1d6+Strength modifier damage and the target must succeed on a DC 8 + Strength modifier saving throw or drop their shield.
rules.drawback: If your shield is broken or lost during this attempt, you cannot use it for the rest of the encounter.

abilities.warioNote: For those moments when you need to send a message: 'Your shield's not safe!'

abilities.name: Revolver Mastery
abilities.description: Unleash a devastating barrage of three consecutive firearm shots, each dealing an extra die of damage.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a dramatic and impactful combat option that can turn the tide of battle in one big moment.
abilities.levelReason: At epic tier, Gunslingers can command the battlefield with their firearms like never before.

rules.effect: Make three attacks at your proficiency bonus + Dexterity modifier, dealing an extra d6 damage on each hit.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if you are incapacitated or restrained.

abilities.warioNote: For the price of four Ability Points, you get to make three shots like it's nothing. Just don't get hit while doing it.

abilities.name: Inspiring Counter
abilities.description: Gain advantage on reaction rolls to defend against attacks, once per turn.
abilities.apReason: Provides a reliable edge by allowing an ally to gain advantage, useful in combat.
abilities.levelReason: Leadership abilities strengthen allies through presence and tactics starting at level 4.

rules.effect: Gain advantage on reaction rolls for the turn. This ends when you take another action or reaction.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if you are incapacitated.

abilities.warioNote: It's just one little counter, but it sure packs a punch! Bet you didn't see that coming!

abilities.name: Epic Mirage
abilities.description: Create a convincing illusion to mislead foes, granting advantage on one ability check or saving throw.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic, one-time effect at epic tier requires a significant investment of Ability Points.
abilities.levelReason: At epic tier, the commoner can manipulate reality with an overwhelming display of power.

rules.effect: DC 18 Wisdom saving throw; advantage on one ability check or saving throw. Ends if the commoner makes an attack.
rules.drawback: The illusion can be dispelled as a reaction.

abilities.warioNote: Alright Toad, you think a little mirage will stop me? It's gonna take more than a trick to beat Wario!

abilities.name: Mighty Stand
abilities.description: Unleash a rallying cry that grants temporary hit points to allies within earshot, bolstering their resolve.
abilities.apReason: One dramatic moment per session—this ability's impact demands a significant cost in AP.
abilities.levelReason: Epic moments require epic leadership—only the highest ranks can command such dramatic shifts in battle.

rules.duration: Until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: All allies within range gain 5 temporary hit points. A saving throw DC 14 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier halves this effect.
rules.drawback: You must be a leader to command such a rallying cry, and your voice is strained after use.

abilities.warioNote: Don't worry about the hit points you lose! After all, it's just one little strain on your vocal cords...

abilities.name: Toolchain Tornado
abilities.description: Unleash a whirlwind of tools, dealing damage based on your Intelligence modifier to all enemies in a cone.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic, one-shot combat ability requires careful preparation and is a defining moment for any Artisan at epic level.
abilities.levelReason: Mastering the Toolchain Tornado requires the depth and experience only an Artisan of epic level can achieve.

rules.effect: You create a cone-shaped burst centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in the cone must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d6 slashing damage on a failed save. The effect ends if all enemies in the cone are defeated.
rules.drawback: You can only use this ability after spending an hour meticulously preparing your toolset.

abilities.warioNote: It's like a tornado of wrenches! But only if you’re willing to put in the time.

abilities.name: Holy Light Aegis
abilities.description: Channel holy light to create a shimmering barrier that grants temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier + Wisdom modifier.
abilities.apReason: Provides a reliable defensive boost for Paladins at this level tier, requiring minimal AP investment.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins can reliably bolster their defenses with divine power at this level.

rules.effect: You gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier + your Wisdom modifier. This effect ends if you fall unconscious.
rules.drawback: While active, you cannot cast spells that have a casting time of 1 action or less.

abilities.warioNote: You think one AP is worth the holy shield? Try standing in a crowd without it!

abilities.name: Fury's End
abilities.description: Enter an enraged state, gaining +2d6 to damage with melee attacks for one minute.
abilities.apReason: The dramatic effect of Fury's End justifies the high AP cost at epic level.
abilities.levelReason: At epic tier, the Barbarian unlocks abilities that can alter the course of battle decisively.

rules.duration: One minute or until you take damage
rules.effect: You gain a +2 bonus to melee weapon attack and damage rolls. Ends if you take damage.
rules.drawback: While in this state, your movement speed is reduced by 10 feet.

abilities.warioNote: For those times when you need to show them who’s boss. Priceless!

abilities.name: Eternal Flame
abilities.description: Summon a persistent, radiant fireball that deals 1d8 fire damage to all creatures in its path.
abilities.apReason: This ability is dramatic and game-changing for one session but comes with a significant cost.
abilities.levelReason: Summons an effect powerful enough to change a battle's outcome entirely.

rules.effect: A 15-foot line of fire deals 1d8 + Intelligence modifier fire damage to all creatures in its path. Saving throw DC is 14 + Intelligence modifier; on a success, the creature takes half damage.
rules.drawback: The spell requires a costly ritual component: a vial of alchemical oil worth at least 50 gp.

abilities.warioNote: You think this little spell will help? For an effect that changes everything, it's worth every AP!

abilities.name: Steel Gale
abilities.description: You unleash a flurry of strikes, forcing enemies to make a Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.
abilities.apReason: A reliable combat edge with moderate movement restriction makes it a fair cost for one AP.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters gain the ability to deliver rapid and precise attacks at this level.

rules.effect: All enemies within range must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone. This ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: You cannot move more than 5 feet while using this ability.

abilities.warioNote: For just one AP, you get to knock enemies down like they're made of paper! But you can't run away as fast... Hey, I gotta make some money too!

abilities.name: Signal Rally
abilities.description: Shout a rallying cry to your allies, compelling them to move up or flank an enemy.
abilities.apReason: Provides a significant tactical advantage to the party for a moderate cost.
abilities.levelReason: Leaders inspire their followers with shouts and signals that bolster morale.

rules.effect: Each ally within range can choose to move up one space or flank an enemy. They gain advantage on their next attack roll and save DC 12 + your Charisma modifier.
rules.drawback: You must declare the target of your signal before using it, and you cannot use this ability if no allies are within hearing distance.

abilities.warioNote: Need some new friends? This one’s got your back—literally!

abilities.name: Toad's Folly
abilities.description: Transform into a massive toad, granting you formidable strength but limiting your movement.
abilities.apReason: This transformation is a dramatic and momentous ability that can turn the tide of battle at epic levels.
abilities.levelReason: Only at epic levels can the commoner unlock such dramatic transformation abilities.

rules.effect: You gain a +4 bonus to Strength and Strength saving throws. You can move up to your speed but not jump or climb. This effect ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: While transformed, you cannot use any of your other abilities.

abilities.warioNote: For 250 AP, this training helps you turn into a toad? Sure, why not? Just don't expect it to be easy!

abilities.name: Mass Defiance
abilities.description: Shout a rallying cry, bolstering allies within 30 feet with temporary hit points equal to your Con modifier + Dexterity modifier.
abilities.apReason: Mass Defiance is a dramatic, once-per-session ability that provides significant support and comes with a clear cost.
abilities.levelReason: Epic leaders inspire and protect their teams in dramatic moments of combat.

rules.effect: All allies within range gain temporary hit points equal to your Con modifier + Dexterity modifier. Ends if you fall unconscious.
rules.drawback: You are vulnerable to attacks of opportunity until the duration ends.

abilities.warioNote: Alright, you got it! Now get outta my shop before I call security!

abilities.name: Masterwork Inferno
abilities.description: Summon a wave of molten metal to devastate foes in your immediate area.
abilities.apReason: Requires precise timing and control; a dramatic moment that can turn the tide of battle.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans can now command the very materials they craft, unleashing destructive force at their peak.

rules.effect: Each creature in a 5-foot radius must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 2d6 fire and slashing damage and are knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You risk burning your own tools if you fail to control the inferno.

abilities.warioNote: For Wario, it's not just about crafting—sometimes you gotta burn 'em to the ground!

abilities.name: Radiant Armor
abilities.description: Gain a +2 bonus to AC until you take a melee attack.
abilities.apReason: The ability provides an immediate and significant combat boost at level 5.
abilities.levelReason: At level 5, Paladins can afford the cost of an ability that enhances their combat prowess significantly.

rules.duration: Until you take a melee attack or end your turn
rules.effect: You gain a +2 bonus to AC. A successful DC 10 Wisdom saving throw ends the effect.
rules.drawback: If you are hit by a melee attack while this is active, you must make the save or lose the benefit for the rest of the encounter.

abilities.warioNote: This isn't just armor; it's a radiant promise to stay safe! ...For a couple AP, of course.

abilities.name: Feral Dash
abilities.description: On your move, gain advantage on your next Strength (Athletics) check to perform a Dash action.
abilities.apReason: Feral Dash is a small reliable edge, allowing for strategic movement in combat.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians benefit from extra movement in combat.

rules.effect: When you use this ability, until the start of your next turn, you can spend a bonus action to move up to your speed.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if you are incapacitated or restrained.

abilities.warioNote: Why pay more? Feral Dash gives you that extra speed boost when you need it most!

abilities.name: Dimensional Rift
abilities.description: Create a rift that teleports enemies to an alternate plane, dealing force damage and disrupting their movement.
abilities.apReason: Requires a significant sacrifice of resources for its dramatic effect at an epic level.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 16 allows for a dramatic conclusion to epic encounters.

rules.effect: Target all enemies within range. They must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be teleported to an alternate plane, taking 2d6 force damage and falling prone.
rules.drawback: The rift can only be cast in unoccupied spaces; failure risks teleporting the caster.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, this one’s a real stunner. Watch your step, or you might end up in another dimension!

abilities.name: Rush Strike
abilities.description: On your move, you can immediately make an additional attack as if using a bonus action.
abilities.apReason: This unlocks the first of several extra attacks at higher levels and requires a bonus action that is limited in frequency.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters gain the ability to make extra attacks at higher levels, and this unlocks their first such bonus action.

rules.effect: You gain an additional attack as a bonus action. This ends when you take another full-action move.
rules.drawback: If you use your bonus action for this, you cannot use other bonus actions until your next short rest.

abilities.warioNote: For just one AP? You get to hit twice as fast. What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Reload Rumble
abilities.description: In one turn, reload all firearms with a +1 bonus to attack rolls for the rest of the encounter.
abilities.apReason: The significant combat buff and limited use justify a high AP cost at level 11.
abilities.levelReason: Gains access to efficient reloading at this level, allowing for quick and powerful firepower bursts.

rules.duration: until the end of the encounter
rules.effect: When you use a bonus action to reload firearms, you gain advantage on attack rolls with those weapons until the end of the encounter. The effect ends if you take another bonus action to reload.
rules.drawback: You can only benefit from this ability once per long rest.

abilities.warioNote: Watch your ammo pile up! Reload Rumble sure packs a punch, but you can't keep reloading forever!

abilities.name: Invisible Strike
abilities.description: Disappear into shadows to make a sneak attack against an unaware target.
abilities.apReason: Requires a master-level play that can turn the tide of combat with a single, powerful strike.
abilities.levelReason: Masterful espionage allows spies to deliver decisive blows in critical moments.

rules.effect: You become invisible and make a melee attack against an unaware target. On a hit, the target takes an additional 2d6 necrotic damage. This effect ends immediately after the attack.
rules.drawback: You must be unseen by any creature to use this ability.

abilities.warioNote: For Wario, it's not just about selling training—it's about making sure you're invisible to the competition!

abilities.name: Inspiring Shield
abilities.description: Rally allies within reach, granting them advantage on their next attack or saving throw.
abilities.apReason: Provides a moderate boost to allied combatants and saves, at the cost of an Action.
abilities.levelReason: Leadership abilities become more impactful as the party solidifies its strategies and formations.

rules.duration: Until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: All allies within range gain advantage on their next attack roll or saving throw. Ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: You must use an Action to dismiss this effect early.

abilities.warioNote: Sure it’s only one extra turn... but hey, it’s worth every AP!

abilities.name: Arcane Eclipse
abilities.description: Summon a blinding solar flare that deals radiant damage to all creatures within its radius.
abilities.apReason: This ability is a dramatic, one-shot spell that can change an encounter beat.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, the commoner can unleash a dramatic and powerful spell.

rules.effect: You create a solar flare centered on yourself. Each creature within 30 feet must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or take 4d8 radiant damage.
rules.drawback: The sun must be visible to you for the spell to function.

abilities.warioNote: Pay the price! For just 4 AP, you can blind your enemies with a solar flare. Who needs sunlight when you have this?

abilities.name: Shield Surge
abilities.description: Temporarily increase your shield's effectiveness, turning it into a defensive fortress.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a dramatic defensive boost, making it a defining moment in combat.
abilities.levelReason: Only available to seasoned Militias who have proven their worth in combat.

rules.duration: Until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: You gain a +4 bonus to AC and advantage on saving throws against damage. This effect ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: While Shield Surge is active, you cannot attack or cast spells.

abilities.warioNote: For Wario, this means more shields sold to those who can afford the extra protection!

abilities.name: Masterstroke
abilities.description: Inflict a critical hit on a single target with an improvised weapon, bypassing their AC.
abilities.apReason: This ability represents a dramatic moment of perfection in combat at the epic tier, requiring significant mastery to execute.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, artisans can execute a perfect finishing move.

rules.effect: You make an attack roll against the target with your improvised weapon. On a hit, it is considered a critical hit.
rules.drawback: Fails if used before reaching level 16.

abilities.warioNote: Alright, you think you're good with tools? Try finishing something this well!

abilities.name: Holy Shield Barrier
abilities.description: Create a shimmering barrier around yourself, absorbing damage equal to your Charisma modifier + your level.
abilities.apReason: Provides significant defensive support with a moderate cost.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocks at level 6 for significant defensive support in combat.

rules.effect: When you take damage, the barrier absorbs up to your Charisma modifier + your level in damage. Ends when dismissed.
rules.drawback: Reduces your movement speed by 10 feet while active.

abilities.warioNote: For those moments where you need to soak up the hits, this is the shield for you! But don't expect to run fast!

abilities.name: Ethereal Cascade
abilities.description: Summon a torrent of ethereal energy that deals lightning damage and blinds enemies within its path.
abilities.apReason: This ability is a dramatic, one-time event that can alter the course of combat but comes at a significant cost.
abilities.levelReason: Requires the mastery to control powerful, otherworldly forces.

rules.effect: You create an ethereal cascade that deals 8d6 lightning damage to all creatures in a 20-foot line. Creatures must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the end of their next turn.
rules.drawback: The cascade leaves behind a lingering shockwave that prevents you from casting spells with verbal components for 1 minute.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, get blinded by my spell and lose your voice too? What kind of deal is that?

abilities.name: Overpowering Blow
abilities.description: Deal extra damage on a critical hit, forcing an opponent to make a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
abilities.apReason: Requires precision and timing, changing one encounter beat with moderate damage boost and short control.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters gain the ability to deliver devastating blows that can turn the tide of battle at mid-tier levels.

rules.effect: The target must make a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. On a failure, the target takes an additional 1d8 bludgeoning damage.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used against creatures immune to being knocked prone.

abilities.warioNote: Overpay for this? You'll see why! It's like knocking a pesky opponent right out of the fight!

abilities.name: Shuriken Salvo
abilities.description: Deal piercing damage to all creatures in a cone in front of you.
abilities.apReason: Strong per-rest play, providing party-wide damage with a high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: High-tier ability providing strong per-rest play for firearms specialists.

rules.effect: You create a cone of bullets centered on you. Each creature in the cone takes 12d6 piercing damage. No save.
rules.drawback: Recharges your action for the rest of the day.

abilities.warioNote: It's like getting all the fun without the hard work! Who needs to reload when you can just... keep shooting?

abilities.name: Toad's Final Leap
abilities.description: Leap through the air to land on an enemy, dealing damage and stunning them.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic final move requires a significant amount of preparation and effort to execute perfectly.
abilities.levelReason: Only the most experienced commoners can master this final leap in their career.

rules.effect: Make a melee attack against an enemy within range. On a hit, the target is stunned until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You must be at least 15 feet away from any cover.

abilities.warioNote: These little toads sure know how to put on a show! For just four AP, you get to be the star of the show!

abilities.name: Defensive Decree
abilities.description: As a bonus action, you can grant temporary hit points to yourself and one ally within 30 feet.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides significant support for the team, justifying its high AP cost at this level.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, Militias can make dramatic, impactful decisions that affect their comrades in a critical moment.

rules.effect: You and one ally gain 5 temporary hit points per militia level. Ends if either of you take damage.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used again until after a long rest.

abilities.warioNote: Oh, you want to buy some 'Defensive Decree'? It's not cheap, but it sure does pack a punch!

abilities.name: Titanic Forge
abilities.description: Forge a colossal weapon from the earth itself, delivering crushing blows that deal massive damage.
abilities.apReason: Requires a dramatic and impactful moment, fitting the epic tier of level 17.
abilities.levelReason: Requires unparalleled skill to craft and wield such a formidable tool.

rules.effect: You create a massive weapon by shaping the earth. When you hit with this improvised weapon, it deals 4d10 + Strength modifier bludgeoning damage. The weapon lasts until destroyed or discarded. A successful DC 25 Strength saving throw ends it.
rules.drawback: Using Titanic Forge expends your concentration for an entire combat encounter.

abilities.warioNote: For a few Ability Points? You get to summon a weapon fit for legends! Or so I keep telling myself...

abilities.name: Lightning Aegis
abilities.description: Summon a shimmering barrier of light that absorbs one weapon attack per use, reducing damage by half.
abilities.apReason: Protects from an attacking threat, making it a moderate mid-tier ability that requires careful timing.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins gain this ability to protect allies and absorb attacks in combat.

rules.effect: When activated, the Paladin summons a shimmering barrier that reduces the next weapon attack against them by half. Ends if the attack hits.
rules.drawback: The barrier only protects against one attack per use and cannot be used until after taking damage.

abilities.warioNote: This ain't no freebie! You gotta pay for the light show, but trust me, it's worth it when you're saving your allies!

abilities.name: Shadowweave Cloak
abilities.description: Instantly cloak yourself and a nearby ally, granting invisibility for one minute.
abilities.apReason: This ability grants a powerful, short-term stealth advantage at high levels, making it a strong per-rest play.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, Rogues gain the ability to manipulate time and space with their shadows in meaningful bursts.

rules.effect: You and one touched ally become invisible until the start of your next turn. A successful DC 15 Perception check notices you are hidden.
rules.drawback: You must remain still for a full round after activation to maintain the effect.

abilities.warioNote: It's like wrapping yourself in darkness—what could go wrong? Just don't fall asleep!

abilities.name: Ragehowl
abilities.description: Roar to stagger enemies within reach, reducing their speed by half on their turn.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge that provides significant combat utility for a low cost at level 4.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians unlock powerful combat abilities at level 4 for sustained effectiveness in battle.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you use a bonus action to dismiss it
rules.effect: Each creature within 30 feet of you that starts its turn within 5 feet of you must make a DC 12 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature's speed is reduced by half until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You cannot move more than 5 feet while this effect is active.

abilities.warioNote: It's just a roar, but it sure packs a punch! Only 1 AP to make your foes feel the fury!

abilities.name: Infinity Arc
abilities.description: Cast a spell with an indefinite duration, ending only when you choose or upon your next long rest.
abilities.apReason: Unlocking one of the most powerful spells with infinite duration is a significant event, thus costing 4 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 19 allows for one dramatic moment per session where the wizard can solidify their legacy.

rules.duration: Indefinite, ends on a condition or long rest
rules.effect: You cast one spell of your choice, choosing its level. The spell has an indefinite duration and can only be ended by you (voluntarily) or through completing a long rest.
rules.drawback: The chosen spell counts against your daily spell slot limit.

abilities.warioNote: For those who think they can't afford infinity... Infinity's free. Sorta.

abilities.name: Snapkick Kick
abilities.description: Deal an extra 2d6 damage on a surprise attack.
abilities.apReason: Provides a moderate boost in combat effectiveness during surprise attacks, which is a mid-tier encounter beat.
abilities.levelReason: Masters of martial combat refine their attacks with experience.

rules.effect: When you make a surprise attack, deal an extra 2d6 damage to the target. This effect ends when you no longer have advantage on the attack roll due to being surprised.
rules.drawback: You cannot use Snapkick Kick if you are not surprised.

abilities.warioNote: For just two AP? You get an extra kick when they sneak up on you! What more could you ask for?

abilities.name: Gunfire Ballet
abilities.description: Elegantly fire a volley of bullets, dealing radiant damage to all enemies within 10 feet.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a significant combat boost, suitable for epic-level play.
abilities.levelReason: Gunslingers can now perform their most dramatic attack at epic levels.

rules.effect: You fire a burst of bullets, dealing 8d6 radiant damage to all creatures in the area. Save DC is 15 + proficiency + Wisdom modifier.
rules.drawback: You must make an Acrobatics check (DC equal to half the total damage dealt) or fall prone.

abilities.warioNote: Watch out! This move might leave you on your backside!

abilities.name: Commanding Shield
abilities.description: Engage in combat while granting temporary hit points to an ally within 30 feet.
abilities.apReason: Provides significant support to an ally, justifying its cost at mid-tier level 7.
abilities.levelReason: Leaders inspire allies and boost their capabilities on the battlefield.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until your next short rest
rules.effect: Choose one willing creature within range. It gains 2d8 temporary hit points and can't be knocked prone for the duration.
rules.drawback: You can't use this ability again until you complete a long rest.

abilities.warioNote: For the price of two AP, you get to make your friends feel all warm and fuzzy! Just don't expect them to fight for you.

abilities.name: Elixir Brew
abilities.description: Create a healing tonic that grants temporary hit points to yourself or an ally.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge at level 2, providing healing without the need for a potion.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners can now bolster their party with simple remedies at level 2.

rules.effect: Create a small vial of tonic that heals the target for 1d4 + Charisma modifier temporary hit points. Effect ends when consumed.
rules.drawback: The ingredients are perishable and must be prepared anew each day.

abilities.warioNote: Oh, it's just a simple tonic. But don't expect it to taste like anything good!

abilities.name: Earthquake Strike
abilities.description: Deal massive damage to a foe, shattering their defenses with a fearsome strike.
abilities.apReason: Requires a dramatic and costly action to deliver an epic strike, justifying its high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Militias can now deliver devastating blows that restructure the battlefield.

rules.effect: You make a melee attack against one creature. On a hit, you deal damage equal to 10d8 + Strength modifier. The target must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw or be knocked prone and stunned until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: Fails if used in tight spaces where a wide swing is impossible.

abilities.warioNote: For those who want to make the ground shake... for real. Pricey but worth it!

abilities.name: Judgment Strike
abilities.description: Deal holy damage to a foe, with an additional saving throw for advantage if they are evil.
abilities.apReason: Requires precise timing and a reaction, making it impactful for a moderate cost.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins gain the ability to deliver powerful divine strikes at this level.

rules.effect: You deal 1d8 + CHA modifier holy damage. If the target is evil, they must make a DC (8 + Proficiency + CHA modifier) Wisdom saving throw or gain disadvantage on all attack rolls until the end of their next turn.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if you are incapacitated.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, you think this Judgement is hot? Try dodging THIS one!

abilities.name: Shadowsplit Escape
abilities.description: Emerge from shadows to disengage, leaving a confusing trail for your pursuers.
abilities.apReason: This ability allows for a dramatic and hard-limited escape at a crucial moment, justifying its high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, Rogues have mastered the art of evading and can perform dramatic escapes with precision.

rules.effect: You teleport up to 30 feet away from a hostile creature within reach, leaving an illusory duplicate that is indistinct for one minute. The duplicate has no hit points and provides advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in the area it occupies.
rules.drawback: The illusory duplicate can only be dispelled by a successful Dispel Magic spell.

abilities.warioNote: Ah, this 'Shadowsplit Escape' sure does pack a punch! It's like disappearing into thin air... or at least making it look that way!

abilities.name: Rage Dive
abilities.description: Leap through enemies, knocking them aside for a devastating strike at your target.
abilities.apReason: A moderate combat maneuver that offers significant impact for its level.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians can now leverage their rage and mobility to clear paths with a single move.

rules.effect: Make an attack against the nearest creature in your movement path. On a hit, it takes 2d6 force damage and is knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You must have expended a rage point to use this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Ooh, it’s like you’re literally diving through the battlefield! You’ll feel the burn... and then land right on top of your enemies.

abilities.name: Arcane Spark
abilities.description: Summon a blinding spark to deal 1d4 force damage and stun targets within 5 feet for 1 round.
abilities.apReason: Provides a tactical edge with limited use but crucial utility for level 2 wizards.
abilities.levelReason: Summons a tactical disruption spell suitable at level 2.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: Target: All creatures within range. Effect: Each target must make a DC 10 + Intelligence modifier Constitution saving throw or take 1d4 force damage and be stunned until the end of your next turn.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used on immune targets.

abilities.warioNote: It's just a little spark, but it packs one heck of a punch! Only 1 AP though—what do you expect from a cheap shot?

abilities.name: Breach Slam
abilities.description: Crash into enemies, knocking them back and freeing space for your allies.
abilities.apReason: Knockback effect and movement make it a versatile combat tool that costs moderate AP for a mid-tier character.
abilities.levelReason: Knockback ability scales well with Fighter's STR-based damage output.

rules.effect: Make a melee attack against one creature within reach. On hit, it is pushed up to 10 feet away from you and you move into its space. You take a -5 penalty on your next attack roll.
rules.drawback: Your next attack after using this ability has disadvantage.

abilities.warioNote: It's like buying a key to the dungeon—just don't expect to keep your treasure!

abilities.name: Gunfire Cascade
abilities.description: Summons a cascade of explosive bullets, dealing massive damage to all enemies within a 30-foot radius.
abilities.apReason: This epic-level ability requires a significant cost in Ability Points, reflecting its powerful and limited nature.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, the Gunslinger can deliver a defining moment with a single, devastating attack.

rules.uses: Once per short or long rest
rules.effect: All enemies within 30 feet take 8d12 fire damage. Save DC 15 + Proficiency + Dexterity modifier. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and is immune to the Gunfire Cascade effect for 24 hours.
rules.drawback: The Gunslinger must spend 1 hour reloading all firearms after using this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Oh, these big guns? They pack quite the punch... for four gold pieces!

abilities.name: Shadowscape Escape
abilities.description: 在与敌人交战时，您可以短暂地隐形并移动到附近的隐蔽物或掩体中。隐形持续1轮，并且每轮必须留在掩体内。
abilities.apReason: 此能力提供一次史诗级别的逃脱机会，但代价是短期的视觉损伤。
abilities.levelReason: 仅限于史诗级别的任务和遭遇战中使用，以确保在面对强大敌人时能够生存下来。

rules.effect: 您隐形并移动到附近的掩体内。隐形持续1轮，且每轮必须留在掩体内。当您离开掩体时，隐形效果结束。
rules.drawback: 每次使用后，您在接下来的1小时内视力受损，视野模糊，对暗影和隐蔽物的感知检定或技能检定有-2减值。

abilities.warioNote: 这可不是普通的隐形术！它会让你在战斗中消失，但别指望能一直隐藏下去……至少你得花点时间让眼睛好起来。

abilities.name: Commanding Salvo
abilities.description: Lead your allies in a coordinated strike, dealing extra damage with advantage to all nearby friends.
abilities.apReason: Requires coordination and focus, making it a mid-tier ability that changes one encounter beat.
abilities.levelReason: Leadership at this level provides the coordination to orchestrate devastating attacks.

rules.uses: Once per short or long rest
rules.effect: All allies within a 10-foot radius make their next attack roll with advantage. They take an additional 2d6 damage on hit.
rules.drawback: You must use your action on the turn you activate this ability.

abilities.warioNote: For a few AP, make your friends fight like they’re in sync with Pac-Man! But remember, you can only use this once before catching a breath.

abilities.name: Wall of Steel
abilities.description: Summon a towering wall of steel that grants temporary hit points to all allies within its radius.
abilities.apReason: Level 20 and creates a dramatic defensive effect for allies at significant cost.
abilities.levelReason: At level 20, the militia can command an epic feat of defense and support for their allies in battle.

rules.uses: Once per short or long rest
rules.effect: Create a 20-foot radius cylinder centered on you. Each ally within the area gains 5 temporary hit points. Ends if you die, are incapacitated, or dismiss it as an action.
rules.drawback: You cannot move more than 10 feet from the center of the wall without ending its duration.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it's strong enough to stop an army... for about a minute. But hey, it’s worth the gold!

abilities.name: Precision Refinement
abilities.description: Craft an improvised weapon into a deadly tool, dealing an extra die of damage.
abilities.apReason: This ability allows for one dramatic moment per session where precision and creativity lead to a significant combat edge, justifying its high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, Artisans refine their creations into devastating tools.

rules.effect: When using an improvised weapon made from a tool as a weapon, you gain advantage on attack rolls and deal an additional d6 damage.
rules.drawback: You must drop the improvised weapon immediately after use.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Precision Refinement? Yeah right... it's like turning a stick into a spear of doom. Just don't expect your weapon back after that.

abilities.name: Eclipse Cloak
abilities.description: Gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks until you are hit or use a bonus action.
abilities.apReason: Level 16 ability with a dramatic impact, requiring significant resources to use once per session.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 16, this ability provides a momentous boost for epic encounters.

rules.duration: until you are hit or use a bonus action
rules.effect: You gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This effect ends when you are hit or take a bonus action.
rules.drawback: Once used, it cannot be activated again until after the current encounter.

abilities.warioNote: Eclipse Cloak? It's like wearing a cloak of shadowy luck! Just one shot though—wanna buy more?

abilities.name: Arcane Flicker
abilities.description: Quickly cast a minor spell as a bonus action, recharging after a short rest.
abilities.apReason: This low-tier ability provides a reliable edge by allowing for quick spellcasting as a bonus action, justifying the cost of one AP.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking access to a more flexible spellcasting option at this level allows for greater versatility in combat and exploration.

rules.effect: You may cast one cantrip as a bonus action. The spell has half its normal casting time. This ability ends when you cast three spells this way per short rest.
rules.drawback: Spells cast in this manner have disadvantage on saving throws.

abilities.warioNote: For those times when you need that little extra zip in your spells! Just don't expect it to last long.

abilities.name: Overpowering Strike
abilities.description: Deal an extra die of damage on your next melee hit.
abilities.apReason: Requires careful timing and action economy, making it mid-tier for level 8.
abilities.levelReason: Strikes that overpower foes are a mid-tier ability for fighters.

rules.effect: On your next melee hit, you deal an extra 2d6 damage. This effect ends if you miss with a melee attack.
rules.drawback: You must take the Attack action on your turn to use this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Overpowering? More like overloading your actions! But hey, it packs one heck of a punch!

abilities.name: Bullet Sonata
abilities.description: Fire a barrage of bullets that each explode on impact, dealing damage to enemies within a 20-foot radius.
abilities.apReason: This ability is a dramatic one-time event at epic levels and requires significant resources to pull off.
abilities.levelReason: A Gunslinger's mastery over firearms allows for this grand finale attack at epic levels.

rules.effect: Fire a barrage of 4d8+Dex modifier bullets. Each bullet deals an additional 1d6 damage on impact and has a 50% chance to explode, dealing 2d6+Dex modifier fire damage to creatures within a 20-foot radius.
rules.drawback: After using Bullet Sonata, you must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be exhausted until the end of your next short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Wow, sure it’s flashy, but did you see the price tag? You’re essentially buying a fireworks show here!

abilities.name: Resolve Rally
abilities.description: Inspire allies within 30 feet, granting them advantage on attack rolls until the end of your next turn.
abilities.apReason: Provides a strong per-rest play ability that benefits the entire party, justifying its high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Provides a strong per-rest play by boosting allies' combat effectiveness in a tactical moment.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: All allies within range have advantage on attack rolls. Ends if you are incapacitated or die.
rules.drawback: You must be able to see all targets, and they must be able to hear you.

abilities.warioNote: Well sure, it's a nice little boost. But hey, gotta keep those prices up!

abilities.name: Toad's Slick Maneuver
abilities.description: Gain advantage on one Dexterity (Acrobatics) check each day.
abilities.apReason: It provides a small reliable edge, fitting a level 3 ability.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners learn basic combat tricks early in their training.

rules.effect: Gain advantage on one Dexterity (Acrobatics) check per day. This effect ends when you make the check.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you have already gained its benefit for the day.

abilities.warioNote: This trick's slick, but it only works once a day! Who knew toads could be so strategic?

abilities.name: Shadowstep Decoy
abilities.description: Create a phantom copy of yourself to distract foes and aid your escape.
abilities.apReason: This ability allows for a dramatic escape or distraction, making it highly impactful but costly in Ability Points.
abilities.levelReason: Only available to Rogues at the pinnacle of their craft, level 17.

rules.duration: Until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You create a phantom duplicate of yourself within reach. Creatures within 5 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or believe you are in that location until the start of your next turn. On your turn, you can teleport up to 30 feet as an action and the decoy vanishes.
rules.drawback: The decoy is not real and can be targeted by attacks and effects.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it's flashy! But does it pay the bills? Not really...

abilities.name: Fury Roar
abilities.description: Roar to inspire allies within hearing range, granting them advantage on the next attack roll.
abilities.apReason: Changes one encounter beat by providing a short-term combat edge and risk-free use.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocks mid-tier combat prowess for Barbarians capable of leading a charge or skirmish.

rules.effect: Allies within hearing range gain advantage on attack rolls until the start of their next turn. Ends if the ally makes an attack.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used when you are incapacitated or stunned.

abilities.warioNote: It's like giving your friends superpowers for just two shiny points! What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Ethereal Scribble
abilities.description: Quickly sketch an illusory distraction, forcing creatures within a 10-foot radius to make a Wisdom saving throw or become distracted for one round.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge at level 4, providing a bonus action for an immediate distraction effect.
abilities.levelReason: Wizards gain the ability to create illusions that can affect their opponents at this level.

rules.effect: DC 8 + Intelligence modifier; on a failed save, the target becomes distracted until the end of their next turn.
rules.drawback: The sketch is only effective against creatures that can see it and are within range.

abilities.warioNote: It's just a quick doodle, but it might throw 'em off their game!

abilities.name: Goring Charge
abilities.description: Unleash a devastating charge, knocking enemies prone and granting temporary hit points.
abilities.apReason: A high-tier ability that requires careful planning but can shift a fight with one powerful move.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters gain the power to devastate foes with a single charge at this level.

rules.effect: Make a melee weapon attack against one creature within range. On a hit, the target is knocked prone and you gain 1d8 temporary hit points.
rules.drawback: You must end your next turn adjacent to an enemy or forfeit the ability for the day.

abilities.warioNote: Don't say I didn't warn you about the danger of overusing your charge! It's a slippery slope to recklessness.

abilities.name: Eclipse Dive
abilities.description: Dive through shadows, appearing behind an enemy to deal 2d8 + Cha modifier slashing damage.
abilities.apReason: Requires dramatic, one-time use in a high-stakes situation, aligning with level 15 epic tier abilities.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, the spy can execute a devastating, high-risk infiltration maneuver.

rules.effect: You make an attack against a creature within 5 feet. If successful, you deal 2d8 + Cha modifier slashing damage and the target must succeed on a DC (10 + Cha modifier) Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You leave yourself vulnerable to attacks of opportunity for the rest of your turn.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, why not? Dive through shadows... and into trouble. But hey, it's your dime!

abilities.name: Harmonic Rally
abilities.description: Lead your allies into a coordinated surge, granting temporary hit points equal to 5 + your Charisma modifier.
abilities.apReason: A strong per-rest play ability that provides meaningful party-wide buffs at level 10.
abilities.levelReason: Requires a strong command presence for such an impactful rest-time buff.

rules.uses: once per short or long rest
rules.effect: All allies within 30 feet gain temporary hit points equal to 5 + your Charisma modifier.
rules.drawback: You must be able to see and hear all targetted allies.

abilities.warioNote: For Wario, this means your friends get a little extra fightin' power! It's like they're eatin' those green mushrooms.

abilities.name: Quick Sketch
abilities.description: Draw a crude but effective weapon in one round, dealing 1d6 damage.
abilities.apReason: A low-tier combat ability that provides a small edge in one round, costing a single AP.
abilities.levelReason: At level 4, the commoner can quickly improvise a weapon suitable for combat.

rules.effect: You make an improvised weapon. On your next attack with it, you deal 1d6 damage. This effect ends when you attack.
rules.drawback: The improvised weapon is crude and can only be used for one attack before you must discard it.

abilities.warioNote: It’s just a stick, but hey, at least it’s something. Don’t go expecting miracles from this twig!

abilities.name: Sharpshooter Strike
abilities.description: On your bonus action, deal an additional d8 damage to one creature you hit with a ranged weapon attack.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge that enhances combat effectiveness without being overpowered for a level 2 character.
abilities.levelReason: Militia soldiers often refine their aim through practice and experience at level 2.

rules.range: melee weapon range of the ranged weapon used
rules.effect: When you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack, add an additional 1d8 damage. This effect ends when you miss or use it again.
rules.drawback: You must have used your bonus action this turn to activate this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Need more practice, soldier? Sharpshooter Strike will have you hitting your mark every time!

abilities.name: Forge Resonance
abilities.description: Emerge from combat as if you had rested, regaining hit points equal to your level and removing all conditions.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic, limited-use ability at the pinnacle of epic play costs four Ability Points to reflect its significance.
abilities.levelReason: At this epic tier, the Artisan can achieve a transformative reset after intense battles.

rules.effect: Regain hit points equal to your level + Intelligence modifier. All conditions are removed. This ability ends when you take a short rest.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used more than once per day, and requires 1 hour of focused work on a forge or similar workspace.

abilities.warioNote: Oh boy, this one's a doozy! Bring your hammer and anvil, it's time to rebuild!

abilities.name: Shadowstep Saber
abilities.description: At will, you vanish into shadows and emerge behind an enemy, delivering a devastating saber strike.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic and hard-limited ability requires a significant cost, fitting its epic tier unlocking at level 19.
abilities.levelReason: Only a master rogue can execute such a precise and dangerous maneuver at this level.

rules.effect: You make a melee attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the target is knocked prone and takes an extra 3d6 damage from your saber. This ability ends if you move more than 5 feet away from the target.
rules.drawback: You must spend 10 minutes in total darkness to recharge this ability.

abilities.warioNote: For the price of a small fortune... you get to be a ninja with a saber. Don't lose it.

abilities.name: Fury Toss
abilities.description: Throw your weapon to pin an enemy, forcing it to attack you instead.
abilities.apReason: Requires a reaction and strategic utility to change enemy targeting, fitting its mid-tier power level.
abilities.levelReason: Unleashes a mid-tier combat ability to change the encounter beat by altering enemy targeting.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You hurl your weapon, pinning an enemy within 5 feet. It must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be forced to attack you for its action on its next turn. The effect ends if the pinned creature moves more than 5 feet.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability until after your first turn in combat.

abilities.warioNote: It's like selling you a way to make that one hit count... for a couple AP.

abilities.name: Tidal Fury
abilities.description: Deal massive damage to one target and grant temporary hit points to allies within reach.
abilities.apReason: High-level burst attack and support ability requires a strong AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Avalanche of damage and healing makes it a powerful per-rest play for the Fighter.

rules.effect: Deal 4d10 slashing damage to a target and grant allies within reach 1d6 temporary hit points until the start of your next turn. DC 8 + proficiency + Strength modifier for saving throw.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if you are incapacitated or restrained.

abilities.warioNote: You think it's just damage? No, this baby also heals your buds. But only when you're not tied up!

abilities.name: Repeating Fire
abilities.description: Fire a burst of rapid, highly accurate shots at an enemy, dealing piercing damage.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic, once-per-session combat ability justifies the high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Only epic-tier abilities are unlocked at this level, offering a dramatic moment per session.

rules.effect: Fire 5 shots of your firearm. Each hit deals 1d8 + DEX modifier piercing damage. No save.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you are using a two-handed weapon.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, why not? One shot to rule them all... for 4 AP! You’ll need your wallet!

abilities.name: Shadowsong
