abilities.description: Merge into the night, gaining advantage on stealth checks and hiding until you take a melee attack.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a significant stealth advantage for one minute at the cost of mobility, fitting its dramatic epic tier unlock.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, spies can manipulate shadows to become nearly indistinguishable from their environment.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you take a melee attack
rules.effect: You gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and are considered invisible until you take a melee attack. The effect ends immediately.
rules.drawback: While using Shadowsong, your movement speed is reduced by half.

abilities.warioNote: Need to disappear? Pay $20 for Shadowsong—become invisible, but can't run fast!

abilities.name: Commanding Charge
abilities.description: Inspire allies within a burst, granting them temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier + Wisdom modifier.
abilities.apReason: The effect provides a strong per-rest play, but also requires spending an Action Point.
abilities.levelReason: Leadership abilities become more potent at this level, providing strong buffs for the party.

rules.duration: Until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: Each ally within the burst gains temporary hit points equal to 1d6 + your Charisma modifier + Wisdom modifier.
rules.drawback: You must spend an Action Point when using this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Alright, sure... but if you’re going to Command the Charge, better bring your wallet!

abilities.name: Toad's Tangle
abilities.description: Trip an opponent with a strategically placed toad trap, causing them to fall prone.
abilities.apReason: Sets up a strategic combat element requiring careful placement, worth two Ability Points at mid-tier levels.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners can now deploy traps with strategic precision at mid-tier encounters.

rules.duration: until a creature ends its turn within the trap's area
rules.effect: DC 8 + Dexterity modifier (Str) save. On failure, target falls prone and takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage.
rules.drawback: The trap must be set in a clear line of sight; you cannot set it behind an obstacle.

abilities.warioNote: Watch out! That toad's trap might just trip your plans!

abilities.name: Bash Block
abilities.description: Gain a +2 bonus to AC as you make an unarmed strike against an enemy, trading defense for offense.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge that enhances defense and attack in one action
abilities.levelReason: Militia need a reliable way to defend and attack in close quarters at this level.

rules.effect: Gain +2 AC until the start of your next turn. Make an unarmed strike as part of this action. If you hit, deal 1d4 bludgeoning damage.
rules.drawback: You cannot use a shield or other weapon while using Bash Block.

abilities.warioNote: For just a single Ability Point, you get to trade some of your AC for a little extra damage? What's not to like?

abilities.name: Masterpiece Weapon
abilities.description: Craft a one-time, legendary weapon that deals massive damage and grants you advantage on attack rolls.
abilities.apReason: This epic ability grants a one-time legendary weapon with massive damage output and advantage on attacks, making it incredibly powerful for the price.
abilities.levelReason: At epic levels, Artisans can create masterpieces that redefine the game for a moment.

rules.effect: Create a legendary weapon with +5 to attack and damage rolls. On hit, target takes an extra 10d6 damage. Ends when used.
rules.drawback: You can only create one Masterpiece Weapon per year.

abilities.warioNote: Haha! Only 4 AP? You get a LEGENDARY weapon that does triple damage and makes you hit like a god... for a year. What a deal!

abilities.name: Stealthy Shadowstep
abilities.description: Summons a shadow to cloak you and your allies within reach, granting total concealment for one minute.
abilities.apReason: This ability represents a monumental shift in combat dynamics, unlocking once-per-day for epic tier.
abilities.levelReason: Only epic Rogues can achieve the perfect moment of complete invisibility.

rules.effect: You and all willing targets within reach become invisible. No creature can see you or take an action against you until the spell ends.
rules.drawback: You cannot move more than 30 feet from your starting position while this effect lasts.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it’s like a one-time sneak past the guard. But you get to be a legend about it!

abilities.name: Rageburst
abilities.description: Gain temporary hit points equal to your Strength modifier x4, and increase your damage rolls by 2 until your next short or long rest.
abilities.apReason: Level 9 ability with strong burst combat potential justifying the cost.
abilities.levelReason: Allows for a powerful burst of strength in combat situations before resting again.

rules.duration: Until your next short or long rest
rules.effect: Gain 4d6 temporary hit points. Increase damage rolls by 2 until end of next short or long rest.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used again until after a long rest.

abilities.warioNote: Rageburst? You think you can handle that much raw power in one go? Pricey, but worth it for that extra edge.

abilities.name: Arcane Shadow
abilities.description: Summon a shadowy duplicate to fight by your side, granting you an ally in combat.
abilities.apReason: Creating an ally in combat requires significant focus, making it a moderate use of Ability Points.
abilities.levelReason: At level 5, wizards gain more control over their environment and can better manage combat threats.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You create an identical duplicate that fights by your side. It has your stats and attacks as you, but deals only half damage. The duplicate lasts until the end of your next turn or until reduced to 0 hit points.
rules.drawback: The duplicate is a shadowy form and cannot interact with objects.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it’s just a shadow, but it can still cause some real damage! For only two APs? You’re getting the deal of a lifetime!

abilities.name: Titanic Slam
abilities.description: Smash your enemy with an unstoppable force, knocking them prone and leaving a trail of destruction.
abilities.apReason: This ability's power at level 20 demands a significant cost in Ability Points to reflect its dramatic impact.
abilities.levelReason: Only the most epic of fighters can muster such devastating power at their peak.

rules.effect: You make a melee attack against one target. On a hit, the target is knocked prone and takes an additional 10d6 bludgeoning damage. The effect ends if you miss or the target moves more than 5 feet away.
rules.drawback: You must hold your ground after using this ability; you cannot move for the next round.

abilities.warioNote: For those who think they're tough... until they meet THIS wall of muscle!

abilities.name: Whispered Salvo
abilities.description: Target an enemy with a shot that whispers secrets of impending doom, forcing a saving throw or suffering a penalty to attack rolls.
abilities.apReason: This ability represents a dramatic, one-time-per-session moment that demands significant resources and risk.
abilities.levelReason: The Gunslinger's mastery over firearms and their ability to deliver critical information in the heat of battle reaches its pinnacle at this level.

rules.effect: Target must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or suffer disadvantage on all attack rolls until the start of their next turn.
rules.drawback: The Gunslinger risks exposing themselves to enemy fire for this precise shot.

abilities.warioNote: Forget the long shots! This one’s a close quarters whisper... but it’ll pack a punch!

abilities.name: Commanding Storm
abilities.description: Lead your allies into a storm of chaos, dealing radiant damage and forcing enemies to make a saving throw or become disoriented.
abilities.apReason: A powerful leadership ability that impacts the battlefield and requires a significant cooldown.
abilities.levelReason: At level 12, leaders need a dramatic burst ability that affects the whole party.

rules.effect: All allies within range gain +2 to attack rolls and damage until the start of their next turn. Enemies in the area must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become disoriented, reducing their speed by half until the end of their next turn.
rules.drawback: You cannot use Commanding Storm again for 8 hours after using it.

abilities.warioNote: It's like raining gold... but only once every 24 hours!

abilities.name: Fog of Toads
abilities.description: Summons a cloud of toads that hinders attackers, reducing their speed by half.
abilities.apReason: Changes one encounter beat by hindering multiple attackers effectively at mid-tier power level.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners can now defend more effectively against multiple foes at once.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until discharged by a creature in the fog of toads
rules.effect: Creatures within 10 feet must make a DC 8 + Wisdom modifier Dexterity saving throw. On failure, they are restrained and their speed is halved until the end of their next turn.
rules.drawback: The toad fog dissipates if more than three creatures enter it.

abilities.warioNote: You think you're slick, but these toads have got your moves all tangled up! Slick as a toad's bottom!

abilities.name: Pummeling Charge
abilities.description: Bash an opponent with your shield, dealing force damage and pushing them back.
abilities.apReason: Pummeling Charge provides a small but reliable combat edge at low levels, making it worth 1 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Militia needs a reliable combat ability that can clear the way in low-level encounters.

rules.effect: Make a Strength check with your shield. On success, deal 1d8+Con modifier force damage and push the target up to 5 feet.
rules.drawback: You must be wielding a shield for this attack.

abilities.warioNote: For just one AP? You get to push someone back! What more could you want from a Militia training?

abilities.name: Shiv Strike
abilities.description: Deal an extra d8 slashing damage on your next attack.
abilities.apReason: Provides a reliable combat bonus at low levels without overpowered benefits.
abilities.levelReason: Rogues gain more reliable combat options as they level up.

rules.effect: On your next attack after using this ability, you deal an extra 1d8 slashing damage. The effect ends when you make the attack.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this reaction again until you finish a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: It's just a little extra cut! What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Furyshout
abilities.description: Shout a primal battle cry, shaking nearby enemies with tremors and forcing them to make saving throws or be disoriented.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a strong per-rest play, giving control over nearby enemies and justifying its high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians gain this ability to provide a powerful burst of battlefield control at their highest tier.

rules.effect: All creatures within range must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become disoriented until the start of their next turn.
rules.drawback: You lose your bonus action for this round.

abilities.warioNote: For just $4 in AP, it's like shaking the table right under their feet! What could go wrong?!

abilities.name: Arcane Eternity
abilities.description: Channel an endless stream of arcane power, dealing damage to all enemies within a 30-foot radius for 6 rounds.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a dramatic, one-time encounter-changing effect worthy of its epic level.
abilities.levelReason: Master wizards command the ultimate expression of their art at this level.

rules.effect: All enemies within 30 feet take 8d6 + Intelligence modifier force damage. A successful DC 18 Dexterity saving throw halves the damage. This effect ends when the caster is incapacitated.
rules.drawback: The wizard must be at least 20 feet away from all targets to activate.

abilities.warioNote: Eh, sure it's powerful... but you're gonna need a lot of AP for that!

abilities.name: Iron Gale
abilities.description: Shake the battlefield with a tempest of ironclad strikes, forcing enemies to scatter or risk being crushed.
abilities.apReason: Requires precise timing as a bonus action, with a strong combat effect that can alter the battlefield geometry for your team.
abilities.levelReason: At level 10, fighters have the combat prowess and strength to unleash powerful area effects effectively.

rules.effect: Each enemy within 15 ft. must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from you and knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You are vulnerable to opportunity attacks during this action.

abilities.warioNote: It's like raining iron... on them! Just don't forget to bring an umbrella!

abilities.name: Bullet Vortex
abilities.description: Create a spinning vortex of bullets that pulls enemies toward you, dealing damage on hit.
abilities.apReason: This ability is powerful due to its area effect, instant damage, and the need for concentration. It represents a significant moment in combat.
abilities.levelReason: At level 20, the Gunslinger's mastery over firearms allows them to create devastating effects like this.

rules.effect: You create a spinning vortex of bullets within range. Creatures within the area must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or be pulled toward you, taking 3d6 piercing damage and being restrained until the start of their next turn.
rules.drawback: You must maintain concentration (as if concentrating on a spell) to keep the vortex active.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, you want this? For 4 AP? You're crazy if you think you can handle that vortex! But hey, it's all about the price, right?

abilities.name: Eclipse Steal
abilities.description: Steal an enemy's next action, forcing them to act as if they failed their attack or spell check.
abilities.apReason: This ability offers a dramatic and impactful moment that can change an encounter's outcome.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, Spies can manipulate the battlefield with decisive effect.

rules.effect: The target must use their next action to make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they cannot take their next action until the start of their next turn.
rules.drawback: Only one target can be affected per round.

abilities.warioNote: Alright, alright... For 4 AP? You get to mess with someone’s plans for good! Just don’t overuse it or I’ll have to raise the price!

abilities.name: Commanding Summit
abilities.description: Lead your allies to victory with a climactic rally, boosting their stats for an encounter.
abilities.apReason: Level 14 epic abilities cost 4 AP, providing a significant but limited-use ability.
abilities.levelReason: Epic abilities unlock at level 14, providing one dramatic moment per session.

rules.duration: Until the end of the encounter
rules.effect: Each ally within 30 feet gains +2 to attack rolls and damage rolls until the end of the encounter. A saving throw DC 14 (Wisdom) is required to negate this effect once per day.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if you are incapacitated or restrained.

abilities.warioNote: Talk about the summit! Now your allies can climb to victory!

abilities.name: Toad Stomp
abilities.description: Deal moderate damage and push enemies back, creating a brief area of danger around you.
abilities.apReason: Requires a reaction, moderate damage output, and has utility in pushing enemies back for one round.
abilities.levelReason: Provides a reliable combat move that can change one encounter beat at mid-level.

rules.effect: Make a melee attack against an enemy. On hit, the target is pushed 5 feet and knocked prone. DC 8 + proficiency + Strength modifier as saving throw to avoid being knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You must be standing on a flat surface for this ability to function effectively.

abilities.warioNote: It's just a stomp... but it can really rattle 'em up!

abilities.name: Steadfast Shield
abilities.description: Increase your shield's AC by +1 until the start of your next turn.
abilities.apReason: Moderate defensive buff for one turn, useful in tight encounters.
abilities.levelReason: Militia benefit from reliable defensive techniques as they gain more experience.

rules.duration: Instantaneous, lasts until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: Your AC is increased by +1 against melee attacks and ranged attacks made before the start of your next turn. This effect ends when you take the Attack action on your next turn.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you are incapacitated.

abilities.warioNote: For a few Ability Points? You get a shield that’s just a little extra sturdy. What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Toolkit Mastery
abilities.description: Increase your tool proficiency by one step, allowing you to use rare tools as if they were common.
abilities.apReason: This is a small reliable edge in utility that unlocks early to support versatile Artisans.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans can reliably manipulate tools and objects at an early stage of their training.

rules.effect: You may use any rare tool as if it were a common tool. This effect lasts until you rest.
rules.drawback: While using a rare tool, your proficiency bonus is halved.

abilities.warioNote: Hey! It's just a simple toolkit upgrade. What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Purifying Strike
abilities.description: Deal radiant damage to a foe, cleansing them of one disease or poison condition.
abilities.apReason: Level 9, strong per-rest play that provides a significant combat and utility benefit with a real drawback.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins use this ability as a strong per-rest play to cleanse conditions and deal significant damage.

rules.effect: You strike the target with holy energy, dealing 1d8 radiant damage and ending one disease or poison condition. Save DC is 8 + your proficiency modifier + your Charisma modifier.
rules.drawback: This ability can only be used once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Got a disease? No problem! For just 3 AP, you can clean it right up!

abilities.name: Furystorm
abilities.description: Unleash a tempest of primal fury, knocking aside foes and dealing massive damage.
abilities.apReason: This is a dramatic one-shot combat ability that can turn an encounter around at level 15, making it appropriately costly.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, the Barbarian can command a devastating storm of primal power.

rules.effect: Target within 5 feet must succeed on a DC (8 + Proficiency + Strength modifier) Con save or be knocked prone and take 10d6 slashing damage. On a save, the target takes half as much damage.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you have less than half your hit points remaining.

abilities.warioNote: It's like getting hit by a hurricane... for $20!

abilities.name: Ethereal Flux
abilities.description: Summons a wave of shifting ethereal energy that damages enemies and heals allies within its radius.
abilities.apReason: Ethereal Flux is a dramatic, session-ending ability that reshapes the battlefield at the pinnacle of wizard power.
abilities.levelReason: Ethereal Flux is a dramatic, session-ending ability that reshapes the battlefield at the pinnacle of wizard power.

rules.duration: Until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: All creatures within 15 feet take 8d6 force damage. Each ally within this area regains 120 hit points.
rules.drawback: You must concentrate on Ethereal Flux for its duration, and failure to do so ends the effect.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, you want this? It’s like getting struck by lightning... but better!

abilities.name: Redemption Strike
abilities.description: Deal massive damage to an enemy, then gain temporary hit points equal to the damage dealt.
abilities.apReason: A powerful combat move requiring careful timing and resource management.
abilities.levelReason: Forces a decisive strike that can turn a battle in your favor.

rules.effect: Make a melee weapon attack. On hit, deal an additional 2d8 + Strength modifier damage and gain that much temporary hit points.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used on allies or creatures already reduced to half health.

abilities.warioNote: You think this is cheap? Try doing it without hitting your target first!

abilities.name: Shadow Vault
abilities.description: Teleport to an unoccupied space within line of sight, ignoring obstacles up to 30 feet.
abilities.apReason: This powerful, once-per-session stealth ability requires significant focus and preparation, hence its high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Only a master spy can master the ultimate in clandestine movement.

rules.effect: The spy teleports to an unoccupied space within line of sight. The spell ends if the spy moves more than 10 feet away from the destination.
rules.drawback: Must remain unseen by any creature for 1 minute or lose the ability's benefit until the next long rest.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, you want to disappear like a ghost? Here’s your chance—$200 in AP, but hey, it's worth it for that one epic escape!

abilities.name: Triumphant Rally
abilities.description: Inspire your allies, granting them advantage on attacks and saving throws until you fall to zero hit points.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic leadership move costs four Ability Points to reflect its significant, one-time impact on the battlefield and your party's morale.
abilities.levelReason: Leadership's dramatic impact at epic levels allows for a single, powerful moment of rallying before the session ends.

rules.duration: Until you drop to 0 hit points
rules.effect: All allies within 30 feet gain advantage on attack rolls and saving throws. Ends if you are incapacitated or fall unconscious.
rules.drawback: You must spend a short rest after using this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Alright, sure... but it’s like trying to sell ice cream in the Arctic. You’ll need a lot more AP than that for this kind of power!

abilities.name: Cheap Tonic
abilities.description: Create a one-use health tonic that restores 8 hit points when consumed.
abilities.apReason: A moderate utility ability that provides a significant health boost, unlocking at level 8 to better support the party.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners can now afford to create more potent healing items as they gain experience.

rules.effect: Drinking the tonic restores 8 hit points. The effect ends when consumed.
rules.drawback: The tonic can only be created once per day and requires commoner-level proficiency in Herbalism.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Need some quick healing? This tonic does the trick for just two AP. What could be better?

abilities.name: Stealthy Dodge
abilities.description: Gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks for 1 minute after successfully dodging an attack.
abilities.apReason: Provides a reliable edge at level 3 with limited usage.
abilities.levelReason: Rogues gain bonuses to Stealth checks at level 3, making it a reliable edge.

rules.effect: Gain advantage on one Dexterity (Stealth) check after successfully dodging an attack. Ends when the duration expires or if you make another Stealth check.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used more than once per encounter.

abilities.warioNote: Alright, alright... for just one AP, you get to hide better after dodging? What a deal!

abilities.name: Tempest's Fury
abilities.description: Harness the storm to deal massive damage, but endure a furious wind for an hour.
abilities.apReason: This ability is dramatic and impactful, fitting the level 20 tier with a single use per day.
abilities.levelReason: Only unlocks at level 20 as it represents a climactic peak of power and control.

rules.effect: Deal an additional 5d6 thunder damage on melee attacks. Save DC 24 (Wisdom + proficiency) against being knocked prone and reduced movement speed to half until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You are struck by a gusting tempest that lasts for one hour, reducing your movement speed to half and imposing disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saving throws.

abilities.warioNote: You think THIS is tough? Try surviving a tempest for an hour! Priceless!

abilities.name: Phantasmal Shield
abilities.description: Create a phantasmal barrier to block one attack or ability per day.
abilities.apReason: Provides a moderate defensive benefit at a reasonable cost for mid-tier play.
abilities.levelReason: Provides moderate defensive value in combat for mid-tier encounters.

rules.effect: DC 10 + Wisdom modifier (opposed save); ends when the phantasmal shield is breached or the creature takes an action.
rules.drawback: The shield only affects one attack or ability per day and offers no actual damage resistance.

abilities.warioNote: Phantasmal Shield? More like phantom fail. Good luck with that!

abilities.name: Battering Bash
abilities.description: Smash through enemies with a fearsome charge, dealing massive damage and knocking foes prone.
abilities.apReason: Requires a dramatic action that can change an encounter beat, justifying its high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Battering Bash is a dramatic move suitable for epic confrontations.

rules.uses: once per short or long rest
rules.effect: You make a melee attack against one creature within reach. On a hit, you deal 3d10 + Strength modifier damage and the target is knocked prone.
rules.drawback: If you miss with this attack, you are disoriented until the start of your next turn.

abilities.warioNote: For those times when you need to make a statement and bring down the house!

abilities.name: Shadow Steal
abilities.description: Steal an enemy's next action, leaving them helpless and confused.
abilities.apReason: This ability offers a dramatic and decisive moment per session, making it epic-tier worthy.
abilities.levelReason: At level 19, the Spy can manipulate combat in decisive ways by seizing control of enemies' actions.

rules.effect: Target must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or become stunned until the start of their next turn. If they fail, you gain control of their actions for that turn.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if the target is immune to being charmed.

abilities.warioNote: For Wario, that's like getting *two* free snacks! Or one really good one...

abilities.name: Rally Cry
abilities.description: Shout a rallying cry to nearby allies, granting them advantage on the next attack roll.
abilities.apReason: Level 2 abilities provide a small but reliable edge, such as advantage on an important roll once per short rest.
abilities.levelReason: Leaders at level 2 can inspire their allies with a simple but powerful command.

rules.effect: All allies within 30 feet gain advantage on the next attack roll they make. This effect ends when they make another attack.
rules.drawback: The leader must be visible and audible to all targeted allies.

abilities.warioNote: For just one AP, you get your friends pumped up like they're ready to take on the whole dungeon! Or at least the next few monsters.

abilities.name: Mass Potion
abilities.description: Create a potion that heals or buffs up to three allies within range.
abilities.apReason: Creating a powerful magic effect that provides healing to multiple allies justifies a high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Allows the commoner to create a powerful healing effect for their team.

rules.effect: Crafts a potion that heals up to 5d8 + Wisdom modifier hit points. Allies must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be incapacitated for 1 minute.
rules.drawback: The commoner must have materials worth at least 20 gp and spend an hour crafting the potion.

abilities.warioNote: Taste the rainbow, but it costs extra to heal your friends!

abilities.name: Stone Shield
abilities.description: Erect a temporary shield of stone to deflect attacks, reducing damage taken by half.
abilities.apReason: Provides moderate combat enhancement and a short duration, aligning with mid-tier abilities.
abilities.levelReason: Militia's mid-tier abilities introduce moderate combat enhancements that can turn the tide of battle.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you take a major action to dismiss it
rules.effect: You create an area around yourself that reduces incoming damage by half. Ends if you move more than 5 feet.
rules.drawback: While active, you have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

abilities.warioNote: Yeah... it's not gonna win any beauty contests, but it'll save your bacon in a pinch!

abilities.name: Healing Aura
abilities.description: Create a protective barrier around allies within 30 feet, granting them advantage on saving throws.
abilities.apReason: A strong per-rest play ability that provides significant support to the party at a high cost.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins gain the ability to significantly bolster their party's resilience at this level.

rules.effect: All allies within range have advantage on saving throws. Ends if you use another bonus action for this feature.
rules.drawback: While active, you cannot cast spells that deal damage.

abilities.warioNote: It's like getting a free shield wall... for your friends. But you can't attack while it’s active! Bet you didn’t see THAT coming.

abilities.name: Stealth Dive
abilities.description: On your turn, you can move up to double your speed and gain advantage on attack rolls against creatures you bypass.
abilities.apReason: This provides a reliable edge in combat and stealth scenarios, making it cost-effective for level 4 Rogues.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, Rogues have the mobility to effectively use this ability for combat.

rules.effect: You gain advantage on attack rolls against creatures you bypass. This effect ends when you move normally or take a non-movement action.
rules.drawback: You must move at least half your speed to activate this ability.

abilities.warioNote: For just a few coins, you get the sneakiest dive in all of Thieves' Guild! But hey, at least you have to run pretty far first!

abilities.name: Berserk Shout
abilities.description: Shout a primal battle cry to grant yourself advantage on attack rolls until your next short rest.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge that provides immediate combat advantage without overpowered effects, unlocking at level 2.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians gain the ability to channel fury effectively at level 2, providing an immediate combat edge.

rules.effect: You gain advantage on attack rolls. This ends when you finish a short rest.
rules.drawback: You must concentrate and cannot use this ability again until you complete a short or long rest.

abilities.warioNote: For just a buck? It's like getting an extra swing in every battle! What a deal!

abilities.name: Mirage Distraction
abilities.description: Create a shifting mirage to draw enemies away, forcing them to make a Wisdom saving throw or lose their next action.
abilities.apReason: Changes the encounter beat by disrupting enemy actions, making it mid-tier for level 7 wizards.
abilities.levelReason: Allows wizards to change the battlefield by disrupting enemy movements effectively.

rules.effect: Each creature within 20 feet of the spell's location must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or lose their next action. The effect ends if you use another reaction this turn.
rules.drawback: You can create only one mirage distraction at a time, and it requires concentration.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! This Mirage Distraction? It's like selling you a ticket to chaos itself. But remember, too much of this and your enemies might just lose their marbles!

abilities.name: Unstoppable Charge
abilities.description: Engage with a powerful charge, pushing back enemies and leaving a trail of destruction.
abilities.apReason: This is a dramatic, one-shot ability that can be game-changing in epic battles.
abilities.levelReason: Epic battles require epic charges that can turn the tide.

rules.effect: You push back all creatures within 10 feet of you. They must each make a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and pushed up to 5 feet away from you. The effect ends if you move more than 30 feet away from the area.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again until you finish a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: For those times when you need to charge through the chaos and leave your enemies behind. Priceless!

abilities.name: Encouraging Word
abilities.description: Calm and bolster a comrade's resolve with a reassuring word, granting temporary hit points.
abilities.apReason: It provides a small reliable edge, making it worth one Ability Point at level 3.
abilities.levelReason: Leadership skills are useful from the start but truly shine as one gains experience.

rules.effect: Target gains 3d6 temporary hit points. Saves against fear have advantage until the end of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You must be within 30 feet to use this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it's just words, but words that heal? Priceless!

abilities.name: Toad's Fury
abilities.description: The Commoner channels their rage into a powerful roar that intimidates enemies and bolsters allies within 10 feet.
abilities.apReason: This is a high-tier level 10 ability, granting significant burst combat and support benefits at the cost of 3 AP.
abilities.levelReason: A level 10 Commoner can unleash significant combat prowess with this burst ability.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you use an action to end it
rules.effect: All friendly creatures within 10 feet gain advantage on attack rolls and saving throws. Enemies within range must make a DC (8 + proficiency + Charisma modifier) Wisdom save or be frightened for 1 minute.
rules.drawback: You cannot activate this ability while you are incapacitated.

abilities.warioNote: Sellin' this training's like sellin' toads to a farmer— you think they need more fightin' power?

abilities.name: Wall of Thorns
abilities.description: Erect a wall of spiky thorns that deal piercing damage to any creature entering its area.
abilities.apReason: Provides a moderate damage boost and battlefield control for the cost of two Ability Points at mid-tier level.
abilities.levelReason: Provides short-term battlefield control and moderate damage at the appropriate mid-tier encounter level.

rules.duration: Until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: Creatures within the area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or take 4d6 piercing damage and be restrained until the start of their next turn. The effect ends when you use an action to dismiss it.
rules.drawback: You can only create one Wall of Thorns per long rest, limiting its usefulness in extended combat.

abilities.warioNote: Alright, it’s just some thorns! But they’re sharp, I promise!

abilities.name: Gear Surge
abilities.description: Gain advantage on attack rolls with improvised weapons until you take damage.
abilities.apReason: Provides a small reliable edge by granting temporary combat advantage, fitting the low-tier level 3
abilities.levelReason: Artisans need small advantages to overcome obstacles and enemies effectively at this level.

rules.effect: Gain advantage on attack rolls with improvised weapons. Ends when you take damage.
rules.drawback: Cannot use this ability if you are already gaining advantage from another source.

abilities.warioNote: These little gears may be cheap, but they sure pack a punch when you need it most!

abilities.name: Holy Surge
abilities.description: Deal radiant damage to enemies within a burst, dealing an amount of damage equal to your Charisma modifier + your level.
abilities.apReason: The high level and burst combat effect warrant a significant 3 AP cost for this strong per-rest play ability.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins gain the ability to unleash a powerful divine surge at this level for meaningful team-wide support and combat control.

rules.effect: You create a burst of holy energy centered on yourself. Each creature in the area takes 8d6 radiant damage + your Charisma modifier.
rules.drawback: Targets can make a DC 15 Religion saving throw to halve the damage.

abilities.warioNote: For those who think it's just another flash, this one packs enough power to light up the whole battlefield!

abilities.name: Rampage Bash
abilities.description: Deal an extra 1d6 damage on your next melee attack, but you must move at least 5 feet after the attack.
abilities.apReason: Provides a moderate damage boost and short control (forced movement) in exchange for a daily drawback.
abilities.levelReason: Unleashes devastating power during a Barbarian's rage.

rules.duration: until end of your next turn
rules.effect: On your first melee attack after activation, deal an additional 1d6 damage. Must move at least 5 feet immediately after the attack.
rules.drawback: After using this ability, you are fatigued until you finish a long rest.

abilities.warioNote: It's like buying a supercharged sledgehammer—just make sure to pace yourself, buddy!

abilities.name: Spellshard Barrier
abilities.description: Create a resilient barrier of arcane energy to block one melee or ranged attack.
abilities.apReason: Mid-tier abilities cost two APs, and Spellshard Barrier provides a moderate combat advantage with defensive capabilities.
abilities.levelReason: Mid-tier abilities provide moderate damage boosts and short control effects; Spellshard Barrier offers both by mitigating attacks with an energetic shield.

rules.effect: DC 10 + Intelligence modifier (Wisdom saving throw) to break; ends when the attack hits or misses. Reduces damage taken by half.
rules.drawback: Only one use per encounter and cannot be used against magic attacks.

abilities.warioNote: It's like buying a shield made of pure spellpower! What could go wrong? Oh, you know... everything.

abilities.name: Mountain Smash
abilities.description: Crush enemies like boulders, dealing massive damage to all creatures within reach.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a dramatic, one-time effect that is costly and impactful for epic-level play.
abilities.levelReason: At this epic level, fighters can command the force of nature with a single devastating strike.

rules.effect: You make a powerful overhand strike, dealing 4d10 bludgeoning damage to all creatures within the area. Creatures must succeed on a DC 22 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: Your weapon deals no damage until you spend a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, you want this? It’s like buying the Eiffel Tower... but with your fist!

abilities.name: Stealth Shadow
abilities.description: Become a shadow of your target, blending into their surroundings to avoid detection for a moment.
abilities.apReason: This ability offers a dramatic and hard-limited stealth advantage at the highest level.
abilities.levelReason: Master spies can manipulate the very essence of shadows to evade foes and allies alike.

rules.effect: You gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and are considered invisible until the start of your next turn, after which you must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, you are seen by everyone.
rules.drawback: If seen by an enemy or ally during this time, you cannot use Stealth Shadow again for 1d4+1 hours.

abilities.warioNote: You think I'd let you just disappear? Not while it costs 4 AP! That's like buying a lifetime supply of invisible cookies!

abilities.name: Stormcall
abilities.description: Roar to summon a burst of storm energy, dealing lightning damage to enemies within an area.
abilities.apReason: Stormcall's dramatic effect and single-use per long rest justify a high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Leadership's epic abilities allow for dramatic, impactful combat maneuvers like Stormcall.

rules.effect: You roar to call a burst of storm energy. Each creature in a 15-foot radius must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 8d6 lightning damage.
rules.drawback: You cannot use Stormcall if you are within 30 feet of an active weather phenomenon.

abilities.warioNote: Lookin' at ya, spendin' four AP on this one? Yeesh! But it packs quite the punch!

abilities.name: Crowd Distract
abilities.description: Create a distraction among enemies, drawing attacks to yourself for the duration.
abilities.apReason: Crowd Distract provides a meaningful combat support effect at level 11, making it a strong per-rest play.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, a commoner can leverage their environment and social skills for significant combat support.

rules.duration: Until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You create a distracting noise or visual, forcing all hostile creatures within 10 feet to make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they must use their action to attack you on their next turn instead of moving or attacking another target.
rules.drawback: If you fail the save, you become disoriented and can't take actions until the end of your next turn.

abilities.warioNote: Need a way to make those pesky goblins focus on you? This'll get 'em! Just don't mess up the distraction or you're next!

abilities.name: Fortify Flank
abilities.description: Gain a +1 bonus to AC for each ally within 5 feet, up to three allies.
abilities.apReason: Provides a moderate defensive boost with limited usage per day.
abilities.levelReason: Militia gain the ability to fortify their allies at this level of combat proficiency.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until concentration is lost (as a bonus action)
rules.effect: Increase AC by +1 for each ally within 5 feet, up to three. Ends if you leave the area.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used again until after a long rest.

abilities.warioNote: You think one shield’s enough? Try being surrounded! For just two AP, you can become the wall everyone needs!

abilities.name: Tool Smite
abilities.description: Slam a tool into an enemy, dealing 1d6 force damage and knocking it prone.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge in combat without expending a standard action.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans can rely on tools to disarm foes with precision.

rules.effect: You make a melee attack against an enemy within reach. On a hit, it takes 1d6 force damage and is knocked prone.
rules.drawback: Your next tool use has disadvantage until the start of your next turn.

abilities.warioNote: These tools might be useful, but they're not exactly flashy—just ask for a bonus action and watch 'em go down!

abilities.name: Judgment Flare
abilities.description: Unleash a searing blast of divine energy that deals radiant damage to all creatures within an area.
abilities.apReason: Requires a dramatic moment and a clear cost for such power.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, a Paladin can deliver a decisive blow in epic confrontations.

rules.effect: All creatures within the line take 15d8 radiant damage. Save DC 18 + Cha modifier; on a successful save, reduce damage by half.
rules.drawback: The Paladin must be able to see all targets in the area and can only use this ability once per long rest.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, Judgment Flare! For 4 APs? You think that's cheap? Try dodging THAT in combat!

abilities.name: Feral Fury
abilities.description: Roar at a foe, stunning them and dealing thunder damage.
abilities.apReason: This high-tier ability provides a strong burst combat effect at a meaningful cost.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians gain the power to devastate foes with their primal roars.

rules.duration: until end of next turn for each creature stunned
rules.effect: You make a roaring shout. Each creature within range must succeed on a DC 15 Con saving throw or be stunned until the start of your next turn. You deal 2d6 thunder damage to one target.
rules.drawback: The roar can only affect creatures you can see and hear.

abilities.warioNote: For the price of 3 AP, you get to make your enemies tremble in fear. What more could you ask for?

abilities.name: Arcane Cascade
abilities.description: Summon a cascade of magical energy that deals radiant damage to all creatures within an area.
abilities.apReason: A high-tier ability that provides significant magic burst for a rest but requires concentration.
abilities.levelReason: Provides powerful burst magic for high-impact spellcasting.

rules.effect: Each creature in the area takes 8d6 radiant damage. Saving throw DC = 12 + Intelligence modifier + proficiency bonus.
rules.drawback: You must concentrate on this effect for 1 minute after use, during which time you are unable to cast spells.

abilities.warioNote: For those with deep pockets and shallow minds... An Arcane Cascade is worth the gold, if you can last long enough after!

abilities.name: Goliath Slam
abilities.description: Smash through foes with a devastating ground-shaking charge, reducing all within reach by half their AC.
abilities.apReason: This ability is a dramatic, one-time-per-session finisher that requires significant resources.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 16 allows for a dramatic finishing move in epic encounters.

rules.effect: You make a melee attack against one creature within reach. On a hit, it and all other creatures within 5 feet of you must succeed on a DC (10 + Strength modifier) Constitution saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You are vulnerable to opportunity attacks until the start of your next turn.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, this’ll flatten ‘em good. But you’ll be wide open for their follow-up attacks!

abilities.name: Flash Step
abilities.description: Rapidly close the distance to an enemy, repositioning yourself within 10 feet of them.
abilities.apReason: Flash Step offers a reliable and quick tactical edge at low levels, allowing the Gunslinger to reposition with ease.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 2 allows a Gunslinger to quickly close in on targets.

rules.effect: You teleport up to 10 feet directly towards a creature you can see, ending your movement there. The target must succeed on a DC 8 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You provoke opportunity attacks for each square moved while using this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Want to be all stealthy? Sure thing! Just don't expect it for free!

abilities.name: Shady Exit
abilities.description: Gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to escape from a contested area.
abilities.apReason: This is a small reliable edge, fitting the low-tier level 2 ability requirement.
abilities.levelReason: Spies often need quick escapes, making this ability critical at level 2.

rules.effect: While using this ability, you gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to escape from a contested area. This effect ends when you successfully complete the escape.
rules.drawback: You must be in a contested area to use this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, now you can sneak out of sticky situations without even breaking a sweat! Priceless!

abilities.name: Commanding Apex
abilities.description: Inspire an ally to fight past exhaustion, granting them a +2 bonus to attack rolls and saving throws until they rest.
abilities.apReason: Unlocking one dramatic moment per session, requiring careful management of resources.
abilities.levelReason: Epic abilities grant one dramatic moment per session, making this the perfect unlock point for Commanding Apex's impact.

rules.duration: Until the end of the next short rest
rules.effect: The chosen ally within range gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls and saving throws. This effect ends when they complete a short rest.
rules.drawback: You must have at least 10 hit points to use this ability.

abilities.warioNote: For those times when you need that extra push. Priceless!

abilities.name: Whispering Horde
abilities.description: Summon a wave of toads to flank enemies, dealing minor damage and imposing disadvantage on their attacks.
abilities.apReason: A strong per-rest play that requires careful timing and limited use.
abilities.levelReason: Summons a powerful temporary ally to turn the tide in combat.

rules.effect: You summon a wave of toads that flank enemies within 5 feet, imposing disadvantage on their attack rolls and dealing 2d4 bludgeoning damage. The effect ends if you take any action other than moving.
rules.drawback: The summoned toads are only effective for one minute and can be dismissed early.

abilities.warioNote: Ah, sure it’s useful... but hey, you gotta pay the toad-teller!

abilities.name: Tactical Shield Slam
abilities.description: Smash your shield into enemies, stunning one and healing allies.
abilities.apReason: High tier ability providing significant burst combat support at the cost of an AP.
abilities.levelReason: Provides a strong burst of combat control and support at this tier.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: Targeted enemy is stunned (DC 14 Con save ends). You and allies within 5 feet gain temporary hit points equal to 2d8 + Con modifier.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you are incapacitated or restrained.

abilities.warioNote: Yeah, it’s a shield slam. What else do you want me to sell? A sandwich?

abilities.name: Tool Trap
abilities.description: Set an improvised trap with tools, dealing 2d6 bludgeoning damage to the first creature that triggers it.
abilities.apReason: Sets up an immediate combat advantage requiring careful planning and resource management.
abilities.levelReason: Requires proficiency in tools and a basic understanding of traps for effective use.

rules.effect: The trap has an attack bonus equal to your Intelligence modifier + your proficiency bonus. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage and is restrained until freed by another creature.
rules.drawback: The trap can only be set in one location and must include at least two tools.

abilities.warioNote: These training points? They're like finding a rare tool in a treasure chest—worth every coin!

abilities.name: Divine Vigor
abilities.description: Gain temporary hit points equal to your Paladin level when you finish a short rest.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a reliable, small edge at the start of short rests for Paladins.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins gain significant benefits from resting, making this ability valuable early on.

rules.activation: At the start of a short rest
rules.duration: Until the end of your next long rest
rules.effect: You gain temporary hit points equal to 1d8 + your Charisma modifier.
rules.drawback: The temporary hit points fade after a long rest.

abilities.warioNote: Got that stamina down? You better believe it’ll give you that extra push when the fight’s just heating up!

abilities.name: Backstab Shuffle
abilities.description: You slide behind an enemy, delivering a swift and precise backstab.
abilities.apReason: Requires precise movement and positioning, offering moderate combat advantage mid-tier.
abilities.levelReason: Allows for more strategic positioning in combat at mid-tier level.

rules.effect: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage against one target you can reach. On a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you are not moving at least 5 feet during your turn.

abilities.warioNote: It's like sneaking up behind a foe—easy as pie when you're already in motion!

abilities.name: Feral Overload
abilities.description: Barbarian lets loose a primal scream that knocks prone all enemies within 10 feet.
abilities.apReason: Requires a strong burst combat move, justifying its high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: A high-tier burst attack that debilitates multiple foes at once, making it perfect for level 12.

rules.effect: Each creature within range must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. The effect ends on a turn if the target takes any action.
rules.drawback: The Barbarian risks losing their balance for 1 round after using this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Feral Overload? Oh, you think it's just about knocking them down? Try not falling on your face too!

abilities.name: Arcane Conflagration
abilities.description: Deal area damage to enemies, centered on a foe you target.
abilities.apReason: This is a strong per-rest play combat ability that requires careful timing and management, fitting its high-tier cost.
abilities.levelReason: A burst combat ability that can change one encounter beat for the party.

rules.effect: Target a single enemy within range. You and all friendly creatures within 10 feet gain immunity to fire damage until the start of your next turn. All enemies in the area must make a DC (8 + Proficiency + Intelligence modifier) Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 fire damage on a failed save.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability for 1 minute after it has been used.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, you think you can just light the place on fire? It's not as easy as it looks!

abilities.name: Mountainous Charge
abilities.description: Charge through foes, knocking them aside with a fearsome impact.
abilities.apReason: This epic-level combat maneuver requires significant preparation and physical prowess, hence its high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Masters of martial combat reach their peak at epic levels to deal devastating blows.

rules.effect: Make a melee attack against one creature within 5 feet. On a hit, the target is knocked prone and takes an additional 10 + your Strength modifier (or Proficiency bonus) bludgeoning damage. The effect ends if you move more than 5 feet away from the target.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability while carrying a heavy load or encumbered.

abilities.warioNote: For Wario, it’s like moving a mountain... but just one at a time!

abilities.name: Flash Bang
abilities.description: Disrupt enemies with a blinding flash, forcing them to make a saving throw or be stunned.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge at level 3, providing a temporary condition to disrupt enemies.
abilities.levelReason: Gunslingers can reliably apply pressure with this distraction at level 3.

rules.duration: Until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: Each creature within 10 feet must make a DC 8 + Dexterity modifier + proficiency bonus saving throw. On a failed save, they are blinded until the end of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You cannot Flash Bang twice in the same combat round.

abilities.warioNote: For just one AP? You get stunned! What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Shadowstep Dash
abilities.description: On your move, you can sprint through shadows, covering twice your speed limit before attacking.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a small but reliable edge in terms of movement and combat, fitting for level 4.
abilities.levelReason: Spy abilities enhance their movement and combat prowess incrementally as they gain experience.

rules.effect: You move up to twice your speed. You can make one melee weapon attack at the end of this movement, but you take a -2 penalty to the attack roll.
rules.drawback: You leave a faint shadow trail that grants advantage to Perception checks made by others within 10 feet.

abilities.warioNote: It's like teleporting... kind of. Just don't expect to see it on your taxes!

abilities.name: Legend's Roar
abilities.description: Shake the battlefield with a roar that grants allies temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier x4.
abilities.apReason: This ability offers significant leadership at an epic tier, requiring a substantial AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Leadership is most dramatic and impactful at the epic tier, where it can turn the tide of battle.

rules.effect: All allies within range gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier x4 until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You must be able to speak and have a clear voice.

abilities.warioNote: Listen up, wanna-be legends! This one’s gonna cost ya four AP, but it’s worth the price of admission if you want to turn the tide!

abilities.name: Toad's Grand Slam
abilities.description: Leverage your knowledge of toad anatomy for a devastating leap and strike.
abilities.apReason: This ability is a dramatic, one-time event that shifts the tide of battle in a single session.
abilities.levelReason: Your accumulated toad expertise allows you to perform one final, dramatic act in an epic encounter.

rules.effect: Make a melee attack against the nearest enemy. On a hit, they are knocked prone and take an additional 2d6 force damage. The target can use their reaction to stand up.
rules.drawback: You must be within 5 feet of an enemy to activate this ability.

abilities.warioNote: For just four AP? You get to make one final grand slam move! But better watch out—your enemies will go down hard!

abilities.name: Masterful Tweak
abilities.description: Craft a temporary weapon from an ordinary object, granting it +1d6 damage for 1 minute.
abilities.apReason: Crafting an effective tool and turning it into a combat weapon requires a moderate investment of Ability Points for mid-tier use.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans can now craft quick and effective improvisations to turn the tide of battle mid-tier encounter.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until used in combat
rules.effect: Create a +1d6 damage improvised weapon for 1 minute. Saves vs Dexterity DC 12 negate.
rules.drawback: Can only be used once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Need to turn that broomstick into a stick of dynamite? You got it, buddy! One AP and you're ready to go!

abilities.name: Tempest Surge
abilities.description: Call a tempest of arcane energy, dealing lightning damage to enemies within range and granting temporary hit points to allies.
abilities.apReason: A powerful per-rest combat ability that requires careful use due to its harsh environmental cost.
abilities.levelReason: Enables powerful burst combat abilities for mid-to-high level wizards.

rules.effect: Deal 2d8 + Intelligence modifier lightning damage to all creatures within range. Creatures that start their turn within the storm must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be stunned until the end of their next turn. Allies gain temporary hit points equal to your level.
rules.drawback: You and allies within 10 feet of you are exposed to the elements, dealing 1d6 cold damage at the start of each of your turns.

abilities.warioNote: It's like getting hit by a hurricane, but with spells! Just what the doctor ordered!

abilities.name: Massive Bash
abilities.description: Smash through a group of enemies with overwhelming force, dealing massive damage to all within reach.
abilities.apReason: This ability is designed as a powerful finisher at the highest level, requiring significant resources to use.
abilities.levelReason: At level 18, the fighter can unleash devastating power that affects multiple foes in one dramatic moment.

rules.effect: You deal 10d6 + Strength modifier damage to all creatures within the area. They must make a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and stunned for 1 round.
rules.drawback: You must spend 4 Ability Points (AP) to activate this ability, reflecting its epic scale.

abilities.warioNote: For those times when you need to make a statement. Priceless damage, but it'll empty your wallet.

abilities.name: Reload Whisper
abilities.description: Quickly reload a firearm with a swift gesture, gaining advantage on your next attack roll.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge, giving the Gunslinger an immediate tactical advantage during a fight.
abilities.levelReason: Gains access to more complex tactical maneuvers as the Gunslinger becomes more experienced.

rules.effect: You gain advantage on your next attack roll with a firearm. This effect ends if you miss the target or use another bonus action before this one.
rules.drawback: You cannot reload a firearm while engaged in combat unless you have advantage on your attack rolls.

abilities.warioNote: It's just a quick reload... but it could save your life!

abilities.name: Shadowscale Cloak
abilities.description: Merge into shadows for cover, becoming invisible to all but those focused on your scent.
abilities.apReason: The mid-tier cost reflects a moderate control effect that changes one encounter beat.
abilities.levelReason: Spies need a reliable way to become undetectable in combat.

rules.effect: You gain the benefit of the Invisibility spell (DC 13) for its duration. You remain visible to creatures that can perceive smells, and any creature that sees you must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become blinded until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: If you move more than 5 feet away from where you cast this spell, it ends.

abilities.warioNote: You think this is cheap? Try escaping without leaving a scent trail!

abilities.name: Commanding Eternity
abilities.description: For a moment, your rallying cry grants allies immunity to fear and death effects.
abilities.apReason: This ability is a game-changing moment that can turn the tide in epic battles.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, the leader can inspire an entire battle with one grand gesture.

rules.effect: All creatures you can see within range gain immunity to fear and death effects until the end of their next turn. A creature can benefit from this ability only once per short rest. Saves against these effects are made at a DC of 18 + your Charisma modifier.
rules.drawback: You must use your reaction to activate this effect, meaning you cannot react defensively.

abilities.warioNote: For just 4 AP? You get a chance to make the battlefield your own for a full minute! What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Frogger's Leap
abilities.description: Leap over foes to land behind them, tripping any within reach.
abilities.apReason: This is an epic maneuver that can turn the tide in combat with one dramatic action.
abilities.levelReason: Epic leap maneuvers are the hallmark of seasoned adventurers.

rules.effect: You gain advantage on attack rolls against creatures you trip. Any creature within reach that you land on must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone. The effect ends when you move more than 30 feet away from the point where you landed.
rules.drawback: On a failed save, tripped foes may attack you as part of their reaction.

abilities.warioNote: Frogger's Leap? Pricey but worth it if you're about to get swarmed!

abilities.name: Mass Militarize
abilities.description: Mobilizes nearby militia into a cohesive defensive formation, granting temporary hit points to allies within range.
abilities.apReason: Requires strategic thinking and coordination, providing a strong per-rest play benefit.
abilities.levelReason: Allows the Militia to provide robust support through strategic formations that enhance party-wide resilience.

rules.effect: All allies within 30 feet gain temporary hit points equal to your level + Constitution modifier. This effect ends if an ally moves out of range.
rules.drawback: You must be able to see all targets and they must be able to hear you.

abilities.warioNote: For the price of three APs, you get an entire militia unit to rally behind you—what could go wrong?

abilities.name: Forge Momentum
abilities.description: Gain a temporary hit point equal to your Intelligence modifier + proficiency bonus while you are wielding artisan tools.
abilities.apReason: Provides moderate benefit and requires a bonus action, fitting for mid-tier (level 5-8) abilities.
abilities.levelReason: Mid-tier combat ability that provides moderate damage resilience during tool usage.

rules.effect: Gain a temporary hit point equal to your Intelligence modifier + proficiency bonus while you are wielding artisan tools. Ends when out of artisan tools.
rules.drawback: Cannot be active if already benefiting from another temporary hit point.

abilities.warioNote: Why bother with just one when you can have two? Double the resilience, double the fun!

abilities.name: Shadowslip Evasion
abilities.description: Emerge from shadows to strike with a bonus action attack, then vanish back into darkness.
abilities.apReason: Provides significant combat and stealth benefits at a moderate cost.
abilities.levelReason: Rogues gain the ability to use shadows for evasion and surprise attacks at this level.

rules.effect: You can make a bonus action attack. After the attack, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You must be in shadowy conditions to use this ability.

abilities.warioNote: It's like teleporting for free, but only if it’s dark out. What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Feral Rampage
abilities.description: Unleash a primal fury that grants you advantage on attack rolls until your next short rest.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a dramatic combat advantage lasting through multiple encounters and requires careful management.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians channel their rage for one final, dramatic moment of unrelenting combat.

rules.effect: You gain advantage on attack rolls. This ends if you are incapacitated or you use a bonus action for another effect.
rules.drawback: You must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 15 + proficiency + Con modifier) at the start of your next short rest, taking 2d6 damage on failure.

abilities.warioNote: Watch out—this one’ll make you roar like the wild! But it’s not cheap, so use it wisely!

abilities.name: Epic Shout
abilities.description: Roar to empower allies within earshot, granting them temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.
abilities.apReason: Level 19 and epic-tier abilities are dramatic but hard-limited, requiring significant cost.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at epic tier allows it to be a defining moment in combat encounters.

rules.duration: Until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: All allies within range gain temporary hit points equal to half your proficiency bonus (rounded down) + your Charisma modifier.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again until you complete a long rest.

abilities.warioNote: For WARIO, this is like selling the last of your gold doubloons - it’s a big moment!

abilities.name: Epic Command
abilities.description: Shout a command that grants temporary hit points to allies within hearing range.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a significant leadership boost at a high cost, justifying the full AP for its dramatic effect.
abilities.levelReason: Leadership culminates in a moment of supreme authority and influence at the highest levels.

rules.effect: All allies within range gain 2d8 temporary hit points. The effect ends if the leader is reduced to 0 HP.
rules.drawback: The leader must declare their command before using this ability, and it cannot be repeated in a single encounter.

abilities.warioNote: Listen here, you wanna-be kings! This one's gonna make your followers feel like they're invincible... or you'll be using it as a crutch!

abilities.name: Toad's Vortex
abilities.description: Summon a whirlpool of toads that grapple and damage all enemies within its radius.
abilities.apReason: This epic-level ability requires significant coordination and risk, justifying its high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: The epic moment for the Commoner to unleash a devastating ability.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: Create a whirlpool that grapples all creatures within its area. Each grappled creature takes 15d6 bludgeoning damage and is restrained until it escapes or is freed by another creature. The effect ends when you take a movement action.
rules.drawback: You must be able to see the area to use this ability effectively.

abilities.warioNote: These little fellas pack a punch! But you gotta be quick or they’ll all be on you!

abilities.name: Shields Unite
abilities.description: All allies within 5 feet gain +1 AC until the start of your next turn.
abilities.apReason: Level 11, strong per-rest play ability that offers meaningful support and has a clear drawback.
abilities.levelReason: Allows a single militia to bolster their team's defenses in critical moments, making it impactful and necessary at level 11.

rules.duration: Until the start of your next turn
rules.uses: Once per short or long rest
rules.effect: All allies within range gain +1 AC. Ends when the effect ends.
rules.drawback: You must be the one to take the brunt of an attack to trigger this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Yeah... 'Shields Unite'? Sounds like a no-brainer! But hey, you gotta pay for the training, right? $400!

abilities.name: Gear Shield
abilities.description: Temporarily increase your AC by 2 until you take a hit.
abilities.apReason: Provides moderate combat utility at a reasonable cost for mid-tier level use.
abilities.levelReason: Enhances combat utility for Artisans in critical moments of battle.

rules.duration: until you take damage or end your next turn
rules.effect: You gain a +2 bonus to AC until you take damage or end your next turn. This effect ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used after taking damage this round.

abilities.warioNote: These shields aren't free, but they're worth the investment when you're in the thick of things!

abilities.name: Shadowstep Slash
abilities.description: Teleport behind an enemy and deliver a deadly slash, dealing bonus damage.
abilities.apReason: Requires a reaction for defense and deals moderate damage with a save effect.
abilities.levelReason: Requires mid-tier combat control and a reliable edge in close-quarters combat.

rules.effect: You teleport behind an enemy and make a melee attack. On a hit, you deal 1d8 + DEX modifier slashing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 15 DEX saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You leave yourself open to attacks of opportunity during the teleport.

abilities.warioNote: Watch your back, Rogues! Shadowstep Slash might be quick, but you’ll still get hit if you’re not careful!

abilities.name: Shove Shield
abilities.description: Push an opponent back with a well-timed shield bash, knocking them prone.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge at level 2 that allows a reaction-based combat maneuver.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters gain the ability to leverage their shields in combat at level 2.

rules.effect: Make a Strength check against the target's Strength saving throw (DC 8 + proficiency + Strength modifier). On success, the target is knocked prone. The effect ends if you move more than 5 feet away from the target.
rules.drawback: You must be holding your shield in both hands.

abilities.warioNote: For just one AP, you can send them sprawling! What could be better?

abilities.name: Twin Barrage
abilities.description: Fire two bullets in rapid succession, dealing extra damage to a single target.
abilities.apReason: Requires precision and timing, making it a moderate mid-tier combat utility that costs two AP.
abilities.levelReason: Gains the ability to unleash powerful dual shots at mid-tier effectiveness.

rules.effect: You fire two bullets at a single target. The second shot deals an additional 2d6 damage on a hit.
rules.drawback: Cannot attack the same target twice with this ability in one combat encounter.

abilities.warioNote: Ya gotta aim real good to pull off this trick shot, but it's worth the extra buck!

abilities.name: Commanding Elevation
abilities.description: Inspire allies to reach new heights, granting them advantage on attack rolls within a 30-foot radius.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic ability requires significant resources and has a clear, hard-limited cost.
abilities.levelReason: Only the most seasoned leaders can command such a dramatic and powerful effect.

rules.uses: Once per short or long rest
rules.effect: All allies within range gain advantage on attack rolls. Ends if you drop to 0 hit points.
rules.drawback: You must spend a reaction to end the effect early.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it’s powerful... but did you know it also leaves you wide open for an attack?

abilities.name: Epic Fumble
abilities.description: You perform a spectacularly clumsy feat, knocking over allies and enemies within reach for dramatic effect.
abilities.apReason: Requires a dramatic moment that can shift an encounter, justifying its high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Only at epic tier can you pull off such an audacious yet risky move.

rules.effect: All creatures within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone. You also are knocked prone if you fail your save.
rules.drawback: You and all allies within 5 feet have disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws until the start of your next turn.

abilities.warioNote: Ya gotta be crazy to buy this! Watch ya step!

abilities.name: Wallform
abilities.description: You can merge with allies to form a temporary, impenetrable wall of bodies.
abilities.apReason: The powerful effect of creating an impenetrable wall requires a significant investment of Ability Points for its high-tier level.
abilities.levelReason: Forming a protective wall is a powerful leadership move for experienced militia members.

rules.effect: You and up to three allies become one mass of interlocking bodies. You gain a +2 bonus to AC, but movement is halved until the end of your next turn.
rules.drawback: While in Wallform, you cannot attack or cast spells.

abilities.warioNote: Man, this is one tough shield wall! You’ll need to save some cash for the recovery time!

abilities.name: Divine Reckoning
abilities.description: Call down a wave of holy light that damages all evil creatures within range.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a powerful combat option at a high tier level and costs an appropriate amount of AP for its potency.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, Paladins can deliver a powerful, area-based attack against enemies.

rules.effect: Each evil creature within range takes 8d6 radiant damage. Save DC 15 + Cha modifier. On a successful save, the creature is reduced to half health instead.
rules.drawback: Cannot target neutral or good-aligned creatures.

abilities.warioNote: Hey, it's not cheap to train you to unleash the wrath of the heavens! Just sayin'.

abilities.name: Shadowstep Blade
abilities.description: Deal an extra 1d6 + DEX modifier slashing damage on your first attack of the turn.
abilities.apReason: Level 11 ability that provides a strong combat buff, justifying the higher AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Unleashes a powerful burst that enhances combat prowess significantly.

rules.effect: When you make your first attack with a slashing weapon on your action, deal an extra 1d6 + DEX modifier damage. This effect ends when you miss or use another action.
rules.drawback: You can only activate this ability once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Need to slice through the competition? This one's for you, but it’s no free ride!

abilities.name: Ragestorm
abilities.description: Call forth a tempest of primal fury, dealing massive damage to enemies within reach.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a dramatic and limited one-time use in epic encounters, justifying its high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, the Barbarian can unleash a devastating final strike in epic battles.

rules.effect: You deal 3d12 + Strength modifier force damage to all creatures within 5 feet. After this ability is used, you are incapacitated until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You are incapacitated for one full turn after using this ability.

abilities.warioNote: For those times when you need to make a grandstand finish—only once per session! Priceless!

abilities.name: Arcane Gale
abilities.description: Summon a gust of wind to push aside enemies, dealing force damage to those it strikes.
abilities.apReason: Level 12 and a powerful burst control effect justifies a 3 AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: A strong per-rest play that offers burst control and utility in combat.

rules.effect: DC 14 + Int modifier (Constitution save); On a failed save, target is pushed 5 feet and takes 8d6 force damage. Effect ends when the target exits the gust's area.
rules.drawback: You must be within 30 feet of at least one creature to use this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Feel the gust of wind, but pay the price in AP! It's like being hit by a tornado... for less!

abilities.name: Shattering Slash
abilities.description: Deal an extra d10 slashing damage on your melee hit, destroying any weapon or shield of equivalent or lesser quality.
abilities.apReason: A reliable combat edge at level 3, this ability provides a significant tactical advantage with a small cost.
abilities.levelReason: At level 3, fighters gain the reliability to shatter their opponent's defenses with each strike.

rules.effect: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, the target must succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or lose one piece of equipment. If they fail by 5 or more, it is destroyed.
rules.drawback: You have disadvantage on your next attack roll.

abilities.warioNote: For just one AP? You get to break their gear! What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Bullet Shield
abilities.description: Create a shield of bullets to block one attack, dealing damage equal to your Dexterity modifier + proficiency bonus.
abilities.apReason: Provides moderate protection and counterattack, making it a significant mid-tier ability.
abilities.levelReason: Gains the ability to counter an enemy's attack with a defensive maneuver at mid-tier power.

rules.effect: When you activate this, you create a shield of bullets that blocks the next attack against you. The attacker takes damage equal to your Dexterity modifier + proficiency bonus.
rules.drawback: You can only use Bullet Shield once per combat.

abilities.warioNote: It’s like getting your own personal bullet storm shield! Watch the price tag though—two APs for the best defense money can buy!

abilities.name: Ink Hide
abilities.description: Spray ink to obscure yourself, granting temporary blindness to nearby foes.
abilities.apReason: Provides a moderate combat disruption for two AP, fitting its mid-tier level.
abilities.levelReason: Allows the Spy to disrupt combat with a strategic distraction.

rules.effect: Each creature within 5 feet of the Spy must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the start of its next turn. The effect ends when the Spy moves more than 5 feet away from the target.
rules.drawback: The Spy must remain stationary and cannot move closer to a creature affected by this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Here's some ink you can spray in your face! Oh wait, that's yours!

abilities.name: Rallying Shout
abilities.description: Boost allies within 30 feet with a commanding voice, granting advantage on next attack roll.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge that can turn an encounter around with a single use.
abilities.levelReason: Leadership abilities become more impactful as the party grows stronger and faces greater challenges.

rules.duration: until end of next turn for each ally within range
rules.effect: Each ally within range has advantage on their next attack roll. Ends if the ally takes a major action.
rules.drawback: Must shout, risking disadvantage on the first attack roll.

abilities.warioNote: For Wario, it's just shouting... but for you, it’s a game changer!

abilities.name: Frosted Maw
abilities.description: In one turn, you unleash a freezing bite that deals cold damage to all creatures within reach.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic move requires the utmost focus and preparation to execute effectively.
abilities.levelReason: Only the most seasoned commoners can harness their inner frost in such a dramatic way.
