rules.effect: You deal 1d6 cold damage to all creatures within 5 feet of you. They must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take half the damage as non-magical frostbite.
rules.drawback: You risk freezing your own limbs if overused; after using this ability, you have disadvantage on Strength checks and saving throws until your next long rest.

abilities.warioNote: Toad’s got frostbite? Sell me some training! Watch out, it’ll freeze you solid!

abilities.name: Forge Gale
abilities.description: Create a gust of scorching air to push back foes, dealing fire damage to all creatures within its radius.
abilities.apReason: Forge Gale is a high-tier combat utility that provides burst damage and control at the cost of a full AP.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans at level 9 gain the tools needed to manipulate forge magic and create powerful effects like Forge Gale.

rules.effect: All creatures within the cylinder take 4d6 fire damage. A creature can make a DC 13 DEX save to halve the damage and be pushed 10 feet away from you.
rules.drawback: You must spend 5 minutes after using this ability to cool down your forge tools, otherwise they become unusable for 24 hours.

abilities.warioNote: It's like having a little volcano in your hands... for $120!

abilities.name: Radiant Shield Wall
abilities.description: Create a wall of light to shield allies within 10 feet for 2d8+CHA modifier radiant damage on entry.
abilities.apReason: Creating a powerful protective barrier that lasts for an entire turn at level 13 justifies its high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 13 allows a Paladin to provide dramatic protection in critical situations.

rules.duration: Until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: All allies within 10 feet gain a +2 bonus to AC and take no damage from radiant attacks on entry until the end of your next turn. Ends if you move more than 5 feet or lose concentration.
rules.drawback: You must use your Action to maintain it, and you cannot concentrate on another effect requiring concentration.

abilities.warioNote: For those looking to stay alive, this shield wall is unbeatable! Just don't expect to do much else in the meantime.

abilities.name: Ethereal Blade
abilities.description: Summon an ethereal blade to strike at enemies, dealing piercing damage on a hit.
abilities.apReason: This ability offers a one-time dramatic combat moment, fitting for its epic level tier.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, Rogues can unleash their greatest combat potential with devastating strikes.

rules.effect: You summon an ethereal blade that deals 2d6 + DEX modifier piercing damage on a successful hit. The effect ends if you lose concentration (as if failing a saving throw), are incapacitated, or dismiss it with a bonus action.
rules.drawback: While active, you cannot wield physical weapons.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, kid! Want to turn your blade into an ethereal ghost? For 4 AP, of course!

abilities.name: Feral Tempest
abilities.description: Roar to summon a primal tempest that deals massive damage within a 30-foot radius and knocks enemies prone.
abilities.apReason: Unleashing such a powerful and devastating attack requires significant focus, making it a costly 4 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians at epic level can unleash devastating attacks that reshape battles.

rules.effect: Each creature within the area must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and take 4d6+CON modifier thunder damage. The effect ends if a creature moves more than 5 feet away from the center of the tempest.
rules.drawback: The barbarian risks exhaustion on a failed save.

abilities.warioNote: Oh man, this one’s a doozy! Feral Tempest? Pricey, but if you’ve got the juice... it just might save your hide.

abilities.name: Arcane Catastrophe
abilities.description: Summon a wave of arcane energy to obliterate all enemies within range, dealing 4d8 force damage.
abilities.apReason: This ability requires a significant toll on the wizard's resources and potential to cause catastrophic damage.
abilities.levelReason: Unleashes an epic burst of destructive power against multiple foes.

rules.effect: All enemies within a 20-foot radius must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they take 4d8 force damage.
rules.drawback: You risk overloading your spellbook with this spell; you can't cast another Arcane Catastrophe for 24 hours.

abilities.warioNote: Oh, it’s a big boom, alright! But be careful; you might need to rest for days afterward!

abilities.name: Chain Slash
abilities.description: Deal an additional slashing damage equal to your proficiency bonus on all melee attacks.
abilities.apReason: A small but reliable combat edge at this tier level.
abilities.levelReason: A reliable combat edge at this tier, enhancing melee attacks without requiring a special activation.

rules.effect: When you make a melee attack with a weapon that deals slashing damage, the target takes an additional slashing damage equal to your proficiency bonus.
rules.drawback: Does not apply if you are unarmed or using a spell attack.

abilities.warioNote: Need that extra punch? This Chain Slash does the trick, just like Mario's hammer!

abilities.name: Shell Guard
abilities.description: Create a temporary barrier of lead shot to block incoming attacks.
abilities.apReason: Provides a significant combat advantage with a moderate cost, suitable for mid-tier play.
abilities.levelReason: Gunslingers gain this ability mid-tier, allowing them to defend against ranged attacks more effectively.

rules.effect: You create a 5-foot-radius sphere of lead shot around you. When an attack roll is made against you, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage by 10 (d8). This effect ends on your next turn.
rules.drawback: The shell shield dissipates if you move more than 10 feet from its center.

abilities.warioNote: It's like having a cloud of tiny bullets ready to thwart those pesky ranged attacks!

abilities.name: Inspiring Barrier
abilities.description: Create a barrier of light to protect an ally within 30 feet, reducing damage taken by half.
abilities.apReason: Provides moderate support and a unique utility at level 5 with a cost that reflects its power.
abilities.levelReason: Leadership abilities typically unlock at level 5 as they begin to provide more substantial support.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until dismissed by the leader
rules.effect: An ally within range can reduce all damage taken by half while this effect lasts. Ends if the target moves more than 10 feet away.
rules.drawback: The barrier is visible, potentially revealing your position to enemies.

abilities.warioNote: It's like giving your buddy a shield made of light! Who needs armor when you've got this?

abilities.name: Toadstool Tyrant
abilities.description: Transform into a towering toad with crushing strength, dealing massive damage to all enemies within reach.
abilities.apReason: This epic-level ability requires substantial effort and risk, making it a significant investment.
abilities.levelReason: Epic transformations are reserved for the most dramatic moments in an adventurer's career.

rules.effect: You transform into a toadstool tyrant, gaining +4 to AC and dealing 3d6 force damage on melee attacks. This effect ends if you take any nonlethal damage.
rules.drawback: The transformation drains your life force; you must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of your turns or be Charmed by the tyrant form.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, you can buy this training. It's not cheap... but I do have other classes that don't cost as much.

abilities.name: Shield Barricade
abilities.description: Create a barrier of interlocking shields that absorbs damage for you or an ally.
abilities.apReason: This is a high-level combat maneuver with significant risk and benefit, making it a dramatic moment per session.
abilities.levelReason: Epic level abilities allow for dramatic, one-time encounters.

rules.duration: Until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You create an interlocking barrier using your shields. The barrier has AC 20 and can take up to 15 points of damage. On your next attack or opportunity attack, you or the target creature takes an additional 5 (1d6+2) damage.
rules.drawback: You cannot move more than 5 feet while maintaining the barrier.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Want to survive that next big fight? This one-time shield wall might just save your hide!

abilities.name: Masterwork Buff
abilities.description: For one hour, you and your allies gain advantage on attack rolls with improvised weapons.
abilities.apReason: Level 10 abilities are strong per-rest plays, and this buff is impactful but not unlimited.
abilities.levelReason: A party-wide buff is most impactful at this level for sustained combat effectiveness.

rules.duration: one hour or until you finish a long rest
rules.effect: You and your allies gain advantage on attack rolls with improvised weapons. This effect ends when you finish a short rest.
rules.drawback: Only one use per day, limiting its availability in extended battles.

abilities.warioNote: Don't mind the wait—only one daily dose of power! You’ll need it for those marathon fights!

abilities.name: Judgment Stroke
abilities.description: Deal radiant damage to a foe, halving their speed for one minute.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic, once-per-session ability requires significant resource management at an epic level.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins unlock this powerful leadership ability at Epic levels.

rules.duration: until the end of the target's next turn
rules.effect: You deal 3d8 radiant damage to one creature. They must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or have their speed halved until the end of its next turn.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again until you finish a long rest.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, for those rare times when you need to drop the hammer. Pricey, but it's worth it if you can pull it off.

abilities.name: Fury's Reckoning
abilities.description: Unleash a devastating berserk charge that stuns enemies and leaves you exhausted.
abilities.apReason: This epic-tier ability requires significant resource investment to yield its dramatic effect.
abilities.levelReason: At epic tier, the Barbarian can command overwhelming force in one grand moment.

rules.effect: You charge at a creature within 30 feet, making a melee attack. On a hit, the target is stunned until the start of your next turn (DC 24 Con save). You must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious for 1 hour.
rules.drawback: You are exhausted after using this ability and cannot gain benefit from food, drink, magic, or other sources until you finish a long rest.

abilities.warioNote: You think it's just another charge? Nah, this is the charge that leaves you on the floor, Wario style!

abilities.name: Epic Arcane Tempest
abilities.description: Create a devastating storm of arcane energy that deals lightning damage to enemies within its radius.
abilities.apReason: This ability is dramatic, requiring the expenditure of significant resources for a powerful effect that can change an encounter. It's epic in both cost and impact.
abilities.levelReason: At epic tier, wizards can command the elements in ways that are truly awe-inspiring and game-changing.

rules.effect: As a reaction to being hit by an attack, the wizard can unleash a tempest. All creatures within 20 feet must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and take 5d6 lightning damage.
rules.drawback: The wizard must spend 4 AP to activate this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Well, I guess you get one free wish outta this training... as long as you’ve got the cash to back it up!

abilities.name: Shattering Slam
abilities.description: Deal an extra 1d6 damage on a successful melee attack.
abilities.apReason: Provides a moderate increase in combat effectiveness for the price of two AP at mid-tier level.
abilities.levelReason: Enhances melee combat with additional damage at mid-tier power level.

rules.effect: When you make a successful melee attack, deal an extra 1d6 force damage.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used with other damage increasing effects.

abilities.warioNote: Shattering Slam? More like shattering your opponent's bones! Just don't expect it to shatter this price.

abilities.name: Hero's Cry
abilities.description: Shout to inspire allies within earshot, granting temporary hit points and boosting their attack rolls.
abilities.apReason: Inspiring a group requires careful coordination, making it moderately costly in Ability Points.
abilities.levelReason: Leaders at this level can significantly bolster battlefield morale with a strategic call.

rules.duration: 1 minute per level of the Leader
rules.effect: All allies within range gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier + Wis modifier. They also have advantage on attack rolls until the start of their next turn.
rules.drawback: You must be able to speak and hear clearly to use this ability.

abilities.warioNote: For just two APs? Get your team fighting like they're on the same side! What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Epic Toad Slam
abilities.description: In one dramatic slam, deal massive damage to a single target and stagger them.
abilities.apReason: This powerful maneuver requires significant physical and mental resources to execute once per session.
abilities.levelReason: Only available at the pinnacle of the epic tier as a defining moment.

rules.effect: You slam your body into a target, dealing 1d8+5 force damage and causing the target to make a DC 24 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. The effect ends if you stop attacking.
rules.drawback: After using this ability, you cannot use it again until after completing a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: For the price of 4 AP, even a Commoner can become an epic force!

abilities.name: Fortress Aura
abilities.description: Create a wall of solidified air around yourself, granting temporary hit points equal to twice your level.
abilities.apReason: Creating a defensive masterpiece like the Fortress Aura is a dramatic moment that can shift an encounter, justifying a high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: At epic levels, the militia can create defensive masterpieces that change one encounter beat.

rules.duration: Until the start of your next turn after activation
rules.effect: You gain temporary hit points equal to twice your level. This effect ends when you take damage.
rules.drawback: While active, you move at half speed.

abilities.warioNote: You think it's easy to make a shield out of air? Try not to trip over your own feet!

abilities.name: Toolmaster's Fury
abilities.description: As a bonus action, you can empower your tools to unleash a devastating strike against one enemy.
abilities.apReason: This high-tier combat ability provides a strong burst effect with a significant drawback.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking powerful burst combat abilities at mid-level.

rules.effect: You make a melee weapon attack against one creature within reach. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 + Intelligence modifier damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you are not holding an artisan tool.

abilities.warioNote: These tools? They're more than just toys! For only 3 AP, you can turn your little gadgets into a big threat!

abilities.name: Divine Wrath
abilities.description: Call down a torrent of holy energy that deals massive radiant damage to all enemies within range.
abilities.apReason: Requires a significant sacrifice to use this powerful attack at such an advanced level, making it impactful yet balanced.
abilities.levelReason: Unleashes a dramatic and powerful attack at the epic tier, providing a defining moment per session.

rules.effect: All creatures within 15 feet take 8d8 + Cha modifier radiant damage. Targets can make a DC 16 + Cha modifier + Proficiency saving throw. On a success, they reduce the damage by half and are not affected again for 24 hours.
rules.drawback: The Paladin must fast-forward through their next short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! This one's a real doozy. Fast-forward your next rest? Worth every AP!

abilities.name: Shadowsplit Leap
abilities.description: Leap through shadows, dealing damage to enemies and leaving behind a lingering darkness.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic ability requires significant preparation and risk to master, justifying the higher AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, the rogue can masterfully manipulate shadows for devastating effect.

rules.effect: You leap through a shadowy space to attack an enemy within 5 feet. You deal 1d6 + DEX modifier force damage and leave behind a lingering darkness that lasts for 1 minute. The darkness grants you advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made in the area until your next short or long rest.
rules.drawback: You must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d6 force damage if you fail.

abilities.warioNote: You want to fly? Buy wings! You want to leap through shadows? Pay extra for the special effect!

abilities.name: Feral Cataclysm
abilities.description: Unleash a primal storm of fury that devastates enemies and shatters their defenses.
abilities.apReason: This epic-level ability requires significant resources, both in terms of power and a barbarian's rage.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 18 provides the epic power to turn the tide in battle with one final, dramatic display.

rules.effect: All creatures within a 10-foot radius must make a DC 24 Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are knocked prone and take 3d12 + Strength modifier thunder damage. The effect ends if you use any action other than your reaction.
rules.drawback: You must be raging to use this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, it’s powerful. But did you really think I’d let you keep your precious rage? It’s only temporary!

abilities.name: Chain Bash
abilities.description: Trip an opponent and bash them with your shield for bludgeoning damage.
abilities.apReason: Requires tactical thinking and a reaction to use effectively; introduces new combat mechanics.
abilities.levelReason: Bash abilities are powerful, this one introduces a new mechanic of tripping opponents.

rules.effect: You make an attack against the target. On a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and take 1d8 + Strength modifier bludgeoning damage.
rules.drawback: While prone, you have disadvantage on attack rolls.

abilities.warioNote: For those times when you need to say 'ouch' really loud!

abilities.name: Bullet Scatter
abilities.description: You can scatter bullets, forcing enemies within a cone to make saving throws or take fire damage.
abilities.apReason: Provides a moderate area-of-effect combat advantage, requiring a save, making it impactful at level 8.
abilities.levelReason: Changes one encounter beat by providing significant area-of-effect damage and control.

rules.effect: Each creature within a 30-foot cone must make a DC (8 + Proficiency + Dexterity modifier) Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 fire damage and be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again until after a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Forgetting to reload? No worries! With Bullet Scatter, you can scatter bullets and watch them ricochet all over the battlefield. Just don't forget your ammo!

abilities.name: Inspire Valor
abilities.description: Boost allies' attack rolls by +1d6 for an hour.
abilities.apReason: Provides significant support and boosts, unlocking as mid-tier ability.
abilities.levelReason: Leaders inspire their allies to greater heights, making this ability unlock at mid-tier.

rules.effect: Allies within 30 feet of you gain a +1d6 bonus to attack rolls. This effect ends if an ally moves more than 30 feet away.
rules.drawback: You must be the target of a successful saving throw against fear or charm effects once per day.

abilities.warioNote: Buy this and watch your allies shine brighter in battle!

abilities.name: Toad's Might
abilities.description: Gain +4 to Strength and Constitution for 1 hour, but you must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the start of each short rest.
abilities.apReason: This is an epic-level ability requiring significant resources to fully realize its potential.
abilities.levelReason: Only epic-level characters can afford the monumental effort required to unlock their full potential.

rules.duration: 1 hour, ends on a short rest
rules.effect: Effect: +4 to Strength and Constitution; Save DC = 8 + proficiency + Constitution modifier. Drawback: Must make a DC 15 Con saving throw at start of each short rest.
rules.drawback: Frequent saves are required, increasing the risk of exhaustion.

abilities.warioNote: Yeah right... If you think this puny training can give you real toad strength, you're even dumber than I am!

abilities.name: Foe Devastator
abilities.description: Unleash a devastating strike that reduces all nearby enemies to rubble, dealing massive damage.
abilities.apReason: This epic-level ability requires significant resources to use effectively in a single moment of combat.
abilities.levelReason: Only usable by seasoned Militias who have proven their worth through countless battles.

rules.effect: You make a powerful strike, dealing 12d8 + Strength modifier slashing damage to all creatures within 5 feet. Creatures must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and take an additional 6d8 bludgeoning damage.
rules.drawback: After using this ability, you are exhausted until you complete a long rest.

abilities.warioNote: Oh, you think that little shield bash is gonna stop me? Try this! *Laughs maniacally*

abilities.name: Forge Storm
abilities.description: Summons a torrent of molten metal to crush foes, dealing 2d8 fire damage to all creatures within reach.
abilities.apReason: Requires high-level control and substantial risk of failure to unleash such destructive power.
abilities.levelReason: Requires substantial control and Artisan expertise to command such destructive power.

rules.effect: Creatures within 10 feet must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 2d8 fire damage. On a successful save, they are knocked prone.
rules.drawback: The Artisan risks overheating tools and causing accidental fires if the Forge Storm is not properly contained.

abilities.warioNote: And who's gonna clean up the mess after your little 'Forge Storm'? You or me?

abilities.name: Divine Vortex
abilities.description: Summon a swirling vortex of divine energy that pulls enemies towards you, dealing holy damage on contact.
abilities.apReason: This epic ability requires a significant cost to reflect its dramatic impact on an encounter.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, a Paladin can unleash a powerful, iconic ability that reshapes an encounter.

rules.effect: Create a 15-foot radius circle centered on you. Each creature in the area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be pulled into the center of the vortex, taking 2d6 + CHA modifier holy damage and being restrained until the effect ends.
rules.drawback: You cannot move or cast spells while the Divine Vortex is active.

abilities.warioNote: It’s like buying a hurricane in a can, but it only works once a day. And you still have to clean up the mess.

abilities.name: Feral Dominance
abilities.description: Harness the fury of the beast to gain advantage on attack rolls against creatures within 30 feet for 1 minute.
abilities.apReason: Dramatic and limited to one big moment per session, this ability requires significant resources.
abilities.levelReason: Unleashes a dramatic shift in power at the pinnacle of the Barbarian's career.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you attack a creature outside this effect's range
rules.effect: You gain advantage on attack rolls against creatures within 30 feet. This ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: While under the effect, you cannot use any Charisma-based abilities.

abilities.warioNote: Fool! This isn't just training; it's a wild ride! You’ll need every AP you got!

abilities.name: Eldritch Cataclysm
abilities.description: Summon a wave of devastating energy that deals 6d8 force damage to all creatures within 30 feet, and they must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.
abilities.apReason: This epic-level spell requires significant mental and magical energy; thus, it costs 4 Ability Points.
abilities.levelReason: Only the most powerful wizards can channel such immense destructive energy effectively at this level.

rules.effect: Creatures within 30 feet make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or are knocked prone. On a failed save, they also take 6d8 force damage.
rules.drawback: After using this ability, you must spend 4 hours in meditation to recover its use.

abilities.warioNote: You think I’m sellin’ short? Just try summonin' a cataclysm like this one!

abilities.name: Crush Flank
abilities.description: Deal extra damage when attacking a target with a flank or behind an ally.
abilities.apReason: Provides moderate combat enhancement but requires careful coordination and limited use.
abilities.levelReason: Provides a significant combat edge in coordinated attacks at this level.

rules.effect: When you hit a target with an attack and have advantage on the attack roll due to having a flank or being behind an ally, deal an extra 2d6 damage.
rules.drawback: You cannot use Crush Flank more than once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: For just a couple Ability Points, turn your allies into living battering rams! Or at least make the bad guys wish they were...

abilities.name: Smoke Screen
abilities.description: Erupts in a cloud of smoke, granting temporary cover for allies within.
abilities.apReason: Provides significant support and stealth advantage at this level, justifying its high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Gunslingers master the battlefield, requiring strong support abilities at this tier.

rules.duration: Until the start of your next turn
rules.uses: Once per short or long rest
rules.effect: Creatures within the area have advantage on Dexterity saving throws and can use their reactions to move up to half their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
rules.drawback: You must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw; failure reveals your position until the effect ends.

abilities.warioNote: It's like selling you an invisibility cloud... for a dime. But it still leaves a scent!

abilities.name: Shroud Glide
abilities.description: Emerge from shadows to surprise enemies, granting you advantage on attack rolls until your next turn.
abilities.apReason: Changes one encounter beat and provides a significant advantage in combat, justifying the mid-tier cost.
abilities.levelReason: Spies gain the ability to exploit the element of surprise effectively at this level.

rules.effect: You can use a bonus action to end your movement within 5 feet and emerge from shadowy cover, granting you advantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn. The effect ends if you move more than 10 feet or are hit by an attack.
rules.drawback: You must remain still for at least one round after using this ability before attempting to use it again.

abilities.warioNote: Watch out! This one’s a sneaky little critter that’ll make your enemies squirm!

abilities.name: Elevating Command
abilities.description: Lead from the front with a rallying cry, boosting allies' attack rolls by +1d6 until they strike.
abilities.apReason: Provides a significant combat boost at a moderate cost, fitting for level 8.
abilities.levelReason: Elevates team performance in critical combat moments.

rules.duration: until the start of your next turn after an ally strikes
rules.effect: Allies within range have advantage on attack rolls until they strike. Ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: You must be seen or heard by allies to activate.

abilities.warioNote: It’s like giving your team a second wind—now if only they didn’t need that extra rest...

abilities.name: Sign Language
abilities.description: Use hand gestures to communicate secret messages, granting advantage on Insight checks to decipher them.
abilities.apReason: Provides a reliable edge in social situations for a small cost.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners learn basic sign language as a form of non-verbal communication.

rules.effect: When you use this ability, you gain advantage on Insight checks to understand or deceive others using sign language. This effect ends when you no longer have line of sight to the target.
rules.drawback: Must be within line of sight and cannot communicate complex information without misinterpretation.

abilities.warioNote: Just sign ‘buy’手势，Wario wouldn’t sell it!

abilities.name: Defensive Stand
abilities.description: Gain a +4 bonus to AC until you take damage. Once per short rest, you can halve the amount of damage taken.
abilities.apReason: This epic defensive maneuver requires significant resources and focus to maintain.
abilities.levelReason: Epic defensive prowess at the pinnacle of one's career.

rules.duration: Until you take damage, once per short rest
rules.effect: You gain a +4 bonus to AC until you take damage. As a bonus action on your turn, you can halve the amount of damage taken from one attack or damage source this round (rounded down). If you are reduced to 0 hit points, the effect ends immediately.
rules.drawback: If you fail a saving throw against an area-effect attack while this ability is active, it ends immediately.

abilities.warioNote: You think this little shield training is gonna save ya? It’s like trying to stop a freight train with a popsicle!

abilities.name: Divine Judgement
abilities.description: Call down a divine storm upon your foes, dealing massive radiant damage to all enemies within range.
abilities.apReason: This ability is reserved for one dramatic moment per session, offering a significant, potentially game-changing effect.
abilities.levelReason: Unleashes an epic moment of pure divine power at the pinnacle of a Paladin's career.

rules.effect: All creatures within 15 feet take 8d6 radiant damage. DC 18 + Proficiency + Wisdom modifier. Saving throw halves the damage, ends the effect.
rules.drawback: Requires a paladin to be at least 20th level and only usable once per day.

abilities.warioNote: Sell this training? Sure, but you might as well sell your soul to the dark side first!

abilities.name: Fury Rush
abilities.description: On your move, you can make a melee attack with advantage. If it hits, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Strength modifier.
abilities.apReason: Fury Rush provides a small but significant combat edge at level 3, making it cost exactly one AP.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocks as a reliable combat edge at level 3.

rules.effect: On a successful hit, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Strength modifier. This ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again until after a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: This charge is no joke! It's like getting a little extra oomph for your moves!

abilities.name: Rending Thrust
abilities.description: Deal an extra 1d6 slashing damage on a critical hit.
abilities.apReason: Provides a moderate boost to combat effectiveness by enhancing critical hits, justifying a mid-tier AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Enhances the fighter's ability to exploit critical hits at this level of combat expertise.

rules.effect: On a critical hit, deal an extra 1d6 slashing damage. Ends when the fighter's turn ends.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if the fighter has already acted this round.

abilities.warioNote: This one's a real winner! Deal extra damage on crits? You better believe it's worth the AP!

abilities.name: Inspiring Roar
abilities.description: Roar to bolster allies within earshot, granting them temporary hit points and advantage on saving throws.
abilities.apReason: Provides a strong per-rest play with broad utility for the party at level 9.
abilities.levelReason: Provides a strong per-rest buff for the party at level 9.

rules.effect: All allies within range gain 2d8 temporary hit points and advantage on saving throws until the end of their next turn.
rules.drawback: The leader must be able to see all targets and have line of effect.

abilities.warioNote: It’s like buying an extra turn for your team! Or at least, it feels that way!

abilities.name: Frothy Fountain
abilities.description: Splash an enemy with a geyser of mud, dealing bludgeoning damage and knocking them prone.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge at level 3 with low AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners begin to gain combat prowess at level 3.

rules.effect: Make a melee attack against an enemy within range. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone.
rules.drawback: The Commoner must be in close combat to use this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Frothy Fountain? Priceless! Just a quick splash, and you've got 'em down for the count!

abilities.name: Sentinel Stand
abilities.description: You become an impenetrable wall, granting temporary hit points to allies within reach and drawing attacks toward yourself.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a dramatic defensive boost, drawing attacks away from allies at the cost of mobility and offensive capabilities.
abilities.levelReason: Only the most seasoned militia can shoulder the burden of becoming a living fortress.

rules.effect: You gain 4d12 temporary hit points. Until the start of your next turn, any creature that hits you with an attack must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or take 6d6 force damage. If you drop to 0 hit points while this effect is active, it ends immediately.
rules.drawback: While in Sentinel Stand, you can't move more than 5 feet and you have disadvantage on attack rolls.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it’s a big ol' wall, but what do you expect for just 4 AP? You could buy a shield too!

abilities.name: Shade Misdirection
abilities.description: Deceive foes by merging with shadows, causing them to target your decoy instead of you.
abilities.apReason: This dramatic ability requires significant preparation and precision, fitting its epic tier cost.
abilities.levelReason: Rogues master the art of misdirection at their peak, creating a dramatic final flourish.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You and a willing creature you can see within touch distance both gain advantage on attack rolls against all creatures that have seen either of you until the end of your next turn. A successful DC 18 Wisdom saving throw ends this effect for you.
rules.drawback: Your decoy is a prone, animated shadow that moves at half speed and cannot take actions.

abilities.warioNote: Man, this one’s a real showstopper! Watch the tables drop their jaws as you vanish into the night!

abilities.name: Epic Arcane Conduit
abilities.description: Harness the cosmos to unleash a devastating burst of pure arcane energy.
abilities.apReason: This epic-level ability demands significant magical resources, making it a rare and potent resource.
abilities.levelReason: Unleashes a dramatic, one-time display of unparalleled magical power.

rules.effect: You unleash a wave of raw arcane energy in a 30-foot radius centered on yourself, dealing 12d6 force damage to all creatures within the area. Creatures must succeed on a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and blinded until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You are exhausted for 24 hours after using this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, this one’s a real money-maker. Watch your wallet!

abilities.name: Steel Surge
abilities.description: Deal massive damage and grant temporary hit points to all allies within reach.
abilities.apReason: Provides significant combat burst and support at high levels; justifies the cost in Ability Points.
abilities.levelReason: Provides a burst of power for the party, unlocking as fighters gain more combat prowess.

rules.effect: Deal 2d6 + Strength modifier damage to all creatures within range. Allies within the area gain +2 temporary hit points per level of the Fighter until the end of their next turn.
rules.drawback: The user must be able to wield a heavy weapon, and they take an additional 1d6 bludgeoning damage on activation.

abilities.warioNote: It’s like getting a mini-army of steel-tipped warriors! But don’t expect it to be cheap, Wario’s charging extra for this one.

abilities.name: Serrated Shrapnel
abilities.description: Deal piercing damage to all creatures within a 10-foot radius, but take half damage from piercing weapons.
abilities.apReason: This is a powerful burst combat ability, fitting for level 10.
abilities.levelReason: Gunslingers need a reliable burst attack at this tier.

rules.effect: You create a burst of shrapnel dealing 3d8 + DEX modifier piercing damage to all creatures within the area. They must make a DC (8 + Proficiency + Wisdom) Dexterity saving throw or take half the damage.
rules.drawback: Your next attack with a firearm has disadvantage until your next short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Ya gotta admit, this one packs quite the punch! But ya better reload quick after that!

abilities.name: Silent Step
abilities.description: You move silently, leaving no sound behind as you glide past foes.
abilities.apReason: Requires a moderate action and provides significant stealth benefit for an encounter beat.
abilities.levelReason: Enhances your movement to allow silent passage in combat.

rules.effect: You gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Until the end of your next turn, you leave no sound when moving at normal speed.
rules.drawback: While using Silent Step, you can't attack or cast spells.

abilities.warioNote: It's like walking on air... except quieter! Pricey, but worth it if you don’t want to alert the whole dungeon.

abilities.name: Slick Sneeze
abilities.description: Disrupt enemy attacks with a sneeze, knocking them off balance.
abilities.apReason: Level 4 provides a reliable combat edge with one AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners gain this ability at level 4 to provide reliable edge in combat.

rules.effect: When you are hit by an attack, as a reaction you can cause the attacker to make a DC 8 + Proficiency modifier + Dexterity modifier Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they are knocked prone until their next action.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability more than once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: For just a penny, you can make an attacker fall flat on their face! What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Frost Barrage
abilities.description: Deal piercing cold damage and impose a movement speed penalty to enemies within range.
abilities.apReason: This epic-level ability provides a dramatic, single-use combat option with a clear drawback.
abilities.levelReason: Militia's epic abilities provide dramatic impacts in key moments.

rules.effect: Deal 4d8 piercing cold damage to all enemies in a 10-foot line. They must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be reduced to half speed until the start of their next turn.
rules.drawback: The Militia cannot move more than 5 feet on its turn while using this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it's cold out there, but for just four AP? It's worth the frostbite!

abilities.name: Masterpiece Finish
abilities.description: On your final strike, you can reroll damage dice once and take the better result.
abilities.apReason: Requires a significant bonus action to execute, offering powerful results but limited utility in combat.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocks at epic levels to allow a dramatic finishing blow in a crucial moment.

rules.effect: When you make your final strike in combat, you can reroll 1d6 of damage and take the better result. This effect ends when you attack again.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability more than once per battle.

abilities.warioNote: It's like hitting the nail so hard it glitters! *But only once!*

abilities.name: Divine Devastation
abilities.description: Summon a wave of divine energy that deals radiant damage to enemies within 30 feet.
abilities.apReason: This ability is an all-out, once-per-session, dramatic finisher that requires significant resources and recovery time.
abilities.levelReason: Only an epic Paladin can unleash the full power of divine annihilation in one decisive moment.

rules.effect: Each enemy within 30 feet must make a DC 19 + Cha modifier + Proficiency saving throw or take 5d8 radiant damage. The effect ends if the Paladin moves more than 30 feet away.
rules.drawback: The Paladin must complete a short rest to recover from this ability's full power.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, you want the big boomstick? It’s $250 in AP! But hey, it’s worth it for that one epic moment!

abilities.name: Shroud Slide
abilities.description: Slide through enemy reach, leaving a cloud of disorienting smoke behind.
abilities.apReason: Requires precision and timing, but does not consume the Rogue's primary resource (action points).
abilities.levelReason: Allows Rogues to bypass reach and create an obstacle for foes at mid-level play.

rules.effect: You slide through the reach of one creature within 5 feet, creating a cloud of disorienting smoke (DC 10 + Dex modifier). On your next turn, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks until the end of your next short rest. The smoke lasts for 1 hour or until destroyed by wind or fire.
rules.drawback: You leave behind a lingering cloud that can be used to obscure vision and hinder movement.

abilities.warioNote: It’s like sliding into second base... with a cloud of confusion!

abilities.name: Epic Spellweave
abilities.description: Weave an epic spell that reshapes reality, altering a creature's form or environment for a moment.
abilities.apReason: This epic ability requires a dramatic and costly resource, fitting for its level in the epic tier.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, wizards can manipulate the very fabric of magic to create truly dramatic effects.

rules.effect: Choose one creature within range. The target's form or environment shifts as you cast a spell of 5th level or lower, affecting their shape, armor class, or environment for 1 minute (DC 20 + proficiency + Intelligence modifier). This effect ends if the target is reduced to 0 hit points.
rules.drawback: The spell consumes one prepared spell slot of 5th level or higher.

abilities.warioNote: Ooh-la-la! This one's a real doozy! But it’ll cost ya... big time!

abilities.name: Sundering Slash
abilities.description: Deal massive slashing damage to a single foe, splitting their defense wide open.
abilities.apReason: A powerful burst attack that justifies the high AP cost for a level 11 ability.
abilities.levelReason: Requires precision and power beyond the typical fighter's reach.

rules.effect: You make a melee attack against a creature within 5 feet. On a hit, you deal an additional 2d10 slashing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: Requires a bonus action and has limited range.

abilities.warioNote: Watch your wallet! Sundering Slash is like buying a house with a single coin—powerful, but not exactly cheap!

abilities.name: Starfall Shot
abilities.description: Fire a shot that splits into three, each dealing 3d6 piercing damage to creatures within 10 feet.
abilities.apReason: Requires a dramatic moment and unique effect for an epic tier ability.
abilities.levelReason: Gains the ability to deal massive damage in one dramatic moment.

rules.effect: A single firearm shot. On a hit, it splits into three shots, each dealing 3d6 piercing damage to creatures within 10 feet of the target. The effect ends when all shots have struck or missed.
rules.drawback: Only one Starfall Shot may be fired per encounter.

abilities.warioNote: For those times you need to make a star fall from the sky... right into your target's face!

abilities.name: Shadow Sneak
abilities.description: On a successful stealth check, you and your allies within 10 feet gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks until the end of your next turn.
abilities.apReason: This is a high-tier support ability that provides significant buffs and control over stealth checks, making it a strong per-rest play at level 10.
abilities.levelReason: Allows the Spy to provide significant party-wide buffs in combat.

rules.range: self and up to 10 feet around you
rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: All allies within 10 feet gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Ends when the effect ends.
rules.drawback: You must make a successful Stealth check to activate this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Need to stay sneaky? This one's got your back... for an extra three AP. But hey, you can't be everywhere at once!

abilities.name: Inspiring Rally
abilities.description: Once per short rest, you inspire your allies to fight with renewed vigor, granting them advantage on one ability check.
abilities.apReason: Unlocking a strong per-rest play for Leaders at level 10, providing significant party-wide buffs.
abilities.levelReason: At level 10, a Leader can provide critical support that can turn the tide of battle.

rules.duration: Until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: All allies within range gain advantage on one ability check. The effect ends when you use this feature again.
rules.drawback: You must spend 2 additional AP to activate this ability during combat.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, it’s just a little rally... but you know what that means: three AP down the drain!

abilities.name: Leap Dive
abilities.description: Leapt into a dive, delivering a powerful downward strike at an opponent.
abilities.apReason: Requires precision and timing, making it a moderate mid-tier ability.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners gain the agility to leap and attack with great force.

rules.effect: Make a melee attack against an adjacent opponent. On hit, you deal 2d6+Strength modifier damage and knock the target prone.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if you are already engaged in combat.

abilities.warioNote: Sell this training? Sure! But you'll need to leap over the cash register first!

abilities.name: Shieldspear
abilities.description: Deal heavy damage while gaining temporary hit points equal to your Constitution modifier + level.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a significant combat advantage and is a defining moment for an epic defender.
abilities.levelReason: Epic defenders often become dangerous in close combat at this tier.

rules.effect: You gain temporary hit points equal to your Constitution modifier + your level. You deal an additional 2d8 damage on melee weapon attacks until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: If you take any damage during this duration, the effect ends immediately.

abilities.warioNote: Need some serious protection? This one’ll bash through shields like it’s made of paper!

abilities.name: Masterpiece Defense
abilities.description: Create an impenetrable barrier of masonry or metal, granting temporary hit points to you and your allies within a 10-foot radius.
abilities.apReason: Creating a masterful defensive structure is a dramatic moment requiring significant skill and resources.
abilities.levelReason: Requires the Artisan's extensive experience to craft such a formidable defensive structure in a single moment.

rules.range: touch (self and willing allies within 10 feet)
rules.duration: 1 minute per level of the Artisan
rules.effect: You create a barrier that provides temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus x4. Allies within range gain +2 to AC until the end of their next turn.
rules.drawback: The barrier can only be created once every 8 hours, and it requires the use of an artisan's tools.

abilities.warioNote: Why would you need this? You can just pay for better armor, right?

abilities.name: Eternal Judgment
abilities.description: Summons a wave of holy energy that devastates all undead within an area, dealing massive radiant damage to them.
abilities.apReason: This epic-tier ability represents one of the Paladin's most dramatic moments, capable of turning the tide in an encounter.
abilities.levelReason: Only a Paladin at the pinnacle of their power can unleash such a devastating divine force.

rules.effect: Each creature within a 20-foot radius must make a DC 30 Wisdom saving throw or take 7d8 + Paladin's CHA modifier radiant damage. The effect ends when all undead creatures in the area are destroyed.
rules.drawback: The Paladin must be of at least 19th level and have expended a 5th-level spell slot to cast this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, it’s powerful! But do you really want your hard-earned AP to go towards something that only a level 20 can use?

abilities.name: Shadowstep Glide
abilities.description: Teleport behind a foe, dealing piercing damage equal to your Dexterity modifier + proficiency bonus.
abilities.apReason: This high-tier ability provides a strong burst effect that changes one encounter beat, justifying its 3 AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Allows the rogue to make a dramatic impact in combat with a reliable burst effect.

rules.effect: You teleport behind the nearest foe within range, dealing 1d6 + Dexterity modifier piercing damage. The target of your attack can make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw to avoid taking any damage.
rules.drawback: You must be unseen by the target when you use this ability.

abilities.warioNote: For those who think 'Evasion Dive' is too common... How about 'Shadowstep Glide'? It's fresh, and it's expensive! Bet you can't say no!

abilities.name: Infinity Spell
abilities.description: Cast a spell of any level once per day, ignoring spell level limits.
abilities.apReason: This ability allows for an unlimited and powerful spell that is game-changing at epic levels; it justifies a high AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking the power to cast any spell at will represents an epic leap in magical prowess.

rules.effect: Casts a chosen spell of your choice. No level limit applies to this use, but you must prepare the spell normally.
rules.drawback: You can only cast one spell per day with this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there, wanna buy the power to cast any spell you want? Just one AP, and you'll have the entire spellbook! Or... you know, four AP. Your choice.

abilities.name: Mountain Shout
abilities.description: Roar so loudly it shakes the earth, granting temporary hit points to allies within 30 feet.
abilities.apReason: Requires a dramatic, once-per-session moment that can shift the encounter's outcome.
abilities.levelReason: A fighter's ultimate battle cry that can turn the tide of a great conflict.

rules.effect: All allies within range gain temporary hit points equal to 5 + your proficiency modifier. Ends if you fall unconscious.
rules.drawback: You must be able to speak and take a bonus action on your turn.

abilities.warioNote: For those times when you need to make sure everyone knows just how serious this battle is. Priceless!

abilities.name: Bullet Deluge
abilities.description: Unleash a devastating volley of bullets, forcing enemies to make a Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.
abilities.apReason: This ability requires a dramatic, one-time moment that is highly impactful, fitting for its level and the epic tier.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, the Gunslinger can deliver a final, epic display of their marksmanship and firepower.

rules.effect: All creatures in a 15-foot cone must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, or be knocked prone. The effect ends if the gunslinger moves more than 30 feet away.
rules.drawback: The Gunslinger risks overheating their firearm and causing it to misfire on their next attack roll.

abilities.warioNote: These training points? They’re worth more than a dozen of those silly 'Bullet Waltz' sessions! But hey, if you’ve got the gold...

abilities.name: Roaring Resolve
abilities.description: Shout a rallying cry to grant allies advantage on attack rolls until they take their next action.
abilities.apReason: This strong party-wide buff effect at level 11 justifies a higher AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Leadership abilities become more impactful as the party faces tougher challenges.

rules.duration: until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: All allies within range gain advantage on attack rolls. Ends when they take their next action.
rules.drawback: You must be aware and able to speak.

abilities.warioNote: Sell this training? For the price of 3 AP? You’re joking, right? It’s like getting a free boost for your friends!

abilities.name: Frog Leap Dive
abilities.description: Leap over enemies and crash into their backs, stunning them for a turn.
abilities.apReason: This mid-tier combat ability requires a bonus action and has a moderate effect, justifying 2 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners gain the ability to leverage their agility in combat at this stage of training.

rules.effect: DC 8 + Constitution modifier + proficiency check; on a success, you leap over an enemy and land behind it, stunning them. The stunned condition ends after your next turn.
rules.drawback: You must be within 10 feet of the target to use this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Yeah right, leap over a foe? You're practically a hero now!

abilities.name: Last Stand Banner
abilities.description: Raise a banner that grants all allies within 30 feet advantage on saving throws.
abilities.apReason: This is a once-per-session, dramatic moment ability that requires a significant cost.
abilities.levelReason: Only used in the most dramatic moments, when the militia stands its ground.

rules.duration: 1 minute, ends if all friends within range are unconscious or leave area
rules.effect: All allies within 30 feet gain advantage on saving throws. Ends if the banner is destroyed.
rules.drawback: The militia must be at least level 20 to activate this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Only for the bravest of militia! Pay up and get that last stand banner!

abilities.name: Chain Shot
abilities.description: Fire a chain of bullets that strikes up to three creatures in a line, dealing 2d6 fire damage plus your proficiency bonus.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the Gunslinger's proficiency and deals significant area damage, making it suitable for level 11.

rules.effect: Fire a single pistol shot that travels along a line, dealing 2d6 fire damage to all creatures in the line. Each creature must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You lose your Dexterity bonus to AC for this action.

abilities.apReason: Chain Shot requires careful aiming and a standard action to perform effectively.
abilities.warioNote: Lose yer defenses fer a bit! Ya might wanna think twice 'bout tryin' this one!

abilities.name: Shadowstep Ambush
abilities.description: Crouch into a hidden position and deal an initial strike to any target within 30 feet with a +2 bonus to your attack roll.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows for a potent opening strike that sets up future attacks, fitting with the rogue's focus on precision and stealth at level 10.

rules.effect: Make an attack against one creature in range. On a hit, you deal 1d8 + DEX modifier piercing damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be prone.
rules.drawback: You can only use this ability once per short rest.

abilities.apReason: The ability provides a significant combat advantage but requires a short rest to recover, balancing its power level.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there, partner! You want that sneak attack? Sure thing, just remember it'll be tough to get another one 'til you catch your breath!

abilities.name: Shadowy Misdirection
abilities.description: Confuse enemies by leaving behind a series of false trails that misdirect their pursuit.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows for strategic confusion and misdirection in combat and exploration, fitting for an advanced Spy level.

rules.effect: Choose one creature you can see within 30 feet. It must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw, or it is confused for 1 minute and takes a -2 penalty to all its attack rolls and ability checks until the end of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You leave behind a faint, visible trail that can be followed by creatures with Wisdom of at least 13.

abilities.apReason: Requires careful planning and a significant use of resources to create believable false trails.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Leave a trail if you want your enemies to follow... or maybe not. Your call!

abilities.name: Deceptive Mirage
abilities.description: Create a convincing illusion of your shadowy form that confuses and distracts enemies within 30 feet.
abilities.levelReason: This ability complements existing stealth-based skills by introducing a new layer of deception and distraction at an appropriate power level for a level 12 character.

rules.effect: Choose one creature you can see within range. It must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw, or it is confused for 1 round. During this time, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
rules.drawback: You leave behind a faint shadow that persists until the end of your next turn, giving enemies a hint of your approximate location.

abilities.apReason: Creating a convincing illusion that affects multiple creatures within the range requires significant finesse and concentration, justifying its AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! You think you're clever, sneaking around like that? Well, at least this trick lasts for a whole minute. But what happens when the shadows start to close in?

abilities.name: Spectral Escort
abilities.description: Call upon spectral allies to escort you and your allies in combat.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides extended support for combat at a reasonable cost in resources.

rules.effect: Deploy two spectral duplicates that protect you for the duration. For each duplicate hit, you and your allies within 5 feet take no damage from the next attack made against them until the end of this turn.
rules.drawback: Each spectral escort consumes 2 points of your grit.

abilities.apReason: Consumes 2 points of grit, which is a significant resource for the Gunslinger class.
abilities.warioNote: Spectra, they may be free, but your grit ain't cheap, ya hear? Two points, that's no joke!

abilities.name: Eclipse Veil
abilities.description: Transform into an ethereal shadow and cloak yourself in darkness for 1 minute.
abilities.levelReason: This ability builds on existing stealth abilities by adding teleportation and advantage checks, suitable for a level 13 Spy.

rules.effect: You gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and can move through difficult terrain as if it were normal terrain. Additionally, you can teleport up to 30 feet at the end of your turn.
rules.drawback: While under this effect, you cannot speak or cast verbal spells.

abilities.apReason: The ability provides significant utility over an extended period with teleportation and stealth advantages but requires silence as a drawback.
abilities.warioNote: Talk less, sneak more! Silence is golden... or so your enemies will think.

abilities.name: Molten Shield
abilities.description: Raise a wall of molten metal to defend you and your allies within 10 feet.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a powerful defensive option at level 15, requiring careful positioning and timing.

rules.duration: until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: Create a 5-foot-thick wall of molten metal that grants you and any creature within 10 feet temporary hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1). The wall deals 2d6 fire damage to any creature that passes through it.
rules.drawback: You cannot move more than 5 feet while the wall is active.

abilities.apReason: The ability requires careful placement and use of actions to maintain its effect.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there, buddy! Ya gotta stand still for this one. Move too much, an' ya risk burnin' yourself!

abilities.name: Shadowsplit Sabotage
abilities.description: Leap through shadows to deal slashing damage and disrupt your foe's defenses.
abilities.levelReason: This ability offers significant combat utility by disrupting enemy defenses at the cost of an action point, fitting for a level 16 rogue.

rules.effect: You leap through a shadow, dealing 2d6 slashing damage to a target within range and imposing disadvantage on their next Dexterity (Acrobatics) or Dexterity (Stealth) check.
rules.drawback: You must have expended an action point.

abilities.apReason: It requires the expenditure of an Action Point to invoke this powerful sabotage maneuver within battle.
abilities.warioNote: You spent that AP on *this*? Ya better be hitting 'em hard with it!

abilities.name: Shadow Surge
abilities.description: Leap through shadows to deliver a devastating strike from behind.
abilities.levelReason: This ability requires careful positioning, making it more powerful as you gain more stealth options like 'Silent Shadows' and 'Ethereal Shadow'.

rules.effect: When you successfully hit an enemy with an attack, you can use your reaction to teleport up to 20 feet behind them and deliver a second strike for 2d8 + Cha modifier slashing damage.
rules.drawback: You must have been unseen by the target for at least one turn before using this ability.

abilities.apReason: Requires careful positioning and a reaction usage.
abilities.warioNote: You need to be sneaky! And patient. Otherwise, you just missed your chance.

abilities.name: Forgestorm Shield
abilities.description: Erect a tempest of molten metal that strikes foes within 30 feet for force damage.
abilities.levelReason: This ability requires a reaction for immediate defense and scales appropriately with the existing combat abilities at this level.

rules.effect: Raise an impenetrable wall of molten metal that deals 4d6 force damage to all creatures within its area. Creatures must succeed on a DC 25 Strength saving throw or be pushed back 10 feet.
rules.drawback: You are engulfed in the shield, taking 2d6 force damage per round until it dissipates.

abilities.apReason: It provides significant defensive capabilities while costing an action point to activate.
abilities.warioNote: You get covered in metal too! But hey, it’s worth it if you survive!

abilities.name: Gunstorm Overload
abilities.description: Call forth a relentless storm of gunfire, forcing enemies to make a Strength saving throw or take fire damage.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales well with the character's proficiency in firearms and provides a substantial area effect.

rules.effect: All creatures within 30 feet must make a DC 25 Strength saving throw or take 4d6 fire damage.
rules.drawback: You expend 2 bullets and lose your Dexterity bonus to AC until the end of your next turn.

abilities.apReason: The ability deals significant damage but has a resource cost for ammunition.
abilities.warioNote: Blew through your bullets, ya scoundrel? No refills 'til tomorrow!

abilities.name: Shadowsplit
abilities.description: Split into two spectral copies and attack from different angles.
abilities.levelReason: At level 17, this ability allows the spy to split into two copies for extended combat scenarios where they can exploit dual targets.

rules.effect: For the duration, you split into two shadowy duplicates. Each duplicate can take a single attack action and targets a different enemy within 30 feet. The duplicates have your statistics but deal half damage with their attacks.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again until after a long rest.

abilities.apReason: This ability provides significant tactical flexibility and requires recovery time between uses.
abilities.warioNote: Copycat! Copycat! You'll need a long rest before you can copy again!

abilities.name: Shadow Echo
abilities.description: Create a doppelganger that mirrors your movements, distracting enemies and granting you additional attacks.
abilities.levelReason: This advanced stealth maneuver provides significant support to combat situations by doubling attack opportunities at the cost of reduced mobility.

rules.effect: When you use this ability, a shadowy clone of yourself appears up to 30 feet away. The clone takes its own turn immediately after your turn and can make attacks against the same targets as you. Both you and your clone have disadvantage on all Dexterity (Stealth) checks while the effect lasts.
rules.drawback: Your movement is halved, and you cannot use this ability again until after completing a long rest.

abilities.apReason: This ability offers extended utility with a moderate drawback, making it a strategic choice for high-level espionage.
abilities.warioNote: Yo ho! You wanna move fast? Then you gotta slow down first. That clone's draggin' ya down!

abilities.name: Shadowstep Shadowweave
abilities.description: Weave through shadows to teleport up to 60 feet and cloak yourself in darkness.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows for both mobility and stealth at a high level, fitting the class's combat and infiltration themes.

rules.effect: Teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space and become invisible for the duration. You can use your action on each of your turns while invisible to make a single melee attack.
rules.drawback: After using this ability, you gain disadvantage on all Dexterity (Stealth) checks until the end of your next long rest.

abilities.apReason: Allows for significant positional advantage and invisibility for an entire minute, justifying its AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! If you're always shadowing your prey like a wily fox, make sure to take that much-needed nap afterwards!

abilities.name: Bullet Storm Overdrive
abilities.description: Harness the storm of bullets to deal devastating damage and knock enemies back.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides an extremely powerful combat option at level 19, requiring significant resource expenditure while delivering a substantial damage output with area effect and knockback.

rules.effect: Fire a storm of bullets that deals 4d8 + DEX modifier fire damage. Enemies within the area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 15 + your proficiency bonus) or be knocked prone and pushed 10 feet away.
rules.drawback: You expend 2 AP to activate this ability.

abilities.apReason: Expends two Action Points for the heightened power of this ability, balancing its potency with cost.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! That’s some high-octane firepower! Ya gotta ante up to get that kind of shrapnel stormin’!

abilities.name: Titanic Refinement
abilities.description: Forge a colossal weapon that enhances your next attack with unmatched force.
abilities.levelReason: This powerful magic ability is reserved for the most skilled Artisans, fitting at level 19 as it requires significant resources and expertise.

rules.effect: On the first attack you make during your next turn, deal an additional 4d8 + Intelligence modifier force damage. This effect can only be used once per short or long rest.
rules.drawback: You must expend a 7th-level spell slot to activate this ability.

abilities.apReason: The high AP cost reflects the significant magical investment required to refine a weapon with such force.
abilities.warioNote: Spendin' a 7th-level spell slot fer this? Ya sure ya got the gold for that?

abilities.name: Bullet Annihilation
abilities.description: Unleash a final, devastating barrage of bullets that can obliterate all enemies within range.
abilities.levelReason: This powerful move is reserved for the most dire situations at level 20.

rules.effect: Deal 8d6 + Dex modifier damage to all creatures in a 30-foot radius. On a critical hit, deal double damage.
rules.drawback: You must expend all your remaining grit before activating this ability.

abilities.apReason: Requires a significant investment of resources to achieve such devastating power.
abilities.warioNote: Ya better have all yer grit, 'cause ya ain't gettin' none back after dis!

abilities.name: Shadow Conduit
abilities.description: Channel the very essence of shadow to create an untraceable conduit for information.
abilities.levelReason: Requires significant focus and concentration for its duration, fitting a level 20 ability that demands both mental prowess and physical stealth.

rules.effect: You establish a secure, invisible channel between yourself and a target you can see within 60 feet. For the duration, you can send encrypted messages to this target without detection or interference. You may send one message per long rest.
rules.drawback: The conduit is only as strong as your concentration; if broken, all transmitted information is lost.

abilities.apReason: This ability requires a high-cost bonus action to activate and maintains a complex effect over an extended period, justifying the AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! You think you can send secret messages? Well, this one ain't cheap. You'll need your wits about ya for sure!

abilities.name: Divine Shield Strike
abilities.description: Deal radiant damage to an enemy and grant temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier.
abilities.levelReason: This ability adds a combat-focused action that enhances both offensive and defensive capabilities, fitting at level 2.

rules.effect: Deal 2d8+CHA radiant damage and grant yourself temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if you are incapacitated.

abilities.apReason: It combines offensive damage with a defensive benefit, making it comparable to other level 2 abilities.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! Ya can't just pop this one outta thin air! You gotta be in your prime to swing like that!

abilities.name: Arcane Shield Surge
abilities.description: Conjure a shimmering shield that deflects the next attack made against you.
abilities.levelReason: This provides a useful defensive tool while still requiring some health to use effectively.

rules.effect: When an attacker makes a melee or ranged attack against you, roll a d8. If the roll equals or exceeds the damage rolled by the attacker, the attack is deflected and takes no effect.
rules.drawback: You must have at least 2 hit points remaining to activate this ability.

abilities.apReason: Provides a significant defensive benefit that can save a life if used correctly.
abilities.warioNote: You better be hangin' in there, or this spell's no good! Got hit points? Got this!

abilities.name: Bulwark Shield
abilities.description: Raise your shield to block incoming attacks, reducing damage by half and forcing the attacker to make a Dexterity saving throw or lose their next attack.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the player's Strength and provides immediate defensive value, suitable for a level 2 character.

rules.effect: Reduce incoming bludgeoning damage from one melee weapon attack by half. The attacker must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 10 + your Strength modifier) or lose their next melee attack.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability until the start of your next turn.

abilities.apReason: Requires the player to sacrifice their action economy in a reaction, which is a real cost.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there, buddy! You want to block that attack? Fine, but you ain't getting your next swing!

abilities.name: Toolchain Surge
abilities.description: Unleash the power of your toolset to deal 1d8 + Intelligence modifier bludgeoning damage in a 10-foot radius.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with level, providing more damage as you gain proficiency in tools.

rules.effect: Deal 1d8 + your Intelligence modifier bludgeoning damage to all creatures in a 10-foot radius. You must be wielding at least one tool.
rules.drawback: You expend 2 AP and lose your Dexterity bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

abilities.apReason: Expends additional AP for a larger area effect and increased damage potential.
abilities.warioNote: Huh! You better have your toolset ready, or it's gonna cost ya some AP!

abilities.name: Rogue's Gambit
abilities.description: Pretend to retreat and then strike from behind.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a significant combat edge by allowing the rogue to evade and counterattack with precision.

rules.effect: When you are hit by an attack, as a reaction you can move up to your speed and make a melee attack with any weapon. If the target of this attack is within 5 feet of you, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier) or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this reaction again until after you take a short rest.

abilities.apReason: The ability allows for quick adaptation in a fight, which can be costly if used too frequently.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! You think you’re slick enough to pull that off? Well, make sure your reflexes are sharp! 1 AP it is!

abilities.name: Arcane Quill Duet
abilities.description: Quickly craft two illusory quills that scribble an arcane message on any surface within 30 feet.
abilities.levelReason: Enhances situational utility without overwhelming combat capabilities at level 3.

rules.effect: Create two illusory quills that leave a message visible for the duration. The message can be read by anyone within 30 feet, but it disappears after one minute.
rules.drawback: You must use your next short rest to clear any messages left from this ability.

abilities.apReason: Delivers a magic effect with a limited duration and requires a subsequent short rest for maintenance, justifying the AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Leave a message... but clear it soon or you'll owe me another AP next time!

abilities.name: Shadowstep Leap
abilities.description: Leap into the shadows, increasing your movement speed and leaving no trace behind.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows for quick, silent exits and entries, fitting a level 3 Spy ability focusing on mobility and stealth.

rules.effect: Increase your walking speed by 30 feet until the start of your next turn. You leave no footprints or other traces during this movement.
rules.drawback: You cannot take any actions immediately after activating this ability.

abilities.apReason: Requires a short rest to recharge and offers an immediate benefit in terms of increased speed and stealth.
abilities.warioNote: You leap into the shadows, but you can't do anything after that. Silly spy!

abilities.name: Shield Toss
abilities.description: Throw your shield to strike an enemy, dealing bludgeoning damage and pushing them back.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows Militia members to support their allies by attacking from a distance, making it suitable at level 3.

rules.effect: Make a melee weapon attack with your shield against a creature within range. On a hit, the target is pushed 5 feet and takes 2d8 bludgeoning damage.
rules.drawback: You cannot use your shield for defense or block until the start of your next turn.

abilities.apReason: The bonus action and pushing back an enemy make this a valuable but not overpowered move.
abilities.warioNote: Yo ho ho! Ye can't defend yerself while ye're lobbin' shields at foes, matey!

abilities.name: Shadow Stalk
abilities.description: You can stalk silently through the shadows, concealing yourself and your allies within 30 feet.
abilities.levelReason: This ability enhances stealth and area effect for a short duration, fitting a rogue's role in combat and exploration.

rules.effect: You become invisible until the start of your next turn, and all creatures you can see within 30 feet also gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks for the duration.
rules.drawback: While using this ability, you cannot take actions that provoke opportunity attacks.

abilities.apReason: It provides an extended area effect and invisibility, costing two AP to use.
abilities.warioNote: You go dark... but your allies? They're all out in the open too! Only one can hide at a time!

abilities.name: Arcane Illusionary Barrage
abilities.description: Create an array of illusory duplicates that attack enemies in your vicinity.
abilities.levelReason: This ability requires multiple actions to set up, provides significant area-of-effect damage and distraction, but comes with a debilitating drawback.

rules.effect: You create up to three illusory duplicates of yourself, each dealing 2d6 force damage on a hit. Targets within 30 feet must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be distracted and take half the damage.
rules.drawback: You are temporarily blinded for 1 round after using this ability.

abilities.apReason: Generates three duplicate attacks over a minute duration, a substantial resource investment for the wizard at this level.
abilities.warioNote: Whoa there, partner! That's some fancy stuff. But don't say I didn't warn ya—now you can't even see straight!

abilities.name: Explosive Volley
abilities.description: Fire two explosive rounds, dealing an additional 1d6 fire damage to all creatures in a 5-foot radius.
abilities.levelReason: This ability requires multiple actions for setup, making it impactful at level 4.

rules.effect: Fire two explosive rounds, dealing 2d6 fire damage to the target and an additional 1d6 fire damage to all creatures within a 5-foot radius.
rules.drawback: You must spend 1 AP.

abilities.apReason: Explosive Volley demands an action to execute, thus costing one Action Point.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! You want some fireworks? Spend that Action Point wisely!

abilities.name: Invisible Echo
abilities.description: Unleash an echoing decoy that distracts enemies and draws their attacks.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the Spy's level, providing a new way to distract enemies while gaining mobility advantages.

rules.effect: Create a clone of yourself within range, visible only to creatures adjacent to you. For the duration, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and can move through the decoy without triggering opportunity attacks. Each creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of the decoy must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 force damage and be distracted until the end of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You cannot control the decoy's actions or movements.

abilities.apReason: Creating an illusionary duplicate and controlling it for a minute requires significant concentration and risk of exposure.
abilities.warioNote: Yo ho! Watch out, ya slippery dev'lin! That trick could cost ya your cover if'n they catch on!

abilities.name: Tool Barrage
abilities.description: Quickly throw multiple tools to pin an enemy in place.
abilities.levelReason: At level 4, this ability allows for rapid tool-based attacks with an additional utility in restraining enemies.

rules.effect: Make a ranged weapon attack with two improvised weapons. On a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be restrained until the end of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You can only use this ability after taking damage.

abilities.apReason: The ranged weapon attack and the potential to restrain an enemy require resources and timing, making it a meaningful use of action points.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! Take one for the team, pal! You gotta take some damage first!

abilities.name: Holy Shield
abilities.description: Summon a shimmering holy shield that grants you and your allies within 10 feet a +2 bonus to AC for the duration of one short rest.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides long-term defensive benefits, fitting for a level 5_paladin.
