rules.effect: You and your allies within 10 feet gain a +2 bonus to AC until the end of one short rest.
rules.drawback: You must finish a short or long rest before using this ability again.

abilities.apReason: The ability offers significant buffs to the party and has a cooldown period making it feel appropriately potent at this level.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! 'Holy Shield' costs 3 AP. You gotta think about those short rests, ya hear? Otherwise, it's free!

abilities.name: Precision Surge
abilities.description: Boost your firearm accuracy for the next minute, but suffer a -1 penalty to all Dexterity saving throws.
abilities.levelReason: Enhances combat effectiveness in prolonged engagements at the cost of increased vulnerability to environmental hazards and traps.

rules.effect: Increase attack rolls with firearms by +2 until the start of your next turn after activation. If you hit, deal an additional 2d6 damage.
rules.drawback: Suffer a -1 penalty to all Dexterity saving throws for the duration.

abilities.apReason: Requires careful planning, as it leaves you vulnerable during a crucial minute of combat.
abilities.warioNote: Ya better aim real good, 'cause ya gonna be takin' some fallin' damage too!

abilities.name: Ink Veil
abilities.description: Paint an ink mirage that grants you and your allies within 10 feet temporary invisibility for 1 minute.
abilities.levelReason: This ability extends the utility and stealth capabilities at level 5 without duplicating existing effects.

rules.effect: You and all willing creatures within a 10-foot radius become invisible to all but those focused on your scent. After this duration, you may spend 1 action point to remain hidden until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: The mirage can be dispelled by light or illumination; if discovered, it dissipates immediately.

abilities.apReason: Creates a temporary area of invisibility with a radius, requiring the player to manage action points for extended stealth.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Ink ain't cheap! But it's worth it if you're gonna pull off that big heist!

abilities.name: Shield Barrier
abilities.description: Raise your shield to form an impenetrable barrier that absorbs damage for you and adjacent allies.
abilities.levelReason: At level 5, this ability offers a defensive wall that can protect both the user and an ally, enhancing survivability in combat.

rules.range: self or adjacent ally within 5 feet
rules.duration: 1 minute or until the shield takes damage again
rules.effect: Raise a shield barrier that absorbs up to 2d8 + your Constitution modifier damage for you and an adjacent ally. While active, you have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.
rules.drawback: You are disadvantaged on Dexterity saving throws until the end of your next short or long rest.

abilities.apReason: This ability provides significant defense to multiple targets but comes with a disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws as its cost.
abilities.warioNote: Ya gotta risk somethin' to get somethin', partner! Disadvantage ain't cheap!

abilities.name: Arcane Echo Array
abilities.description: Summon multiple phantasmal duplicates to assist you in combat and cast one spell at will.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides additional combat support in the form of phantasmal allies, enhancing a wizard's offensive capabilities at level 6.

rules.effect: You create up to three phantasmal copies of yourself within a 30-foot radius. These duplicates can cast one spell at will each per day. They are not real and take no damage.
rules.drawback: The duplicates are illusions and cannot be targeted by attacks or effects.

abilities.apReason: Creating multiple copies that can cast spells requires significant magical energy and concentration.
abilities.warioNote: Yo! Watcha thinkin', summonin' more ghosts? You better hope they don't go rogue!

abilities.name: Shattering Shells
abilities.description: Fire a shot that explodes into multiple fragments, dealing an additional 1d6 force damage to the target and any adjacent enemies.
abilities.levelReason: Allows for area of effect damage at close range, enhancing team-based combat effectiveness.

rules.effect: Fire a shot that explodes into multiple fragments, dealing an additional 1d6 force damage to the target and any adjacent enemies within 5 feet.
rules.drawback: Requires a successful hit; no effect on a miss.

abilities.apReason: Delivers a powerful burst effect but requires precision firing and grit.
abilities.warioNote: Ya better hit 'em, or ya waste all that ammo! Shatterin' shells ain't cheap!

abilities.name: Ink Barrage
abilities.description: Spray ink in a line to obscure vision within and block the path of foes.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with level by increasing the duration and effect range while maintaining a manageable drawback.

rules.effect: Create a 20-foot-long line of ink that grants temporary blindness to all creatures in it. Creatures within the area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the end of their next turn.
rules.drawback: You must expend an action to prepare the ink, and you can only use this ability once per long rest.

abilities.apReason: Spraying ink is a complex and impactful action that requires preparation, fitting its AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: You'd better have your ink ready, or you'll be squirming in the dark!

abilities.name: Formation Shield
abilities.description: Command your allies to form a protective circle around you, reducing incoming damage by half for all within the formation.
abilities.levelReason: This ability requires a long rest to use again and provides significant defensive benefits to both you and nearby allies, fitting for a level 6 ability.

rules.effect: All allies within 5 feet of you gain a +2 bonus to AC until the end of your next turn. You and all allies within the formation take only half damage from attacks made against any target within the formation.
rules.drawback: You and your allies suffer disadvantage on attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks while in the formation.

abilities.apReason: The effect of reducing incoming damage by half on multiple targets is substantial, making it costlier in action points.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there, buddy! Forming a shield wall takes time and effort. You’ll need to rest up before you can do it again!

abilities.name: Radiant Purge
abilities.description: Infuse allies within 30 feet with holy energy, granting them immunity to poison and disease for 1 minute.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides significant healing support by granting immunity to debilitating diseases and poisons, which is valuable in a campaign where environmental hazards are common. It fits well at level 7 as it provides a long-term benefit.

rules.effect: All allies within 30 feet gain resistance to poison and disease damage, and are immune to these effects for the duration. This ability has a cooldown of 1 short rest.
rules.drawback: You must complete a short rest before using this ability again.

abilities.apReason: This ability has a cooldown of one short rest to ensure it does not become overpowered, but still offers substantial support to the party.
abilities.warioNote: Ya gotta chill out for a bit before ya can heal your friends again. But at least they stay safe while you wait!

abilities.name: Barrage Barrage
abilities.description: Fire two rapid bursts of gunfire in different directions, dealing massive damage within a wide area.
abilities.levelReason: This ability requires a significant number of expended rounds, making it impactful at level 7 while still being balanced.

rules.effect: Choose two targets up to 30 feet apart. Both targets take 4d6 piercing damage and are knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You must expend 2 bullets from your current firearm.

abilities.apReason: Expending multiple bullets and dealing high damage to two targets makes this a costly yet powerful option for the Gunslinger.
abilities.warioNote: You're wastin' good lead there, bub! But I ain't complainin'. That's what it takes to bring down those big critters!

abilities.name: Misdirected Mirage
abilities.description: Create a misleading optical illusion to confuse your enemies for one minute.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows the Spy to manipulate battlefield perception effectively at higher levels, providing long-term confusion and strategic advantage.

rules.effect: You create an illusory duplicate of yourself within 30 feet, which moves and interacts with objects as if it were real. Creatures that fail a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15) are confused for the duration, losing their next action.
rules.drawback: While creating the mirage, you become vulnerable to opportunity attacks.

abilities.apReason: Creating a detailed and effective optical illusion that can influence multiple creatures requires careful focus and a significant diversion of resources.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! You think you're sneaky? Try not to get caught in your own trick!

abilities.name: Toad's Lure
abilities.description: Draw enemies to your location with the allure of an enchanted toad.
abilities.levelReason: Introduces a new stealth mechanic at level 7 by manipulating enemy decision-making and imposing penalties on them.

rules.effect: For every creature within 30 feet, you can choose whether they move towards or away from you. Creatures that decide to approach take a -2 penalty to their next attack roll.
rules.drawback: After using this ability, you must spend your next short rest performing an elaborate performance with no other actions.

abilities.apReason: Requires a significant action to perform the ability and has a lasting effect, justifying its moderate AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Hehe! Now you can make those pesky adventurers do all your dirty work for ya!

abilities.name: Bulwark Barrage
abilities.description: Unleash a volley of javelins that deals 4d6 piercing damage to all enemies within 15 feet.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows Militia members to disrupt multiple enemies with ranged attacks, fitting well within their role as defenders and support combatants.

rules.effect: Each enemy in the area takes 4d6 piercing damage. You must have a ranged weapon ready.
rules.drawback: You expend 2 AP to activate this ability.

abilities.apReason: Activating a powerful ranged attack that affects many foes requires careful preparation and concentration.
abilities.warioNote: Yah, yah, gotta spend them AP like they're gonna run out! Y'know what's better? Sellin' yer soul to me!

abilities.name: Forge Tempest
abilities.description: Unleash a torrent of molten metal and debris, dealing 2d6 bludgeoning damage to creatures in a 15-foot radius.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the Artisan’s level, dealing more damage and requiring a short rest to use again.

rules.effect: Create a burst of molten metal, causing 2d6 bludgeoning damage to all creatures in a 15-foot radius. You must be wielding artisan tools.
rules.drawback: You become blind for 1 round as the debris clouds your vision.

abilities.apReason: The reaction activation and significant AoE damage make this a high-cost ability that requires careful deployment.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! You're gonna need a broom AND a mop after that little display, bub!

abilities.name: Shady Mirage
abilities.description: You create the illusion of yourself to confuse and distract foes.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows for extended control over an enemy, giving a significant strategic advantage in combat.

rules.effect: Choose one creature you can see within range. Until the end of your next turn, that creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15) or be charmed by you for the duration.
rules.drawback: You cannot move more than 30 feet away from the creature affected until the start of your next turn.

abilities.apReason: Creating an illusion and maintaining its effect, as well as holding position to maintain it, requires careful management of resources.
abilities.warioNote: You can't run away while playing illusions! Gotta stay close for the magic trick to work!

abilities.name: Feral Tornado
abilities.description: Call down a swirling vortex of wind that deals slashing damage to all enemies within its radius.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows for a powerful burst attack that can affect multiple enemies at once, fitting for level 8.

rules.effect: Create a 10-foot-radius, 30-foot-tall cone of wind. All creatures in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 2d6 slashing damage and are knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You must be within 30 feet of an open space to activate this ability.

abilities.warioNote: You better be in open ground to use this, or you're just spinning your wheels!

abilities.name: Bullet Surge
abilities.description: You channel your energy into a concentrated burst of gunfire, dealing massive damage to all creatures within reach.
abilities.levelReason: This ability requires a significant resource expenditure and adds a new tactical option for the Gunslinger.

rules.effect: Fire a sustained burst that deals 4d8 fire damage to each creature in a 20-foot cone (DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, half damage on success).
rules.drawback: You must expend 2 bullets from your pistol and take a -2 penalty to all ranged attacks made this turn.

abilities.apReason: The ability requires careful preparation, as it is costly in terms of ammunition and combat flexibility.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! Ya wanna deal some serious damage? Then ya gotta spend bullets... and yer finesse!

abilities.name: Ink Misdirection
abilities.description: Create a distraction by leaving behind an ink stain that misdirects enemies.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a significant mechanical benefit at level 8 by forcing enemies into a potentially dangerous action and requiring recovery time.

rules.effect: Draw one enemy within 30 feet to make an attack against the ink stain, granting you advantage on your next stealth check.
rules.drawback: You must expend a short rest after using this ability.

abilities.apReason: The ability requires careful positioning and has a limited duration, making it impactful without overpowered usage.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! Ink's messy business, so take your time cleaning up!

abilities.name: Cheap Explosive
abilities.description: Set off a homemade explosive that deals moderate damage to enemies in its blast radius.
abilities.levelReason: At level 8, this ability provides a significant area-of-effect combat option that fits the commoner's improvisational theme.

rules.effect: Explosive device creates an explosion dealing 6d6 fire damage within a 15-foot radius. Targets must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: The explosive consumes your next short rest for preparation.

abilities.apReason: Creating and setting off an explosive is both strategic and resource-intensive, justifying a higher AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Man, you ain't no toad! You use up your next short rest for this? That’s a lot of lost time! But hey, it packs quite the punch!

abilities.name: Chain Shield Barricade
abilities.description: Create a shield wall that provides cover for allies within 10 feet.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides area control and protection, fitting a level 8 militia that focuses on defense and support.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: All creatures within 5 feet gain half-cover while you are adjacent to them. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You must be able to touch and see an ally within 5 feet.

abilities.apReason: Creates a beneficial effect over an area which is difficult for enemies to target, requiring a reaction to set up.
abilities.warioNote: Need to get out of the way quick, or you'll be stuck in your own shield wall!

abilities.name: Forge Barrage
abilities.description: Launch a cascade of molten fragments from your tools, dealing 1d8+INT modifier fire damage to each target in the area.
abilities.levelReason: Provides a significant area effect with a real risk, fitting for level 8.

rules.effect: Choose one creature you can see within 30 feet. It must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8+your Intelligence modifier fire damage.
rules.drawback: You must use an artisan tool as a bonus action to prime the barrage before your next turn.

abilities.apReason: The reaction activation and significant damage output justify a cost of two AP.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Gonna need to prime that barrage first — ain't no time wastin' here!

abilities.name: Sacred Retribution
abilities.description: A devastating strike that deals radiant damage to an enemy and creates a holy wave affecting nearby allies.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides significant combat support and damage output, fitting for a level 9 paladin.

rules.effect: Deal 3d8+CHA modifier radiant damage to one target. Nearby friendly characters within 10 feet gain temporary hit points equal to 2d6 + CHA modifier until the end of their next turn.
rules.drawback: Requires a short rest to recover after using it.

abilities.apReason: High-damage ability with a moderate recovery cost.
abilities.warioNote: You're gonna have to sweat it out at the temple baths after that one.

abilities.name: Shadow Veil Slash
abilities.description: Leap through shadows and deliver a flurry of strikes, leaving enemies in disarray.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the rogue's level while offering a powerful combat option that requires careful positioning and timing, fitting well at level 9.

rules.effect: Deal 2d6 + your Dexterity modifier slashing damage to two creatures of your choice within range, and they must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be disoriented for the duration.
rules.drawback: You must spend an additional action on your next turn to recover from this ability.

abilities.apReason: The ability allows for a significant combat advantage with a moderate action cost.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Think you can handle the rush? Spend an extra action to recover from this one!

abilities.name: Arcane Conduit
abilities.description: Harness the power of multiple spells into a single devastating strike.
abilities.levelReason: At level 9, wizards can handle more complex combinations of spells which make Arcane Conduit both powerful and challenging.

rules.effect: Select three different 9th-level wizard spells. You cast all three as a single action, dealing the average damage of each spell to one target within range.
rules.drawback: You must prepare and memorize only two such spells for this ability.

abilities.apReason: This ability allows the wizard to cast three high-level spells in one action, a significant advantage that comes at a substantial resource cost.
abilities.warioNote: You can't just conjure up power like this every day, ya cheatin' scoundrel! Pick your spells wisely!

abilities.name: Explosive Barrage
abilities.description: Launch a barrage of explosive bullets that deal fire damage to all enemies in the area and knock them prone.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales well with the Gunslinger's level and provides a significant combat advantage at short range.

rules.effect: Fire a barrage of explosive bullets, dealing 2d8 fire damage to all creatures within 15 feet (DC 14 Dexterity saving throw for half). Creatures failing the save are also knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You must reload your firearm after using this ability, costing you an action.

abilities.apReason: The effect is powerful for a short rest ability, dealing area-of-effect fire damage and knocking enemies prone, which justifies its 3 AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Yo ho! Reloadin' after this? You better have plenty of bullets in your belt!

abilities.name: Mass Shield Block
abilities.description: Create a barrier of shields to block incoming attacks, reducing damage taken by allies.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides significant defensive support at level 9, allowing allies to survive attacks more effectively.

rules.effect: You and all allies within 30 feet gain a resistance to damage from one attack. The next attack that hits any of you deals half damage.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again until after a long rest.

abilities.apReason: Requires a reaction and grants substantial protection to nearby allies for the duration of one battle encounter.
abilities.warioNote: Ya gotta rest up after dat. No shield blockin' 'til tomorrow!

abilities.name: Evasive Maneuver
abilities.description: Dodge an attack by moving away from it and deal damage to the attacker with your reaction.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows for a powerful reactive combat maneuver while maintaining the rogue's focus on agility and precision.

rules.effect: When you succeed in a Dexterity saving throw against an attack, make an attack roll against the attacker's AC. On a hit, deal 1d6 + DEX modifier damage.
rules.drawback: You are vulnerable to opportunity attacks during your movement.

abilities.apReason: Requires a reaction and has a vulnerability cost, justifying its AP cost at level 10.
abilities.warioNote: Watcha thinkin', buddy? You're dodgin' attacks now, but you better hope your friends are coverin' for ya!

abilities.name: Arcane Reservoir
abilities.description: Channel arcane energy into a reservoir that can later be released as devastating force.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows for powerful area-of-effect damage at the cost of preparation time, fitting a level 10 spell slot.

rules.effect: At the end of your turn, you release the stored energy in a burst. This burst deals 4d8 + Intelligence modifier force damage to all creatures within 15 feet.
rules.drawback: You must prepare this ability each day and cannot cast it if you have expended all your spell slots.

abilities.apReason: It allows players to save up energy and use it strategically during a key moment in combat.
abilities.warioNote: Oh ho! Save your juice 'til you really need it, or you might find yourself dry as a bone!

abilities.name: Toolchain Tempest
abilities.description: Summon a raging storm of tools that lashes out at foes in all directions.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the character's level, providing a significant combat advantage while requiring a cooldown period.

rules.effect: Deal 2d6 bludgeoning damage to each creature within a 10-foot-radius burst centered on you. Creatures must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and take an additional 1d6 bludgeoning damage.
rules.drawback: You lose the ability to use tools for one minute after using this ability.

abilities.apReason: The effect is area-based and highly damaging, making it powerful enough to justify its AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: You think you can summon a tempest with tools? Why not just use your hammer for what it’s made!

abilities.name: Divine Ward
abilities.description: Create a shimmering barrier that provides temporary hit points to an ally when they take damage.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows for timely support of allies in combat without overwhelming the player with too many support options at this level.

rules.effect: When an ally within 30 feet takes damage, you create a barrier that grants them +5 temporary hit points. This ability can be used once per short rest.
rules.drawback: You must be able to see the target and they cannot be hostile towards you.

abilities.apReason: Provides a useful defensive boost once per short rest, requiring some resource management.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! One use per break. You can't just keep spamming this one like it's free!

abilities.name: Raging Carnage
abilities.description: Harness your rage to deal extra damage and gain an advantage on attack rolls within 10 feet.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales well with the Barbarian's existing high-damage abilities like Fury Cleave and Raging Storm, adding a burst of extra damage in a close-range area.

rules.effect: Choose one creature you can see within range. You gain advantage on attack rolls against it, and creatures in a 5-foot-radius burst around it take an additional 3d6 thunder damage.
rules.drawback: You must spend 2 additional action points to activate this ability.

abilities.apReason: The additional action point cost reflects the tactical flexibility required to position yourself optimally for this ability’s effects.
abilities.warioNote: Yo ho ho! Five APs? That's more than a double cheeseburger at Wario's! But you get extra damage and advantage, so it might be worth it!

abilities.name: Arcane Tempest Shield
abilities.description: Summons an impenetrable shield of arcane energy that reflects incoming damage and grants temporary hit points to you.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows wizards to defend themselves effectively at level 11, offering a potent defensive option with a meaningful drawback.

rules.effect: When a creature strikes you with an attack, it takes the original damage dealt plus 2d8 force damage. You also gain +5 temporary hit points.
rules.drawback: You cannot cast spells for 1 round after activating this ability.

abilities.apReason: The reaction cost combined with the long rest recharge and significant effect justify the AP cost of 3.
abilities.warioNote: Ya gotta give up somethin', kid! Whatcha expect fer this shield o' yours? It’s a wizard's most powerful defense, but nothin’ comes free!

abilities.name: Shadowsplit Slash
abilities.description: Slice through the shadows to unleash a devastating sneak attack against an unaware target.
abilities.levelReason: This ability complements existing combat-focused abilities like Silent Strike and Invisible Strike, providing a powerful sneak attack with an additional shadow-based damage modifier.

rules.effect: Make a melee weapon attack against one creature within reach. On a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take an additional 8 + your proficiency bonus damage from shadows.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again until after you complete a short rest.

abilities.apReason: The Shadowsplit Slash requires careful positioning and a significant drawback in terms of cooldown between uses.
abilities.warioNote: Yo, if you're plannin' on slicin' 'em up wit' shadows, ya better rest up or else it'll be a long wait for your next move!

abilities.name: Toad's Tempest
abilities.description: Summons a storm of toads that deal lightning damage to enemies within range.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the character's level, providing a potent combat tool for a level 11 Commoner.

rules.effect: You call upon the toad god's wrath, creating a tempest that deals 2d6 lightning damage per round to all creatures in a 15-foot cone. At the end of each creature’s turn within this area, it must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and take an additional 2d6 lightning damage.
rules.drawback: You expend one AP and your next action is restricted to moving no more than half your speed.

abilities.apReason: This ability requires a significant cost in AP and action economy to balance its power and utility at this level.
abilities.warioNote: Ya better be ready with yer next move, or else it’ll be all splash damage fer ya!

abilities.name: Forge Barrier
abilities.description: Create a wall of metal shards that deals damage to any creature that passes through it.
abilities.levelReason: This ability complements other high-impact combat maneuvers by providing an area denial tactic for the battlefield at level 11.

rules.effect: As a reaction, you can create a barrier of metal shards in your space. Any creature that moves through the barrier must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 17). On a failed save, they take 2d8 piercing damage and are knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You cannot create another barrier until you complete a long rest.

abilities.apReason: Creating a tactical and strategic barrier that can significantly alter battle dynamics requires thoughtful use of resources.
abilities.warioNote: Ya gotta be tired from all them long rests, Artisan. Can't keep makin' barriers like there's no tomorrow!

abilities.name: Feral Surge
abilities.description: Leap forward and unleash a primal surge that damages enemies in your path.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows for a long-range, damaging charge with a significant drawback, fitting well within level 12's power curve.

rules.effect: Make a charge attack against all creatures within 10 feet; each hit deals 2d8 + STR modifier thunder damage. You must move at least 15 feet to activate.
rules.drawback: You are fatigued until the start of your next turn.

abilities.apReason: Requires an action and has a non-trivial drawback of fatigue.
abilities.warioNote: You’re already spent, buddy! Charge once and you’ll feel the burn for sure!

abilities.name: Titanic Shield
abilities.description: Erect a colossal shield wall that deals thunderous damage to all enemies within its reach and protects you from incoming attacks.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows for massive area of effect and protection, fitting as a level 12 feature.

rules.effect: Create a 10-foot radius shield wall that deals 2d8 thunder damage to all creatures within its range each turn. You gain a +2 bonus to AC while the shield wall is active.
rules.drawback: While the shield wall protects you, it leaves you unable to move or cast spells.

abilities.apReason: Creates an area effect with ongoing damage and defensive benefit, requiring careful use.
abilities.warioNote: Ya can't run 'n' roll in this shield wall! It's stuck there like a rock!

abilities.name: Commanding Shieldwall
abilities.description: Form a protective wall of allies around you to block incoming attacks.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides significant support and protection for allies over an extended period, fitting for level 12.

rules.effect: Create a 5-foot-radius circle centered on yourself, granting all allies within it temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier x4. While within this area, they gain advantage on saving throws against effects that would push them or otherwise move them.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again until after you complete a long rest.

abilities.apReason: Provides substantial benefit to the party over an entire combat encounter at the cost of one action point.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! One use per long rest? That's not cheap, but you know it'll save lives!

abilities.name: Mass Toad Shield
abilities.description: Rally toads in the area to form a defensive barrier that provides temporary hit points to allies within reach.
abilities.levelReason: This supports the existing theme of providing beneficial effects to allies, fitting for a level 12 ability.

rules.effect: Create a toad shield that grants all nearby allies 4 temporary hit points per level of the caster. Lasts for 1 minute.
rules.drawback: You must spend 2 AP to activate this ability.

abilities.apReason: Provides an ongoing benefit that is significant in combat without being overly powerful.
abilities.warioNote: Toads cost extra! Two AP it is, or you’re outta here!

abilities.name: Defensive Counter
abilities.description: Counterattack after taking damage to deal radiant damage and push the attacker back.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a strong defensive counter at close range, fitting for a level 12 character who can already engage in combat and leadership.

rules.effect: When you take bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage from a creature within 5 feet of you, immediately use this feature. You can make a melee weapon attack against the attacker; if successful, deal 2d6 radiant damage and force them to move up to 10 feet away from you.
rules.drawback: You must be able to reach the attacking creature with your weapon.

abilities.apReason: The reaction-based activation and push effect provide significant tactical benefit, justifying the AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Eh, you gotta pay extra to block that block, right? 'Cause we got standards here!

abilities.name: Forge Vortex
abilities.description: Summon a swirling vortex of molten metal that pulls enemies into its maw.
abilities.levelReason: At level 12, this ability allows Artisans to control an area effect combat maneuver with a significant damage and movement debuff.

rules.effect: Draw all creatures within a 30-foot cone towards the vortex, dealing 2d8 fire damage to those who fail their saving throw. The vortex also reduces movement speed by half for affected targets.
rules.drawback: You must remain within the 30-foot range of the vortex at all times while it is active.

abilities.apReason: This powerful area effect combat ability requires a resourceful use of AP to ensure it can be used strategically in key moments during the campaign.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there, buddy! If you wanna summon that fiery whirlwind, ya gotta cough up some serious cash… Or else!

abilities.name: Judgment Shield Array
abilities.description: Create a line of divine barriers to protect allies within range, absorbing damage equal to your Paladin level + CHA modifier.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides extended protection for allies at a high cost of concentration, fitting well with the theme of prolonged divine support.

rules.effect: Draw a straight line of up to five 5-foot squares within range. Each square created grants an ally in that area +2 AC and absorbs 1d8+CHA radiant damage per round, reducing to half damage after three rounds.
rules.drawback: You must concentrate on this effect; you can't attack or cast spells while maintaining the barrier.

abilities.apReason: This is one of the most versatile and powerful abilities yet, requiring careful management of resources to maintain its effects.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Got a minute? This one's a doozy — you'll need to focus on it like it's your only friend!

abilities.name: Feral Rampage Dive
abilities.description: Leap into the fray, dealing thunder damage and forcing enemies within reach to make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a powerful offensive and control option that complements existing abilities like Feral Overpower and Fury Shout, fitting at level 13.

rules.effect: You leap into melee, dealing 2d6 thunder damage to all creatures within reach. Creatures in your path must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 18) or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You gain disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn.

abilities.apReason: The ability offers significant combat impact with area of effect damage and control, justifying the higher AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Nah, you’re already dizzy from all that rage. Take a nap before diving into battle again!

abilities.name: Astral Cascade
abilities.description: Invoke the stars to rain down an array of celestial darts that deal radiant damage.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows for high-damage area-of-effect attacks that match other level 13 spells but focuses on the unique theme of celestial magic.

rules.effect: Summons a cascade of 3d6 radiant damage stars, dealing the damage to all creatures in a 30-foot cone.
rules.drawback: Concentrating on this ability reduces your spell save DC by 2 until the end of your next turn.

abilities.apReason: The spell has a significant effect with a cone AoE and deals substantial radiant damage, justifying its AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Hey kid! Don't go wasting all your spells! You'll need them for the big boss!

abilities.name: Overwhelming Overload
abilities.description: Unleash an overwhelming surge of strength that damages enemies and knocks them prone.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides significant combat utility at level 13, dealing large area damage and knocking foes prone.

rules.effect: Deal 4d6 + STR modifier damage to all creatures in a 10-foot radius and knock them prone. Creatures within the area must make a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You are vulnerable to critical hits until the end of your next turn.

abilities.apReason: The effect is powerful enough that it requires a high AP cost to balance its effectiveness.
abilities.warioNote: You’re packing so much power you can’t even stand straight! Remember to take it easy or you’ll collapse!

abilities.name: Silent Shadow Leap
abilities.description: Leap into the shadows and land behind an unaware target.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a strong combat advantage by leveraging stealth for a surprise attack, fitting a level where such abilities are impactful but not overpowered.

rules.effect: You make a Dexterity (Stealth) check contested by the target's Perception. On a success, you land within 5 feet of your target and they are surprised until the start of their next turn.
rules.drawback: The target can use its action on the first round to attempt an opposed Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against you.

abilities.apReason: This ability offers significant tactical utility and a rare surprise effect, justifying the AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Ooh, you think you can sneak up on me? Well, you gotta be quiet as a mouse... but if I catch you, watch out for my sticky trap!

abilities.name: Commanding Vanguard
abilities.description: Inspire your allies to the frontline with a rallying cry that grants them temporary hit points and advantage on initiative rolls.
abilities.levelReason: This ability enhances allies' defenses and initiative, providing a significant tactical advantage in combat.

rules.effect: Allies within 30 feet gain +2 to AC until the end of their next turn and have temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1). They also have advantage on initiative rolls.
rules.drawback: You must spend 5 AP to activate this ability.

abilities.apReason: Activating an important leadership ability that provides a lasting benefit at the cost of Action Points.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! It's like giving your friends a shiny new shield and making 'em faster on their feet... for a price, o' course!

abilities.name: Toad's Potion Mastery
abilities.description: Quickly concoct an emergency potion that restores hit points to the user.
abilities.levelReason: At level 13, this ability allows a commoner to rapidly heal themselves without consuming an action or requiring ingredients.

rules.effect: Conjure a small vial of potent elixir which heals you for 2d6 + your Constitution modifier hit points.
rules.drawback: The potion is fragile and must be consumed immediately after creation, leaving no time to dodge.

abilities.apReason: Mimics the utility of more advanced potion-making abilities but is available at a lower cost than similar abilities at other levels.
abilities.warioNote: Hey, it’s not like I’m charging you extra for this quick fix! Just be careful—those vials are mighty fragile!

abilities.name: Mass Shield Stomp
abilities.description: Stomp the ground to create an area of interlocking shields that protects allies and deals damage to enemies within.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales well with the character's level and provides both offensive and defensive benefits.

rules.effect: Allies within a 10-foot radius gain +2 AC until the start of your next turn. Enemies in the area take 4d8 bludgeoning damage and must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You must use an action to stomp the ground, costing you movement for that round.

abilities.apReason: Provides significant group benefit via AC boost and area damage/routing enemies at a higher AP cost than lower-level abilities, justifying its place as an advanced option for a seasoned militia member.
abilities.warioNote: Ya gotta use an action to make this thing work! But it's worth the effort, right?

abilities.name: Feral Carnage
abilities.description: Transform into a berserker, gaining massive strength and dealing extra damage to enemies within reach.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a long-term boost in combat prowess at the cost of vulnerability and health.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you choose to end it
rules.effect: For the duration, your Strength is increased by 2 (to a maximum of 24). You deal an additional 3d6 damage with weapon attacks. However, you take an extra 1d6 damage from all sources.
rules.drawback: You are vulnerable to critical hits.

abilities.apReason: Significant buffs that last for an extended time require a high AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there, buddy! You think this gonna make you invincible? Nah, it'll just make ya more fragile. But the damage... oh boy, the damage!

abilities.name: Rampage Demolition
abilities.description: Smash through multiple foes in one powerful strike, dealing massive damage to all within reach.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the fighter's strength and allows for devastating area-of-effect damage at level 14.

rules.effect: Choose up to three creatures within reach. Each creature takes 8d6 bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone.
rules.drawback: After using Rampage Demolition, you must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of your next turn.

abilities.apReason: The powerful effect requires significant concentration and leaves a lasting impact on the user.
abilities.warioNote: You better have a strong constitution, buddy! One wrong move after this and you're as good as down for the count!

abilities.name: Dual Barrage
abilities.description: Simultaneously fire two shots that deal an additional 4d6 damage each to two separate targets.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows for strategic targeting of multiple foes with significant explosive potential, fitting for a level 14 Gunslinger.

rules.effect: Fire two shots, dealing 8d6+DEX modifier piercing damage to the first target and an additional 4d6 damage each to a second distinct target.
rules.drawback: Spend 2 grit to activate.

abilities.apReason: The dual shots require careful aim and preparation, justifying the AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! It's like you're splitting your attention between two targets. You better not miss!

abilities.name: Toad's Shield Charm
abilities.description: Create a shimmering toad shield that grants nearby allies temporary hit points.
abilities.levelReason: This support ability at level 14 provides a significant benefit to allies while still costing something in terms of defense.

rules.effect: You create a toad-shaped shield of magic, granting each ally within 10 feet 5 temporary hit points. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you use this ability again.
rules.drawback: While the shield is active, you lose your Dexterity bonus to AC.

abilities.apReason: Creating a protective barrier for allies requires tactical consideration and is valuable, but not overly powerful.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Need some extra protection? This ability’s great, just remember—less dodging for you!

abilities.name: Holy Reckoning
abilities.description: Unleash a holy storm that deals radiant damage to all creatures within an area and imposes disadvantage on their saving throws until the end of your next turn.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales well with the character's level, providing a powerful but costly utility at a higher tier.

rules.duration: until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: Creatures within a 20-foot radius must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, they take 4d6 radiant damage and have disadvantage on all saving throws until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You become Exhausted (reduced to half maximum hit points) until the end of your next long rest.

abilities.apReason: The effect is large area and has a significant drawback in exhaustion.
abilities.warioNote: Wahahaha! Holy Reckoning? You'll feel it... until you sleep it off!

abilities.name: Fury's Vortex
abilities.description: Create a swirling vortex of primal energy that pulls enemies towards you and deals damage.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows a barbarian to control the battlefield by drawing enemies close, dealing significant damage while maintaining a risk for the user.

rules.effect: Enemies within 10 feet must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pulled towards the vortex, taking 3d6 force damage. Those that succeed take half damage.
rules.drawback: You are also pulled towards the vortex and take 1d6 force damage each round it is active.

abilities.apReason: This ability requires a reaction and has a moderate drawback, making it balanced at level 15.
abilities.warioNote: Whoo! Watch out, bub! You might just find yourself in that vortex too!

abilities.name: Titanic Counter
abilities.description: Counter an enemy's attack, redirecting their momentum and dealing force damage.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a valuable defensive option that scales with the fighter's strength, fitting well at level 15.

rules.effect: When you are the target of a melee attack, you can use your reaction to counter it. You deal force damage equal to 2d6 + your Strength modifier and push the attacker back 10 feet.
rules.drawback: You must be hit by the attack to activate this ability.

abilities.apReason: Activating this ability during combat requires quick thinking and can be costly in terms of opportunities lost.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! Ya gotta get hit ta use this! Lemme keep mah prices down, y'hear!

abilities.name: Conjuring Valor
abilities.description: Summon a shield of light that grants temporary hit points equal to your Leader level.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides significant defensive support and benefits allies, fitting for a level 15 leader who can bolster their team's resilience in prolonged conflicts.

rules.effect: A shimmering shield of light forms around you, granting you 15 temporary hit points. Allies within 30 feet gain the same benefit.
rules.drawback: You must use an action to dismiss this effect early if it becomes too dangerous.

abilities.warioNote: T'aint cheap! But it's worth every AP when your shield keeps you and your allies alive!

abilities.name: Toad's Fortify
abilities.description: Temporarily increase the defense of an ally within your reach.
abilities.levelReason: Support abilities are valuable at higher levels where combat pressure increases. This ability provides crucial defensive support.

rules.effect: Until the end of their next turn, a touched ally gains +2 to AC and advantage on saving throws against non-magical attacks.
rules.drawback: You become the target of any attack that your ally would have taken.

abilities.apReason: Provides significant benefits to an allied fighter, making it a worthwhile action to use in critical situations.
abilities.warioNote: You're so cozy with your buddy, you might get caught in that arrow yourself! Eep!

abilities.name: Forge Resilience
abilities.description: Fortify your defenses with a surge of molten metal, granting you and nearby allies temporary hit points.
abilities.levelReason: This utility power provides a significant defensive boost that aligns with other high-level artisan abilities like Masterwork Finish and Masterpiece Defense.

rules.effect: You and all willing creatures within 5 feet gain temporary hit points equal to your level + your Intelligence modifier. This effect lasts for a full minute.
rules.drawback: After using this ability, you must spend the next long rest without crafting any items.

abilities.apReason: The short cooldown and moderate AP cost reflect the ability's utility-focused nature, providing a worthwhile benefit for its cost.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there, you ain't no tool unless ya got the cash to spare after this one!

abilities.name: Sanctified Retribution
abilities.description: Call forth a wave of divine retribution that deals radiant damage to all enemies within 20 feet and forces them to make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the start of your next turn.
abilities.levelReason: This ability requires a long rest to use, making it powerful but not overpowered for a level 16 paladin.

rules.duration: until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: Deal 4d8+CHA modifier radiant damage to all creatures within 20 feet. They must make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until your next turn.
rules.drawback: You must complete a short rest after using this ability.

abilities.apReason: The effect is highly damaging and has a significant duration effect, justifying its AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! You're gonna need to rest up after that one! Gotta save your energy for the next big fight!

abilities.name: Shadowsplit Barrage
abilities.description: Leap through shadows to unleash a volley of strikes against multiple enemies.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with rogue abilities by allowing multiple targets and increasing damage output, fitting a level 16 rogue's power curve.

rules.effect: Deal 2d6 slashing damage per target you hit, up to three targets within your reach. After the attack, you must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or become disoriented until the end of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You become disoriented until the end of your next turn after using this ability.

abilities.apReason: The ability provides significant combat utility but has a cost to the rogue in terms of disorientation.
abilities.warioNote: Nah, you think that just because you can hit multiple enemies, it don't mean you won't mess up your own head. Use this one right or it’ll be a long walk back!

abilities.name: Raging Annihilation
abilities.description: In a primal fury, you annihilate your foes with unyielding strikes that deal massive damage.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a significant damage boost at the cost of reduced resilience, fitting for a level 16 barbarian.

rules.effect: For one turn, deal an additional 4d6 + strength modifier damage on each melee hit. This effect can be used a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus (typically 3 or 4).
rules.drawback: Using Raging Annihilation imposes disadvantage on all saving throws and ability checks until the end of your next short rest.

abilities.apReason: The powerful effect and duration justify this AP cost given its combat-centric nature.
abilities.warioNote: Ya better be ready fer some tough times after ya unleash that fury! Yer gonna be takin' more hits than a greasy chef!

abilities.name: Titan's Siege
abilities.description: Engage in an unholy assault, dealing force damage and granting temporary hit points.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the character's level, providing significant damage output in exchange for a duration cost.

rules.effect: Deal force damage equal to your level + Strength modifier to all creatures within 5 feet. You gain temporary hit points equal to 2 * your Fighter level.
rules.drawback: You are incapacitated and cannot take reactions until the end of this minute.

abilities.apReason: The ability requires careful positioning and deals substantial damage over time, justifying its AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: You go down for a minute, pal! That’s the price of this unholy might!

abilities.name: Commanding Harmony
abilities.description: Unite allies in perfect harmony, reducing all damage taken by half until the end of your next turn.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a significant defensive boost at level 16, aligning with other high-level leadership abilities that offer powerful effects.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: All allies within 30 feet reduce damage taken by half until the end of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You must use your Action to activate this ability.

abilities.apReason: The effect of halving damage for all nearby allies justifies the Action cost and unique benefit.
abilities.warioNote: Use yer Action wisely, mister! Ya only get one chance to make 'em all sing in harmony!

abilities.name: Toad's Whirlwind
abilities.description: Summons a tornado of toads that deals 2d6 force damage and knocks back all enemies within its radius.
abilities.levelReason: As a level 16 ability, it builds on existing toad-themed combat abilities while offering a new and powerful effect.

rules.effect: Create a 15-foot-radius whirlwind that deals 2d6 force damage to all creatures within its area. Creatures in the area must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked back 10 feet.
rules.drawback: You are also caught in the whirlwind and take half as much damage.

abilities.apReason: The area of effect and damage scale with the character's level while maintaining the thematic utility of toads.
abilities.warioNote: Toads sure know how to make a mess! But hey, you get to knock 'em back too!

abilities.name: Mass Shield Barrier
abilities.description: Bolster your allies with a wall of shields, granting temporary hit points to all nearby defenders.
abilities.levelReason: This ability requires a reaction, offers significant combat support, and has a meaningful drawback by requiring proximity to allies.

rules.effect: All allies within 15 feet gain +2 to AC and 10 temporary hit points until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You must be within 30 feet of at least two allies for this ability to function.

abilities.apReason: Provides area-of-effect support with temporary hit points and increased AC, which is costly in terms of resource management for the player.
abilities.warioNote: Ya gotta be close ta yer friends fer dis one, otherwise it's jus' a big ol' miss!

abilities.name: Forgevein Tap
abilities.description: Tap into the veins of the earth to summon a wave of molten metal that deals force damage to all creatures within 30 feet.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the character's INT modifier and provides a significant combat advantage in area-effect damage, befitting an Artisan at level 16.

rules.effect: Summons a wave of molten metal dealing 6d8 + INT modifier force damage to all creatures within 30 feet. Targets can make a Dexterity saving throw to halve the damage.
rules.drawback: Requires the artisan to expend 100 gp worth of materials to fuel the effect.

abilities.apReason: The powerful area-of-effect damage and duration justify the AP cost of 4.
abilities.warioNote: Sellin' materials fo' 100 gp? Thats a steal! Or is it? Ya gotta do th' math!

abilities.name: Divine Oathkeeper
abilities.description: Swear an unbreakable oath that compels you to avenge the fallen or protect the innocent, granting temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier + twice your Paladin level.
abilities.levelReason: This ability represents a significant commitment that aligns with a Paladin's duty, fitting their level 17.

rules.effect: When you swear an oath, gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier + twice your Paladin level. These hit points last for 1 hour or until you take damage.
rules.drawback: You must fulfill the terms of the oath within a week, otherwise you incur a -2 penalty to all Charisma checks and saving throws for one month.

abilities.apReason: Activating the oath requires a reaction, which is a rare opportunity, and the temporary hit points granted are substantial.
abilities.warioNote: Swear too many oaths, and you'll find yourself in a heap of trouble! Stick to one at a time!

abilities.name: Fury's Annihilation
abilities.description: You channel primal energy into an unstoppable storm of destruction that devastates enemies within a burst.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the character's strength modifier and provides a devastating burst attack suitable for an experienced barbarian.

rules.effect: In a 20-foot radius around you, unleash a storm of primal energy that deals 8d6 + STR modifier fire damage. Creatures within this area must make a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and take an additional 3d6 fire damage at the start of their next turn.
rules.drawback: This ability exhausts you, reducing your speed by half until the end of your next long rest.

abilities.apReason: The high AP cost reflects the powerful damage output and area effect, requiring significant preparation before use.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! You want to unleash that kind of fury? That’ll be five Action Points, bub! Or is it rest you’re thinking about? Either way, it’s not cheap!

abilities.name: Arcane Nexus
abilities.description: Forge a nexus of power that drains an enemy's life force for a brief moment.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the wizard's high Intelligence modifier and leverages significant damage at close range.

rules.effect: Target must succeed on a DC 29 Wisdom saving throw or take 6d8 necrotic damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.
rules.drawback: You are temporarily weakened; you have disadvantage on all attack rolls and ability checks until the end of your next turn.

abilities.apReason: This ability requires careful positioning, strategic use, and a significant cooldown, justifying its AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! Ya got one shot at this 'nexus' thingy. Use it wisely, or be left in the dust!

abilities.name: Titan's Reckoning
abilities.description: Unleash a titanic force that shatters all in its path.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows fighters to capitalize on their last moments, ensuring an explosive final stand.

rules.effect: When you are reduced to 0 hit points, you can use this ability as a reaction. You unleash a devastating force that deals 5d8 + Strength modifier slashing damage to all creatures within 30 feet. Each creature must succeed on a DC 24 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You are incapacitated until the end of your next turn.

abilities.apReason: The ability's powerful effect and limited use make it a valuable resource at level 17.
abilities.warioNote: Oh yeah? So you’re gonna need a lot of healing after that little stunt! And don’t forget your long rest, buddy!

abilities.name: Gunstorm Barrage
abilities.description: Unleash a barrage of gunfire that forces enemies to make a Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the character's proficiency in firearms and deals significant damage while offering a knockdown effect.

rules.effect: Fire a volley of bullets at one target within range, dealing 8d6 piercing damage. On a failed save, the target is knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You must reload your firearm after using this ability.

abilities.apReason: Requires careful aim and leaves the gunslinger vulnerable for an action to reload.
abilities.warioNote: You’re gonna need some extra brass, pal! Reload after this one!

abilities.name: Phantom Web
abilities.description: Weave a web of shadows that ensnares an enemy, immobilizing them for a turn.
abilities.levelReason: At level 17, this ability provides a powerful but balanced option for controlling enemies over time.

rules.effect: Target must succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained by a web of shadows, reducing their movement speed to zero for the duration.
rules.drawback: You leave behind an ink residue that leaves you visible and exposed within 10 feet.

abilities.apReason: This ability requires careful planning and has a significant duration, making it costly in action points.
abilities.warioNote: Leave a trail of ink, huh? Yer gonna need a bath after this one, partner!

abilities.name: Unity's Reckoning
abilities.description: Unleash the power of unity to obliterate foes with a devastating strike.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a potent burst of damage and defensive capabilities, but requires you to be in close proximity to the target.

rules.effect: Choose one creature within 30 feet that you can see. You and all allies within 5 feet gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier + Wisdom modifier. The chosen target takes an amount of force damage equal to twice your level.
rules.drawback: You must be the closest ally to the chosen target.

abilities.apReason: The ability offers significant benefits to allies with a large cost to the leader themselves.
abilities.warioNote: You better not miss! Or you're paying for that shield wall twice!

abilities.name: Fury's Unyielding
abilities.description: You enter an unrelenting state of fury, gaining immunity to all non-magical damage and doubling your speed.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a significant boon in terms of survivability and mobility, fitting well for a level 18 Barbarian who seeks to endure prolonged combat without succumbing to non-magical harm.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you are reduced to 0 HP
rules.effect: For the duration, you have immunity to all non-magical damage and your speed increases by +15 feet. This effect ends early if you take any magical damage.
rules.drawback: If you take any magical damage while in this state, it immediately ends.

abilities.apReason: The ability offers substantial benefits in terms of survival and speed, making it a significant tactical asset that costs four AP.
abilities.warioNote: Ye better keep those magic spells outta reach, else you're done for! WAAAAAAAH!

abilities.name: Ethereal Requiem
abilities.description: Create a resonant wave of ethereal sound that deals 8d6 lightning damage to all creatures within 30 feet, blinding them for 1 minute on a failed saving throw.
abilities.levelReason: This ability leverages the wizard's control over arcane energies to create a powerful and blinding sonic effect, suitable for a level 18 spell.

rules.effect: Creatures within 30 feet must make a DC 25 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. They take 8d6 lightning damage on a failed save.
rules.drawback: Requires concentration (ends early if lost)

abilities.warioNote: Ehhh... You gonna need some earplugs for this one, buddy. Or maybe just stay outside?

abilities.name: Earthshaking Stomp
abilities.description: Stomp the ground with devastating force, knocking down all enemies within reach and dealing heavy damage.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the fighter's strength and provides a powerful area-of-effect combat option befitting an 18th-level fighter.

rules.effect: You make a powerful stomp, causing each creature within 5 feet of you to make a DC 28 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. On a failed save, they take 3d10 bludgeoning damage.
rules.drawback: You must concentrate on this action for the duration; if interrupted, your concentration is broken.

abilities.apReason: The ability offers significant damage and control effects within its range, justifying its high AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: You gotta focus for this one! If you blink, you’re toast, ya big oaf!

abilities.name: Reload Ignition
abilities.description: Boost your firearm's damage and rate of fire in exchange for an expended action point.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the Gunslinger's level by providing significant offensive boosts in exchange for an expensive resource, making it a fitting level 18 feature.

rules.effect: For the next hour, your firearms deal an additional +2d8 damage and allow you to fire twice as many rounds before needing a reload.
rules.drawback: You must spend 1 Action Point (AP) when activating this ability.

abilities.apReason: Activating this ability requires expending two Action Points to achieve its powerful effect.
abilities.warioNote: Ya better be ready to spend some AP, partner! Reload Ignition's gonna take 'em!

abilities.name: Shadow Gambit
abilities.description: Deceive and exploit an enemy's next action, redirecting their attack to a target of your choice.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows for dynamic combat manipulation, fitting well with the Spy's thematic focus on deception and stealth at level 18.

rules.effect: As a reaction, when an enemy within 30 feet attacks you or casts a spell, you can redirect their attack to any target of your choice within range. The attack roll is made normally against the new target. On a hit, the original target takes no damage.
rules.drawback: You must be within sight and line of effect for this redirection to work.

abilities.apReason: Redirecting an enemy's attack requires a significant strategic advantage and is considered a high-value ability.
abilities.warioNote: Yo, it's like takin' somethin’ away from one guy 'n givin' it to another! And you gotta be lookin', too!

abilities.name: Toad's Verdant Shield
abilities.description: Raise a protective barrier of vines and thorns that blocks incoming attacks.
abilities.levelReason: This ability enhances the commoner's defensive capabilities in a unique way at level 18.

rules.effect: Create a 5-foot-radius barrier around you for 1 minute. Creatures entering the area must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 piercing damage.
rules.drawback: While protected by this shield, your movement speed is reduced to half.

abilities.apReason: Provides a significant utility and defensive advantage but comes with a movement penalty.
abilities.warioNote: Move slower, toad? Why don't ya just sit still then!?

abilities.name: Wall of Shields
abilities.description: Erect a wall of shields around you and your allies, creating a formidable barrier that blocks the first attack made against any one creature within range.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows for critical defensive positioning and is meant to be a last-resort reaction rather than an action, fitting the utility lane of the class.

rules.effect: Choose one creature within 10 feet. That creature and all allies adjacent to it gain a +4 bonus to AC against the next attack made against them that they have not already resisted this turn.
rules.drawback: You are vulnerable until your next action, meaning you cannot perform any actions other than reactions during this time.

abilities.apReason: The ability requires careful timing and placement as it blocks only one attack per creature within the wall's range.
abilities.warioNote: Vulnerable! You're wide open until you act again. Why not just stand there? 🛡️

abilities.name: Sovereign Retribution
abilities.description: Call upon your sovereignty to deliver a final strike that turns the tide of battle.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a powerful defensive reaction at high levels, ensuring critical moments are turned to the paladin's favor.

rules.effect: As a reaction, when an enemy reduces you to 20 or fewer hit points, you can use this ability. You make a melee attack against the attacking creature. On a successful hit, it takes 5d10 radiant damage and is knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You cannot use Sovereign Retribution again until after completing a long rest.

abilities.apReason: The risk of being reduced to low hit points and the need for a long rest between uses justify the moderate action point cost.
abilities.warioNote: Ya better be at full health, otherwise it’s no use! Wasting an AP on this when ya're hurt? Ya gotta think ahead!

abilities.name: Shadowstep Sovereign
abilities.description: Summon a shadowy sovereign to command enemies, forcing them to attack you or your allies.
abilities.levelReason: This ability reflects the level's power curve, providing an impactful combat tool without overbalancing the rogue at this level.

rules.effect: Summons a shadowy sovereign that exerts influence within 30 feet. Enemies within this radius must make a DC 25 Wisdom saving throw or target the nearest living creature with an attack on their next turn.
rules.drawback: The sovereign can only be summoned once per long rest and requires a successful DC 18 Intelligence (Arcana) check to summon.

abilities.apReason: The effect of forcing enemies into attacking targets they may not have chosen otherwise is powerful and requires a rare resource to use.
abilities.warioNote: Only one sovereign at a time, ya greedy bunch! Take it or leave it!

abilities.name: Stormborn Tempest
abilities.description: Channel the fury of the tempest to unleash devastating strikes against your foes.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides significant combat prowess at level 19 by enhancing core stats and attack damage while introducing a situational drawback.

rules.effect: You gain +4 to STR and CON, deal an additional 3d6 damage with melee attacks. This effect also imposes disadvantage on saving throws against being knocked prone.
rules.drawback: While active, you are vulnerable to severe weather effects within a 50-foot radius.

abilities.apReason: The increased damage and stat boosts are substantial, requiring a high AP cost to reflect the powerful nature of the ability.
abilities.warioNote: Ya better find shelter, partner! This one's so strong, even the storm clouds take notice!

abilities.name: Colossal Smash
abilities.description: Smash through enemies in your path, dealing devastating damage and creating an area of destruction.
abilities.levelReason: This ability requires a reaction to use and deals significant area-of-effect damage, fitting the power level of a level 19 fighter.

rules.effect: Choose one creature within 5 feet. You make a Strength (Athletics) check contested by the target's Dexterity (Acrobatics) or Strength (Athletics). On a success, you knock the creature prone and deal 6d8 bludgeoning damage plus your Strength modifier. Creatures within 10 feet must succeed on a DC 25 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and take 3d8 bludgeoning damage.
rules.drawback: You cannot use Colossal Smash again until after you complete a long rest.

abilities.apReason: Colossal Smash is an instant-kill reaction that affects multiple targets in its range, making it very powerful. It justifies a high AP cost to ensure it’s used strategically.
abilities.warioNote: Ooh-la-la! This one's strong enough to take out half the battlefield with one swing!

abilities.name: Crimson Vortex
abilities.description: Create a swirling crimson vortex of bullets that pulls enemies toward you and deals piercing damage.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a powerful control effect for long-duration combat, fitting the level 19 capstone.

rules.effect: Enemies within 30 feet are pulled toward the caster. For each enemy within the area, they must make a Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone and take 4d6 piercing damage.
rules.drawback: You must expend one use of your grit.

abilities.apReason: It offers a significant area-of-effect and control effect with a cost in resources.
abilities.warioNote: Ya better got yer grit ready, 'cause it ain't cheap ta call down that crimson vortex!

abilities.name: Crowning Sacrifice
abilities.description: Offer yourself in a mighty surge that devastates the enemy and heals allies.
abilities.levelReason: This ability represents an ultimate show of leadership where the leader's sacrifice brings about a decisive turn in battle.

rules.effect: All allies within 30 feet heal for 4d8 hit points, and deal an additional 3d6 damage to all enemies in a 15-foot cone.
rules.drawback: You must drop to 0 hit points to activate this ability.

abilities.apReason: The high AP cost reflects the immense power and risk involved, requiring a significant personal sacrifice from the leader.
abilities.warioNote: Wahahaha! Gotta love a good show of loyalty... or idiocy!

abilities.name: Toad's Territorial Roar
abilities.description: Loudly proclaim your territory with a fearsome roar, causing nearby enemies to recoil in fear and reducing their AC.
abilities.levelReason: This ability complements the existing combat and magic abilities, providing a utility-focused option that affects multiple foes in an area around you.

rules.effect: All enemies within the 30-foot radius must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or have their AC reduced by -2 until the start of their next turn. This effect cannot be resisted.
rules.drawback: You lose your ability to speak coherently for the duration of your next short rest.

abilities.apReason: The effect of reducing AC on all nearby enemies within one round justifies a moderate AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Listen to your toad instincts! Or maybe just keep quiet and don’t talk too loud...

abilities.name: Fortress Guard
abilities.description: Erect an unshakable shield wall, granting temporary hit points to allies within the area and imposing a severe movement penalty on enemies.
abilities.levelReason: This ability reflects a Militia's role in providing steadfast defense and imposing significant penalties on the enemy while maintaining protective barriers for allies.

rules.effect: Create a 20-foot-radius barrier that provides temporary hit points equal to your Constitution modifier + twice your level. All allies within the area gain advantage on saving throws against fear and poison effects, but movement speed is reduced by half.
rules.drawback: You must expend one of your action points to activate this ability.

abilities.apReason: Activating such an area-based defensive ability that provides extended benefits requires a strategic expenditure of resources.
abilities.warioNote: Ya gotta shell out an action point ta build this steel wall! Ya ain't cheap!

abilities.name: Divine Sovereignty
abilities.description: Embody your divine sovereignty to grant allies and yourself a surge of strength and resilience.
abilities.levelReason: This ability enhances the paladin's leadership and support abilities, fitting at level 20 as it provides an ongoing benefit for both self and allies.

rules.effect: Grant all allies within 30 feet temporary hit points equal to your Paladin level + your Wisdom modifier. You gain this benefit as well.
rules.drawback: You and all affected allies are exposed to any ongoing damage effects they were previously immune to.

abilities.apReason: The ability provides a continuous benefit for the entire party, making it more costly than a single-use combat ability.
abilities.warioNote: You just bought the farm if you're not careful! With this deal, you’re trading your life for everyone else’s! WAAAAAAAH!

abilities.name: Tempest's Unleashing
abilities.description: Invoke the tempest within and unleash a torrent of damage and fury upon your foes.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a significant increase in damage output at the cost of defensive capability, suitable for a level 20 barbarian who has already maxed out their physical and combat capabilities.

rules.effect: Deal an additional 4d6 damage to all creatures within 30 feet at the start of each of your turns. For every creature within this radius, you take a -1 penalty to AC until the end of the encounter.
rules.drawback: You lose your Dexterity bonus to AC for the duration.

abilities.apReason: This ability significantly boosts the barbarian's damage output with a strong drawback affecting defense, justifying its high AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Tough luck, pal! You gotta trade some armor for that extra stormy power. Ain't no free lunch in this game!

abilities.name: Eternal Nexus
abilities.description: Forge an unbreakable bond between yourself and the arcane, drawing power from it indefinitely.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows wizards to maintain a constant state of amplified spellcasting power and area-effect potency, making it suitable for level 20 where it can have significant impact.

rules.effect: For the duration, you gain a +2 bonus to all spell attack rolls and spell DCs. Additionally, any spell with an area of effect or that affects creatures within a radius deals an extra 2d6 damage.
rules.drawback: You must focus your mind entirely on maintaining this bond, reducing your Intelligence score by 1 for the duration.

abilities.apReason: The ability provides an extensive bonus to spell attack rolls and DCs, along with additional damage, which is highly beneficial. The drawback of reducing Intelligence temporarily justifies the high AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Meh! You're too focused on that arcane bond, pal! Maybe you should take a break from all those spells!

abilities.name: Final Bullet Waltz
abilities.description: In a final flourish, you fire your last bullet at an enemy, dealing massive damage and forcing them to make a saving throw or be stunned.
abilities.levelReason: This is the pinnacle of a Gunslinger's prowess, requiring both finesse and raw power.

rules.effect: Target must succeed on a DC 25 Wisdom saving throw or become stunned until the end of their next turn. This attack deals 8d6 piercing damage.
rules.drawback: You lose your weapon after using this ability.

abilities.apReason: It represents a final, devastating strike that can turn the tide in combat.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! You’re not supposed to be using your last bullet on that! Find another gun!

abilities.name: Crowning Apex
abilities.description: Lead your allies to their peak performance, granting each one temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier + half your level.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the character's overall power as they advance, providing a significant but limited boost to allied resilience and durability.

rules.effect: Each ally within 30 feet regains (your Charisma modifier + half your level) temporary hit points. This effect can only be used once per day.
rules.drawback: You must complete a short rest before using this ability again.

abilities.apReason: The daily nature of the ability requires careful management of resources and a meaningful cost in terms of recovery time.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! It's not every day you get this strong! Save it for when you really need to shine!

abilities.name: Toad's Epic Resilience
abilities.description: Your toad resilience becomes legendary, allowing you to recover from the most dire of situations.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the character's max HP and provides a significant boost in utility for critical situations.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until end of next short rest
rules.effect: Gain +5 to all saving throws for 1 minute, but you lose your hit points equal to your current hit point maximum at the start of each of your turns.
rules.drawback: You gradually weaken yourself to achieve temporary resilience.

abilities.apReason: The risk of losing a considerable amount of hit points per turn justifies this high AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Ya better be careful, lil' toad! If ya overdo it here, yer gonna need all those extra HP just to recover!

abilities.name: Mighty Shield Barrage
abilities.description: Unleash a barrage of steel-shield strikes that deals bludgeoning damage to all enemies in the area.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the character's Constitution and provides a significant damage output at close range, fitting for a level 20 player.

rules.effect: Deal 8d6 + your Constitution modifier bludgeoning damage to each enemy within 15 feet. You are incapacitated until the end of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You are incapacitated until the end of your next turn, preventing you from taking actions or reactions.

abilities.apReason: The incapacitation effect and the high-damage output justify this as a costly 5 AP ability.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! You can't just waltz in here and wreck everything with that shield barrage! Ya gotta pay the toll!

abilities.name: Arcane Web
abilities.description: Weave together threads of magic to ensnare creatures within a 20-foot radius.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the wizard's spellcasting capabilities and provides a potent area effect at level 2.
