rules.effect: Creatures within the area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they are restrained by an invisible web for the duration. They can use their action to make another saving throw.
rules.drawback: You must expend one spell slot of 2nd level or higher to cast this spell.

abilities.apReason: It requires a long rest for re-use, adding an opportunity cost in terms of preparation time.
abilities.warioNote: You don't have all day! Save that big spell until you really need it!

abilities.name: Two-Handed Smash
abilities.description: Deal an extra 1d8 damage with your two-handed weapon and gain advantage on the next attack roll.
abilities.levelReason: This ability introduces a cost-effective way to improve combat prowess by sacrificing an action in favor of a damage and chance boost.

rules.effect: When you use an action to make a melee attack with your two-handed weapon, you deal an extra 1d8 damage. On the same turn, gain advantage on any subsequent melee attack.
rules.drawback: You must use your Action for this move, reducing the number of attacks in your Action.

abilities.apReason: It requires using an action, which is a limited resource, providing balance at level 2.
abilities.warioNote: Ya better think twice 'bout givin' up yer Action fo' dis one! Ya might miss out on that extra attack!

abilities.name: Shield Block
abilities.description: Block incoming melee attacks to reduce damage by half and gain advantage on your next attack.
abilities.levelReason: Provides defensive value at close range without requiring the use of another action

rules.effect: When you are hit with a melee attack, halve the damage taken and gain a +2 bonus to your next attack roll against the attacker.
rules.drawback: You cannot make an opportunity attack this turn.

abilities.apReason: Allows for both defense and offense, making it a balanced choice
abilities.warioNote: Block that thing! Then go get 'em! One hit and you're free to strike back - but no sneaky attacks!

abilities.name: Toolchain Shield
abilities.description: Raise your arms to block incoming attacks with a toolset, reducing damage by 1d6 + Intelligence modifier.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides immediate defensive support at level 2, complementing existing offensive abilities like Tool Toss and Toolchain Surge.

rules.effect: When an attack is made against you, reduce the damage taken by 1d6 + your Intelligence modifier. You must be holding a tool or improvised weapon to use this ability.
rules.drawback: You can only use Toolchain Shield once per short rest.

abilities.apReason: The reaction activation requires a strategic use of resources to protect oneself in combat.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! You're only allowed one shield up at a time, so pick your moment wisely!

abilities.name: Divine Shielding
abilities.description: Create a radiant barrier that grants an ally within 30 feet temporary hit points equal to your Paladin level.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides significant defensive support at a reasonable cost, fitting for a level 3 paladin.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you use this feature again
rules.effect: An ally within 30 feet gains temporary hit points equal to your Paladin level when you activate this ability.
rules.drawback: You become blinded and deafened while the shield exists.

abilities.apReason: The drawback of becoming blinded and deafened is a tangible penalty that costs an Action Point.
abilities.warioNote: Blind as a bat? Deaf as a post? That's the price you pay for keeping your friend safe! Wuhu!

abilities.name: Feral Berserker
abilities.description: Enter berserk mode, gaining temporary hit points and increasing your Strength bonus to damage rolls by 1.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a significant boost to survivability and melee prowess, fitting for level 3.

rules.effect: Gain 2d8 temporary hit points and increase your Strength bonus to damage rolls by 1 until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You cannot use other actions or bonus actions while in berserk mode.

abilities.apReason: Requires a short rest to recover, indicating its potent effects on the character's combat capabilities.
abilities.warioNote: You're goin' in berserk mode, huh? You won't be makin' any other moves 'til you cool down. Good luck!

abilities.name: Shattering Spin
abilities.description: Spin your weapon in an arc, dealing slashing damage to all creatures within reach.
abilities.levelReason: At level 3, this ability provides a powerful area-of-effect combat option while maintaining balance with existing abilities.

rules.effect: Make a melee attack against each creature within the 5-foot radius centered on you. On a hit, deal 2d6 + Strength modifier slashing damage.
rules.drawback: You must focus your concentration for the next round and take the Attack action.

abilities.apReason: Requires an action to activate and deals significant damage within a small radius.
abilities.warioNote: Ya gotta focus on yer spin for the next round! Yer not fightin' with distractions, got it?

abilities.name: Invisible Emitter
abilities.description: Emit an invisible pulse that confounds nearby creatures.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the spy's level, allowing them to affect a wider area and deal more damage over time.

rules.effect: Allcreatureswithin30feetmustmakeaDexteritysavingthrowDC15ormoderateinjury.
rules.drawback: Afteractivatingthisability,youcannotmoveormakeanattackuntiltheroundends.

abilities.apReason: Emitting an invisible pulse that confounds creatures is a significant offensive action that requires careful planning and preparation.
abilities.warioNote: Yo, fatty! You want to make things invisible? Then you gotta stay still for a bit!

abilities.name: Unified Stand
abilities.description: Unite allies within reach into a defensive formation, granting them advantage on saving throws.
abilities.levelReason: This ability supports the leader's role in bolstering allies and enhancing their resilience, fitting for level 3.

rules.effect: All allies within 10 feet gain advantage on one saving throw per turn. This formation can be reactivated once per short rest.
rules.drawback: You must spend 2 AP to activate this ability.

abilities.apReason: Activating a defensive formation that persists over multiple turns requires a resource.
abilities.warioNote: You gonna need those Action Points to set up that perfect defense! Or is it just me?

abilities.name: Toad's Quickfix
abilities.description: Quickly repair or improvise a broken object, granting +1d4 temporary hit points to yourself.
abilities.levelReason: This utility ability provides a quick fix that benefits both combat and survival, fitting for a level 3 commoner.

rules.effect: Repair an improvised weapon or tool. You gain +1d4 temporary hit points.
rules.drawback: You must spend 10 minutes after using this ability to fully repair the item.

abilities.apReason: Allows use at will but requires a drawback and a cost in time.
abilities.warioNote: Spend 10 minutes on repairs? I thought you were a quickfix toad! You better come back with a fully functional tool!

abilities.name: Shadow Leap
abilities.description: Leap through the shadows to strike behind an enemy with your rapier.
abilities.levelReason: This ability builds upon existing stealth and combat abilities by adding teleportation, a unique feature for Rogues.

rules.effect: Teleport up to 20 feet in a straight line, ending prone behind an enemy within range. You have advantage on your first attack roll against the target.
rules.drawback: You must move at least 15 feet from your starting point.

abilities.apReason: Requires an action and has a significant movement cost as its drawback.
abilities.warioNote: You gonna have to run quite a bit just to get in position, ya little sneak!

abilities.name: Shadowstep Shadowdash
abilities.description: On your movement action, teleport up to 30 feet and make a melee attack.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows for powerful long-range attacks and evasive maneuvers, fitting a level 12 rogue's power curve.

rules.effect: Teleport up to 30 feet, then make a melee attack with advantage against one creature within reach. The target takes an additional 2d6 + DEX modifier slashing damage.
rules.drawback: You must use your movement action for the teleport.

abilities.apReason: Requires an action to teleport and attack, which is a significant resource in combat.
abilities.warioNote: Ooh, you gonna dash around like a widdle rat! Gotta pay for that teleport, ya know?

abilities.name: Spectral Saber
abilities.description: Summons a saber made of ghostly energy to slash at an opponent, dealing radiant damage and leaving behind a spectral imprint.
abilities.levelReason: This ability requires an action to summon and restrain, making it impactful at level 12.

rules.effect: Touching a creature deals 4d6 radiant damage. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or become restrained by spectral energy until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You are exhausted for 1 hour after using this ability.

abilities.apReason: It provides a significant combat effect with a drawback that aligns with the level's power curve.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! This one’s powerful, so remember, no running out of stamina!

abilities.name: Stealthy Misdirection
abilities.description: Deceive your enemies with a clever misdirection, confusing them for one round.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides significant support to the party by confusing enemies, giving allies an opening to strike.

rules.effect: Select up to three creatures you can see within 30 feet. Each must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15) or be confused, forgetting your actions for the duration.
rules.drawback: You cannot take reactions until the start of your next turn.

abilities.apReason: Confusing multiple creatures requires a quick and clever misdirection, justifying the AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there, ya slick rogue! Misdirectin' your foes is one thing—tryin' to confuse them for an entire round? That's gonna cost ya 2 AP!

abilities.name: Silent Shadow Strike
abilities.description: Vanish into shadows and leap to strike an unaware target from behind, dealing 2d6 + Cha modifier piercing damage.
abilities.levelReason: This combat-focused ability fits a Spy's role in close-quarters fighting and adds strategic depth at level 14.

rules.effect: Disappear into shadows and leap to a target within range, landing behind it. You deal 2d6 + your Charisma modifier piercing damage with your next attack against the target.
rules.drawback: After using this ability, you are fatigued until the start of your next short rest.

abilities.apReason: Requires an action to use, making it impactful but not overpowered for its cost.
abilities.warioNote: Eh, disappearin' into the shadows? You’re gonna need a lot of snacks while you're fatigued!

abilities.name: Gunline Charge
abilities.description: Leap forward and unleash a concentrated burst of gunfire that deals 2d8+DEX modifier fire damage to all enemies within a 10-foot line.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a powerful offensive option that complements the existing combat abilities of the Gunslinger.

rules.effect: Deal 2d8+DEX modifier fire damage to all creatures in a 10-foot line. Must move at least 15 feet.
rules.drawback: You must move at least 15 feet towards the target line.

abilities.apReason: Requires careful positioning and movement, making it impactful but not overpowered at this level.
abilities.warioNote: Move it move it! Gotta keep them on their toes with a little extra distance!

abilities.name: Ink Cloak
abilities.description: Blend into the shadows to become nearly invisible to all senses.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a significant boost to stealth and survival, making it highly valuable for espionage missions.

rules.effect: You become indistinguishable from your surroundings, granting you advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks for the duration. Once per short rest, you can use this ability to create an ink cloud within 30 feet that lasts until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: While in Ink Cloak, you move at half speed and cannot take reactions.

abilities.apReason: The ability offers long-term utility with the cost of reduced movement speed and reaction availability.
abilities.warioNote: Now you can blend in like ink on paper! Just don't expect to run fast or react quickly.

abilities.name: Firedance Volley
abilities.description: Invoke an explosive volley of gunfire, dealing fire damage to enemies within a 30-foot radius.
abilities.levelReason: At level 16, the Gunslinger can handle more complex and powerful combat maneuvers that require significant firepower with tactical precision.

rules.effect: Firedance Volley deals 2d8+DEX modifier fire damage to all enemies within its area of effect.
rules.drawback: You must reload your firearm as a bonus action after using this ability.

abilities.apReason: This ability requires careful positioning and is effective in multiple enemy encounters, justifying its 4 AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! You think you're a gunslinger? Well, reloadin' your weapon ain't free. Ya gotta pay the price!

abilities.name: Venomous Evasion
abilities.description: Evasive maneuvers leave behind a trail of toxic residue, harming foes who touch you.
abilities.levelReason: This ability requires a higher-level potion and deals significant poison damage, fitting for a level 17 Rogue.

rules.effect: When you use this ability, each creature that touches you must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or take 4d6 poison damage. A creature can't be affected more than once per turn.
rules.drawback: You expend a potion slot of 2nd level or higher to create the toxic residue.

abilities.apReason: The effect is powerful enough that it justifies a moderate AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! Poison's cheap! But you gotta have the right vial... and I got 'em!

abilities.name: Artifact Empower
abilities.description: Infuse a tool with ancient power, enhancing its potency and effectiveness.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a significant boost to combat effectiveness and skill checks, justifying its placement at level 17.

rules.effect: For the duration, the chosen tool deals an additional 2d6 force damage. You also gain advantage on any skill check related to your chosen artisan skill.
rules.drawback: You must drop all other tools and focus solely on the empowered one.

abilities.apReason: The enhanced damage output and skill advantage require a substantial AP investment.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! Drop all those other tools and focus on that one. You can't have 'em all glowing like that!

abilities.name: Titanic Reforging
abilities.description: Reforge your weapon to unmatched power, dealing an additional 3d8 force damage in a devastating strike.
abilities.levelReason: This ability requires significant resources and is reserved for the highest level to maximize its impact and challenge.

rules.effect: For the next minute, your weapon deals an additional 3d8 force damage to one target. At the end of each of their turns within this effect's duration, a creature must make a DC 25 Strength saving throw or take half as much force damage.
rules.drawback: You lose all proficiencies with improvised weapons until the start of your next long rest.

abilities.apReason: The ability significantly boosts combat effectiveness and lasts a minute, requiring a major cooldown period.
abilities.warioNote: Ya better be ready fer a long rest after this one, bub! Ya won't have the tools ya need fer hours!

abilities.name: Inkwell Mirage
abilities.description: Breathe life into your ink pool, creating an illusionary doppelganger that mimics your actions for a round.
abilities.levelReason: This ability requires significant concentration and is limited in range, making it a fitting level 19 power for the spy class.

rules.effect: Create a mirage of yourself within 30 feet, which takes the place of your movements for one minute. Any creature that interacts with the mirage must succeed on a DC 25 Deception saving throw or become confused until the end of its next turn.
rules.drawback: You cannot move more than 10 feet away from the mirage without it dissipating.

abilities.apReason: Creating an effective illusion that confuses enemies and limits movement is costly in terms of focus and potential tactical flexibility.
abilities.warioNote: Eyeballs on stalks! This trick might buy you some time, but don’t try it too close to walls—those inkblots won’t be so stealthy then!

abilities.name: Shadowstep Sovereign's Reckoning
abilities.description: Command the battlefield by summoning a shadowy sovereign to deliver devastating attacks against foes within sight.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a powerful combat utility that allows the rogue to control the battlefield, making it suitable for level 20.

rules.effect: Summons a shadowy sovereign that makes three melee attacks against each enemy of your choice within 30 feet. Each attack deals 4d6 necrotic damage and has advantage on the roll.
rules.drawback: You cannot move or take any actions while the sovereign is active.

abilities.apReason: This ability offers significant battlefield control and damage output but requires you to surrender your mobility during its duration.
abilities.warioNote: You can't run around while your shadowy bodyguard is duking it out! Stay still, or your buddy will just leave you high and dry!

abilities.name: Mighty Forge
abilities.description: Forge a colossal weapon that grants you +4 to all attack rolls and damage rolls for the next hour.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the character's level, providing a significant boost to combat effectiveness that only diminishes after a recovery period.

rules.effect: You gain a +4 bonus to attack and damage rolls until the start of your next turn. This ability cannot be used again for 24 hours.
rules.drawback: After using this ability, you must spend a short rest before it can be used again.

abilities.apReason: This effect provides a substantial power boost for an extended duration, justifying its high AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Haha! Ya gotta rest up after that forge-fest, or you won't be able to keep that iron flowing!

abilities.name: Blindside Thrust
abilities.description: Surprise an opponent from a different direction than they expect to deal extra d8 slashing damage.
abilities.levelReason: This ability introduces a strategic positioning element that requires situational use, making it appropriate for level 2.

rules.effect: Deal an additional 1d8 slashing damage on your attack if you surprise the target from a direction different than they are facing.
rules.drawback: You must be within 5 feet of the target and have advantage on your attack roll.

abilities.apReason: The strategic requirement to position oneself in an advantageous direction before attacking justifies the AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: You think you can sneak up on me? Sure. Just don’t expect it from behind!

abilities.name: Spread Shot
abilities.description: Firearms spray in an arc to hit multiple targets within reach.
abilities.levelReason: Provides a versatile attack pattern that scales with the character's abilities and is useful against multiple targets, fitting for level 2.

rules.effect: Make a ranged weapon attack against each creature of your choice in a 15-foot cone within range. Each target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + DEX modifier) or take 2d6 fire damage.
rules.drawback: Must spend 1 grit to make additional attacks.

abilities.apReason: Requires grit as the cost which reflects the precision and control needed for such an action
abilities.warioNote: Ya better got some grit if ya wanna fire away at all them targets! Grit’s cheap... but you’ll need it!

abilities.name: Eclipse Gambit
abilities.description: Dive into darkness to escape, gaining advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
abilities.levelReason: This ability offers a significant boost in stealth for short-term use, fitting well at level 2.

rules.effect: Gain a +5 bonus to your next Dexterity (Stealth) check.
rules.drawback: You must spend an action point to activate this ability.

abilities.apReason: Activating the Eclipse Dive requires spending an Action Point due to its temporary and powerful effect on stealth checks.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Spendin' yer Action Points like that? Ya sure 'bout it? Ya might need 'em later!

abilities.name: Shifting Shot
abilities.description: Shift your position to evade an attack, dealing 1d6 fire damage in the process.
abilities.levelReason: At level 3, this ability provides an evasive combat maneuver that leverages the Gunslinger's mobility and fire-based attacks.

rules.effect: As a reaction to being hit by a melee or ranged weapon attack, you can shift up to your movement speed and deal 1d6 fire damage.
rules.drawback: You must be within reach of the attacker.

abilities.apReason: The reaction usage requires spending AP, adding a strategic cost for this defensive option.
abilities.warioNote: Ya better be quick on yer feet, or you're just givin' the enemy somethin' ta shoot at!

abilities.name: Malleable Shield
abilities.description: Craft a shield of malleable metal to block damage.
abilities.levelReason: Provides a defensive boost and reduces incoming damage at the cost of holding an improvised weapon.

rules.effect: Create a +1 bonus to AC, reducing damage from the next attack by 2d6 until your next short rest.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if you are holding an improvised weapon.

abilities.apReason: Crafting a temporary shield is resource-intensive and requires focus.
abilities.warioNote: Ya gotta let go o' that wrench, or ya can't make this sweet shield!

abilities.name: Holy Shield Gambit
abilities.description: Channel divine power to create a shimmering shield that provides temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier + Wisdom modifier.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides significant defensive value, fitting for a level 4 paladin who can already cast other divine abilities.

rules.effect: Create a shimmering shield providing 5 temporary hit points per point of your Charisma and Wisdom modifiers.
rules.drawback: Reduces your movement speed by 5 feet while the shield is active.

abilities.apReason: Provides substantial temporary hit points and reduces mobility, making it a valuable but limited resource.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! It's not like you're invincible just because you've got this shield! Slower isn't faster!

abilities.name: Wild Charge
abilities.description: Ram into enemies for a guaranteed critical hit on your first melee attack of the turn.
abilities.levelReason: This ability complements existing combat abilities by offering a guaranteed critical hit on the first melee strike of the turn, enhancing close-quarters combat effectiveness.

rules.effect: On your first melee attack of the turn, you can make a wild charge. This attack deals an extra 1d6 damage and is guaranteed to hit with advantage.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you are grappled or restrained.

abilities.apReason: The ability provides a significant tactical advantage but requires careful planning to use effectively.
abilities.warioNote: Yo ho! You can't ram if you're stuck like a pickle in mud! Think before you charge!

abilities.name: Breach Charge
abilities.description: Smash through enemy formations and create an opening for your allies.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows militia members to break through enemy lines at level 4, providing immediate tactical advantages.

rules.effect: You may make a melee attack against an enemy formation, dealing force damage equal to (1d8 + strength modifier). If successful, you clear a path and grant your allies advantage on their next attack within 30 feet of the breach for 1 round.
rules.drawback: You are vulnerable to opportunity attacks during this charge.

abilities.warioNote: Toads! You're clearin' a path fer your friends... but don't get yerself killed doin’ it!

abilities.name: Ethereal Veil Strike
abilities.description: Deliver a precise strike through an ethereal veil, dealing bonus damage to invisible creatures.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the rogue's proficiency and adds a new element of precision combat by targeting invisibility.

rules.effect: Make a melee attack against an invisible creature within range. If successful, deal an additional 2d6 necrotic damage.
rules.drawback: You must spend 1 Action Point to activate this ability.

abilities.apReason: Activating an ethereal strike is a precise, focused maneuver that requires careful timing and preparation, thus costing 1 Action Point.
abilities.warioNote: Pay up, Roguish Scoundrel! You need to spend some cash for this fancy trick!

abilities.name: Arcane Quill Array
abilities.description: Quickly sketch multiple illusory distractions in the air, confusing foes and reducing their accuracy.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows wizards to create multiple illusory duplicates, enhancing their battlefield presence and requiring a significant resource for concentration.

rules.effect: You create up to three illusory duplicates that hover in the air, each forcing a target within 10 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw or suffer disadvantage on their next attack roll. The effect ends if you lose concentration (as if concentrating on an active spell).
rules.drawback: Concentrating on this ability requires using your Action.

abilities.apReason: Creating multiple distractions and maintaining concentration is a challenging task that warrants an AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! You want to confuse 'em all? Then you gotta pay the price, buddy!

abilities.name: Gear Synergy
abilities.description: Enhance your improvised weapons and tools to deal +1d6 damage.
abilities.levelReason: This ability enhances the versatility and offensive capabilities of an Artisan at level 5 by allowing them to bolster their improvised weapons or tools temporarily.

rules.effect: Until the end of this short rest, any improvised weapon or tool you wield deals an additional 1d6 damage.
rules.drawback: You must relinquish one of your current improvisations to activate this ability.

abilities.apReason: Enhancing an improvised weapon or tool requires a deliberate action, hence costing one AP.
abilities.warioNote: Yo, you want that extra damage? You gotta let go of somethin' first! Gotcha covered with this deal.

abilities.name: Divine Command
abilities.description: Command allies within 30 feet to follow your lead with a +1 bonus to initiative and saving throws.
abilities.levelReason: This leadership ability complements existing support abilities by enhancing allies' performance in combat and survival situations, making it suitable for a level 6 paladin.

rules.effect: Allies within 30 feet gain a +1 bonus to initiative checks and all saving throw rolls. This effect lasts for 1 minute.
rules.drawback: You must use your action to issue the command each time you activate this ability.

abilities.apReason: Activating an ability that affects multiple allies within the duration requires a limited resource.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! This ain't free, pal! You gotta use your action to make them follow your lead!

abilities.name: Shady Misdirection
abilities.description: Create a shifting phantasm to confuse enemies, granting you advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
abilities.levelReason: This ability enhances a rogue's stealth and misdirection at an appropriate level by providing a significant advantage on important checks while costing the ability to act physically.

rules.effect: You create a shifting phantasm that confounds nearby creatures, granting you advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This effect can be maintained for up to 1 minute.
rules.drawback: While using this ability, you cannot interact with objects or characters beyond simple gestures.

abilities.apReason: Creating a complex phantasm that confounds others is resource-intensive, requiring three Action Points.
abilities.warioNote: Ya dun need ta be makin' gestures? That's more work than ya think! (-_-)

abilities.name: Feral Stomp
abilities.description: Stomp on your foes, dealing 2d6 bludgeoning damage to all creatures within a 10-foot radius.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a strong area-of-effect combat option for a level 6 barbarian, allowing them to disrupt a group of foes.

rules.effect: Deal 2d6 bludgeoning damage to all creatures within a 10-foot radius of you.
rules.drawback: You must end your next movement within 5 feet of an opponent or suffer disadvantage on your attack rolls until the start of your next turn.

abilities.warioNote: You better be stomping on the right side o' folks, or you might end up with a broken foot! 🤴

abilities.name: Forge Cloak
abilities.description: Swiftly cloak yourself in a shimmering layer of metal, granting you temporary hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier x3.
abilities.levelReason: This ability introduces a new mechanic of temporary hit points and movement reduction, fitting the theme of defensive crafting without duplicating existing abilities.

rules.effect: You gain temporary hit points equal to 3 × your Artisan level + your Intelligence modifier for the duration.
rules.drawback: Your movement speed is reduced by half while cloaked.

abilities.apReason: Introduces a temporary defense mechanism at the cost of mobility.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! You can't run fast in all that metal armor, but hey, it's pretty cool looking!

abilities.name: Shadowstep Gambit
abilities.description: Teleport behind a creature and gain advantage on your next attack against it.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides significant combat utility at level 7 by allowing rogues to reposition for optimal attacks while imposing a cooldown period.

rules.effect: You teleport behind an enemy within 30 feet as a bonus action, then make a melee attack against that creature on your next turn. If you hit, the target takes an extra 2d6 damage.
rules.drawback: The ability cannot be used more than once per short rest.

abilities.apReason: Requires an action and has a short rest recharge, making it costly in terms of resources.
abilities.warioNote: Yo, Rogues! You can only Shadowstep Ambush once per break. Don't waste that chance!

abilities.name: Ferocious Charge
abilities.description: You charge through the battlefield, slamming into an enemy and leaving them reeling.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the character's Strength modifier and provides a significant mechanical boost during combat at level 7.

rules.effect: Make a melee attack against a target within range. On a hit, you deal an extra 2d6 damage and knock the target prone. After charging, you are fatigued until your next short or long rest.
rules.drawback: You become fatigued after using this ability, requiring rest to recover.

abilities.apReason: Requires an action, providing immediate but limited combat utility that fits within the expected costs for this level.
abilities.warioNote: Tired already? Fatigue comes with the territory of charging into battle!

abilities.name: Arcane Veil Cloak
abilities.description: Wrap yourself in an impenetrable veil of arcane energy, reducing all damage taken by half for a turn.
abilities.levelReason: Provides a significant boost to survivability at close range, suitable for a level 7 wizard.

rules.effect: Reduce all damage taken by you by half for 1 round. This does not stack with other damage reduction effects.
rules.drawback: You cannot benefit from any other forms of damage reduction while this effect is active.

abilities.apReason: Reduces all incoming damage by half for one turn, providing a substantial defensive boon with a moderate cost.
abilities.warioNote: Alright kid, you can't wear two cloaks of arcane protection at once! Pick your poison!

abilities.name: Sanctified Touch
abilities.description: Touch an ally with holy grace to imbue them with healing and divine strength.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides significant healing and combat advantage, making it valuable at level 8 where Paladins can afford the action cost and benefit from additional uses per long rest.

rules.effect: Heal up to 5d8 hit points to a target ally. The healed creature gains advantage on their next attack roll.
rules.drawback: You must spend 2 AP and use your action.

abilities.apReason: Sacrificing an action to heal a companion while also giving them a significant combat buff justifies this 2 AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Huh, you want to heal your friend? Well, you're gonna have to spend some Action Points for that! 'Cause we ain't got all day!

abilities.name: Arcane Phantasm
abilities.description: Summons a phantasmal ally that fights by your side, dealing force damage and forcing enemies to make Wisdom saving throws.
abilities.levelReason: This ability complements other similar summoning spells by offering a different combat role and additional strategic options at level 8.

rules.effect: Summons a phantasmal ally that grants temporary hit points equal to half your level, and deals 2d8 force damage to enemies within 5 feet. Enemies in range must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 13 + your spellcasting modifier) or be frightened until the start of their next turn.
rules.drawback: The phantasmal ally can only attack creatures it can see, and you cannot control its actions.

abilities.apReason: The summoned phantasm requires concentration and provides significant support, making it comparable to existing level 8 magic abilities in terms of complexity and cost.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! It’s a ghost buddy! But don’t expect it to follow your orders too well…

abilities.name: Raging Overwhelm
abilities.description: Smash through foes with a wave of overwhelming force.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows for a significant increase in raw damage output and adds an additional layer of utility by granting advantage on relevant checks.

rules.effect: Deal an additional 2d6 damage to all creatures in your melee attack. While this ability is active, you have advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.
rules.drawback: You are exhausted at the start of your next short or long rest.

abilities.apReason: The cost reflects the substantial boost to both attack rolls and saving throws, along with the exhaustion penalty that provides a meaningful drawback.
abilities.warioNote: Punching through foes is fun. But you’ll be exhausted afterwards! Maybe pack some snacks?

abilities.name: Toad's Market Bonanza
abilities.description: Negotiate deals that secure resources and benefits worth +3d10 gold per week for you and your allies.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides significant social benefit by securing resources worth a substantial amount of gold over time, making it suitable for level 9.

rules.duration: until end of next short rest
rules.effect: Negotiates advantageous deals, yielding a cumulative +3d10 gold each week until you complete a long rest.
rules.drawback: You must spend 2 AP to activate this ability.

abilities.apReason: Activating this ability requires two Action Points (AP) due to its powerful effect and the lasting benefits it provides.
abilities.warioNote: Sell yer stuff cheap, buy at full price! Yer profits might be high, but ya gotta spend some gold ta make 'em!

abilities.name: Forgefall
abilities.description: Summons a cascade of falling debris to pin down and damage foes within its radius.
abilities.levelReason: This level 9 ability offers a powerful combat maneuver with significant effects, fitting the Artisan's combat-oriented abilities.

rules.effect: Create an area of debris that deals 1d8+INT modifier bludgeoning damage to all creatures within its radius and imposes disadvantage on their movement.
rules.drawback: You must spend 1 AP to activate this ability.

abilities.apReason: Requires spending an Action Point for its potent effect and area of control.
abilities.warioNote: Need to spend some AP on that Forgefall? Ya gotta fork it over, ya hear?

abilities.name: Judgment of Conviction
abilities.description: Condemn a single foe to the fires of judgment, dealing radiant damage and forcing them into a state of intense fear.
abilities.levelReason: This ability represents the culmination of a paladin's judgment-based attacks at level 10, allowing for both offensive and psychological warfare.

rules.effect: Targeted creature must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. On a successful save, they take 2d6 radiant damage.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again until after completing a long rest.

abilities.apReason: The duration, saving throw requirement, and limited use per day justify its high AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Ya want to get rid of a pesky foe? This one's the ticket, but ya won't be using it for days after! Yikes!

abilities.name: Ravage Gambit
abilities.description: Roar to unleash a devastating shockwave, stunning foes in your path and dealing thunder damage.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a strong area-of-effect combat option at level 10, fitting the theme of dealing massive damage in a burst.

rules.effect: All creatures within a 10-foot cone centered on you are stunned for 1 round, and take 8d6 thunder damage.
rules.drawback: You must finish your next turn adjacent to an enemy.

abilities.apReason: Dealing significant damage with a drawback makes this a balanced ability cost-wise.
abilities.warioNote: You’ve gotta be close to the bad guys for this one, Wario wouldn't want you getting hurt!

abilities.name: Fortress Stance
abilities.description: You assume the stance of an impenetrable fortress, becoming nearly unassailable and dealing massive damage to intruders.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides significant defense and offensive capabilities at level 10, fitting with other combat-focused abilities of similar power.

rules.effect: Gain a shield bonus of +4 to AC and deal an additional d8 slashing damage on melee attacks. While in this stance, you cannot be knocked prone or knocked unconscious by damage.
rules.drawback: You are confined to a single 5-foot square for the duration.

abilities.apReason: Provides both defensive and offensive bonuses, as well as a limitation to movement.
abilities.warioNote: You can't dance in there, pal! Move it outta the way!

abilities.name: Serrated Volley
abilities.description: Fire three pistols in rapid succession dealing piercing damage and forcing all creatures within a 10-foot radius to make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take half damage.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides significant combat utility by allowing for rapid, damaging fire with a potential area effect and saves against taking reduced damage.

rules.effect: Deal 2d6 piercing damage to all creatures within a 10-foot radius. Creatures must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take half the damage.
rules.drawback: You must reload one pistol after this ability, costing you an action.

abilities.apReason: The ability offers an impactful effect but is balanced by the cost of reloading one pistol after use.
abilities.warioNote: Ya gotta reload after ya use dat Serrated Volley, so ya better load up on extra clips!

abilities.name: Ink Conceal
abilities.description: Merge with shadows to create a temporary inkblot decoy that misdirects and confuses foes.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the spy's level, enhancing stealth and misdirection while offering a strategic advantage in combat.

rules.effect: Create an inkblot decoy within 30 feet. Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the decoy must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or become confused until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You leave behind a faint trail that can be followed by an Intimidation check (DC 15) for one minute.

abilities.apReason: Creating a decoy that confuses foes requires careful planning and precision, thus costing an action point.
abilities.warioNote: YEAH RIGHT! LIKE YOUR INK'S GONNA CONFUSE 'EM IF IT DON'T EVEN LOOK REAL!

abilities.name: Market Savvy
abilities.description: Haggle with merchants to secure better deals and boost your daily profit by +3d6 gold.
abilities.levelReason: At level 10, this ability provides a significant boost to daily income through enhanced bargaining skills.

rules.effect: Increase daily profit by +3d6 gold, requiring at least an hour of negotiation and haggling.
rules.drawback: Must engage in prolonged negotiations; you are temporarily distracted and cannot participate in combat or other actions during this time.

abilities.apReason: The ability offers a substantial benefit with minimal cost, fitting the utility and social theme of the Commoner class.
abilities.warioNote: Sell your soul to the devil... and get a better deal! Waaahahaha!

abilities.name: Helmfort Aura
abilities.description: Empower nearby allies with a resilient helm fortification, granting temporary hit points.
abilities.levelReason: This ability enhances defensive capabilities at higher levels by providing a stacking temporary hit point bonus and requires a helm, making it more strategic and valuable as the player progresses.

rules.effect: You and all allies within 10 feet gain 5 temporary hit points per level, which stack with other Helmfort Auras.
rules.drawback: You must be wearing a helm to activate this ability.

abilities.apReason: Provides a significant defensive buff for nearby allies with limited activation cost.
abilities.warioNote: You gotta be wearin' somethin' on your noggin' to activate this one, buddy!

abilities.name: Shadowstep Flurry
abilities.description: Deal three slashing damage dice with your next attack.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a significant combat boost by allowing multiple attacks with increased damage, fitting a level 11 rogue who can already leverage sneak attack and other abilities.

rules.effect: When you take the Attack action, your first melee weapon attack this turn deals an extra 2d6 + DEX modifier slashing damage.
rules.drawback: You must forgo your DEX bonus to AC until the end of your next turn.

abilities.apReason: The ability offers a substantial combat enhancement but requires the player to forgo their DEX bonus to AC as a drawback.
abilities.warioNote: Forswear your armor! For just three AP, you can turn your next swing into a flurry of precision and pain. But then... you'll be a sitting duck until that next move!

abilities.name: Reload and Ricochet
abilities.description: Reload your firearm, then fire it to ricochet the bullet off a surface before hitting a target, dealing extra damage.
abilities.levelReason: This ability requires a full action to reload and shoot but provides significant damage output with the added effect of ricochetting, making it appropriate for level 11.

rules.effect: Reload a firearm as part of this action. Fire the weapon at a target within 30 feet, dealing 2d6 fire damage plus your proficiency bonus. The bullet ricochets off any solid surface within 5 feet of the target before hitting another creature in range, dealing an additional 1d6 fire damage.
rules.drawback: You must have line of sight to both the initial target and the ricochet point.

abilities.apReason: The ability requires a full action and provides a powerful combat effect, justifying an AP cost of 3.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Reloadin' and ricochettin' ain't cheap! Ya better be ready to dish out some dough for this one!

abilities.name: Militia Mass Defense
abilities.description: Create a wall of overlapping shields to protect allies within 30 feet.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides strong defensive support by creating an area of high AC, fitting at level 11 as a significant defensive tool.

rules.effect: All allies within 30 feet gain a +2 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn. This effect can be used once per long rest.
rules.drawback: You must forgo all movement during the duration.

abilities.apReason: The ability allows for multiple allies to gain a +2 AC bonus and can be sustained over time, justifying its higher AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! Stand still or you won't have no shield wall! Gettin' moved around messes up the formation!

abilities.name: Divine Shield Array
abilities.description: Deploy a defensive barrier of holy energy that grants temporary hit points to all nearby allies and reduces incoming damage by half for one minute.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the character's level and provides a significant defensive boost, fitting for a high-level paladin.

rules.effect: All allies within 30 feet gain temporary hit points equal to your Paladin level + Cha modifier. The damage reduction lasts until the end of this turn.
rules.drawback: You cannot move or take reactions while deploying this shield.

abilities.apReason: The effect offers substantial benefits to allies over an extended duration at the cost of mobility and reaction use.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Want to be surrounded by holy protection? Can't move or react, buddy. It's all part of the package!

abilities.name: Shadowstep Shadowburst
abilities.description: Teleport behind an enemy and make two melee attacks as part of your movement.
abilities.levelReason: This ability builds on the existing Shadowstep mechanics, adding an additional attack and a knockdown effect for a significant combat advantage.

rules.effect: You teleport up to 30 feet behind an enemy and make two melee attacks. If both attacks hit, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You leave a faint trail of shadows that can be seen by creatures within 60 feet.

abilities.apReason: The ability requires precise timing and movement, making it a valuable but costly option in combat.
abilities.warioNote: Yo ho! Ya want ta buy this? It's like teleportin' right behind the bad guy, make 'em dance, then drop 'em. But ya gotta watch out fer dat shadow trail!

abilities.name: Arcane Tempest Cloak
abilities.description: Summons a swirling tempest to cloak you in its fury, granting temporary hit points and advantage on saving throws against magical effects.
abilities.levelReason: This ability enhances survivability and adds to the wizard's defensive capabilities.

rules.effect: You call forth a tempest that grants you 5 temporary hit points and advantage on saving throws against magical effects for the duration.
rules.drawback: While cloaked, you move at half speed.

abilities.apReason: The utility provided by this ability justifies its AP cost of 2.
abilities.warioNote: C'mon! Ya ain't invincible jus' 'cause ya got a cloak o' tempests!

abilities.name: Spectral Barrage
abilities.description: Summons a wave of spectral bullets that deal radiant damage to all creatures in a line.
abilities.levelReason: This ability introduces a new mechanic by combining spectral and firearms elements, suitable for a level 12 Gunslinger.

rules.effect: You unleash a barrage of spectral bullets, dealing 3d6 radiant damage to up to three creatures in a straight line. Creatures hit must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You expend a bullet from your firearm pool for each creature damaged.

abilities.apReason: This ability has a high utility and damage output but requires a resource cost to maintain its power level.
abilities.warioNote: You run out of bullets! Maybe bring a backup? Just sayin'...

abilities.name: Ambush Veil
abilities.description: Becomes invisible and strikes with deadly precision in a hidden ambush.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a strong combat advantage by combining invisibility with increased damage output at the cost of requiring visibility.

rules.effect: For the duration, you become invisible until your next turn. On your first attack action during this time, you deal an additional 2d6 damage to your target.
rules.drawback: You must have a clear line of sight and line of effect to an unseen target.

abilities.apReason: The additional stealth and combat bonus requires careful planning and a specific tactical positioning, justifying its AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Ambush Veil's got you covered in sneakiness and damage, but don't forget to pick your spot right!

abilities.name: Spectral Evasion
abilities.description: Blur your form and blend into the shadows, becoming invisible for a moment.
abilities.levelReason: This ability enhances the rogue's stealth capabilities by offering a longer duration of invisibility compared to similar abilities like Shadowstep Shadow and Shadowweave Cloak, making it suitable for prolonged stealth missions.

rules.effect: You become invisible until the start of your next turn. During this time, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and can move up to 30 feet without triggering opportunity attacks.
rules.drawback: While invisible, you cannot take any actions or reactions other than moving.

abilities.apReason: The extended duration and stealth benefits justify this cost in AP.
abilities.warioNote: You can't do much while you're invisible, but when you are, no one will see you slip by! Wahoo!

abilities.name: Deadly Quiver
abilities.description: Swap out a bullet for an explosive one at the start of your turn, dealing massive damage to enemies within reach.
abilities.levelReason: At level 13, this ability provides a significant combat advantage by allowing a powerful area effect with a strategic bullet swap.

rules.effect: You can swap out a bullet for an explosive one at the start of your next turn. When you fire this special bullet, it deals 5d6 piercing damage and also creates a burst centered on you with a radius of 10 feet. Creatures within the burst take 3d6 thunder damage.
rules.drawback: You lose one grit when swapping out the bullets.

abilities.apReason: The tactical choice and area damage make this a costly but impactful ability.
abilities.warioNote: Whoa there! That's one heck of a bang! Give me 5 grit, or the bullets stay in the chamber!

abilities.name: Hammerfall Recharge
abilities.description: In a flurry of strikes, you channel all your tools into a single devastating blow.
abilities.levelReason: This ability offers a significant boost to combat effectiveness at this level, allowing for a powerful finishing move.

rules.effect: Deal an additional 3d6 damage on one melee attack made with an improvised weapon. This ability can only be used once per short rest.
rules.drawback: You must make this attack before the end of your next turn.

abilities.apReason: The added damage and limited use per short rest justify the AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! You think a little more patience will help you get that extra swing in? It’s gonna take some time to recharge!

abilities.name: Blinding Radiance
abilities.description: A burst of blinding light deals radiant damage and forces creatures within to make saving throws or fall unconscious.
abilities.levelReason: This ability requires a significant action to activate but provides a powerful area effect that blinds creatures and deals damage. At level 14, it fits as an impactful combat move.

rules.effect: Creatures in a 10-foot radius must make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, they are blinded until the end of their next turn and take 3d6 radiant damage.
rules.drawback: You become blind for your next action.

abilities.apReason: Blinding Radiance is an action-based ability with a substantial drawback, making it costly in terms of opportunity cost.
abilities.warioNote: You can make 'em blind, but you'll be seeing spots for your next move! Price: 3 AP!

abilities.name: Veilweave Strike
abilities.description: Weave through enemies to strike a target behind cover, dealing piercing damage.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows for precise strikes behind cover, fitting well into a rogue's focus on stealth and combat prowess at level 14.

rules.effect: You make an attack roll against a creature within range. If you hit, the target takes 2d6 + DEX modifier piercing damage and is knocked prone.
rules.drawback: After using this ability, you must spend one minute hiding from view before making another attack.

abilities.apReason: Requires careful positioning and recovery time, justifying the moderate AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: You'd better find some cover, Rog! Otherwise, you're as visible as a shadow in broad daylight!

abilities.name: Celestial Harmony
abilities.description: Channel celestial energy to heal allies and bolster their defenses.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides significant healing and defensive support, fitting for a mid-to-late level wizard.

rules.effect: Heal a creature within range by 2d8 + Intelligence modifier hit points. Additionally, grant advantage on the next saving throw made before the end of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You must concentrate and are incapacitated while doing so.

abilities.apReason: Provides substantial support to allies in battle at the cost of your concentration and movement.
abilities.warioNote: You're so focused on keeping them safe you might trip over your own feet! 🎶

abilities.name: Ink Shadowform
abilities.description: Merge with shadows and ink to become a living shadow for 1 minute, blending into darkness.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows the spy to become a living shadow for an extended duration, providing both stealth and mobility benefits at the cost of physical strain.

rules.effect: You can become invisible and move through difficult terrain as if it were not there. For every 5 feet you move, you take 1d6 damage.
rules.drawback: For each 5 feet moved while in Ink Shadowform, you take 1d6 damage.

abilities.apReason: The ability offers significant benefits over the course of a minute but requires careful management due to its damage penalty.
abilities.warioNote: You're inked up! Ink Shadowform sounds like fun... until your body starts to hurt.

abilities.name: Victorious Resolve
abilities.description: Grant allies the resilience to overcome any challenge, bolstering their defenses and enhancing their combat effectiveness.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a sustained benefit that enhances the resilience of allies, fitting for a powerful leader at level 14.

rules.effect: Allies within 30 feet gain temporary hit points equal to your Leader level (rounded down) and have advantage on saving throws against being frightened or paralyzed.
rules.drawback: You must complete a short rest before using this ability again.

abilities.apReason: This ability offers a significant boon to allies' defenses and combat abilities while requiring limited resource management.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! If you're using this one too much, you might just be out of pep talk juice!

abilities.name: Shield Legion
abilities.description: Unleash the power of the many to form an impenetrable wall of shields around allies.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with level as it provides a significant defensive benefit to allies within range.

rules.effect: Create a barrier of shields that grants +2 AC to all allies within the 30-foot radius. The shield wall lasts for 1 minute and can be maintained by any ally in the area.
rules.drawback: You must maintain concentration on this effect, which requires an action each time you take damage.

abilities.apReason: It provides a strong defensive buff that lasts for a minute and can protect multiple allies, requiring concentration which is a valuable resource.
abilities.warioNote: You think it’s easy to hold off an army with just your shield? It’s tougher than it looks! Remember, you gotta keep concentrating or the wall falls!

abilities.name: Toolchain Fortitude
abilities.description: Fortify your defenses with a shield made of reinforced tools and metal.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a significant defensive boost and is in line with other level 14 utility abilities.

rules.effect: You gain temporary hit points equal to twice your Artisan level (28 HP at level 14). These points are lost if you drop or abandon any of the tools that form this shield.
rules.drawback: You must drop all held tools to create the shield, leaving you weaponless until it expires.

abilities.apReason: The creation of a temporary shield that grants hit points at the cost of dropping tools.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Drop yer tools, ya dolt? Ya can't fight without 'em, but ya get a nice shield while ya're at it!

abilities.name: Veilweave Cloak
abilities.description: Wrap yourself in an ethereal cloak of shadows that distorts your form, granting you advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks until the start of your next turn.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides a significant stealth advantage and ongoing pressure on enemies at the cost of concentration, making it fitting for level 15.

rules.duration: until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: You become invisible and gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks for up to 1 minute. When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you fails its saving throw against this effect, it must make another save after the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: This ability requires concentration.

abilities.apReason: It grants an extended duration and ongoing advantages with a concentration drawback.
abilities.warioNote: Concentrate on staying unseen, or you might just disappear into nothingness! Pricey but powerful!

abilities.name: Astral Resonance
abilities.description: Harness the power of astral energy to heal allies within a burst.
abilities.levelReason: This powerful healing spell is fitting at level 15, providing significant support to the party.

rules.effect: Each creature in a 20-foot radius centered on you heals 6d8 hit points. You must concentrate for the duration of this ability.
rules.drawback: You are incapacitated while concentrating.

abilities.apReason: The instant cast and high heal numbers justify a high AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Now you can't heal yourself! Concentrate or take a fall.

abilities.name: Bullet Whirlwind
abilities.description: Spin rapidly and unleash a flurry of bullets that deal 2d8+DEX modifier fire damage to all enemies within 15 feet.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales well with the character's level and adds a new style of combat that emphasizes mobility and rapid fire.

rules.effect: You spin in a circle and fire rapid bursts of gunfire, dealing damage to all enemies within 15 feet. Each target takes 2d8+DEX modifier fire damage.
rules.drawback: You must spend 2 grit to activate this ability.

abilities.apReason: This ability provides significant offensive capabilities at the cost of expended resources, matching the grit mechanic of the class.
abilities.warioNote: Spend your grit wisely, ya punk! No reloads on this one!

abilities.name: Shadowform Dive
abilities.description: Merge into the shadows and teleport behind an enemy to deliver a swift and silent strike.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows for a powerful and evocative stealth-based maneuver at level 15 that complements other abilities in the spy class.

rules.effect: Teleport up to 30 feet to appear behind an enemy, dealing 2d6 + Cha modifier slashing damage.
rules.drawback: You must be unseen by the target before activating this ability.

abilities.apReason: Requires careful positioning, making it a strategic choice during combat.
abilities.warioNote: Yo! Watch out, ya might end up behind the enemy without even knowing it!

abilities.name: Breach Legion
abilities.description: Unleash the full might of your comrades to breach fortified positions in one devastating wave.
abilities.levelReason: This ability allows a militia member to leverage teamwork and strategic positioning, making it ideal at level 15 where coordination becomes more crucial.

rules.effect: Choose up to three allies within range. Each ally deals an additional +2 bonus damage to all attacks and checks until the start of their next turn.
rules.drawback: You must reduce your own movement speed by 5 feet for this action.

abilities.apReason: Breach Legion requires careful planning and coordination, justifying its AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Gotta think about your team, buddy. Move slower, but you pack a punch!

abilities.name: Ethereal Veil
abilities.description: Summons an impenetrable ethereal barrier that grants you and your allies temporary cover, deflecting incoming attacks.
abilities.levelReason: This ability enhances defense without compromising offense, making it a fitting level 16 spell for a wizard to use strategically in combat.

rules.effect: You create a 5-foot diameter ethereal barrier that provides total cover to you and nearby allies within reach, reducing the damage of attacks by half (rounded down) until the end of your next turn.
rules.drawback: While under the effect of Ethereal Veil, you cannot attack or cast spells.

abilities.apReason: It allows for defensive positioning and temporary cover, which is valuable but not at the highest cost.
abilities.warioNote: Ehhh, you can't attack while hiding behind your own wall of ectoplasm? What kind of wizard are you?

abilities.name: Arcane Volley
abilities.description: Channel arcane energy into a volley of bullets, dealing fire and force damage.
abilities.levelReason: This ability requires significant energy, fitting for a level 16 gunslinger who can afford more powerful options.

rules.effect: Fire a devastating volley that deals 2d8+DEX modifier fire and force damage to all creatures within a 30-foot radius.
rules.drawback: Consume a charge from your Arcane Reservoir.

abilities.apReason: Provides substantial damage output at the cost of an arcane reservoir charge, making it a valuable but costly choice.
abilities.warioNote: Hey! That's one of my best sellers! But you gotta cough up a charge for it!

abilities.name: Ink Doppelgänger
abilities.description: Create an ink copy of yourself to distract enemies and buy time for escape.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales well with the Spy's other level 16 stealth abilities, enhancing evasion and providing additional utility without overpowered effects.

rules.effect: Summons a spectral doppelgänger that duplicates your appearance within range, granting you advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and allowing you to take the Dash action as a bonus action. The doppelgänger lasts for 1 minute or until an enemy successfully hits it with an attack.
rules.drawback: The doppelgänger is only effective against enemies that have not seen you within the last hour.

abilities.apReason: Requires a long rest to use again, ensuring it is not overused while still offering significant tactical value.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Think you're slick? Just remember, those ink copies only fool the blind.

abilities.name: Venomous Veil
abilities.description: Weave a veil of toxic mist around yourself, dealing poison damage to any foe within your reach.
abilities.levelReason: This ability scales with the rogue's level by providing a longer duration and increased damage output.

rules.effect: Create a 5-foot-radius cloud centered on you. Any creature that starts its turn in the cloud takes 2d6 poison damage, and has disadvantage on Strength (Athletics) checks and saving throws until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You must maintain concentration while within the cloud.

abilities.apReason: The creation of a 5-foot-radius cloud that persists for a full minute requires significant magical energy.
abilities.warioNote: Oh, you want to play dirty? Fine. But stay in reach or get ready to dodge the poison! That'll cost ya.

abilities.name: Epic Toad's Gambit
abilities.description: In one turn, you distract and disorient foes, giving an ally advantage on their next attack roll.
abilities.levelReason: This ability offers a significant tactical disruption while requiring a substantial cost to use, making it suitable for an advanced level like 17.

rules.effect: Choose one creature within reach. That target and all creatures within 10 feet of it have disadvantage on the next ability check or saving throw they make before the end of their next turn.
rules.drawback: You are blinded for 1 minute.

abilities.apReason: Requires a long rest to recover and offers a powerful, immediate combat advantage at the cost of self-blindness.
abilities.warioNote: You get all sploshed up, can't see squat, and still have to pay for the potion! What a deal!

abilities.name: Fortress Formation
abilities.description: Create a shield wall that grants temporary hit points to allies within range and provides cover for them.
abilities.levelReason: This ability leverages the militia's defensive capabilities at a high level, providing sustained area-effect support and tactical positioning.

rules.effect: Allies within 10 feet gain temporary hit points equal to your Con modifier + your level. They also gain cover against attacks made by creatures not adjacent to the formation.
rules.drawback: You are reduced to half speed while the formation is active.

abilities.apReason: Creates a significant area-of-effect benefit with a substantial drawback that requires careful use.
abilities.warioNote: Y-Y-You better have a good reason to use this one! It's not cheap, you know!

abilities.name: Veiny Surge
abilities.description: Channel the veins of the earth for a surge of raw power.
abilities.levelReason: This ability enhances combat effectiveness while requiring a physical toll on the artisan.

rules.effect: For every point of your Intelligence modifier, you gain +1 to attack and damage rolls. Additionally, once per short rest, you can deal 2d6 force damage with an improvised weapon.
rules.drawback: You must remain in contact with the ground for the duration.

abilities.apReason: Veiny Surge provides significant combat bonuses and a powerful short-rest attack, justifying its AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Need some extra oomph? This one's got it. But ya gotta stay grounded for the whole minute — no floating around!

abilities.name: Sanctified Vigil
abilities.description: Paladins can maintain an unyielding vigilance, drawing in and repelling threats to their allies.
abilities.levelReason: At level 18, this ability provides significant defensive support to the paladin and their allies by imposing penalties on attackers.

rules.effect: Until the end of this duration, any creature that attacks you or your allies within a 30-foot radius must succeed on a DC 25 Wisdom saving throw or become stunned until their next turn.
rules.drawback: You and your allies gain disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws while this ability is active.

abilities.apReason: Provides a substantial defensive benefit that lasts for an extended period.
abilities.warioNote: You think you’re being attacked? Maybe it’s just your bad luck! But hey, at least you’ve got friends!

abilities.name: Shadowstep Veil
abilities.description: You cloak yourself and up to three allies in a veil of shadows, blinding foes within 30 feet.
abilities.levelReason: This ability provides significant tactical advantage for a long duration, fitting for level 18.

rules.effect: All targets within range become difficult terrain for enemies. Each enemy that starts its turn targeting a veiled target must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You and all affected allies are immobilized until the duration ends.

abilities.apReason: Requires an action to activate and maintains a long-lasting effect that benefits multiple targets, justifying its high AP cost.
abilities.warioNote: Ya gotta pay the big bucks fer somethin' this stealthy. Might as well buy a whole cloak o' shadows!
